Having seen that omen, they were all surprised: "What is the cause, what is the cause of this appearance?" In the assembly, there was De Thich, named Vo Cau Sanh, sitting not far from Bo Gia Pham. He immediately stood up from his seat, bowed to the World-Honored One, and clasped his hands towards the Buddha, asking in verse:)

Everyone is skeptical, not knowing what happened. In the Great Assembly hall, the Buddha was preaching the Dharma when suddenly these phenomena occurred. This is not a normal phenomenon. Before that, all kinds of generals appeared. People attending the conference suddenly felt their bodies unable to move or lift their arms. “Strengthened Earth Realm” means that in their body, the Earth Element loses its effect. However, they know this is temporary and will not cause any problems. Why does that phenomenon happen? Doubt, fear, not knowing what causes and conditions give rise to that appearance? Everyone thinks so. Among them, there were many great Bodhisattvas who asked the Buddha. In the great assembly here, there is a god named Thich Thich.

We can say Thien De Thich is the Jade Emperor the Great Emperor, the god Dao Loi, whose name is Vo Cau Sanh. This is the manifestation of the great Bodhisattva. All Emperor Thich Thien, as well as Brahma, in that Dharma assembly, facing the Buddha and asking about the most profound principles, are all Bodhisattvas incarnate. Only when a Bodhisattva manifests will he have that wisdom. Also because he was sitting not far from the Buddha, when he stood up to ask, it would be very convenient. He immediately stood up from his seat and bowed towards the Buddha. To request Dharma, first of all, one must follow the ritual. We are all ordinary people, everyone requests the Dharma, or asks any questions, completely without following those rules. It's okay for everyone to ask, the teacher asked for it, and his friends did the same. When the Buddha was in this world, during a great Dharma conference, it was not casually asked like that. You want to request Dharma; First of all, you need to leave your seat and pay respects to the Buddha first. After bowing to the World-Honored One, in the sutras it is often said “kneel down, kneel down”, that is, kneel down on one knee. Now we kneel on both knees. Ho knelt, clasped his hands, facing the Buddha. Before asking questions, he had to praise the Buddha. Next, he used verses to praise the Buddha.

(Sutra) “The emperor's teachings, his view, his good teachings, Muni, the universal teachings, the ultimate salvation The dharma, the spirit of all sentient beings, destroys suffering and suffering. His a conditioned place in the middle, appearing in all the clouds and universes. The spirit invites the assembly to rejoice, the birth of pure faith, the stage of awakening Mahayana, overcoming doubts, true birth view?The body of the heavenly people, the earthly world increases solemnly, unable to overcome the election, testing the appearance of the river's destiny? The two hands of the universe appear, releasing light, illuminating the ten directions to eliminate sins, that is, the Guru! What are the views, all kinds of people, all the self-righteous people? All the people are uncertain, the fate is mixed, the spiritual power is tested? The Buddha, the devil, the Buddha, the great teacher, the Buddha declares.
(Sutra: “Who speaks the truth, sees true. The One Mau Ni skillfully abides, everywhere because they proclaim, the ultimate and true Dharma, causing all sentient beings to eliminate suffering and causes of suffering. What is the cause of this place? All of them are happy, all have pure faith, all move towards Mahayana, get rid of doubts, and have true views? The body of the great mass of gods, people, and earth becomes stiffer, heavier, unable to move on its own. What is the reason for that appearance? Both hands are filled with jewels, radiating light from all directions, eliminating suffering, and attaining peace, Master! What is the cause, who will come to show this magical power? Is it Buddha, Bodhisattva? Or Brahma, Thich, God? Dear master, please tell us quickly.”).

The Buddha's words and the problems the Buddha saw were all true. “True” means true. “Truth” is a true statement. When the Buddha preached the Dharma, he often said: “Listen! Listen!” (Listen carefully), that is, “listen as it really is”, which also means “contemplate your mind”, use your mind to listen, don't use your ears to listen. When speaking, you must speak according to your heart and speak the truth; that is Truong Tuong. The Buddha spoke all the truth. The Buddha preached the Dharma, also lived, held an alms bowl, but he did not leave Samadhi. Tathagata is always in Concentration, all movements do not leave Concentration. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is like that, all the time he does not leave Concentration, he is active in Concentration. Concentration can give birth to wisdom. Means are in wisdom, everything done is skillful means.

In fact, the actual basis of skillful means is born from basic wisdom, and basic wisdom is born from the True Form of the Physical Body. One day, you will fully attain enlightenment, see the True Form, the words you speak will all be words of reality, and your knowledge will also be true knowledge, not false. You stay in a realm corresponding to the Truth, usually in Concentration.

“Muni” (Muni) is also translated as Tich Mac. The word Mau Ni in Śākyamuni Buddha is translated into Tich Mac, Tich Mac is Tinh. It can also be said that Nirvana is Nirvana, or it can also be said that Nirvana is Nirvana, which is one of the three types of dharma seals. If you stay skillfully in Tinh Tinh, where will you stay? In the True Earth, abide in the True Form and Physical Body, abide in the Middle Way, abide in the First Meaning. That's what Tinh Tinh means.

Non-Constructed Being Thich praised the Buddha: "Buddha! You are complete in all true words. You are the one with true knowledge, always in Concentration." “Praise widely for the general assembly” (Praise widely for the whole assembly): I hope that you will use skillful means, that is, wise means arising from basic wisdom, to show skillful teachings and educate us who are ignorant. Requesting Dharma is not easy! Whenever we request the Dharma, in addition to praising it, we also wish for its meanings to be revealed. When inquiring about those meanings, the questioner must also use all skillful means to raise the question. Asking questions is not easy! Must ask for guidance, and also must study. As in the present, among Dharma friends chatting about everyday life, [must ask] how the children are, how the body is, how the social phenomena are. In the dharma conference at that time, very few asked these questions, but they were also no exception; However, the skillful language is different. The Buddha taught us the ultimate skillful dharmas, solid and indestructible, and vajra-natured. The Buddha is "the one who has the true speech, the true view, the true good abiding in Muni, the one who spreads the teachings to all, the ultimate ultimate dharma" (the one who speaks the truth, sees the truth, the one who skillfully abides in Tranquility, for all sentient beings widely proclaiming the dharma that is ultimate and solid and true), specializes in speaking the vajra dharma, the immovable dharma, allowing sentient beings to enter the truth. That is a request.

Therefore, I wish for the Buddha "the spirits of all sentient beings, to destroy suffering and suffering, to cause all sentient beings to destroy the results of suffering and the causes of suffering. Why do clouds of rain appear in this assembly?" In the current dharma assembly, the most strange and special phenomena appeared, clouds pouring rain like that, pouring down mysterious treasures, in each person's hand there was a Wish-fulfilling Pearl, causing all sentient beings not only to eliminate the effects of suffering, but even the suffering people did not have it. If there is a cause, there will be an effect. Only eliminating the results of suffering, not the cause of suffering, or we practice the path only seeking to change the results of suffering, not seeking to change the cause of suffering. Now we are not comfortable, the disease has been cured, we have to consider that the disease can still come back. Therefore, that cause [causing illness] must be eliminated. Why do you get sick? That's a miserable person. Why do we suffer? Why don't other people suffer? I suffer, [feeling] this world is very unfair! Others have money, I don't have money. Why? Those who do not seek causes, only seek equality in results, will not be equal! There is no equal way! Equality must be equality in humanity, we must understand this principle!

The question here is what is the cause that in this dharma assembly, so many special and strange signs appear? After appearing, those clouds appeared pouring out precious and mysterious decorations, pouring down items necessary for life, until the Nhu Y Treasure Pearl appeared. Why? Because those realms make the masses extremely happy and happy, everyone is happy, extremely happy, giving birth to pure faith and mind. Speaking of the word Pure, it is talking about greed, anger, ignorance, arrogance, doubt, Body View, Boundary View, Precepts, Wrong Views, [as well as the Ten Evils], that is, greed, anger, ignorance, false speech, reliance on speech, double tongue, evil speech, killing, stealing, and lust are all absent, but a pure mind arises. Due to faith in the mind, pure belief and a very superior feeling arise.

Everyone knows Mahayana; When it comes to Mahayana, it is more colloquial to say “become a Buddha”. Once you have set your mind towards becoming a Buddha; that is Mahayana. Knowing that realm is inconceivable, not ordinary. Our biggest obstacle is not having faith. Why don't you have faith? Due to too much doubt: "Is that true? Can one become a Buddha?" Too many question marks, I don't know how many question marks have been marked? It's all doubt! Those who doubt are not completely unbelievers, but rather half-believers and half-doubters. If you don't believe at all, you won't even have doubts; Basically, they don't believe it! Doubt contains a little bit of trust, having doubt is good! The meaning contained in doubt is like that. That skeptical mind is still a mind that cannot understand, cannot achieve, and has no real insight. Causing such people to give rise to true views (true views and explanations), [that is the meaning of the sentence] “overcoming doubts, giving birth to true views”. “True views” means true views. A person who clearly understands his nature will give rise to views that are all true views, and the views and interpretations that arise from his mind are all true views.

There is another type of situation: Suddenly at that moment, whether gods or humans, all the great assembly attended the dharma assembly, why did “the earthly world increase in severity” (the earthly world increased in hardness and heaviness)? “Earth realm” is the body, the Earth Element is hard and heavy. “Inability to win the election” means that if you want to raise your hand, want to move, you cannot move. I remember when I was reading a novel, it said something called “body concentration”. Once immobilized, one finger cannot move. Here it is said that due to the mighty power of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, the body [of the assembly in the Dharma Assembly] will feel unable to move. What is that cause? Why does that phenomenon exist?

There is also a particularly strange phenomenon, “jewels appearing on both hands” (both hands have pearls appearing). This verse is intended to repeat what was said before, and the Emperor wants to repeat it again. Things that were not discussed in detail before will be reiterated in this verse. “Two-handed pearls appear”: You see Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's hand holding the Nhu Y Treasure Pearl. Nhu Y Bao Chau means "what you pray for will appear". Avalokiteshvara holds a vase of pure water. That vase not only contains water, but also contains everything. As long as you pray for something, it will appear. Not only does the pearl appear, but the pearl also pours out precious substances, pouring out all kinds of treasures. Furthermore, from those treasures that have appeared, each treasure radiates light, illuminating the Buddha lands in the ten directions. However, absolutely not everything is shown. That means you have a pearl in your hand, a pearl shows all kinds of treasures, and can pour out all kinds of treasures.

After that, the light appeared again. Wherever these lights shine, there will be good luck and joy. In the previous section, [the scriptures said] that when the light shines on all kinds of diseases, they are completely cured. Then, if you are a person cultivating the path, encountering that light, you will also attain enlightenment, all the sufferings will also be “i.e. extinguished” (to cease, to be eliminated), “i.e.” is to cease. All suffering will stop and everyone will be happy.

“The World-Honored One”: The teacher is called the World-Honored One. White World-Honored One! What is the cause? Why is it possible for the masses to see, [that is the meaning of the sentence] “to invite the audience to see”. We all saw it, each of us saw it with our own eyes. Why is it that as soon as the light ceases, nothing [suffering] can be seen? Why is there such light, what is the cause? What caused the public to be able to see, what was the cause? Until all kinds of incense, flowers, decorations, and garlands appeared, making each person's body become very dignified, very complete, in the past this was never the case! Regarding these phenomena, everyone is very skeptical, “heaven and human beings are hesitant” (heaven and human beings are hesitant). “Hesitation” is doubt, not knowing what it is? Since it is impossible to speculate on the causes and conditions for such phenomena, is it possible that a Buddha or Bodhisattva has come? Is it because they show supernatural powers? Either it is because of Brahma, or the demon king, or Emperor Thich Thien [who has a particularly great power]. That is still a question mark! Who has such great merit to be able to demonstrate magical powers that make the public have such feelings?

“Only wish that the great master, quickly declare it for the assembly” (Respectfully, the great master, quickly declare it for the assembly): The Buddha is the great master who will guide us, please tell the assembly quickly. In the minds of the masses, they cannot put down their doubts, there is still hesitation and doubt. Therefore, sir. As soon as De Thich asked, Buddha immediately answered.

(Sutra) At the ear, the World-Honored One reported to the Unattached Being of the Heavenly Deity Thich wrote: “Non-class beings are aware, possess Bodhisattvas. Sattama Mahasattva, whose name is written Ksitigarbha, has immeasurable, countless great aeons, five defilements and evil times, has no Buddha world, matured sentient beings, golden data, eight hundred thousand na-du-da-ba-la Bodhisattva verses, for the sake of desire, reverence, closeness, offerings to the self, contemplating the Great Assemblage of births according to joy, purifying the relatives, author of Thanh Van image, the future will try, the divine power will manifest change".
(Sutra: At that time, the World-Honored One told Sakyamuni Buddha: "You should know, there is a Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat named Ksitigarbha, who for countless aeons, during the evil times of the five defilements, in the world without Buddha to mature sentient beings, along with eighty hundred thousand Na-du-da Tan-ba-la Bodhisattvas in the assembly, because they wanted to come here to pay homage, be close to me, and make offerings to me. Because they were happy to see the Assembly of Mahasambhava, they together with their relatives, using the image of Sravakas, will come to this place, using their supernatural powers to manifest things. that transformation).

Because Indra Sakyamuni asked so, the Buddha immediately explained to him. The Buddha is Omniscient, there is nothing He does not understand about all things. The Buddha knew that Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva was about to come, so he told the Uncontained Thien De Thich: "You should know, at present there is a great Bodhisattva named Ksitigarbha". "Immeasurable, countless great kalpas" (In immeasurable, countless great kalpas) refers to the process of His practice, transforming and guiding sentient beings over a very long period of time. Therefore, use “countless” to visualize. “Kiep” is Indian, [in full] Kiep Ba (Kalpa), translated as Thoi Phan. [Life is] the longest period. Whenever we talk about Kiep, we imagine a very long time. When we talk about a short time, we call it “moment”. Moment (kṣaṇa) in Indian is the shortest time, Kiep is the longest time, but here it is “great kalpa”. There are big, middle, and small kalpas. This great Bodhisattva's vow power is extremely great. He specializes in the evil world of the Five Defilements to save sentient beings.

The Five Impairments (Pañca-kasāyāh) are this era. We often talk about the Dharma-Ending Age, which means that this era is very bad, turbid, dirty, not clear. In an era of turbidity, filth, and impurity, if you want to protect the environment, it will not be possible. We really can't protect. Our life can end at any time, unlike Bac La Chau (Bac Cau Lo Chau), [the life span there is] eighty-four thousand years old, not muddy or dirty, very clear. Because of us, the old also die, and the young also die, we just don't know when! Birth and death are uncertain, dirty, and not pure. Each person has different views on different issues. People have too many perspectives, even for themselves they have too many views. That is Drsti-kasāya. Due to the disagreement in looking at the problem, there is Defilement of Defilements (Kleśa-kasāya). Regarding Defilements, I think everyone can know their own afflictions, no need to say more! This world has five or sixty billion people, each person's afflictions and views are very cloudy, that is Defiled Beings (Sattva-kasāya). In general, this era is not good.

In this era, for the “no Buddha world” (a world without Buddha), Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's vow is to save sentient beings in the evil world of the Five Defilements. Where there is no Buddha, where the tribulations of the Three Paths are especially severe, He will go there to save those sentient beings. “Mature sentient beings” is His wish. “Na-du-da tar-ba-la” (Nayuta Viṃvara) are big numbers, ten million; How many ten million? Eighty hundred thousand times ten million. That is referring to the relatives who came together with Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. As for the number of as many as eighty hundred thousand ash-ba-la, this world of ours cannot accommodate that many people. That's the state of mind, don't look for numbers. We just understand the idea [that's okay].

Śākyamuni Buddha said to the Unsullied Heavenly Deity: Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva wants to come here to be close to me and make offerings to me. At the same time, the Bodhisattva sees this Great Assembly of mine and is very pleased. He will come to rejoice, praise, and participate in this Dharma assembly. But He appeared in the form of Thanh Van. Thanh Van's appearance is shaved hair and wearing colorful robes. All Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva shave their hair and appear in the form of Thanh Van, but sometimes we see a statue of him sitting wearing the Five Buddha crown, that is, [on the crown there is an image of] Five Directions Buddha[5]. That is the [form] used in Diem Khau. Except for the Diem Khau Dharma Assembly, if you do dharma work or pray for sentient beings, you must wear the Five Buddha crown. However, such times are very rare, usually he has his head bare, we worship the statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva which is the image of Thanh Van. He wanted to come to this Dharma conference, so that transformation appeared.

(Sutra) Thi Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Ma Ha Slap, possesses immeasurable, countless, inconceivable, sublime and dignified places of merit that cannot be measured by all the world's Sravakas and Single Senses. Try the great Bodhisattva's knowledge of the wonderful merits and rebirths, the precious source of liberation, the pure eyes of the Bodhisattvas.
(Sutra: This Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva has countless, countless, inconceivable merits and enemies. The great Bodhisattva is the treasury of wonderful merits, the birthplace of precious liberations, and the bright and clear eyes of Bodhisattvas.

But this Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva has immeasurable, countless and inconceivable merits. Although He manifested the form of Thanh Van, He was more majestic and dignified than all the great Bodhisattvas, better than Manjushri, Samantabhadra, and Avalokiteshvara. In the eleventh chapter of the Ksitigarbha Sutra, the earth god Kien Lao praised Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva as follows: “In this world, I have met many great Bodhisattvas such as Manjushri, Pho Hien, Avalokiteshvara, Maitreya, their merits and vows are inconceivable, but Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva far surpasses them”. Comparing Bodhisattvas with each other, as well as between Buddhas, is only intended to show the merits of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, so the later part of the Ten Rings Sutra also states it clearly, and the Ksitigarbha Sutra also states it clearly. Just as he vowed to specialize in saving sentient beings in the evil world of the five defilements, to save sentient beings in hell in a world without Buddha, it is not easy to be saved! Therefore, all Buddhas praise.

There is a story: Venerable Kasyapa wanted to hear how far the Buddha's sound spread, so he used his supernatural powers [to go far away]. As a result, he did not know where he had arrived, but the sound of the Buddha was still in his ears. What country have you come to? He came to the people's Dharma meeting, right at the time of eating rice. He was at the mouth of a monk's bowl, walking on a bowl used to eat rice. The monk who was eating that meal thought he was just a small insect. The Buddha [there] told that monk: "Don't move! That is the chief disciple of a Buddha in the East." Having finished speaking, that monk did not dare to move. That Buddha immediately turned to Venerable Kasyapa and said: "You can recite the name of Master Śākyamuni Buddha. Whenever you recite the name of Master, your stature will be equal to that of this disciple." As soon as I recite the name of Master Śākyamuni Buddha, the amount of His body becomes immeasurable and boundless.

I bring up this story because I want to prove something? Buddha Buddhism and Taoism are the same. Because of saving that one type of sentient beings, He can only appear similar to them. Therefore, when he arrived in hell, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva immediately appeared as a monk, that is, a monk who was very miserable. Sometimes you see the statue of Ksitigarbha, whether in a dream or in the realm you see, he is like an ordinary monk. If you see a lot of outstanding light, it means your karma has changed, and you will see Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva also changing. Buddhas and Bodhisattvas appear depending on your mind.

For example, when you come to worship Ngu Dai Mountain, each person sees a different Manjushri Bodhisattva, that is, depending on your mind, it appears. All great Bodhisattvas are like that. Since the Ksitigarbha Sutra and the Ten Wheels of Kṣitigarbha Sūtra both aim to display the merits of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, the merits of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva will be mentioned as especially outstanding. If it were another sutra, such as the sutra about Manjushri Bodhisattva, it would be completely different: Manjushri Bodhisattva is especially superior. Manjushri Bodhisattva soon became a Buddha, the teacher of the seven Buddhas, the mother of the Buddhas, that is, Prajna is the mother of the Buddhas. That is displayed for living beings to see. There are also sutras in which the Buddha praised this Bodhisattva; Through another sutra, the Buddha suddenly showed another Bodhisattva, praising his merits. You must understand this principle, do not give rise to a discriminatory mind! If you say “Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's merit is great, Guan Yin Bodhisattva (Avalokiteśvara)'s merit is small”, you are making a mistake! But in the sutras, the reason why the Buddha said so was to make the masses recognize and make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, causing a feeling of superiority to arise in their minds. That's what the meaning is!

Buddha praised Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva for having immeasurable, countless, inconceivable and sublime merits to adorn. All the world, Thanh Van, Doc Giac are all immeasurable. If you want to measure His merits, it is impossible to measure! Do you still remember in the first chapter of the Ksitigarbha Sutra: In front of the Buddhas, Bodhisattvas, up to the heavens, people who came to attend the Dharma Assembly, the Buddha asked Manjushri Bodhisattva: "Can you calculate the number of people attending the Dharma Assembly?" Manjushri Bodhisattva said to the Buddha: "Using the power of my wisdom to calculate for a thousand lifetimes, I still cannot fully know that number."

Buddha said: “I use Buddha's eyes to see for a thousand lifetimes but still have not completed that number”. Using the Buddha's eye to see, the total number is still not complete. The Buddha's eye illuminates everything but still cannot reach that number. This is to promote the merits of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, causing sentient beings to develop a superior mind. Studying Dharma, studying Buddha, you also have to apply your own wisdom. If you understand the meaning of Buddha, you will achieve success.

It's the same in this sutra. The Buddha praised Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and said: All the Sravakas and Pratyekabuddhas cannot be measured, nor can the Bodhisattva's merits be calculated in detail. This great Bodhisattva is the treasury of all wonderful merits, containing immeasurable merits. It is also the place where all the treasures of liberation are born. Therefore, from the Nhu Y Treasure Pearl in each person's hand, countless precious treasures can flow out. Because Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva contains all the precious treasures, he can make everyone attain the true Dharma vision. That's why it is said "the eyes of the Bodhisattvas are clear and pure" (the clear bright eyes of the Bodhisattvas). If you hope to achieve that, you must practice for countless lifetimes, for fear of not succeeding. Those words of praise express a very noble and superior meaning.

(Sutra) The animal market of Nirvana for mercy and compassion Defend. Nthe Nhu Y Chau universe is a treasure of wealth, depending on what you wish for, your spirit will be fulfilled. Donate to the merchants, the treasures will be given to you, you will have the power to give birth to good roots and fields of food, you will have the power to store and liberate the peaceful energy, and you will have the wonderful treasures of merit and peace. The good person's actions are like wandering in the sun. Shining a light on the Taoist, due to Minh Cu. Eliminates afflictions and heat like the clear moon. Like a person who has no means of attaining wealth. Like a fake postcard with a private salary. Like the magician's way of meeting the path. Like hysteria, a magical medicine. Just like a fake illness meets a good doctor. Like the old man, he used a staff. Like the fake base, it's just ready for court.
(Sutra: The one who guides the merchants to reach Nirvana. Nhu Y Chau flows out all things của báu, tùy lòng mong cầu đều khiến cho trọn đủ. Ví như bến báu cho các thương nhân thu thập [của báu]. Là ruộng tốt có thể sanh trưởng căn lành. Là dụng cụ chứa đựng niềm vui giải thoát. Là hiền bình có thể tuôn ra các thứ báu công đức mầu nhiệm. Chiếu người làm lành ví như mặt trời rạng rỡ. Soi kẻ lạc đường ví như đuốc sáng. Trừ nóng phiền não như mặt trăng trong mát. Như kẻ không chân có được xe cộ. Như người đi xa có đủ lương thực, chi dụng. Như A person who is lost and confused finds someone who gives guidance. Like a bed or chair for a tired person to rest on.

“The Nirvana Merchant Taoist Market Beast” (A guide for merchants to enter Nirvana): If you want to become a Buddha, it will be like a merchant going into the sea to collect treasures, you must invite a guide to go into the sea to collect treasures. If you want to progress towards Nirvana, you must also have a guide. Who is the guide? Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is the one who guides and leads you towards Nirvana. Just like the Wish-fulfilling Pearl that pours out all kinds of treasures, whatever one desires are satisfied, He will not be bored. There are friends who, after bowing to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, or after reciting sutras, first of all, pray for the peace of their own family members, or pray for good health in body and mind; After that, pray for fortune. There's still a lot of demand! Someone asked me: "Master! I pray too much. Is Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva upset?" I replied: "How much do you pray for? If you ask for one billion, ten billion, a hundred billion, a thousand memories, ten thousand millions, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva doesn't mind. The more you pray, the better your practice shows, so you can pray that much. Otherwise, you won't be able to pray!"

Everyone recites the Ksitigarbha Sutra and then makes a vow. I think you don't pray too much, because your mind is not that great, you can't pray, and you can't even think about it. Do you pray for all sentient beings to become Buddhas? Praying for Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's blessings to make all sentient beings become Buddhas, hoping to forever live in the Dharma Realm, is that such a request? Never asked! Your mind cannot be considered great, you only think about yourself. We need to think about the people we meet, think about our fellow countrymen. One step further and you can think of more than sixty billion people on earth. Have you thought about other planets? Do you think about the Dharma world? Do you think that all sentient beings in the Lotus Pond Hai Association will become Amitābha Buddha? Very few people make those vows! [Just thinking] "It's okay for me to be reborn, I can come and join the Lien Tri Hai Hoi, becoming a member is great!" Do you hope that the masses in the Lotus Pond Assembly will all turn into Amitābha Buddha? If you have never hoped, from now on, you must hope and make a vow. Not only can you come to the Lotus Pond Hai Assembly yourself, but Shravakas and Pratyekabuddhas, as long as you are born into the Lotus Pond Hai Assembly, everyone is Amitābha Buddha. I even hope that in the Sa Ba world, no matter how great the suffering is, the people in this world who are now living with me can definitely become Buddhas, and together with me, they can become Buddhas.

If you make a slightly bigger vow, “after they all become Buddhas, I will become a Buddha”. Hundreds of thousands of millions of things can be said to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Kneel before him, recite Ksitigarbha's holy name ten sentences, and after reciting, make your vows, especially for those vows. That is cultivating religion. No matter how big your vow is, you will have that much magical power. Thanks to borrowing the vows of the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, the Pure Land of Amitābha Buddha becomes your wish. Samantabhadra Bodhisattva's vow is to “exhaust all emptiness throughout the dharma world, making all sentient beings become Buddhas”, that is Samantabhadra's great vow. You must understand this principle; Bodhisattva will not be bored. Trouble is caused by your own random thoughts, giving rise to false thoughts. It's all about thinking about the realm of the five desires, that's not good! If you think of a holy realm, or an inconceivable realm, it will be a good field that can grow good roots. That's why it is said "all good roots grow in that land".

“Prosperous ability to store liberated air of happiness” (A tool to store the joy of liberation): What is “Liberating happy energy”? It is liberation. Don't understand the word “lac ki” as “musical instrument” used to play music. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is the earth that contains all the seeds of liberation, all can be liberated, is the peaceful[6] that can manifest all precious and mysterious merits. Just like I just mentioned the vase of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, all magical treasures appeared, eliminating disasters and avoiding disasters. Whatever you need, it will appear in Aquarius. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's light shines on those who do good, only illuminating those who do good, but those who do evil do not achieve success. Those who do evil must change to do good. That is “daily promiscuity”. “Lang day” means the bright sun.

For those who are lost and cannot find the way, there is a bright light ahead, or a bright torch, or a big torch to show the way. When the brain is hot, the clear moon is the coolest, [so it is said] “like the cool moon” (like the cool clear moon). If you are a person without legs, there will be a wheelchair for you to sit in, like a car, [it should be said] like "a superfluous possession" (having a vehicle). For example, if you go on a long journey, are both thirsty and hungry, and have no water or food, then food will be provided for you. Like a confused person who has lost direction, he will guide you. “Like a homeless person, one can obtain a far surplus, like a far-away person, a source of self-reliance, like a confused person, a person of enlightenment, like a hysterical person, a wonderful medicine” (Like a legless person gets a vehicle, like a person traveling far gets food and supplies. Like a lost person finds someone to show the way. Like a crazy person gets good medicine).

That person has gone crazy, is there any way to cure it? So you have to find good medicine and see a good doctor. If you encounter a miracle drug, you can immediately stop the madness. We think that sick people are crazy; Actually, we're all crazy! Why not practice Bodhi path? There are Dharma friends who believe that they practice a lot; I'll try it! I said: Twenty-four hours a day, how much can you practice? You still don't practice as much as me, so why do you say you practice a lot! Calculate for yourself, in twenty-four hours, each hour is sixty minutes, how many minutes are there reciting Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha? How many minutes do you have to meditate on greed, anger, ignorance, thoughts of killing, stealing, sexual misconduct, thoughts of lying, fictitious words, and harsh words? Have you counted or not? You practice too little! Everyone must practice more! When you practice, don't practice for yourself. If you practice too little, you will consider yourself very eminent. The distance is too far, how can we clear our minds, how can we eliminate disasters and avoid disasters? Think carefully about how to avoid disaster and disaster?

“For the merchants to treasure the treasure, the power to grow good roots of food, the power to prosper and store liberated air of happiness” (For example, a treasure trove for merchants to collect, a good field that can grow good roots, a tool to store the joy of liberation): “Gas” is a type of container, What does that container contain? Contains the happiest things. What is the happiest thing? Deliverance! When liberated, there will be no afflictions, no desires; That is called “liberation of bliss”. These are absolutely not musical instruments like the pipa or guqin, "lac" here means "joy". “A gentle vase can give birth to precious and mysterious merit”: That vase can give birth to all merit; In the previous section, I said that the vase was like the vase of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva. This is the visualization of the merits of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva.

Whoever can do good deeds, do good deeds, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's light will be like radiant sunlight shining on your body. For those who have lost their way, "losing the path" means losing your way. While walking, Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha is like a bright torch fire illuminating you. If living beings have afflictions, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's light immediately eliminates that heat, like the cool moon, leaving you without heat.

“Like a person without wealth, possessing far beyond” (Like a person without legs having a vehicle): When you are very tired on the road, having a vehicle will be able to reduce that misery. "Like a person traveling far away, having food and provisions" (Like a person traveling a long distance getting food and provisions): If you travel a long way without food and money, you will not be able to arrive. "If you're confused, you'll see the path", meaning: Having lost your way, someone will show you the direction, just like when we're walking and ask for directions. Another meaning is that in life, we find a method of skillful means to escape from birth and death, which is reciting the holy name Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva.

According to what is said in this passage, what can Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva give us? It is “skillful means”. When a person cultivates the Way, due to the power of aspiration, the person who prays to Him will be able to achieve good things, but that is for people with predestined conditions, but those without predestined things still cannot achieve it. “Like a hysterical person, one receives wonderful medicine” (Like a hysterical person receives good medicine): We have advised many Dharma friends to offer water to Ksitigarbha. When worshiping, you must be very sincere in your heart. When it's time to drink, you must follow the method taught by Shakyamuni Bodhisattva Avalokiteśvara in the Ksitigarbha Sutra to achieve benefits. What benefits do you get? Whenever there is illness and suffering, the illness and suffering will be reduced. Without wisdom, without memory, there will be memory. A hysterical person is a person who is insane, either because of a problem with their thoughts, or because of fear, causing a mental disorder. If you recite the holy name Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva will be like good medicine. Or a sick person meets a doctor. That's what the Buddha told the Uncontained Being Thich De Thich: "To all the great assembly attending the Dharma Assembly", that is, speaking to all the Bodhisattvas and Sravakas in this Great Assembly. The Buddha turned to the crowd and said: Ksitigarbha has so many merits, making it seem like the old people have a walking stick to lean on, like a tired person has a bed and chair to rest.

(Sutra) The four streamers, the virtuous. Those who are beasts and banksters, those who create a boat tycoon, have the three good roots to win the retribution, and have the three good roots to lead the stream. Always practice almsgiving, like the ever-changing cycle. Maintain solid precepts, like Dieu Cao mountain. Effort cannot be destroyed, as Vajrayana says. An patient is immovable, like the earth.
(Sutra: Making a wharf for those who cross fourdlines. Making boats for those who aim for the other shore. It is the victorious revenge of the three good roots, the result of the three good roots. Constantly giving generously is like an ever-rotating wheel.

“The four lines of the four streams fake the author Kieu Luong” (Making a wharf for those who cross the four lines): “Kieu Luong” (the wharf) is an example. “Four streams” (Four streams) refers to the four streams of birth, old age, sickness, and death. He acts as a bridge for you, meaning to help you attain salvation. Right when you want to go from this shore [of birth and death] to the other shore [of liberation], He can make a boat for you. It is the victorious revenge of the three good roots. The three good roots are no greed, no anger, no ignorance, because "no greed, no anger, no ignorance" can give birth to all good dharmas. "Like the stream-flow results are derived from three good roots": "The three good roots" are generosity, compassion, and wisdom. Almsgiving and compassion can help you overcome all evils, but can also cause the afflictions of greed, anger, and ignorance to flow into almsgiving and compassion. Therefore, often practice almsgiving (generous alms giving). “As the wheel always rotates” (Like the wheel always rotates) means without stopping. Because of reciting Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and respecting Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, that Bodhisattva will be able to help you maintain the precepts firmly, like Mount Dieu Cao (Su Di).

“Diligence is indestructible, like a diamond. Patience is immovable, like the great earth” (Diligence is as indestructible as the precious diamond. Patience is immovable, like the great earth): Talking about indestructible diligence, it will be a very difficult thing. If we practice a dharma, such as reciting the Ksitigarbha Sutra, or visualizing the holy image of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, even while you are practicing, there will be many obstacles. “Obstacle” means making it impossible for you to achieve. Every day you [self-determined] to recite one Ksitigarbha sutra, but there are always things that make you interrupt and not be able to recite the sutra. If you persist in reciting the holy name Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva without interruption, any destructive event cannot destroy your diligence. Why can't it be destroyed? Because you have a strong mind. Often there are obstacles that we cannot overcome or cannot do. At that time, the two aspects of diligence and leisure have a great relationship, especially for those who study Buddhism and believe in Buddhism. Not achieving real benefits is because we are not diligent enough and cannot persevere!

If we vow to recite a Ksitigarbha sutra every day, in any difficult time, without interruption, then diligence will have strength. Why must we be diligent? It's also because many people can't do it without interruption! Even for things that seem very small at first glance, such as every day we have to recite Ksitigarbha's holy name a hundred sentences, I think this is too easy and cannot be interrupted. But I will forget, or because other things interfere, I won't do it anymore! I think every Dharma friend understands this.

At first, after you vowed to believe in the Three Jewels, I told many Dharma friends: "Having received the Three Refuges, from today onwards, at night before going to sleep, recite ten times 'take refuge in the Buddha, take refuge in the Dharma, take refuge in the Sangha'. After reciting, you will sleep. When you wake up in the morning, just open your eyes, right on the bed, in front of you." When finished, recite ten times, take refuge in the Buddha, take refuge in the Dharma, and take refuge in the Sangha." It's as simple as that! Everyone thinks they can absolutely do it. I asked many Dharma friends, at first, when they accepted the Three Refuges, they assured that they could do it. A year later, ask them again: "Can you do it? Can you do it every day?" "Oh my god! I forgot about it!" For what reason? Of course, it's because we often hesitate, karma relaxes, and don't take this matter seriously!

The merits of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva are as many as mentioned above, because the Buddha taught the Unconditioned Birth of Thich Thich. After we hear it, do we believe it or not? This is a huge problem! We often listen to the Dharma a lot and study the Dharma a lot. Many Dharma friends often say: "I know too little about Buddhism, so I can't enter it." I see that's not the case! I said: "You know a lot." At least, do you know what Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha are? Don't know how to use effort? Reciting Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva includes everything! Reciting Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva has already been collected! Do you have thoughts or not? How many verses do you recite each day? Twenty [four] hours a day, excluding sleep and work time, how much time is left in your mind to recite the Three Jewels?

Today, there were many Dharma friends eating together, I thought: At that time, [the vast majority] talked about East, talked about West, never mentioned Buddha, never mentioned Dharma, never mentioned Sangha. If you remind people like that at any time, they will think you are very obnoxious and talk too much. Do you have that feeling? You don't say it, they forget it! When you recite the Three Jewels every day for twenty-four hours, at night when you go to bed, think: "How much time do I have today to recite Buddha's name, Dharma's name, and Sangha's name?" Whether you ask for inspiration, blessing, inspiration or blessing is all up to you. I remember shaman Tinh Van said "the biggest enemy in life is oneself". That statement is very reasonable! If we can visualize like that, visualize for a long time, not say twenty-four hours, but one-third, or eight hours, until one day we can recite the Three Jewels for four hours, be diligent and not lazy, absolutely will not fall into the three realms. You increase it to eight more hours, then increase it to twelve hours, you can definitely achieve your karma!

Why don't we understand clearly? Why is it not clear? Why don't you know? Why is there no wisdom? Why can't enter Concentration? Because your mind is very far away from the Three Jewels! If I say these words, everyone probably won't hear them. Because [you say to yourself]: I have believed in Buddha for many years. Currently, reciting Buddha's name every day, I am already "professional". At one point while everyone was gathering, I suddenly thought: What are everyone doing now? Are you talking about Buddha or not? Is there any mention of Buddhism? Are you practicing or not? Are you slacking off or being lazy? Thinking of being as patient and unmoving as a diamond, just like the earth, we still have to put in more effort!

(Sutra) Tinh Lu is secret, because it is like a secret organ. Solemn and dignified, like a magical flower. Wisdom is profound and vast, like the ocean. Before being infected, the world is empty. Miraculous results are close to the cause, like a bunch of phyllo flowers. Serve pagans like a lion king. Thousands of heavenly demons, like great dragon statues. Slay the troubles of bandits with the help of a divine sword. Embrace all the nonsense, like the Single Sense Vehicle. Removes afflictions and afflictions, like pure water. Ability to eliminate impurities, such as leprosy. Breaking them together is like a sharp sword.
(Kinh: The deep Tinh Lu is like a secret treasure. Binh like the Single Enlightenment Vehicle. Wash away impurities and afflictions like pure water. Can eliminate impurities like a strong wind.

“Secret Tinh Lu is like a secret organ” (Secret Tinh Lu is like a secret treasure): Tinh Lu is contemplation, which also means when you quiet your mind and think. This is a very deep realm, inconceivable! For example, we arbitrarily recite a certain mantra, the long mantra is Da La Ni, the short mantra has three words, four words, the true mantra has only one word, such as the word An. Many words are seed words, depending on which Bodhisattva taught them. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva has such merits, has such merits, can make us "equitable and solemn, like a wonderful flower. Deep and vast wisdom, like a great ocean" (equality reaches the solemnity and beauty like a mysterious garland. Wisdom is as wide and deep as the ocean). Those are the Buddha's words praising Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva.

“Untainted first, leaving the state of emptiness” (Not contaminated like the state of emptiness): The state of emptiness is not contaminated. Emptiness is not contaminated. The wonderful results in the past were due to that person's cultivation. Practicing the cause in the present will bring wonderful results in the future.

“Magical results are close to the cause, like a bunch of phyllocosmic flowers” (Magical results are close to the cause like flowers and leaves): Just like when flowers and fruits bloom, because they still have to use branches and leaves to support them. Beautiful flowers must also be supported by green leaves. When you sow the seeds, they will first sprout leaves, then flowers. The leaves will absorb nutrients. That's the relationship. Subdue the infidels, like a lion subdues all demons, like a great dragon. “Slaying afflictions and troubles like a magic sword” (Slaying troubles like a magic sword): The magic sword is the sword of wisdom.

“Bored with all the noise, like the Single Enlightenment Vehicle” (Bored with the noise like the Single Enlightenment Vehicle): What about the Single Enlightenment Vehicle? He likes to find a quiet, deep mountain place to practice, bored with noise.

“Cleans away afflictions like pure water” (Washes away impurities and afflictions like pure water): These two sentences, the upper one corresponds to the lower one. If we wish to wash away our afflictions, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva will turn into pure water, washing away our afflictions. If you want to eliminate stench and impurity, it will be like a strong wind blowing it away. "Cut off the bonds, like sharp swords and swords"

(Sutra) Protecting the guardians, like the body, like existence. Preventing enemies from resentment is like a store, like a city. Saving people from danger is like a parent. The treasures are terrified, due to the weakness of the forest. Like the far-away summer, at the head of a great tree. The person is hot and thirsty, creating clear and cold water. The fake body of the law is full of fruit and fruit. You reveal your fake appearance and change your clothes. The author of heat and dharma, creates great secrets. The poor person, doing as he wishes. The terrible tool, the refuge. The taste of all the colors and colors, the effect of camaraderie and dance. The degenerates of water and water create the Moon Love Pearl.
(Sutra: Protects from fear like relatives, like friends. Prevents enemies, like hào, như thành. Cứu các nguy nan, giống như cha mẹ. Che giấu các kẻ khiếp nhược, yếu đuối, giống như rừng rậm. Như mùa Hè đi xa, nương dưới cây to. Làm nước trong mát cho người khát vì nóng bức. Làm quả ngọt cho người đói thiếu. Làm y phục cho kẻ lõa lồ. Làm mây dầy lớn cho người khốn khổ vì nóng bức. Làm báu như ý cho người nghèo túng. Làm chỗ nương về cho người sợ hãi. Làm mưa ngọt lành cho người trồng cấy. Làm Nguyệt Ái châu cho các cloudy water).

“Protect the guardians, like the body, like the being” (Protect from fears, like relatives, like friends): When fear arises, our relatives and friends will help us eliminate difficulties. To prevent resentment from bandits, fearing that bandits would attack us, we repaired the citadel. Outside the citadel, dig trenches to protect the citadel. “Moat” is a river dug to protect the citadel. These all have simile meanings. “Save people from danger, like parents” (Save people from danger, like parents): No matter who they are, when they encounter difficulties, they always think of their mother and call their mother. People who are at death's door, or when they are most in danger, or when children are suffering, the vast majority call for their mothers. Only our parents care about us. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is like our parents protecting and protecting us.

“Hiding the fearful and weak is like a forest” (Hiding the fearful and weak is like a jungle): Those who encounter fear, in order to avoid danger, hide in the dense forest. "As Ha goes far away, at the head of a big tree", it means: Like when going far away, being smothered by the sun, very painful, going to a big tree to enjoy the cool air. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is like a big tree that gives us fresh air. If you are suffering from the heat and are very thirsty, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is like cool water. As for those who are hungry, thirsty, and poor, He makes all kinds of sweet fruits, [meaning] very delicious food. Those who have no clothes to wear, that is "reveals" (naked people), Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva immediately gives clothes to us. “The heat-warming person, the great secret cloud” [meaning] when it is very hot, He is like a thick cloud, blocking the sunlight, we immediately feel cool.

“The poor person, creates as he wishes” (For the poor, he makes treasure as he wishes): “As the Wish”: Like a poor person who has a treasure. Just like a jewel held by Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva in his hand, all kinds of treasures can appear as desired. “The terrible person, taking refuge” (Being a refuge for those who are afraid): If they are afraid, they take refuge with the Bodhisattva, their mind will be at peace, without fear. "The taste of all the precious colors, creating orange and dust" (Making sweet rain for growers): When times are dry and the crops are not lush, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva immediately pours out good rain, that's the meaning.

“The Water Degenerate, creating the Moon Ai Chau” (Making the Moon Ai Chau for all kinds of turbid waters): Here, we do not have this type of pearl. Nguyet Ai Chau can turn cloudy water into clean water. Even though the water is very cloudy, drop Nguyet Ai Chau in and the water immediately becomes pure. Therefore, while we are turbid and impure, whenever we recite the holy name Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, our mind immediately becomes pure. In times of trouble and lack of liberation, you can go to the Buddha hall, or in front of the Ksitigarbha statue, meditate for a while, chanting the holy name of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, you will feel much better. These are all intended to visualize the merits of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva.

(Sutra) Spirits of sentient beings, good roots are indestructible. The wonderful realm appears, the spirit of the congregation rejoices. Encourage sentient beings and increase compassion. Pray for blessings and solemn spiritual tools. Powerful to eliminate afflictions, like medicine from the earth. The ability to disturb the mind, like a state of maintenance. His eloquence is unsatisfactory, like a water wheel. Photography involves the mind, like contemplation of wonderful colors. An patient and steadfast, like Dieu Cao mountain. General Tri is profound and vast, like a great ocean. Than Tuc is unhindered, free from nothingness. Eliminate necessarily or obstructive habit energy. Do like burning the sun, eliminating likes and dislikes. Often meditate in meditation, Formless true path. Omniscience, wonderful jewels. Useless energy, turning the great wheel of Dharma.
(Sutra: Causes sentient beings to have good roots that do not perish. Reveals a mysterious realm that makes them sanh vui thích. Khuyên lơn, khơi gợi hữu tình tăng thêm lòng hổ thẹn. Khiến cho kẻ cầu phước huệ trọn đủ trang nghiêm. Có thể trừ phiền não như thuốc khiến cho ói ra. Có thể nhiếp loạn tâm, như cảnh Đẳng Trì. Biện tài chẳng vướng mắc, như nước đẩy guồng quay. Nhiếp sự, buộc tâm, như quán diệu sắc. An nhẫn, trụ vững, như núi Diệu Cao. Tổng trì sâu rộng giống như biển cả. Thần Túc vô ngại, khác nào hư không. Eliminate all Or obstructive habits, like the bright sun instantly dissolving the thin ice. Often walking in the Formless Pure Path, and the wonderful treasure of Omniscience can turn the great wheel of Dharma in vain.

Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva can make our good roots indestructible. If we have sown seeds now, have good roots, or good roots that are indestructible in the future, we can meet Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and recite the holy name of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, and Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva will be able to bless you. In the Ksitigarbha Sutra, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva made a vow in front of Śākyamuni Buddha, and Sakyamuni Buddha entrusted sentient beings in the Dharma-Ending Age to him. He said: “As long as you have merit equal to a particle of dust, or a drop of water in the Buddha Dharma, you will make that person liberated”. He has made a vow and will carry it out. Just plant good roots, wait until the conditions are ripe, they will definitely grow, revealing a magical realm that makes sentient beings happy.

Currently, in this assembly, He has manifested and manifested realms that are very superior and very inconceivable; Everyone feels happy, can make all sentient beings feel ashamed, understand why they themselves cannot be liberated? Why can't we accumulate good karma? Why can't we help others? Why is my own selfish mind so heavy? Why do so many tribulations befall my body? Then I'm ashamed of myself for being wrong in the past and not accumulating good karma, so in this life I'm inferior to others in everything. Then Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva can help you, make you increase your blessings, make your repentant mind strong, make you dignified, make you eliminate afflictions.

If your stomach is not clear, drink a little enema, just like we have a lot of afflictions, don't understand how to be liberated, recite the holy name Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, recite the Ksitigarbha sutra, you will be able to be liberated. That's the meaning. The mind is very scattered, chant the holy name a lot. Reciting the holy name is the best method. Sometimes when we recite sutras, the effect is not as good! Reciting the holy name can test your own scattered mind, but it can also test [to realize] that you are full of afflictions! If you don't recite a hundred verses, recite a thousand verses. Still couldn't do it, so he recited ten thousand sentences. If he couldn't, he recited 100,000 sentences. Still couldn't do it, so he recited a hundred thousand sentences. Such an effect immediately arises.

I'm not talking nonsense; I did that myself! First, I prepare to recite a thousand verses. If he didn't succeed, he recited ten thousand sentences. Ten thousand sentences did not accomplish anything, so recite ten thousand sentences. Ten thousand sentences did not succeed, so recite one hundred thousand sentences and it worked! If it still doesn't work, continue reciting, there is no limit to the number of recitations. However, this is just planning to do something. I hope to do something, hope to achieve peace, hope to get what I want; First, test it yourself, then recite it! When you first start reciting, your mind is still scattered. By the time you recite hundreds of thousands of sentences, hundreds of thousands of sentences or more, the confusion will naturally become less. That's called kung fu, everyone recites it the same way. If you recite like that, you will also achieve like that. Whoever is willing to do so will achieve the same. But you must know how to let go and recite it day and night. You must set a time limit, or within twenty days, recite one hundred thousand sentences. Every day, on average, how many sentences will we recite? We must do it. As long as you can't do it, you don't sleep, don't eat, and wait until it's done. It's also possible that you don't need to sleep or eat, you can still sleep as usual, but you still have to recite like that. If you study the Quan Yin method, chanting Bodhisattva Avalokiteśvara is also okay. Reciting the holy name of any Bodhisattva is fine! As long as you are diligent and put in the effort, you will be able to achieve it.

The things said in the above passage are all examples. When preaching the sutra, preaching the Dharma, or arguing with others, you have no eloquence and are often hindered. Others ask, I can't answer. Then reciting the holy name Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva many times will increase your wisdom. Or drink Ksitigarbha Water and you will be blessed by Him. At that time, facing the scene in front of you, you will be able to capture the mind. Otherwise, in front of the scene, the mind cannot be captured. Scenes are phenomena. In the face of all phenomena, you will be able to remain unmoved.

“Like contemplating wonderful colors, patiently and patiently abiding” (Like contemplating miraculous colors, patiently, firmly staying): What is the color of “wonderful colors”? Miraculous form is formless. This is very deep! Just like contemplating the wonderful form body, the wonderful form body is formless. Let me give you an example: when we contemplate the holy image of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, we rely on the body with that form [to meditate]. It is fake, because [that form] is a painting or a statue, but from that fake, the real can be born. What is the real thing? General “formless”. Miraculous body means light.

Contemplating like that for a long time, that light and your light, your own mind and the self-nature mind of Ksitigarbha, the two sides will merge, patiently remaining motionless! Totally upholding all dharmas, reciting countless meanings at a deep level, wisdom like the ocean. Than Tuc is divine power, that is, Than Tuc Thong. His divine power (Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva) is unobstructed, seemingly empty. Nothingness is unobstructed to everything. That is the merit of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. He practiced and entered very deeply, all obstacles and negative habits were completely eliminated. The situation of elimination is like the sun shining on thin ice: As soon as the sun rises, all the thin ice disappears.

“Thuong du Tinh Lu formless right path” (Usually walking in Tinh Lu formless right path): What is “formless correct path”? It is wisdom, the Bodhi path, and the Dharma of Non-Birth forbearance. Formless means that all forms do not exist. True religion is immorality. Then it will be possible to attain Omniscience. All-Wisdom is ordinary. [The word] “All-Wisdom” is specifically used to describe: Among all the wisdom spoken by the Buddha, All-Wisdom is the most sublime wisdom. Only then will it be possible to turn the most inconceivable wonderful wheel of Dharma. The wonderful wheel of Dharma can eliminate all the ignorance of all sentient beings.

(Sutra) “Good man! Thi Dia Tang Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tát, who is like a vision of immeasurable, countless, inconceivable, surpassing the merits, data of relatives, desire to try again, appears first as a supernatural being.”. The World-Honored One expounded on Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva all the merits and virtues. At that time, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva, eight hundred thousand na-du-da-tan-ba-la Bodhisattva, with divine powers, appeared in the Sravaka image, in the South of the future, cof the Buddha's pre-abode, all his relatives, respectfully bowed to the World-Honored One, with the presence of three-tapped interference, at Tathagata's front, together with his palms, chanting and writing.
(Sutra: “O good man! That Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva has countless merits. With such inconceivable superior virtue, together with his relatives, he wanted to come here. First of all, such supernatural powers appeared." The World-Honored One finished speaking about Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's merits. At that time, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva and eighty hundred thousand na-du-da-t-ba-la Bodhisattva used their supernatural powers and appeared in the form of Shravakas, from the South. Come first. Buddha, he along with his relatives respectfully bowed at the feet of the World-Honored One, circumambulated three times to the right, clasped his hands, stood before the Tathagata, and praised with verses.

The Buddha towards the Unsullied Heavenly Emperor praised Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva for all his inconceivable and superior merits, but the Bodhisattva's relatives are also those who have followed him to save sentient beings for a long time, the number of which is incalculable, that is, [generally speaking, there are] eighty hundred thousand million ashram Bodhisattvas. save sentient beings here. Even though the Bodhisattvas have not yet arrived, they have already manifested such supernatural powers.

“The World-Honored One explained the merits and virtues of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva” (The Blessed One finished explaining the merits of that Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva): Void-Born Heavenly Emperor Thich asked why did the false signs appear? The Buddha immediately said: There is a Bodhisattva named Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva who will bring eighty hundred thousand Na-du-da Tan-ba-la relatives and come here to make offerings to me, to come to this Great Assembly to rejoice in the merits, so there are so many wonderful scenes. As soon as the Buddha finished speaking, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva also arrived.

“At that time, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva, eighty-hundred thousand na-du-da frequency-ba-la Bodhisattva, with divine powers, appeared in the Sravaka image, pines in the Southern future” (At that time, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva along with eighty hundred thousand na-du-da Tan-bat-la Bodhisattva used his supernatural power to manifest the form of Thanh Van, coming from the South): Coming from the South, of course, speaking when the Buddha was preaching, the Bodhisattva came from [the south of] La Lan Mountain. However, some people explain that La Lan Son is the Pure Land of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. However, if it is Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Pure Land; He should have been right at La Lan Son, why did he have to come from the South? In the end, where does Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva reside? All over, everywhere! Wherever there is hell, wherever there is suffering, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is right there, he can come from anywhere!

After the Buddha finished speaking, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva used his supernatural powers to come to the Dharma assembly. “At that time” (At that time), that is, when the Buddha had just finished teaching the Immaculate Conception of Thich Thich, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and his relatives immediately appeared in the form of Shravaka, and arrived before the Buddha. When arriving, first perform a ritual: First, respectfully bow at the feet of the World-Honored One. That is the ritual we all do every time we worship.

When worshiping, why do people have to turn their hands upside down? [Turn over] both hands to support the Buddha's feet, called "face-to-face offering ceremony" (head and face pressed against the Buddha's feet to offer life-giving ceremony). Your hands should not be placed too far apart, because your face and hands are both pressed against the Buddha's feet. Face pressed against Buddha's feet, hands pressed against Buddha's feet. That is “face-to-face and follow-up ceremony”. To pay homage, one must bow at the feet of the World-Honored One.

When the Buddha was in the world preaching the Dharma, [as well as] when we go to a temple or shrine, or when we see a stupa, we must “follow the tam tat”, that is, walk around three times [clockwise]. Why must the Buddha statue on the main hall of a temple be worshiped in the middle, not against the wall? Because it is necessary to disturb Buddha. As soon as you enter, you must definitely circumambulate in the right direction, that is, circumambulate clockwise as prescribed by the Buddha. After chanting three times, he bowed. Whenever you enter, you must circumambulate three times. After circumambulating three times, you must pay respects. After bowing, he sat before the Buddha.

Here, when Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva arrived, he came before the Buddha. After circumambulating three times, he stood and used verses to praise the Buddha's merits. The Buddha praised Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, and Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva praised the Buddha. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva had not yet arrived, but he had already shown miraculous powers. The Buddha praised Bodhisattva for his inconceivable merits. He came before the Buddha, respectfully bowed, then circumambulated to the right three times, stood before the Buddha, clasped his hands and praised the Buddha's merits.

(Sutra) Master Luong Tuc, a kind heart is always abundant, as patient as the great earth, eliminating anger and anger.
anger and anger).

This is the first verse. For every four verses there is a verse, a total of thirty-four praises, that is, thirty-four verses are used to praise the Buddha. “Luong Tuc Venerable Master” means a person of complete blessings, complete wisdom, a teacher who shows the way, leading all sentient beings to escape the sea of ​​suffering of birth and death. “The compassionate mind is always universally endowed” (The compassionate mind often covers everything), meaning: The Buddha's mind is great, always eliminating suffering and giving joy to sentient beings. “Kindness” means giving joy. “Spectrum” is all-pervading, without omission, and equal. “Phu” means to cover. That is, the Buddha's compassion covers all sentient beings.

“Patience is like the great earth, eliminating anger and resentment” (Patience is like the great earth, completely eliminating all anger and resentment). “An patience” means to endure. For all the afflictions and all the things that are not according to the Dharma of all sentient beings, all the disasters in the evil life of the five impurities, the Buddha used great compassion. Not only can it be endured, but it can also be eliminated. The Buddha himself had no anger or resentment. If sentient beings have thoughts of anger, the Buddha will eliminate them on their behalf. “Universal wealth” means all sentient beings, which also means hoping to eliminate anger and indignation for all sentient beings. Be careful: Anger and anger are the most dangerous things in anger and ignorance.

Therefore, a thought of anger of sentient beings arose, hundreds of thousands of barrier doors opened! The angry mind of sentient beings gets angry whenever there is something they do not like. If you get angry, you will burn down the forest of merit. That is the first verse praising merit.

(Sutra) You have a perfect appearance, adorn the Buddha lands, have the power to be compassionate, and have the utmost perfection.
realm).

The Buddha's appearance is complete, not only limited to the human sky, but also complete with countless good and dignified appearances. There are two types of appearance: One is the appearance of the Nirmanakaya, the other is the appearance of the Sambhogakaya. The form of the Sambhogakaya is like Lo Xa Na Buddha (Rocana), that is, the Sambhogakaya of Śākyamuni Buddha, the perfect form of a thousand feet, like the form of Infinite Light of Amitābha Buddha. Infinite Light of Life is the Sambhogakaya form of the Buddha, the supreme form of all Buddhas. Regardless of Sambhogakaya or Incarnation, they all have thirty-two marks and eighty excellent qualities. That's called human nature. The Buddha has countless beautiful and dignified features.

“Adorn the Buddha lands” (Adorn the Buddha lands): Adorn all the Buddha lands. It can be said that “Buddha lands” is the land of Śākyamuni Buddha, the Sa Ba world, but it can also be said to be the entire Dharma world of all Buddha lands. Every Buddha adorns the Buddha land. Buddha's compassion is not the great compassion of love, but the “truth of compassion”.“truth” is the truth. When it comes to “truth”, it means the true mind, which is also our True Form. The word Emperor contains that meaning. “The Truth of Compassion” is the right compassion, eliminating all suffering, giving joy to all sentient beings, making it possible for all sentient beings to clearly understand their own Dharma nature, making it possible for all sentient beings to fulfill the Prajna wisdom that pervades all Buddha realms. Buddha's compassion saves all living beings without distinction. That is the second verse.

(Sutra) Eternal love of the nets, as it is, abiding in goodness, letting go of the pure lands, defiling them. birth.
(Sutra: Forever free from the net of love, like reality, stay well, abandon pure realms, save them born contaminated).

This is praising Śākyamuni Buddha for becoming a Buddha, achieving ultimate purity, forever without desire. The word “hammock” is a visual word. Craving in “desire” is like a [tightly tied] net. Looking for a clue, you cannot find it. It means that [beings] are entangled in the net, unable to escape. The Buddha forever cut off the net of craving. He not only cut himself off, but also wanted to cut off the net of craving for all living beings. Because He was able to attain the true Truth, Truth, and Truth, he remained skillfully at peace, always remaining in the realm of nothingness and stillness, which is also Nirvana.

We say: “He abides in the Pure Land of Everlasting Light!” In such a good place, the Buddha does not abide, He “releases the pure lands” (leaves the pure realms), He leaves the realm of the Solemn Retribution and the Pure Land of Everlasting Light to enter the evil world of the Five Defilements in order to save sentient beings from impurities. The sentient beings in this world are very infected, the Buddha came to save them. This is praising the Buddha's inconceivable merits!

(Sutra) Original vow to purify impurities, mature evil sentient beings, develop solid right effort, practice all sufferings happiness.
austerity for a long time).

Buddha in this Saha world saves sentient beings with great difficulty. That is His existing aspiration, the aspiration when He first started. He vowed: "In the future, when I become a Buddha, I will save the most miserable and filthy living beings. I will go there to save them. Those living beings are full of all evil views, stubborn, difficult to tame, difficult to save, and I will mature them all." This is not easy to do, it requires countless lifetimes of bravery, diligence, and continuous practice. [That is] “steadfast and right effort” (diligently practicing right and solidly). “Practicing asceticism for a long time” (Practicing asceticism for a long time): “Practicing asceticism” means being able to practice asceticism exactly like sentient beings, showing an example, practicing even in suffering, only then can sentient beings mature. The next verse is intended to remind.

(Sutra) Cultivate the nine ascetics, cultivate the mind, cultivate the virtues of charity, precepts, forbearance, and tolerance. Effort, Concentration, Hue.
and Effort, Concentration, Hue).

Practice the Six Paramitas, ten thousand virtues, Almsgiving, Precepts, Patience, Diligence, Meditation, Wisdom, that is, the Six Paramitas. How to achieve the Six Paramitas? Practice immeasurable asceticism. Therefore, Śākyamuni Buddha said: In this Sa Ba world, there is no place as small as a mote that is not the place where the Buddha gave up his life. [In the text explaining] the eighth of Samantabhadra's ten great vows, [Bodhisattva Samantabhadra said] how does the Buddha save sentient beings in this world? When he wrote scriptures to benefit sentient beings, there was no paper, so he peeled off the skin from his body to make paper, broke his own bones to make a pen, and used the blood from his body to make ink. That's how he wrote the scriptures. When we study the sutras, we must have such a respectful mind, thinking about the Buddha in the past who, to save us, practiced those austerities. When we hear about such a state, fear will arise: He sacrificed himself to feed the tiger, cut [his own] flesh to feed the eagle [to save the pigeon being chased by the eagle].

We've all heard stories like this; When you think about it, you will feel panic. The Buddha practiced Almsgiving, Precepts, Patience, Diligence, Meditation, and Wisdom, all of which were not easy to achieve. It's not because you practice for a day or two, it's because you've practiced for a long time that you can achieve it!

(Sutra) Offering offerings to immeasurable things, Buddhas, Bodhisattvas, Sravakas, offering sacrifices to sentient beings, thirst for illness fake death.
(Sutra: Having served countless Buddhas, Bodhisattvas, Shravakas, and saved sentient beings and others hunger, thirst, illness, death).

Praying from above, turning from below: Looking towards all Buddhas to seek Dharma, making offerings to all Buddhas, making offerings to sages and monks. I also want to save sentient beings. “Help” is to help all sentient beings, to sacrifice oneself to save others.

packaging.
(Sutra: Originally for the sake of sentient beings, he sacrificed many lives. Originally just for the Dharma, sacrificed many bones, blood, skin).

For the benefit of sentient beings, one sacrifices one's own life to benefit others. This is a complete contrast to us. We always hurt the lives of others to protect our own lives. Mouths fluttering, "I'm for everyone like this and that", actually, everyone is for me! In the past, the generals who uttered those words were exactly the same. In the past, there was a verse: “When one general attacks a city, ten thousand bones dry up” (If one general achieves industrial success, many people will die). A famous general, do you know how many people had to die to succeed him? On the battlefield, sacrificing many people helped him achieve, that is karma. But the Buddha is in complete contrast, for sentient beings, he sacrificed his own life for many lifetimes, not just in one or two lifetimes. Buddha once spent many lifetimes for a sentient being, sacrificing his own life to save that person. For the sake of seeking the Dharma and preserving the Dharma, he could use his own skin as paper, his bones as a pen, and his blood as ink. Bodhisattva Samantabhadra Bodhisattva's eighth great vow said so.

(Sutra) Self-peaceful discharge lac, compassion sensitive not belonging emotional, specialized not yet sentient beings, need to practice to cut off Or hammock.
(Sutra: Abandon one's own peace, have mercy on sentient beings, specialize for sentient beings, diligently cultivate the net Or).

He did not seek peace and joy for himself, but specialized in helping sentient beings achieve happiness, just like Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, every Bodhisattva, every Buddha is like that. Although the world of Ultimate Bliss is good, Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva does not stay in the world of Ultimate Bliss, but goes to the Sa Ba world to save sentient beings. The Flower Store world of Śākyamuni Buddha is a pure land. He came to the world of Flower Adornment to manifest, to the world of Sa Ba to save suffering sentient beings. The lifespan in other Buddha lands is eighty-four thousand years, sometimes eighty thousand years, or forty thousand years; Śākyamuni Buddha's lifespan is only one hundred years!

(Sutra) Virtuous household of the six senses, always far from all desires, contemplating the conditioned, impermanent, suffering, emptiness, non-existence ego nature. All suffering karma increases, the stage of craving is the cause, the roots of the six roots are fixed, and all desires are forever cut off.
(Sutra: Skillfully preserve the six senses, always stay away from desires. Contemplate the conditioned, impermanent, suffering, emptiness, non-self nature. The growth of suffering and craving are all causes. So cut off the first six senses, forever end all desires).

Buddha saw that living beings were increasing their suffering. Why does karma increase? Because the cause is craving. Using craving as the cause, one feels great suffering as a result of suffering. You must recognize and carefully preserve your own six senses. The six senses are eyes, ears, nose, tongue, body, and mind. Be careful, don't be careless, don't commit crimes, don't give up all kinds of desires. Stay away from all desires. Contemplate all conditioned dharmas: All dharmas in the world, whether tangible or form, are impermanent. Contemplate all dharmas as impermanent, contemplate all dharmas as suffering, contemplate all dharmas as emptiness. Suffering karma increases, do you know how that suffering happens? It is because of craving that it is the cause, because of craving that it exists. Therefore, in the six senses of eyes, ears, nose, tongue, body, and mind, if desire and desire are cut off, suffering will not increase. Suffering karma cannot increase, you will not have to suffer. Here, the Buddha appears to educate all sentient beings, praising the Buddha for using this method to teach and save sentient beings.

(Sutra) In the universal world of sentient beings, always abiding in great compassion, although overcoming Bodhi, the child is not forgiving. pray.
