(Sutra: Courageous, diligent, endless vows. Because of that great compassion that is steadfast and indestructible, Be strong, diligent, and endlessly vow to increase your power. In one day or night, or in the span of one meal, you can save countless hundreds of thousands of sentient beings, causing them to be liberated from all kinds of suffering, and making all legitimate wishes fulfilled wherever you wish, if sentient beings who are oppressed by all kinds of wishes can single-mindedly recite the name, chant, and take refuge. Admiring, respecting, and making offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva, all legitimate wishes will be achieved, leaving all sorrows and sufferings, depending on the appropriate nature, placing them in the path of birth to heaven or Nirvana).

thirst property force, property

The ability to recite the name, chant, pay respects, and make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva will necessarily attain the dharma one seeks, the food is abundant, according to one's needs, the wisdom of heavenly birth, the path of Nirvana.

(Sutra: Anywhere, if sentient beings are suffering from hunger and thirst, they can sincerely confess name, chant, worship, respect, and make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat, all wishes will be achieved in accordance with the Dharma, food will be abundant, according to their nature, and they will be placed in the path of heavenly birth, Nirvana).

These words all have the same meaning [as the previous passage].

(Sutra) Depending on the country, there are weaknesses. Love, Dharma with a small variety of clothes, treasures, medicine, preparation, preparing tools, having the ability to single-mindedly recite the name, chant, pay homage, make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva, necessarily attain the dharma sought, clothes, treasures, medicine, preparation, access to personal tools, unattached, according to the dharma, peace of mind in rebirth, Nirvana religion. Depending on the place, all sentient beings, love and ridicule are separated, resentment is gathered together, with the ability to recite the name, chant, pay homage, and make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva, necessarily attain the assembly of love and ridicule, resentment and resentment are separated, according to the time of acceptance, peace of mind is born in heaven, the path of Nirvana.
(Sutra: Anywhere, if sentient beings lack clothes, precious ornaments, medicine Yen, bed, linen, and other necessary items, so that one can wholeheartedly recite, chant, worship, and make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat, all the legitimate wishes will be achieved. The clothes, jewelry, medicine, bed, linen, and other necessary items are not complete, according to their nature, they will be placed in the path of heavenly birth, Nirvana, wherever they are. Those who love and love must be separated, those who hate and hate must be gathered together, but can wholeheartedly confess the name, chant, admire, respect, and make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva, then all will be gathered by those who love, separate from those who hate, and according to their nature, they will be placed in the path of heavenly birth, Nirvana).

That is suffering. Love but can't gather, haters don't want to meet but can't. That's called "resentment meets suffering, love separates suffering". If you sincerely recite and chant Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, the sufferings of separation and resentment will naturally disappear and be placed in peace in the path of heavenly birth, Nirvana.

(Sutra) Depending on the place, sentient beings are weak, their body and mind are suffering, they are mentally ill, they have no ability even their mind. name, recite, pay homage to, and make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and Mahasattva, they will definitely attain peace in body and mind, eliminate all diseases, satisfy them at any time, attain peace and attain heavenly birth, the path to Nirvana.
(Sutra: Anywhere, if sentient beings, body and mind are suffering, are bothered by diseases brain, but can single-mindedly confess the name, chant, admire, respect, and make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva, then all will be happy in body and mind, all diseases will be cleansed, worthy of the nature, placed in peace on the path of heavenly birth, Nirvana).

The above passages praise Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Surely everyone will be skeptical: According to those scriptures, just by reciting the holy name Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, we can achieve everything we lack, get whatever we wish for, and even become Buddha. [Need to remember]: According to what the scriptures have taught, as long as you single-mindedly recite the name Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, when Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva enters samadhi, He will bless you. In every sutra there is “willed mind”, don't throw away those two words “willed mind”. If you lose “will”, this passage will have problems. He taught: It is necessary to “have the ability and the will to call the false name” (to be able to call the name with the whole heart). Everyone worships, before each sentence there is "willingness to confess the name". Everyone worships, before each sentence there are two words “one mind”. Therefore, we should not have problems with our faith.

What is the problem with faith? [If you wonder]: "The Buddha told Good Doubting Bodhisattva that Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva has so much merit, why do I follow it but the effect is different? Is the Buddha lying or not?" As in the above section, He taught [single-mindedness], but because you don't do that, it won't be effective! Among your ten thousand recitations, is there a single one that is sincere? As long as there's one sentence, it's fine. Therefore, there are times when it is very compatible, which also means that at that time, your mind is very pure. Is there any way to achieve it? Everyone must definitely practice visualization, visualize Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, as for the method of visualization, we will talk about it in the next section.

When it comes to cultivating concentration and tranquility, when you want to visualize, how should you apply it? You will gradually be able to correspond, authentically correspond. The Buddha did not say a single false sentence, nor did he have a single sentence to deceive us. If it doesn't work, why would He deceive us? Buddha and Bodhisattva are not like that. But we followed the method taught in the Buddhist scriptures, so why didn't we achieve results? Because basically you don't study properly. You identify yourself as a disciple of Buddha, and are also practicing; But basically you don't study, you don't do what you've been taught!

For example, in the twelfth chapter of the Ksitigarbha Sutra, Śākyamuni Buddha told Guan Yin Bodhisattva (Avalokiteśvara): If your memory is poor and you cannot read and recite the Buddhist sutras, it is because the obscurations have not yet been eliminated, so offer a bowl of water in front of the statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Early this morning, he made offerings, and early the next morning, he poured out that cup of water and drank it. After drinking, wash the bowl, then worship again and drink the offered water. After that, you must be cautious and sincere. Therefore, Buddha taught that within twenty-one days, do not kill, abstain from alcohol, meat, sexual misconduct, and lying. Ordinary people can do these things, and disciples of the Three Jewels can do all of these things, but they can't do it with all their heart and mind to remember the title of Great Sage! Therefore, there is no correspondence!

We have just explained in more depth the so-called “willful thinking of the name of the Great Being”, this is related to what we have just read in the [Ten Chakras] sutra. How do you reach “mindfully reciting the name of the Great Being”? There is effort in it, but there are also a few secrets. To be clear, [actually] nothing is a secret, but when you can't do it, it's still a secret! This must rely on the power of visualization. “The mind” is not recited with the mouth, nor is it seen with the eyes, but contemplated in the mind. There is an old Chinese saying: “A sincere heart will be spiritual” (A sincere heart will be spiritual). If your mind is sincere, even golden stones will crack. Those who study Buddhism have a mind that is less agitated than other people, and it will be easier to become pure.

We follow the teachings in the Buddhist scriptures to do it, or we have not yet reached the goal, have not yet reached the corresponding level, we must find out the reason why? You must check your own thoughts and correct them yourself. If it doesn't work once, if it doesn't work twice, then it's ten times! Why does cultivating require decades of effort? If you do it right, you will immediately become enlightened. Once you become enlightened, you will know that this is what happened. Until you know the original story is like that, it doesn't exist. This principle seems very simple at first glance, but it is very difficult to do! It's easy to say, just use your normal mind to deal with it, but you don't know for sure that normal mind!

Many people ask me: They drank Ksitigarbha water, but there was no good effect! I said: "Someone has achieved good results, you should ask him how he did it?" But it worked well, don't do it again. If you do it again, there will no longer be [that good effect], there will be times of clarity, times of darkness. The minds of sentient beings are sometimes clear, sometimes dark, we cannot decide. Therefore, wisdom is clear and dark, the two sides are always unsteady: Sometimes it is clear, sometimes it is dark; was dark and then restored to its original state of clarity. It is said that “karma is discovered”, sometimes the person becomes clear, the karma disappears. However, no matter what, whenever Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva chants, he absolutely will not fall into the three realms. However, we have to go through some rotation.

Whether the Ksitigarbha Sutra, the Contemplation Sutra, or the Ten Wheels of Kṣitigarbha Sūtra are the same, just by chanting the title of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, now that you have formed a relationship, you will be able to achieve that merit. Because in the Ksitigarbha Sutra, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva himself assured Śākyamuni Buddha of that. He said: “For all [living beings] in the End of the Age, as long as you have a little good root in the Buddha Dharma, even if it's as small as a strand of hair, you will definitely save that person”. Thus, relying on Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's divine power will have no problem. However, you should not wait for Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva to come to you because of that sentence! You still have to try your best! Otherwise, the time will be very long.

Now we just recite the scriptures once. The principles mentioned in the above scriptures are very deep, you should read them first. If you really want to study the Ten Chakra Sutra, then in the next part, wait until it comes to the second volume, using Buddha's Ten Chakras to treat our Ten Chakras. Regarding the scriptures in the following two books, let's use a little skill, that's where we practice. Above is the Self-Part, first of all, praising the merits of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva for your mind to focus on: “Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is truly inconceivable!” In your heart, a very sincere feeling will arise, if you study it, it will be easy to enter.

The Buddha praised Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's merits again, but in many great Dharma conferences, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva rarely attended. Manjushri Bodhisattva and Guan Yin Bodhisattva (Avalokiteśvara) are often on either side of the Buddha, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva rarely comes! Only when it is related to Him that it is necessary to initiate a dharma conference will He attend. Many Dharma conferences do not include Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Why? He must appear everywhere in many Buddha lands. What is his name? Not necessarily called Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva has countless millions of names, His Concentration is also countless memories, [even] His name is also countless millions of Concentrations. Also, which Bodhisattva would be Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva? We went to Wutai Mountain to worship Manjushri Bodhisattva. Who is Manjushri Bodhisattva? You meet so many people! In fact, every day we meet Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, or Ksitigarbha is next to us every day, we just don't know it! Therefore, you just keep reciting it. When you recite the Ksitigarbha Sutra, when you think of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is already in your mind.

This passage mentions Good Doubting Bodhisattva because he did not explain it, nor had he ever heard of it, but in this dharma conference, he met and also heard about [Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva]. First of all, the Buddha praised the merits of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva; After that, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva used a mysterious verse to praise the Buddha's merits. Good Question Bodhisattva felt that Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva was inconceivable, so he asked: "When did Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva sow good roots? Which Buddha realm is Bodhisattva in now? Is that Buddha realm far or near from our Saha world? In his past life, what good roots did Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva plant, as well as what merits did he practice?" Good Questioning Bodhisattva asked the Buddha [those questions]. At first, the Buddha did not respond, because if he said it, he was afraid that sentient beings would be skeptical and not believe him, so the Buddha immediately said "forget it". Because Good Doubt Bodhisattva asked for instructions again, the Buddha taught it. That is in the Ten Wheels of Kṣitigarbha Sūtra, Śākyamuni Buddha praised Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva.

In addition, we see in the Ksitigarbha Sutra, or look at the Sutra on Contemplation of Good and Evil Karma, [will know] that Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva practiced for a long time. At the same time, the Buddha did not elaborate. His introduction to the Bodhisattva Good Doubt was just a brief summary! In that part, first of all, talk about the Concentration subjects entered by Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. “Concentration” means observation. Only through Concentration can Hue be born. When we have something going on, we say "wait for me to calm down and think", which has that meaning. Because Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is everywhere, all places are where he resides. He abides freely in the Buddha realms. Didn't Good Question Bodhisattva ask [Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva] "in which Buddha realm do you reside and how far is it from here?" The Buddha replied: “Wherever he resides in the Buddha land, that place is the land for Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva to practice the Bodhisattva path”. It's not just the Sa Ba world, it's not just the world of Ultimate Bliss, it's not just the world of the Eastern Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata! As long as there are three disciples, there will be Him.

Therefore, in many Mahayana sutras, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is rarely present. That's the problem: Is He really not here? No! It's just that his name is not Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Depending on the realm that has appeared, depending on the body that has appeared, He has other names!

This passage says that He entered a total of twenty-three types of Concentration; Actually, it's just a brief outline. In the Ksitigarbha Sutra, or the Contemplation of Good and Evil Karma Sutra, he entered Samadhi even more. Every morning, I enter hundreds of thousands of billions of billions of Dharma gates. First, use Concentration to move, then use wisdom to save, that is, first use Concentration to observe for a while, then use wisdom to save sentient beings.

In this world, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is especially predestined to the Sa Ba world. According to the meaning of the scriptures, we in this world should have attained salvation, so why are we still suffering so much? It must still be due to fate. We recite the holy name Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva every day! I quote two sentences from the sutra spoken by Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva himself: There are many sentient beings who have not yet seen and heard my name, “no literary name, nothing but mysterious thoughts?” [meaning]: Even my name has not been heard, how can they recite my name? Regarding this point, [probably] we will be skeptical: "We recite every day, why do we still not hear the holy name Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva?"

The Sutra of Contemplating Good and Evil Karma says this: “Be single-minded”. When using the Contemplation Wheel [to see how deep and shallow your own karma is], you must be single-minded. Without sincerity, one will not hear the name Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, nor does it correspond to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Kien Tinh Bodhisattva asked Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, He said: "All sentient beings want to learn the Dharma of repentance, if they want to worship Ksitigarbha Repentance, they must be single-minded. If you cannot be single-minded, any phenomenon will not be achieved, even 'if you don't hear my name, how can you contemplate?' Basically, if you don't hear my name, how can you recite it?" also means "not reciting". It's obvious that I'm reciting, it's obvious that I've seen and heard it, why [do you say] "not reciting"? Because you are not sincere!

The Sutra on Contemplation of Good and Evil Karma says: "If those beings learn to repent, they will not be able to set their mind, they will not achieve a good appearance, they will not receive thoughts, they will not attain the precepts" (If those beings, although they learn to repent, will not be able to have a sincere heart, will not attain a good appearance, even if considered [correct] I] have received the precepts, but still have not attained the precepts). Nothing can be achieved! When we study the Dharma, we often do not follow the Dharma to do it! Having received the Three Refuges, but you do not practice the Three Refuges, can you still be considered a disciple of Buddha? Is accepting the Five Precepts, not keeping the Five Precepts, considered attaining the precepts? That's what the meaning is!

Bodhisattva Firm and Pure Faith (Dṛḍhamati) asked Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva: "You said, you said, "Do you mean single-mindedness?" When Kien Tinh Bodhisattva asked like that, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva replied: "Good man! When I talk about single-mindedness, there are generally two types. What are the two? One is when you first learn and pray with a single-minded mind, the second is a single-minded intention, the corresponding achievement is a strong single-minded mind. Having these two types of single-mindedness, you will be able to achieve good form. The second type of single-mindedness has a lower, middle, and upper mind, three different things". Because of the passage I just read, everyone will be able to know the importance of single-mindedness. In the following part of the Ten Wheels of Kṣitigarbha Sūtra, it will also be explained. The previous part only talks about the Bodhisattva's merits in general, and does not talk about the truths that he accomplished. But when studying the sutras, you must first find the meaning in that sutra, explore the contradictions between the sutras, resolve the areas you think are contradictory, resolve your doubts first, then you can be sincere, penetrate, can be saved, only correspond to the Bodhisattva's vows, correspond to what you desire.

If you don't follow the Dharma, you don't follow the Dharma, then you study the Dharma but don't follow the Dharma. It is our common disease. Studying the sutras without following the sutras, how can this be explained? There are many people who study Buddhism. Buddha taught them how to do things, but they don't do them like that. After that, he still harbored resentment and criticized Buddhism for not being spiritual. It's not that you're not spiritual, it's that you don't follow it, or you don't follow the dharma, you must follow the dharma. There are things that can be understood in terms of reason, but in terms of facts, it is absolutely impossible! Therefore, after understanding this principle, we clearly understand why we spend all day worshiping and reciting Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's name, but it seems like our wishes are still not satisfied.

In the Bodhisattva's blessing, there are also very clear phenomena, whether in a dream, or seeing Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's blessing, your accident will immediately disappear, you can immediately understand clearly, your mind will open up and understand, or your karma will disappear. That is called “minh gia” (clear blessing), very clear! There is also a type of “mighty family”, which means to silently bless and guide you step by step. If the blessing is clear, the Bodhisattva has wisdom, we do not have wisdom, we will easily be arrogant, or if you dream of seeing a good appearance and light, you will announce that you are blessed everywhere to gain fame and gain: "Last night, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva released light before me, I was very happy." As soon as the other person heard it, he said, "You have achieved something." He quickly took out the red envelope and offered it to you. What a failure! You have fallen! Therefore, when praying, you must definitely understand this type of sublime understanding! No matter which sutra you study, you must study according to the Dharma, and don't skim over it.

[Someone will probably wonder]: Isn't that what [the ancestors often] say “sudden enlightenment”? Sudden enlightenment is not separate from the practice (practicing in the Truth). Don't see people becoming enlightened, just hearing it and understanding it [but thinking it's easy]; After that, they achieve the supreme understanding, the pure universal form, not because of [only practicing] in this life, but because of many lifetimes of practice! We see workers using tools very skillfully, finishing work in a blink of an eye. When you do it, your head is sweaty, you're still groping, you don't understand how to do it! They also make things that are not worthy of being called secondary products. The morals are exactly the same! First of all, you must understand this principle, then you listen to the verses in this sutra, and are blessed by the power of the Bodhisattva's concentration. Until the Bodhisattva lives in any country, anywhere, there are many sentient beings who can gain benefits. The main quarter

you will be able to feel it!

[If you say] “I don't see”, why do I feel that way? Why does the scripture say that? The two sides don't seem to correspond. You should understand this principle: You don't even have the bare minimum of making a vow! Only with a sincere heart of interest, upon hearing [the merits of] Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, he was very moved; That is just the mind's desire, it has not yet reached the level of ambition! Willpower has a certain level. Having developed a determined mind, like a strong, diligent mind, it is still divided into three minds. Reach deep in your heart: “Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is me, I am Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva”. Visualize like that and it will correspond. Naturally you will attain a completely different realm. If we hear about Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, we can reach the point of "letting go of everything and leaving everything to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva", we still haven't been able to do it!

Based on the requirements in the Sutra of Contemplation of Good and Evil Karma, when using the wheel of appearances, how one should worship, follow the Dharma, whatever one prays for, it is necessary to have vigor, that is, to be strong and dedicated, to repent for twenty-four hours, regardless of day and night, chanting names and chanting. Ksitigarbha Sutra, bowing one's head in worship. It's not enough to just follow the text and bow once and you're done! Must be done continuously, with certain requirements! But for us ordinary people, for our physical strength and our current body and mind, if we follow the Bodhisattva's regulations, we cannot do it. Then there will be blessings. You just need to really do it and you will be blessed.

Once upon a time, there was a patriarch. He used his own life to practice. Because he liked to fall asleep and was extremely lethargic, he put himself in a position where he was bound to die. Everyone was afraid of death, so he went to sit quietly on a cliff to see if he was still asleep or not. If you fall asleep, you will fall with a thud, if you fall you will surely die! Can doing so control afflictions? No success! He sat still, but could not maintain it, so he fell over. Vi Da Bodhisattva immediately pulled him up. He asked: "Who protects the dharma? Who saved me?" Vi Da Dharma protector told him: "I am Vi Da Bodhisattva, come to protect you." As soon as he heard that, he became arrogant and said: "In Nam Thiem Bo Chau, there are only a few people who practice like me, I'm afraid!" Vida Bodhisattva said: "I have met too many people like you, as many as cow hair. If someone has an arrogant mind like you, I will protect and maintain the dharma for you in ten lifetimes. During ten lifetimes I will not protect you." Vida Bodhisattva immediately disappeared.

He thought: "At first, I didn't ask you to protect the dharma. It's good if you protect the dharma, it's okay if you don't protect the dharma. I still practice like that." He sat again. Sitting for a long time could not sustain him, his body was limited, he fell down again, Vi Da Bodhisattva saved him. [Patriarch wondered]: "Isn't it true that you don't protect me? Why do you protect me?" Vida Bodhisattva said: "One thought of yours has transcended ten lifetimes. I said ten lifetimes cannot protect you, but one thought of your diligent mind has transcended ten lifetimes." When we encounter danger or are in difficult circumstances, do thoughts arise that transcend ten lifetimes? It is often said that “let go of your body and mind”, do we let it go or not? I understand very clearly!

Based on the passage of the Buddha's answer to the Bodhisattva's Good Doubts in the Ten Wheels of Kṣitigarbha Sūtra, [it will be seen] that this is not Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva praising his own merits, but rather what the Buddha said. The Buddha said: That good man, right in the land where he lives, due to the power of concentration, the power of vows, the power of compassion, the power of religion, wherever he is, that place will be auspicious. However, the sentient beings in that place must also have their hearts and minds corresponding to Him. If you don't correspond, you still won't achieve it! But there are places where it is said, as in the twelfth chapter of the Ksitigarbha Sutra, the Buddha told Guan Yin Bodhisattva (Avalokiteśvara): "This Ksitigarbha is especially predestined to sentient beings in this world. As long as sentient beings have a wish, sentient beings have thoughts, they will all be blessed", there are no such strict requirements. Furthermore, in the thirteenth chapter of the Ksitigarbha Sutra, the Buddha finally entrusted: "To the sentient beings of the Dharma-Ending Age, you must definitely use your divine power and vows to help and protect them".

Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva immediately vowed: "In the Dharma-Ending Age, those who only need to have a little good root in the Buddha Dharma, even if it is a mote or a drop of water, I will definitely save that person and make that person liberated". Compared to the corresponding determination just mentioned above, combining both sides to see, [you will understand] that when studying the Dharma, you cannot be attached to writing or language. Otherwise, you will be discouraged and unable to have a sincere heart.

Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva said: “If I have a little merit equal to a mote, or a drop of water in Buddhism, I will save it all”, [yet] now I have a lot of merit in Buddhism, not just a drop of water, why doesn't Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva save me? You give birth to such thoughts of resentment! Regarding Buddhism, we must look at every aspect, always practice, we must look at it like that.

(Sutra) Depending on the place, all sentient beings have weaknesses, mutual behavior, rise and fight, ability and determination name, recite, pay homage to, make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and Mahasattva, necessarily attain the release of toxic mind, harmonize with each other, be happy and patient, develop precious repentance, be kind to each other, follow each other's wishes, attain heavenly rebirth, the path of Nirvana.
(Sutra: Anywhere, if sentient beings oppose each other, conflicts arise, disputes, but can wholeheartedly confess the name, chant, admire, respect, and make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva, all will abandon harmful thoughts, be at peace with each other, joyfully endure, regret and be shy at times, treat each other with compassion, and according to their meritorious nature, place them in the path of heavenly birth, Nirvana).

This passage has a very easy to understand meaning, no need to explain. Everyone knows very clearly: In the present, we always have all these phenomena, how can we escape, so that Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva will place us in the path of heavenly birth, Nirvana? Must be sincere! I just read [a passage] of the Sutra on Contemplating Good and Evil Karma, I wonder if everyone has forgotten it or not? We must study, that is, learn to make a sincere vow. If you don't study, you won't achieve your ambition. Most of us have a scattered mind, a dull mind, this has a great relationship with faith. We must cultivate faith. Believing in the Dharma deeply and unwaveringly is very difficult! No matter how to say it, I'm afraid my friends will still say "Is that true?" Just leave a question mark: "Why can't I achieve it?" Many people have this question mark, not bothering to ask themselves to what level their own ambition has reached? Because you don't have the will and don't correspond to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, you won't be able to achieve that situation. This is talking about the path of heavenly birth, Nirvana, but also about eliminating disasters and avoiding disasters, which is more or less still possible!

Based on my personal experience, since coming to America, Dharma Master Hoang Giac and I both understand: Anyone who comes to the Buddha's hall to rejoicing and worship will gain certain benefits; However, it is not a radical and ultimate benefit! Because his mind is not thorough, he cannot achieve radical benefits. Sometimes he prays for something, or prays for his children's accidents to be eliminated. Once his children's accidents are eliminated, he no longer believes or does anything. Thus, the path of heavenly birth and Nirvana will not be achieved! Furthermore, comparing the two, the worldly view is especially heavy, and the mind of renunciation is especially light; What is heavy becomes heavier and heavier, what is light becomes lighter and lighter!

I see many friends like that. In one year, everyone changes greatly. What we can do is advise and inspire them. When we worship together, once we achieve our goal, they will no longer worship, and we will also separate from each other: "Ah! I will bow at home and listen!" I said: "Don't lie to me! Who are you bowing to at home?" "No! I'm still chanting!" I don't know what to recite! We should not deceive ourselves! If you want to deceive ghosts and gods, you won't be able to deceive them! Can you fool the Bodhisattva? Bodhisattva is right in your heart. If your mind is spiritual, your career will be spiritual. That is your own mind. In the next part, we will explain that Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is our own mind.

In the previous section, I said: “Earth” is our center of gravity. “Tang” is “secret organ” (hidden). Our mind includes those things. Anyway, those two aspects are both Emptiness; But Emptiness is not empty, but it can turn into merit and virtue, and can also turn into all sorrow and affliction, depending on how you understand it!

(Sutra) Depending on the place, weak sentient beings, trapped in prison, women, precepts, old age, exile, control system During this period of time, you can endure the sufferings of all beings, have the power to recite the name, chant, pay homage to, and make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and Mahasattva, and you will definitely attain liberation from prison, poverty, precepts, old age, and enlightenment. You will be free and happy, and at any time, you will be able to attain peace and attain rebirth in heaven, the path of Nirvana.
(Sutra: Anywhere, if sentient beings, are locked up in prisons, chains, The shackles and chains that tightly bind the body and endure all kinds of sufferings, but can wholeheartedly recite the name, chant, worship, respect, and make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva, then all the prisons, shackles, fetters, and chains will be liberated, free and happy, and according to their meritorious nature, they will be placed in the path of heavenly birth, Nirvana).

Release the calamity of prison, escape the suffering of being chained; Once liberated, you will be free and happy. But there is also a problem here, what is the problem? Our concept of time is different from Buddha's concept of time. The Buddhas see it as a moment, testing you, but you feel it has been decades. I personally understand this deeply, maybe everyone else doesn't understand this. Because you have never been in prison, nor have you been in prison for such a long time, but who doesn't have sorrow and suffering? I see everyone has it. Even if you have a lot of money, even if you are an emperor or a prime minister, if you do not achieve your goals, you will still suffer. Having gained power, fear of losing it. Having wealth, fear of losing it. Such sadness, think of every measure to preserve it.

You have great wealth, chant Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, pray that the wealth will not be lost, can you keep it like that? Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's arrangements will not be the same as you think, and perhaps your wealth will disappear a little faster! Why is that? Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva wishes to cultivate blessings for you, and does not let you keep those things, these things are poisonous snakes! You think that Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is not spiritual; In fact, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is very spiritual. He blesses you so that you can avoid accidents. Even while we complain, we often gain benefits! “Freely and happily, depending on the time, the path of heavenly birth, Nirvana” (Freely happy, depending on the nature that should be saved, rest on the path of heavenly birth, Nirvana): However, when Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva saves sentient beings, His ultimate goal is to make you achieve the unborn, immortal path of Nirvana. Being born into heaven is also a process, isn't it the joy you hope to achieve? Being born in heaven is much more joyful than the joy in the human world. That is no worries, no sorrow, no more sorrow forever. If you practice again to become a Buddha, it will be even better!

(Sutra) Depending on the place, weak sentient beings, like being imprisoned, immortals are tortured, are trapped Harmful, with the ability to recite the name, chant, pay homage to, and make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva, you will definitely attain freedom from bondage, immortality, family harm, and according to your wishes, you will be able to attain heavenly birth, the path of Nirvana. Depending on the place, all sentient beings, their bodies and minds are entangled, their energy and energy are meditative, they have the ability to single-mindedly recite names, chant, pay respects, and make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva, they will definitely attain joy in body and mind, their energy will be strong, and at any time, they will be able to attain heavenly birth, the path of Nirvana.
(Sutra: Wherever, if sentient beings, deserve to be imprisoned, beaten, tortured, To correct the harmed person, one can single-mindedly recite the name, chant, worship, respect, and make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and Mahasattva. All will be freed from imprisonment, beatings, and harm. Depending on their ability to be saved, they will be able to rest in the path of rebirth, Nirvana, wherever they are. If sentient beings, their bodies and minds are tired, their energy is exhausted, they can whole-heartedly recite the name, recite, worship, respect, and make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Tat Ma Ha Tat, all are comfortable in body and mind, at ease, with strong vitality, depending on the base they should be saved, and are placed in peace in the path of heavenly birth, Nirvana).

Buddha told Hao Doubt Bodhisattva: "You ask me about the merits of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva? I told you every single thing like that." That's still just a little part, because the suffering of sentient beings is so great. Each individual's body is different, and there are too many afflictions. Therefore, even though I say something like that, it is still just a general outline.

“Depending on the place” (Anywhere): Whenever you say “depending place at place”, you are talking about Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Wherever Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is, sentient beings in that place can avoid suffering. Body and mind fatigue means internal fatigue, physical fatigue, extreme fatigue! People have to work several jobs and also have to go to school. I'm in the US, and I've seen people work two jobs and still have to go to school. Go to school in the evening, go to work in the morning. There are people who are very happy, have a prosperous family life, and can afford to send them to school. There are people who are very miserable. When they come to America, they have to earn and work to support themselves. Some people even live crowded together in one room. I'm in New York, I heard that there are a few people renting a bed together, three people, he uses eight hours, I use eight hours, the other person uses eight hours. During these eight hours, I go to work while he sleeps; Eight hours later, it's someone else's turn to go to work. Three people share one bed like that. That's the truth, not a joke! Some people's houses are very large and airy. Why? That's due to one person's blessings, another person's bad karma. If we say it's very unequal, then it's actually very equal. We heard that story and felt very equal. That's karma! You create your own karma, you suffer it yourself, you can't escape it! If that person sincerely recites Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, perhaps they will change.

People who are in the midst of suffering will easily give rise to ambition. Once achieved, the ambition disappears and changes again! Pray for your body to be a little stronger. Once your body is truly a little stronger, you will immediately forget about the Bodhisattva and let it go again. Everyone has this problem, I have it too! When I was in prison, I thought of Buddha and the Three Jewels. Just out of prison, it's not like that anymore, it's not like every thought [of the Three Jewels] comes to mind. In prison, it was miserable, very stressful, and there was nothing else to do, my mind was so focused on thinking. As soon as I got out, there were so many things, so many happy things, I forgot all about Buddha's life, I couldn't think like that anymore. That's natural. Unless you successfully cultivate Concentration, you will achieve the status of No Regression! Otherwise, all living beings are the same!

Or if you have no energy, pray to the Bodhisattva to increase a little more energy. I am very grateful to Bodhisattva, from the time he was in prison until now, he has not had any illness in his entire life. I'm eighty-one years old this year, almost eighty-two years old, and I still feel very energetic. You listen to me, you still have energy. How will the Bodhisattva bless you? Not getting sick is enough! Therefore, why should every Dharma friend repay Buddha's kindness and Bodhisattva's kindness? Because they have blessed me so much, I am enjoying the blessings without knowing it! Today, I watched TV and saw that a tornado hit four US states, causing a total loss of twenty-eight billion dollars. Twenty-eight billion US dollars is not a small number. If a tornado passes through like that, there will be no place to stay. Yesterday was very happy, the storm passed, today is not happy anymore, waiting for salvation, having to wait! You are suffering, waiting for help, very miserable! Although you all see such phenomena in the world, you all have a kind of good-luck mentality: "It's not my turn yet." Everyone has this idea: "It's not my turn yet, maybe I won't get hurt." Disciples of the Three Jewels must always attribute all merit to the Three Jewels, the Three Jewels will bless us, making us still strong. If you sincerely recite the name Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, your body and mind will be comfortable, relaxed, and your energy will be strong.

(Sutra) Depending on the place, all sentient beings are weak, all the bases are uninstrumental, all things are damaged, the mind is capable of calling name, recite, pay homage to, and make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and Mahasattva, they will necessarily attain complete roots, without damage, depending on the season, attaining peace and rebirth in heaven, the path of Nirvana.
(Sutra: Wherever, if sentient beings, their senses are not enough, there are places that are damaged, but can single-mindedly recite the name, chant, admire, respect, and make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat, all of which will have complete faculties, not damaged, depending on the nature of the faculties that should be saved, and placed in peace on the path of heavenly birth, Nirvana).

For these sentences, I have the following way of thinking: Is it true that people with six damaged, incomplete organs will immediately grow back or not, or will the amputated leg grow another leg? That's not what it means! Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva blesses you, using a different method to bless you, so that after you die, you will be reincarnated again [with a complete body]. There is another type: That person is truly a person whose six senses are not perfect, a blind person suddenly sees the way, a deaf person suddenly hears a sound. This has been proven by specific cases. When we came here a few years ago, there was a little girl wearing hearing aids who was speechless. Less than a year ago, she could talk and studied very well. She had only chanted Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva a little, but her chanting force was very sincere, her mind was pure and unadulterated. That's a ten year old child, from Kaohsiung, there's someone here who can prove it. That's the truth. That is Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva eliminating the "six imperfect senses" for her, placing her in the path of heavenly birth, Nirvana, and still having to continue to practice. Therefore, the senses are empty

But at the end of each paragraph [explaining the help of] the suffering [of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva], there is one condition: You must wholeheartedly confess the name, chant, worship, respect, and also make offerings. As soon as everyone heard about making offerings, they thought they had to spend money, not necessarily! The best offering is the dharma offering, that is, using the holy name to make offerings. When you make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, you can either recite the Contemplation Sutra, or recite the Ksitigarbha Sutra, or use Dharma to make offerings. There is also a way to use your mind to make offerings. If you don't have a lot of money, or if you have money, but have no way to get out, then just think of going to the flower shop, or the fruit shop, and you'll be fine. Someone asked me: "Master! Isn't doing this a crime of theft?" I said: "You don't take anything from anyone, so what's the point of breaking the precept of stealing?" The precept of stealing is when someone takes something from its place [without permission], then you commit the precept of theft. And this is the change in your mind, why break the precepts and steal? You think the fruits are better than their fruits, they are born from ideas. Born from thoughts, it is a dharma of offerings, that is, a way of making offerings by thoughts. That is the offering method in “extensive practice of offering” of Samantabhadra's ten great vows.

Therefore, when making offerings, you can use the method of offering, but I must warn everyone: Don't be too greedy, you can't let go of anything, just think "I recite a few sutras, the method of offering has already been accomplished", not even a penny is spent, not even a little effort comes out, it's gone wrong! Because the dharma needs to be combined with the Truth, in a forced situation, there is no other way, you will use the dharma to make offerings. But if you have the power to do it, you must rely on Truth to express the Dharma so that Truth and Truth can be unobstructed. If I didn't say that, someone would probably curse me for calling on people to not spend money to make offerings to the Three Jewels, to just use their thoughts to make offerings. What can the monks in the temple eat? Therefore, we must combine the two, don't get sidetracked! When you listen to the Dharma, ten thousand times, don't give birth to Dharma Clinging. If you speak like this, you will be attached like this; If you say it like that, you will be attached like that, it will be very troublesome. You can't learn, and even if you try to learn, you won't be able to! You must understand this principle!

(Sutra) Depending on the place, sentient beings are weak, crazy, mentally deranged, possessed by demons, capable of willful thinking Confessing the name, chanting, paying homage to, and making offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and Mahasattva, you will definitely attain a mind free from distractions, free from all distractions, and according to your wishes, attain peace and be born in heaven, the path of Nirvana.
(Sutra: Wherever, if sentient beings, crazy, deranged, possessed by demons, But if you can single-mindedly recite the name, chant, admire, respect, and make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and Mahasattva, you will all have a mind free from hysteria, free from disturbances and harm, and depending on your nature, worthy of salvation, will be able to rest in the path of heavenly birth, Nirvana).

This is a hysterical person, suffering from mental illness, this type of illness is not easy to treat. Crazy people are very difficult to treat. There are also people who are influenced by ghosts, this really happens! It is true that there are ghosts in the house (the house is plagued by ghosts). When we encounter them, we chant sutras. Recite the blessing sutra. There is a Taoist friend who said that as soon as he opened the Ksitigarbha Sutra, his grandmother appeared, his grandmother also came, and his six relatives scared him to death. That person also doesn't know what's going on! That is, they look for that person [praying for] salvation. They searched for a long time, but could not find anyone who had the predestined relationship to help them transcend. Therefore, as soon as they recite the Ksitigarbha Sutra, they come to you, don't be afraid. Some people see it in their dreams, some people see it while awake.

In New York, I had a disciple who developed this phenomenon; After that, don't recite the Ksitigarbha Sutra anymore! Before that, that person recited the Ksitigarbha Sutra, drove from home to the company during the day, saw a skull in all four directions, and a tall and large person ran towards his car. He was frightened and dizzy; From then on, I no longer recite the Ksitigarbha Sutra. After that, at home I often encountered similar things, seeing ghosts. When encountering such a thing, you must be steadfast. He didn't believe me. I said, "You have to be steadfast and continue to treat them well." He said: "No more reciting! If you don't reciting, there will be no more." However, there are many of our Dharma friends who recite the Ksitigarbha Sutra, but there is also no one who does not recite it. There are still a lot of people who recite one set every day!

If such a phenomenon arises, single-mindedly chant, admire, respect, and make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva, your mind will recover and will no longer be hysterical! The evil spirits that cause harm and confusion will also disappear! Not only that, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva also teaches you how to study and which methods to use! It's okay to chant sutras, it's also okay to practice the Contemplation Sutra, it's also okay to practice the Ten Wheels of Kṣitigarbha Sūtra, or it's also okay to practice visualization. After that, we will place you in peace on the path of heavenly birth, Nirvana.

(Sutra) Depending on the place, sentient beings are weak, greedy, angry, ignorant, resentful, evil disability, arrogance, evil views, lethargy, heedlessness, suspicion, the stage is bound to flourish, the brain is disordered in body and mind, often not at peace, with the ability to single-mindedly recite the name, chant, pay homage, make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva, necessarily attain liberation from desire and desire, be at peace in body and mind, at any time, be assured of rebirth in heaven, the path of Nirvana.
(Sutra: Anywhere, if sentient beings, greedy, angry, foolish, resentful, stinginess, jealousy, arrogance, arrogance, evil views, lethargy, laziness, doubt, etc. are all illustrious, mind-numbing, mind-numbing, often not at peace, but if one can single-mindedly recite the name, chant, worship, respect, and make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat, then all will be free from desire and desire, etc., body and mind will be at peace, according to the nature that should be saved, and will be placed at rest in the heavenly path of rebirth, Nirvana).

Looseness and doubt are two different things. “Doubt” is skeptical, “loose” means scattered, very lacking in diligence. Diligence contrasts with letting go, which has such an inclusive meaning. If sentient beings have a very heavy mind of desire, a very hot temper, a very heavy mind of anger, there are also foolish people, wrong views, who view things and problems always differently from others. As for Phan, some people even think it's good, and when they're dissatisfied, they scream. Seeing one person oppressing another will give rise to a mind of resentment, one cannot bear to be angry! Everyone thinks that person has a chivalrous demeanor and a strong spirit of justice. Buddhism doesn't say that, because you don't clearly understand the reason, don't understand cause and effect, and don't know what happens. What is the story of the past life, what is the story of the future and the past. Why did that happen? You start complaining because of grievances! I think that's Phan, Phan is discontent. Either because others treat you [unkindly] you become resentful, or when you see other people's things you become resentful. This shows that you have no choice but to hate that person. You want revenge, but you don't fight back, so you keep hatred in your heart. There is no way now, wait for the opportunity “I will deal with you”; this belongs to Hatred.

Xan is stingy and greedy. Even though I have it myself, I refuse to let it go. Envy is being jealous of others. Seeing others letting go, but not being able to let go myself, [so I get jealous]. Or when you see others doing good things, you can't do them yourself, but you're jealous of them, jealous of other people's efforts, and hate talented people. Pride is feeling that you are better than others. Arrogant, if you add the word Female next to it, it will be Kieu (lovely, graceful). Kieu and Man are often related. There are many types of Manh. There is a type where you are not as good as others, but feel that you are superior, this type is called Too Man. There are people who see other people being good and say, "There's nothing interesting! I can do it too!" That is also a type of Man. Actually, that person can't do it, basically doesn't have that ability, and still feels that he is superior to others. This is arrogant!

Evil views are of the stupid type. They have a different way of looking at problems than others, [thinking] "Just eat salty food, no need to worry!" Killing fish, killing shrimp, killing whatever, everyone thinks that those things should be eaten; that is evil view. Harming others, still thinking that it is something worth doing. I heard an old lady say: "Pigs and goats are for people to eat. Pigs and goats are food." [Speaking like that], people leave it to feed the tigers. If pythons, poisonous snakes, or fierce beasts ate you, would you let them eat you? Each person has their own situation. However, their strength could not resist you and you killed them. You don't raise goats, they live in the mountains in their own way. It eats grass, even if you don't feed it, it can still live its way! You catch it and kill it. Raising it in the house [killing it] is still acceptable, but goats living in the mountains, what's the obstacle for you? You think it's worth doing; Those are all evil views.

There is also a type of evil view that always wants to harm others. When I was in prison, there were prisoners who went to prison, still hoping to harm others every day. There are prisoners who specialize in reporting to those who are worse than them. They won't harm others for three days and will be moody! There are many examples of evil views, everyone has them. Don't think that you are very pure! Using this way of understanding to look at the problem, you will see that we all have it. However, after studying Buddhism, I tried to change.

No one can avoid falling asleep. Some people need to sleep for ten hours, some people need to sleep for a few hours. The Buddha taught us to reduce sleep, the more we sleep, the more lethargic we become. As for the situation, just joking, if they don't read the sutras, they won't fall asleep. As soon as I opened my bed, I immediately fell asleep. There are also those who do not meditate and do not sleep. As soon as they meditate, their heads nod immediately. Why? We often say it's karma, that's karma! Sleeping is the Thing because it obscures your intelligence, called Thuy Mien Cai.

There are times when the mind is dull, no matter who has it, I also have it. A few days ago, when I recited the Buddha's name, finished my repentance, and when I meditated, I just finished reciting the holy name, and I felt a little drowsy. Master Hoang Giac reminded me: "Old magician! You fell asleep." I immediately noticed, no way! If you pay attention and wake up mentally, you will feel better. This is not a good thing. Some people advise you to rest a little, sleep for a while and you will feel better immediately. How can sleep get better? Sleeping all the time. You sit quietly for a while, contemplating your mind. When you feel sleepy, you practice contemplation. If you truly meditate on Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva will enter your body and mind. The light of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva will dispel the drowsiness of sleep. Sleeping too much is our fault. Just calculate, how much time do you spend sleeping in your whole life?

Distraction is when you are excited, your mind will be distracted. Playing football is exciting, five or six hours is okay. Tell that person to meditate quietly and practice or recite sutras here. Sitting for just an hour is unbearable! After sitting for half an hour, I felt impatient, restless, and wanted to stand up. If you play ball, play very hard, make that person play for a few hours, it's okay! There are also people who play mahjong; Play all four games, then play four more games, the more you play, the more aggressive you become. Why? Relaxation (indulgence). That is the karma of sentient beings.

Doubt is the biggest obstacle in religious practice, everything is filled with question marks. There are many people who have been used to being deceived by their parents since childhood. When they become adults, no matter what anyone says, they are left with question marks. Therefore, friends who have children, do not deceive them. A child's mind is very naive, no matter what you tell him, he will immediately believe it. Later, he saw that things weren't like that, and from then on, he was skeptical about everything. Especially for those who study Buddhism, if you tell them the holy scenes and merits of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, [they will doubt]: "Why can't I achieve it? This old monk is talking nonsense!" They were skeptical. Doubt is the biggest obstacle in cultivating the path. Why doubt? The opposite of Doubt is Faith. If faith is not complete, there will be doubts. There is doubt about everything, suspicion is that fate and fate are obstructing the path. That situation is very strong.

“Giai Tat xi thang” (All are illustrious): The whole thing is very hot, your mind and body are disturbed, making your body and mind unable to practice the Way, unable to be at peace. Dear friends who suffer from these diseases, when lust, anger, ignorance, anger, stinginess, jealousy, arrogance, arrogance, evil views, lust for sleep, indolence, and doubts arise, you must put them down, be at peace, single-mindedly recite, worship, and respectfully make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. We have experimented with these things. The reason why you have troubles is because you have those things. No matter what happens, whether it is caused by external circumstances, or because we receive a phone call from a disciple, or because something happens to them, if we are moved, we will be as troubled as they are.

There was a period of time when we were in Tam Phan city (San Francisco) in the US, at the time when Mainland China was conducting a test of targeting missiles to Taiwan, we went to buy newspapers and watched Taiwanese television every night. Why? Dharma Master Hoang Giac said: "I see that you are very interested recently", I said: "That's right! Very interested". Since Taiwan has so many disciples who have taken refuge, what will happen to their families? Must pay attention! Whenever you care, you get chaotic. On the Mainland there are many relatives like that, and Taiwan also has many Buddhist friends like that. Therefore, whenever you encounter something you care about, you cannot control it yourself, and naturally you will get confused with it. Please chant Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva! If you recite, you recite, if you pray, you pray, but it feels unspiritual, because on this side you recite with all your might, you pray with all your might, on the other side they still fight with all your might! The truth in front of you will often cause your moral force to decline. This is often called “the force of retreat”.

Normally, when we say No, say Fake, you have to understand for yourself: It's okay for you to say No, say Fake, but when it comes to sentient beings, if you say No, say Fake, will they believe you or not? Over there they are suffering, you here say No. Like fish, we do not understand its language. If you understand its language, you will know its suffering! [You will hear them complaining]: “You guys sat happily on the table, used oil to fry me, used a knife to cut me, and said: 'It's so delicious, really delicious!' And you also pay attention to the taste!” “If you want to know the swords and soldiers of the world, listen to the disciples and sell them at night” (If you want to know the swordsmen in the world, the slaughterhouse, please listen to the sound of midnight). Nowadays, we eat and drink all kinds of things. No matter how much you plan, the homing missiles and airplanes will all fly over! If you try too hard to get in, you will be retaliated against in all sorts of ways! Therefore, when we understand this principle, we should sincerely recite Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's name. In this way, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva can save us from suffering and rest in the path of heavenly birth, Nirvana.

Make a sincere vow. Making a vow can increase our single-mindedness, saying "I hope to save all sentient beings, I think of the suffering of all sentient beings." As I just said, it can be said in two ways. Speaking from a good perspective, “desiring to eliminate the world of swords and warriors” (wanting to eliminate the lifetime of swords and soldiers in the world), every day we pray for the disasters in this world to disappear, and pray for Buddha and Bodhisattvas to bless them. That is good, that is great compassion. Think in a different way, [that is, care about things we] didn't care about before. Why don't you think about the Middle East, or countries hit by storms, do we have a happy mind when others are in trouble? Our enemy was caught in a storm and [gloated]: "See! The sky is against you!" Are you happy when others have trouble or misfortune? If so, it's a crime and must be treated equally. Why are there so many natural disasters? The human world has no way to punish you, the human world cannot take revenge on you, are you saying "it's not fair"? “Thien” means natural. Natural power will happen!

If you want to find the cause, go find it! In the past, from childhood until now, I have never heard of “protecting the environment, protecting ecology”, nor do there seem to be as many accidents as there are now. Currently, especially many! Why is the climate unusual? Humanity studies celestial bodies, not cause and effect. We all understand: Will the Earth still exist for a long time? Can't last long! Every day we exploit, every day we want to exploit many things from the earth. After mining, where will those things be taken? We exploit the continent to get oil, for what purpose? Burned or processed, where will they go after processing? Not lost at all! It's in the air. The air is also an object, it gradually condenses. Condensation will then fall back into this world, decay, then, accumulation will grow, growth will then sink again. Rotate in rotation like that. That is called the Karma of Living Beings, called the Wheel of Karma.

When we preach the Ten Wheels of Kṣitigarbha Sūtra, we talk about the Wheel. Luan means "eternally without stopping". Buddhism talks about this. Current scientists also confirm this problem, corroborate the problem: "It is people who create karma, they themselves create things". Every day they complain about polluted air, but every day the pollution increases. How to do this? Therefore, when we recite Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's name, we must dedicate it. The karma created by sentient beings must be personally suffered. Why do they do that? Because their minds are crazy. If you want to find a person who is not crazy, there will be very few, but we as Buddhist disciples must stop being crazy, wholeheartedly confess the name, chant, worship, and respectfully make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva has such great power, can enter so much Samadhi, can give us so much peace and joy, can place us in peace on the path of heavenly birth, Nirvana. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva has that power. Do we have the power to pray for it? Yes! It is the will. The power of the mind and the blessing power of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, combined, this problem is immediately solved.

(Sutra) Depending on the place, the weakness of all sentient beings, the fire element, the water element, the wind element, or in the mountains, chewing on the bank, receiving amnesty, going crazy, falling into despair, having a mind that is not damaged, having the ability to single-mindedly recite the name, chant, pay respects, and make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva, will necessarily be able to escape all dangers, be at peace, not harmed, at any time, be at peace with rebirth in heaven, the path of Nirvana.
(Sutra: Anywhere, if sentient beings are burned by fire, drowned by water, or blown away by wind blown away, or on cliffs, precarious cliffs, trees, or houses, falling, falling, in terror, one can single-mindedly recite the name, recite, admire, respect, and make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva, all will be free from danger, safe, unharmed, depending on the nature worthy of salvation, to rest in the path of heavenly birth, Nirvana).

No matter where you are, just chant Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva will go there. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva pervades everything

place.

(Sutra: Anywhere, if sentient beings, are bitten by poisonous snakes, poisonous insects, or hit by All kinds of poisons, but one can wholeheartedly confess the name, chant, admire, respect, and make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva, all of which will be freed from harmful thoughts and, depending on their nature, worthy of salvation, will be able to rest in the path of heavenly birth, Nirvana).

These are things we often see. In the following text, when talking about the Ten Wheels, it will be clearly stated where these disasters come from. I intend to skip ahead and not say anything. In the Self-Quality section, read it once and follow the text of the text. Master Hoang Giac suggested: "Ordinary people cannot understand much. It would be better to say a little." Today, I will ramble a bit, the progress of preaching the sutras will be very slow. Each sutra has its main meaning, what is its central meaning? When we study a text, or do something, there is generally a central purpose. We must place emphasis on the central purpose, but talking about these phenomena will be beneficial. Does everyone know why these phenomena occur? Right when your mind moves, the wind rises. As soon as the mind moves, karma is immediately born.

Talking about myself, I am like this: I want you to do good, others think it's fanning the wind and starting a fire. If in prison you say "you should try to recite Buddha's name and do more good things", others will say that you are fanning the wind, making fire, propagating Buddhism. Therefore, as soon as your mind moves, others arrogantly think it is fanning the wind; As a result, the more you blow the wind, the bigger the fire becomes. The bigger the fire, the faster it burns. The faster the fire burns, the more accidents there are in the world. Right now, everyone is fanning the wind and lighting the fire, and the fire is even more intense! Everyone, think about it, water belongs to consciousness. Water and consciousness both go down; The heavier the emotion, the bigger the water disaster. The heavier the anger, the bigger the fire. Everyone couldn't hold back their anger, and the storm disaster became even greater. Every day you hollow out the earth, the earth will take revenge. Therefore, in 1976, Tangshan (in Hebei province) suffered a major earthquake, the entire bottom of Duongshan city was empty, excavating for hundreds of years. Once hollowed out, could it not collapse? Under the empty ground. Currently, there are many places where the strata (soil layers) are still sinking. Why did it sink? Withdrawing all the groundwater, who will maintain it?

There is an old saying in China: “Heaven's evil actions are possible, self-inflicted evil actions are inoperable” (Heaven sow injustice, you can still resist, creating injustice by yourself cannot live). Create your own karma, bury yourself. If that were not so, why would the earth be destroyed? No matter what they do, they still consider themselves right, waiting until everything is destroyed is not a matter of our generation, it is a matter of countless thousands of years to come. The earth is still very big, keep digging! Anyway, I haven't seen anything in a while! Even though we haven't seen anything yet, [the consequences have arisen] in our mind.

How to calm your mind and have less desires? Recite the holy name for many. Didn't I just mention determination? If you don't recite, how can you reach your ultimate mind? From nothingness to a mind, we must definitely achieve our heart, don't be in a hurry. “As soon as I chant, my mind immediately wanders, how can I chant?” When you recite for a long time, your distracted mind will no longer exist! You are completely absent of mind, which is truly distracting.

There are people who have asked me like this. That person said: "When I don't recite Buddha's name, don't sit still, and don't recite sutras, it doesn't seem like my mind is as distracted, there aren't as many afflictions. Whenever I recite sutras, I feel like I'm doing my best to stir up false thoughts." How do people explain? Without reciting sutras, there seems to be no affliction. While reciting the sutra, it seems like there are too many afflictions, is that so? Without reciting sutras, you are in trouble. You chant the sutra and then separate yourself from afflictions, turn around and look back at afflictions, that's the situation. If you don't recite the sutras, you're always in chaos. How can you recognize chaos? When you calm down and recite sutras, that means you have other thoughts; Therefore, I feel my mind is very scattered. If you don't recite sutras, you will always be in chaos. How can you know how to be scattered? Reciting for a long time, you will reach your mind. If you pray for one moment, you don't have the heart, so you should bow for two strokes! If you pray for a long time, strength will naturally arise.

Currently, we have many Dharma friends who have been worshiping for a long time. While they worshiped, their hearts were very pure. You will never approach, you will never understand! As you approach, you will gradually understand, gradually enter, everything is like that. Don't feel very sluggish because we haven't yet achieved our ambition. It's okay! Sincerity comes from studying! Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva teaches us to learn to make a single-minded vow, to make a vow many times, to study a lot, and to achieve our single-mindedness. Once the will is fulfilled, the power of the path will also be fulfilled, and suffering will gradually be eliminated. You vow to be healthy in body and mind, not suffer from illness or suffering, vow to have a peaceful family, peaceful relatives, and safe people in Taiwan.

In addition, to our eyes, this globe still exists. If everyone is not at peace, Taiwan will not be at peace either. It is necessary that the entire earth is at peace for you to be able to achieve peace. If your family is not at peace, if you hope to be alone, it won't be possible, there will be many people who will come and disturb you, isn't that the case? If your children, husband, wife are not at peace, and you alone want to be at peace in your home, I see it as a very difficult matter. Everyone is at peace, then you will be at peace. If humanity is at peace, then the world will be at peace. If all sentient beings are at peace, only then can humanity be at peace.

I'm not saying it's wrong to eat salty food, kill fish, or slaughter ducks. Whether you want to eat is your business, whether you want to kill is your business, but while you kill and eat, a compassionate thought must arise. You say: "I don't just eat you, I always compensate you. I recite the Buddha's name for you so that you don't fall into being an animal again." As long as you have such a thought, it is already very difficult to have! When I preach the Sutra on Contemplation of Good and Evil Karma, I specialize in teaching “willedness of mind”. The mind is sincere and earnest, focused, courageous, and diligent. Only if you recite like that and make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva will it be effective. If the recitation is superficial, the effect will not be great. The scriptures here do not say so [clearly], because this is Self Part, just the Buddha praising the merits of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. When you really apply it, you will definitely achieve your ambition. Therefore, every sentence of the scriptures has the word “capable of determination” (capable of determination), every sentence has “will of mind to name”, don't forget “will of mind”. If you don't have "willpower", there won't be any effect! But to be sincere, you must practice. Cultivating “willed mind” is very difficult, first of all you have to cultivate “faithful mind”. First of all, you must have extreme faith. If you are confused and one day you get sick, you will think that finding a doctor is an urgent matter. What effect does reciting Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva have? That won't be effective at all!

There are Dharma friends who also know that there is no way to cure the disease, so they recite Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's name and recite it with sincerity, and the effect is born. But someone who is bitten by a worm, a snake, or even poisoned by poison, can really think it through, or in the dream he vomits, or when he is awake he vomits, that person will have a reaction. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva neither appears nor senses anything; he vomits or excretes himself. Right from the beginning, in each passage of the sutra there is “the heart to confess, recite, pay homage to, and make offerings”. These sentences are all related to each other. First, you must be single-minded and you will be able to leave and eliminate suffering. Not only does it leave and eliminate suffering in the present, but in the future, after death, one does not fall into the three realms, does not fall into the realm of hungry ghosts or animals, and can be directly reborn in heaven. After being born in heaven, he continued to listen to the Dharma, continued to practice the path, and attained Nirvana.

(Sutra) Depending on the place, weak sentient beings, possessed by demons, become afflicted with diseases, or develop sun and sun, Or the one who develops every day, or the person who has three or four days and children at the same time, or the spirit is crazy, the body and mind are warring, deluded and forgetful, without knowledge, with the ability to single-mindedly name names, chant, pay respects, make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat, one will definitely attain liberation without fear, mind and body at peace, according to the time, peace of mind, heavenly birth, the path of Nirvana.
(Sutra: Anywhere, if sentient beings are possessed by evil spirits, they become infected with malaria, or illness every day, or illness every other day, or every three or four days, illness every three or four days, or causing hysteria, body and mind trembling, dazed, stupid, not knowing anything, but can wholeheartedly recite the name, chant, admire, respect, make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat, all will be liberated, not afraid, body and mind peaceful, comfortable, according to the nature that should be saved, to be placed in peace in the path of heavenly birth, Nirvana).

Each sentence “depending on the place” is saying that wherever Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is, in which country, that country will benefit. Sentient beings in that place are possessed by evil spirits, sometimes even foxes or ferrets, and are fascinated by them. Although it is said to be enchanting, it must also be fate! That devil has a destiny with you, but not everyone encounters it. Buddhist disciples all believe in ghosts and gods, because in the six paths of living beings, ghosts are one path. If they are people who do not believe in Buddha, they will say, "If you don't see ghosts, you won't believe," claiming that there are no ghosts. There are people who see ghosts and arrogantly say that you have dizziness, which is not very trustworthy. Because in the six paths, humans and animals are the species we come into contact with, while the beings in hell, hungry ghosts, Asuras, gods, and ordinary people do not come into contact with us at all, so we immediately think that those beings do not exist.

“Possessed by the devil” (Possessed by the devil): The devil not only clings to your body, making you uncomfortable, but also sometimes leans on another person's body, making that person crazy, deranged, holding a knife, brandishing a gun to kill you without that person even knowing. Just like I see those who seek luck, I don't doubt this at all. How could a twelve year old child know anything? But as soon as the “god” descended to the body, the person who supported the fortune immediately grabbed the pen and wrote quickly, writing many poems. Does that person know it or not? Do you say yes or no? Authentication is yes[10]. In all of Buddha's words, not a single sentence, not a single word is false. We often say "based on evil", there are people who don't believe. There are people who are bewitched by demons, the most serious situation is making that person crazy, hysterical, this happens a lot. Some people don't believe it, so I just said to be sincere. First of all, it is necessary to establish faith. Once you have faith, only then can you be sincere. It is true that there are people who are controlled by demons, some people develop malaria, once a day, or every other day, or every three or four days, and at the right time it attacks, that is being controlled by demons. Whenever the disease occurs, when it's cold, it's almost like death, when it's hot, it's an unbearable fever!

If malaria is caused by demons, it will make you hysterical and crazy. We see that person is crazy and crazy running around all day, already hysterical. Normal life and righteous actions are lost. At that time, if that person's friends can recite the holy name Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva to help that person recover a little bit of consciousness; Then, teach that person to chant to himself. If that person can chant to himself, it will be effective. There are many such cases, everyone must trust them. The demon path is a path [of the six paths]. There are more demons than people. People die and turn into ghosts, and animals that die also turn into ghosts. The six paths of sentient beings are all transformed by each other. If you can wholeheartedly chant the holy name Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, you will be able to make this disease change for the better and ward off evil spirits.

Once upon a time, when I was in the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, there was an old layman who had believed in Buddha for many years. He was fascinated by a fox from the Han Dynasty. He specially came from New York to the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas to request the Venerable Tuyen Hoa for treatment. Venerable Tuyen Hoa at that time had a disciple who said that the fox was not an ordinary fox, but instead of a fox, he was called “white fox prince” (white fox prince). Why do I know so well? One day, that shaman drove that old layman to me so I could give a sermon to that fox. Therefore, I know it very thoroughly. [The fox] from the Han Dynasty to the present, indeed exists, he saw it, we did not. He wanted me to teach him the Dharma. I told him, the unjust family should be untied, not tied up, teaching about Suffering, Emptiness, and Impermanence. He himself cried, but the fox also cried. After that, that magician formed a relationship with that fox. Not only do I not want to leave it. He preached the Lotus Sutra in New York, recited the Great Compassion Mantra, and the fox also recited the Great Compassion Mantra. The two of them cooperated with him. When the shaman preached the Lotus Sutra, the fox blessed people, but because it did not have the power of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, something was not right.

Ordinary people, after being bewitched by demons, will often have that phenomenon. That's true, but there still has to be a predestined relationship with them. Without causes and conditions, it cannot arise. Especially disciples of the Three Jewels, why do they encounter this kind of fate? When we recite the Ksitigarbha Sutra, after reciting it, we will see that, especially at night, we will be very scared. As soon as we recite it, we will feel fear.
