II. The Ten Rings - Chapter II

(Second Chapter: Ten Rings)

Sufficient, one is firm in heaven and earth, all things come before earth, one palm, reverence, and one say to the Buddha: "I ask the World-Honored One, immeasurable oceans of merit, only the four vows open and promise, the one who explains and eliminates doubts".
(Sutra: At that time, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva stood up from his seat and straightened up. dressed, bowed at the Buddha's feet, undressed one shoulder, put his right knee close to the ground, clasped his hands, respectfully, and said to the Buddha: "I now ask the World-Honored One, the ocean of immeasurable merits, I respectfully ask for your approval, in order to explain and eliminate doubts).

Now we begin to teach the Main Sect Part of the Ten Rings Sutra. In the text of this chapter, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva wants to talk about the Ten Wheels. He even asked the Buddha to teach him what the Ten Wheels are? There are the Ten Wheels of sentient beings and the Ten Wheels of Buddha. The Dharma taught by the Buddha corresponds to the types of karma created by sentient beings. Now we are in suffering, looking for liberation. How can we be liberated? Buddha teaches us methods, every sutra is like that. First of all, the Bodhisattva requested and the Buddha revealed. Bodhisattva asked again, Buddha spoke again. Whenever Buddha is mentioned in a Dharma assembly, it will always be Śākyamuni Buddha.

In the Self section, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva praised the Buddha, and the Buddha also praised the Bodhisattva. After that, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva stood up from his seat. When requesting the Dharma, there must be a ritual of request before that. Nowadays, the saints are no longer there, the sages have passed away, only ordinary people are left who superficially request the Dharma, they don't even express the meaning, they just say: "Dharma master! How can that be explained?" In the past, [asking that way] wouldn't have worked! If you want to ask a question, stand up from your seat, arrange your clothes properly, “the birth of the heavens must endure, the fate must come before the earth” (right shoulder of the shirt, right knee close to the ground). Nowadays, our robes always reveal the right shoulder, so why every time we bow, we have to dislocate the right shoulder? Because before bowing, there are times when the weather is cold, so you put on a robe to cover both shoulders. When a person is about to ask for advice, he must turn his robe over to reveal his right shoulder, which is called “thien dan huu kien” (dislodging the right shoulder of the shirt). The Indian way of kneeling is to place the right knee close to the ground, with only one right thigh kneeling down: When kneeling, one thigh is close to the ground, the other thigh is raised up. Then, clasp your hands together. That is the ritual of requesting Dharma. If you want to request Dharma, you must perform this ritual.

But when Buddhism spread to China, especially after the Tam Vu Dharma destroyed the Buddha[19], Zen Buddhism abolished all the ancient rules in Buddhism, abolished [the rituals] taught by the Buddha. teach. Although it is said to be “cancel”, it can also be said that in order to enlighten the person in charge, we do not pay attention to formality, shouting, hitting, and even cursing! Don Ha[20] split Buddha statues and burned Buddha statues. These situations cannot be considered routine! That is not in accordance with the rules taught by the Buddha. Scream loudly twice, or slap your ear, or kick you, any form is available, as long as you are enlightened, it is enough. Their purpose is like that, but in the details of Buddhism, doing so is not possible! Regardless of whether a great Bodhisattva asks the Buddha for guidance, or you want to request Dharma, there must be this ritual. I have just given an outline of the Dharma request ceremony.

Next is the presentation, when requesting the Dharma, one must also praise. “I ask the World-Honored One” (I now ask the World-Honored One) has the meaning of asking. “Sea of ​​immeasurable merit” (Sea of ​​immeasurable merit): Buddha's merit cannot be limited. So what to use for comparison? Like the sea. The sea is deep and wide, His wisdom is as deep and wide as the sea, but there is nothing unknown, nothing ununderstandable. Therefore, I request the Buddha to accept, respectfully grant his grace, allow me to speak, and skillfully explain our doubts to us. [That is the meaning of the sentence] “the one who explains eliminates doubts”. Our method is to first raise that [question], then ask for an explanation; The method in India is to praise first, then please enlighten me and help me clear my doubts. Then I said [wondered] what happened. The Bodhisattva had just asked permission, but before Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva asked, the Buddha praised again.

(Sutra) The World-Honored One wrote: “True good men, all-embracing dharma, unhindered knowledge, many desires To benefit others, please ask the Tathagata according to your wishes, to distinguish, explain, and be happy." Ushi, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva, recited the question: "In the thirteenth kalpa, it is necessary to practice asceticism, all sentient beings, except the three calamities, five defilements, many Buddha-factors, need to make boundless offerings, see the Great Assembly, the faith of the assembly is in harmony, understand the philosophy, need to be diligent, in the future they will gather together, the monks' view is like this, boundless.
(Sutra: The World-Honored One said: "You are a true and wise man, in all dharma wisdom you see no hindrance. In order to benefit other sentient beings, you ask the Tathagata. You can ask as you please, I will distinguish, explain, and make you happy for you." At that time, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva asked in verse: - During thirteen kalpas, I have been diligent. practicing asceticism, for all sentient beings, except for the three disasters and five defilements, in front of the Buddha's verses, they make boundless offerings. They have seen the Great Gathering, they are faithful and harmonious, they are wise and diligent, they all come together, they have never seen it like this, there are no impurities

“The World-Honored One wrote: “True good man” (The World-Honored One said: - You are a truly good man), meaning: You are a truly good man. “Good” here is not the ordinary good man, but the ultimate good man. The Buddha all called his disciples “good man”, or “good man, good woman.” cause", all add the word "Compassion". "Compassion" means you have a good fate to be close to me, that good fate is not easy. You are a person who tends to be good, eliminates all defilements, is completely pure. This is the Buddha who praised and promised Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, saying: "Your wisdom towards all dharmas has no obstacles, you can understand it yourself. You don't need to ask, but why do you want to ask? “For the sake of wanting to benefit other sentient beings” (For the sake of benefiting other sentient beings): If Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva did not ask for guidance, the Great Collection of Ten Wheels of Kṣitigarbha Sūtra would not be able to say it. The Buddha rarely preached the Dharma himself, it was necessary for someone in authority to ask for the Buddha to preach the Dharma. Without the appropriate foundation, [people] like us will have no way to appeal. He wanted to “benefit”, that is, create benefits for all other sentient beings, so he asked the Tathagata. I will “interrogate at will” (allow you to ask as you please), just ask whatever you want, I will distinguish and explain to you, making you happy. Making Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva happy is making all sentient beings happy; Therefore, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva asked.

Next are the main questions asked by Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, which are also the focus of this sutra. What do you want to ask? He said he had practiced for thirteen lifetimes, spending thirteen lifetimes practicing asceticism. How long is a lifetime? Can be divided into four kalpas: Creation, Persistence, Destruction, and Emptiness. Four intermediate kalpas are considered one great kalpa. The present kalpa is the Eternal kalpa. During the Eternal Tribulation, the lifespan of humans ranges from eighty-four thousand years, or eighty thousand years in round, with a slight decrease every hundred years, until the lifespan of humans is ten years. From the age of ten, every hundred years increases by one year, increasing to eighty-four thousand years. This [cycle] of one increase and one decrease is counted as one eon. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva said: What do you use the time of thirteen kalpas, that is, thirteen times the cycle of one increase, one decrease, eighty-four thousand years, for what? Ascetic practice. He practiced asceticism, not the hard asceticism like us.

We know that Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is always in hell, in the evil life of the five defilements, at a time when there is no Buddha Dharma, when sentient beings are suffering, He reaches out to sentient beings, using such a long period of time, it is impossible to count the number of years, if calculated according to the number of days, it would be much more! For the sake of all sentient beings, for the sake of all sentient beings, the three disasters and eight disasters are eliminated. “Three disasters”: The three major disasters are fire, water, wind, the minor three disasters are sword soldiers, famine, and pestilence. These two types of three disasters must be eliminated in the hope of changing the social form, changing it for the better. Tam tai is not as popular as it is today.

Five Defilements (Pañca-kasāyāh): Defilements (Kalpa-kasāya) are not good times. Impaired Views (Drsti-kasāya): Living beings look at problems differently, are very confused, and often argue because of disagreements. Why are Defilements of Life, Defects of View, or Defilements of Defilements (Kleśa-kasāya) like that? The birth of afflictions is too heavy. Living beings in this age, judging from their lifespan, judging from their physical appearance, judging from their various appearances, are all turbid and impure, [that is Impure Beings (Sattva-kasāya)]. Finally, there is Defilement of Life (Āyu-kasāya). This is called “five evil defilements world”.

I have practiced asceticism for such a long time, to help all sentient beings escape the suffering caused by the three disasters and five defilements. I have been in front of many Buddhas (a koṭi is a memory), that is, in front of many billions of Buddhas like that, making many offerings, boundless offerings. I have also seen all the huge gatherings of each Buddha. The disciples who heard the Dharma in those gatherings, the disciples who were close to the Buddha, were all very harmonious, their faith was very pure, and they were all very intelligent and wise people. After listening to the Dharma, they were still able to practice diligently and courageously. They all came with the group to listen to the Buddha Dharma. “The increased view is like this, free from impurities of the assembly” (Never seen a Dharma assembly like this, without the mass of impurities): When there is that assembly of the Great Assembly, it seems that there are no three disasters, no five impurities. Never seen such [a dharma assembly], there is no impurity, there are no such beings. I spent thirteen lifetimes cultivating and participating in many gatherings of Buddhas. The meeting place of the Buddhas is very beautiful, and the crowd who attends is very pure. The world in those societies is also very beautiful, and living beings are also very pure. But now I see it differently, the main meaning Bodhisattva wants to ask here is to ask about this world.

(Sutra) Clouds test the Buddha land, filthy and evil, damaged and pure, the wise are far away, the evildoers live together, creating the sins of the Uninterrupted, slandering the true Dharma, destroying the saints, giving rise to evil views, falsely speaking, cutting off common sense, creating the Ten Evil Karmas, not fearing the suffering of future generations. Ignorance, blindness, greed and many defects, clouds and rivers turn the Buddha Wheel, trying to save sentient beings? Clouds and rivers break continuously, like diamonds of affliction? “The world of Buddha is filthy and evil, harming pure goodness” (Why is this Buddhaland filthy, evil and damaging the good and pure): Why is this country, also the Sa Ba world, filthy, incomparably chaotic, full of evil beings, without pure good faith? “Tot pure goodness”: In the previous section, we talked about Thanh, here we talk about Tinh. This is the effect of translating text. Such a pure mass of people, there is no one who is "intelligent, wise, diligent, pure, or wise" but when they come to this world, they all leave. All sentient beings who do evil are gathered together, this world is filled with turbid evil. “Creating many crimes of Non-Interruption” (Creating many crimes of Non-Interruption): All are creating karma of the crime of Non-Interruption: Killing mother, killing father, killing Arhat, making Buddha's body bleed, disrupting the harmony of Sangha. Those are called the five sins of Indifference. Even “slandering the Dharma” (slandering the Dharma).

“Truth dharma” here means the pure dharma spoken by the Buddha. Speaking from our side, believing that you are Buddha is even more profound. Here, the true dharma is to practice the Ten Good Karmas, also the ten karmas of the body, mouth, and mind. "Following the Buddha's teachings, not doing evil things", [this is] considered the Dharma. [Not only do they slander the Dharma, but they] even slander “saints”. “Saints” refers to Buddha or great Bodhisattvas. [Slandering the saints] is slandering the Three Jewels. They look at problems differently from us, even burning Buddha statues, killing monks, imprisoning monks, and even burning the Tripitaka, considering it superstition.

“Destroying the saints, giving rise to evil views, false theories of eternal views” (Destroying the saints, raising evil views, speaking nonsense of theories of eternal views and annihilation): They talk to each other only with false words, if it is not the End, it will be the Permanent. In general, there are two sides that do not agree with the Middle Way. Or say, "Once a person's life is over, it's over", that's Doan Kien. Wishing to preserve your body for the future, preserving your own body, wanting to live longer, that is Thuong Kien. If that's true, there really is such a thing in the world, everyone will never want to die, it's impossible! Not falling into Fragment, but falling into Constantity. To speak falsely, to speak in reverse, [that is] “false theory and eternal discourse”.

What they have created are all the Ten Evils. The body has three things, "killing, stealing, and sexual intercourse". The mouth has four things: "lying, embellishing, double-talking, and harsh talking". The mind has three things, "greed, anger, ignorance". These ten things are called the Ten Evil Karmas. Add the word Emptiness to the Ten Virtues. Does not give rise to greed, anger, or ignorance. Do not commit murder, theft, or sexual misconduct. Do not commit [lying, embellishing, double-talking, speaking harshly], killing, stealing, or committing sexual misconduct. When creating the Ten Evil Karmas, they (sentient beings in the Sa Ba world) were never afraid of having to suffer retribution in the future. Because they raised the Duan Kien, [thinking that] there is no next life. They are not afraid of suffering in the next life, not to mention [desiring to attain the statuses of] Sravaka, Pratyekabuddha, Bodhisattva Vehicle.

“ Far away from the three vehicles” (Or far away from the three vehicles): Even more unable to get close to good dharma, cultivating the true Dharma path, they are still far away. Having left the three vehicles, where will we head? Fall into the three evil destiniess. “Unclean towards evil realms” (Unclean towards evil destiniess): Suffering in the three evil destiniess. The most miserable things are hell, hungry ghosts, and animals, and the human world doesn't look good at all! If you enjoy all the blessings of heaven, you will definitely fall into hell. It's okay to say that the five paths are evil, but it's also okay to say that the six paths [are all evil]. In common sense, “the evil tendency” (toward the evil destinies) is about the three evil destiniess.

Why do they do that? Because their ignorance obscures the pure dharma eye. [That is the meaning of the sentence] “ignorance, ignorance”. They don't see it. It's not greed, it's jealousy. “Greed, jealousy, a lot of deceit” (Greed, jealousy, a lot of deceit): [If it's not just greed or jealousy], it's also extremely deceitful. For living beings like that, in a society like that, how will the Buddha save sentient beings? “The clouds turn the Buddha wheel” means how will he preach the Dharma? How to turn the Buddha Wheel to deal with the evil wheels of sentient beings? These are the meanings included in this Ten Chakra Sutra.

Why is it called Luan? Luan (wheel) has the function of crushing. As here, we have the driving force to push [the wheel] forward, the wheel can be crushed, the Buddha Wheel will crush and transform the evil karma of sentient beings. How did the Buddha turn the Buddha Wheel to save those sentient beings? “The cloud breaks continuously, like a vajra of afflictions” (How to destroy afflictions that are as solid as a vajra continuously): The afflictions of sentient beings are hard and solid like a vajra, existing continuously without ceasing. How does He turn the Buddha Wheel to cut off the continuous stream of karma of sentient beings, also cutting off the flow of afflictions, giving rise to a stream of purity, allowing them to attain liberation. Or use the wisdom of Vajra Prajna Paramita to eliminate afflictions, causing them to attain samadhi.

“Van Ha attains Total Knowledge” (How to attain General Knowledge), that is, attain samadhi, attain great concentration. [Total Recognition] is “the sum of all dharmas, holding immeasurable meanings” (including all dharmas together, holding immeasurable meanings). So is it possible to attain the Non-Birth Dharma of Forbearance? “Forbearance” here is Vo Sanh Dharma Forbearance. If that's true, can it be achieved?

“The Golden Self sees the guru, the Great Collection is even rare, the person who increases the knowledge of the land, he is like the virtuous people, he has many merits, he needs to practice the Bodhi path. He treats the ignorant people, often reveals the Buddha Wheel” (I now see that the guru's Mahasamadhi Assembly is very rare. Never seen in other places where there are all the teachings. Such virtue, full of Dau Da merit, diligently cultivating the Bodhi path, how can one teach the Buddha Wheel in the midst of the ignorant crowd): Bodhisattva praises the Buddha. I now see the Master's Great Ascension Assembly, seemingly transformed. How does He save us and transform the evil life of the five impurities into [good] like this? I have never seen a Dai Tap association like this in other places. “Do-da” (Dhuta) is affliction. By eliminating all afflictions, all those afflictions are eliminated. Eliminating afflictions is merit. How to achieve such merit? How to get rid of those afflictions? If you diligently practice Bodhi, you will achieve it. The order in the Bodhi path is to practice step by step. From repenting of poor things, then, cultivating Concentration, cultivating Hue, this is very difficult!

“Van Ha treats the ignorant crowd, often revealing the Buddha Wheel” (How can one be able to open the Buddha Wheel in such an ignorant crowd): In the midst of such an ignorant crowd, how can the Buddha be pure? How can we still preach the Dharma to save sentient beings? “Opening the Buddha Wheel” is preaching the Dharma. From here on, the Buddha used similes to explain the Ten Wheels, and also used the Buddha's Ten Wheels to transform the Ten Evil Wheels of sentient beings. Here, the ten evil karmas are the Ten Wheels. How does the Buddha Wheel move? The Buddha used a simile and even showed the rotation of the Buddha Wheel. What the Buddha is about to say is the Ten Rings [of the Buddha].

(Sutra) The Buddha wrote: - Good disaster! Good ears! Good man!, in the past, the Buddhas of the world, the Buddhas of the five defilements and evil times, should ask the Buddhas of the Buddhas of the Buddhas of the past, so they should ask the World-Honored Ones of the Buddhas as to the meaning of the Dharma. Such as the question of the Dharma, the cause of the island, the understanding of goodness, the perfection of all the virtues, the attainment of skillful means and marvelous wisdom. The golden taste is mature in all sentient beings, the spirit of attaining the benefits and peace of events, in the spirit of all Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas, skillful in the holy conduct of giving and giving, the six Paramitas, mature in all sentient beings, the virtues of all sentient beings, the merits of all wisdom and wisdom are at sea speed and perfection. The one who turns away from all the evil deeds of the Kshat-di-li king will never fall into the three evil beasts. The spirit tries to save the Three Jewels, their nature, majesty, virtue, and eternal prosperity. Serving the Tathagata is like teaching the Dharma. Hearing! Hearing! What good thoughts! Ngo positions are distinguished and explained.
(Sutra: The World-Honored One said: "How good! How good! Good man! In the past, during the evil time of the five defilements, you were in the worlds of Buddhas as numerous as the sands of the Ganges River, and asked the World-Honored Buddhas as many as the sands of the Ganges River about such Dharma meanings. Regarding the Dharma meanings that you asked like that, you worked hard, skillfully communicated, and perfected the teachings. conduct, reaching the other shore, has achieved the wonderful wisdom of skillful means. Now, to mature all sentient beings, to make them achieve the benefits of peace, to make all Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas use the treasury of holy acts of skillful means such as Giving, etc., six Paramitas to mature the supreme virtues for all sentient beings, to quickly complete the ocean of merit of Omniscience. To transform the cruel actions of all kings So that they will not fall into the three evil realms. Because it makes the Three Jewels' glorious virtue last in the world, so ask the Tathagata the meaning of the Dharma like that! Listen carefully, I will distinguish and explain for you

When talking about the Ten Wheels, first of all, [Buddha] used the story of the king in the early world receiving the throne and the process of how to achieve the throne to explain how the Buddha cultivated the Buddha way? After the Bodhisattva asked for such instructions, before the Buddha preached the Dharma, he said: "You asked this, not only asking towards me, but you asked too many times. Not only did you ask me, but you also asked as many Buddhas as the sands of the Ganges River." The Buddha then praised: "Good ear! Good ear!", that is, praising the Bodhisattva's question, he asked a very good question! "Good man" is the word the Buddha used to call Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. "In the past, Ksitigarbha was at the level of all Buddhas in the world of the five defilements and evil times" (In the past, during the evil time of the five defilements, he was in Buddha worlds as numerous as the sands of the Ganges River): Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is always born. In an era where there is no Buddha in this world, in order to teach and transform sentient beings during the time of evil, it can also be considered that there is no Buddha who has entered Nirvana, only the Buddha Dharma remains, but we do not clearly understand the true meaning of those dharmas.

Next, it is unclear whether that solution is real or fake, fake or real. I see it like this: Regarding the types of Dharma meanings such as Existence, Esotericism, Four Teachings, Five Teachings, Pure Land, Sage Hand, we lack wisdom so we cannot understand clearly! This shows: At present, it is indeed a world of evil and five impurities. When the Buddha was in this world, there were many Dharma meanings. If we just listen to the Dharma, we can immediately become enlightened, can immediately realize the Truth, and can eliminate afflictions! As for [at present], although we listen to many sutras and study many sutras; However, it is impossible to cut off Or, it is impossible to attain Pure Dharma Eye.

Most people see the problem, if it doesn't fall into Paragraph, it will fall into Regularity. The thinking mind, not thinking about Permanence, will think about Doaning, which rarely matches the meaning of the Middle Way. This proves that our good roots are shallow and thin. After studying this sutra, you must practice it. The Buddha Wheel method teaches us how to practice. How to practice? Must really do it. However, at present, although we study, we cannot learn patience. I say this, everyone, don't get angry! The Dharma friends put Dharma learning in the second level, which is also very good, or if they put it in the third level, which is also very good. I say this includes both monks and nuns. People who truly have a heart that is passionate about birth and death, know that this world is impermanent, realize that this world is suffering, they will not treat dharma like that. Now we know in our hearts how we treat the Dharma. Why is that? This is due to our past karma, the eyes of wisdom are obscured by ignorance. That is our situation at present. Why is there no such wisdom? Why in real life are we so careless? We are still attached; In fact, we all know that the Buddha taught us many good treatment methods, so why don't we do them? That is the reason why Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is hard and tired in this world.

Therefore, Śākyamuni Buddha told Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva: "The questions you have asked, you have asked too many Buddhas. Among Buddhas as numerous as the sands of the Ganges River, you have asked those principles. You have spent a lot of effort for the principles you have asked, and have paid a huge price. Personally speaking, you have understood them. reached, the conduct has been perfected, has reached the other shore, has attained the wonderful wisdom of skillful means, can show sentient beings all kinds of means, devise all dharmas to lead sentient beings to believe, to lead sentient beings to enter. Bodhisattva Mahasattva has all the skillful means to save sentient beings, because not all Bodhisattvas have all the skillful means. When the great Bodhisattva Mahasattva has learned the Dharma, has attained enlightenment, and attained enlightenment, the method of benefiting sentient beings is not simple. Because there are so many types of sentient beings, it is necessary to apply extremely skillful means according to the actions of the Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha are complete. All that is hidden in that treasure is Almsgiving, Precepts, Patience, Meditation, Wisdom, Six Paramitas, Compassion, Joy, Equanimity, and the Four Immeasurable Minds.

“Nhất Thiết Trí trí công đức đại hải tốc viên mãn cố” (Vì mau chóng viên mãn biển cả công đức của trí Nhất Thiết Trí): Trí Nhất Thiết Trí là đại trí huệ trong hết thảy các thứ trí huệ, ở đây là nói về đức Phật. “The one who completely transforms all the cruel actions of the Kshat-de-li kings” (For transforming the cruel actions of all the Kshat-de-li kings): At present, the cruel and cruel actions of the Kshat-de-li kings in the Dharma-Ending Age are complete. Whoever is the leader, we all consider them King Sat-di-loi. The policies they implement, the vast majority of them, create karma. To Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's question, the Buddha said: "You should change that evil king, don't let him do cruel things to avoid falling into the three evil realms."

At the same time, because it is possible to absorb the nature of the Three Jewels, [causing] the dignity of Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha to flourish for a long time and stay in the world for a long time. Therefore, he asked Tathagata that these dharma meanings were very good and very important. What must it be like to be able to make sentient beings escape from suffering, so that sentient beings in the Dharma-Ending Age of the five evil worlds do not fall into the three realms? You asked a very good question, so please listen attentively! Listen! I will tell you. You must listen according to reason, listen according to truth.

For each Dharma requester, the Buddha used the phrase “to hear, to hear”. Did Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva not listen correctly? The Buddha taught us the method: When listening to the Dharma, we must listen attentively. [We] cannot listen to reason, [we have to accept the request] at least not to be trifling or double-minded. Now while listening, focus your mind on listening so you can enter. If you don't concentrate your mind, you won't be able to enter that meaning! This is the great Bodhisattva requesting the Dharma, the Buddha preaching the Dharma, all to set an example for us. After listening, you must also be skillful in contemplation and visualization. “Ngo has the position of distinguishing and explaining” [meaning] now I will differentiate and explain each thing clearly for you. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva immediately replied: “Yes, World-Honored One!” [meaning] “yes! Buddha”. I like to listen, I am very happy to hear the Buddha preach the Dharma. This is the ritual, one asks, the other answers. However, we still haven't gotten to the main part. Here is the method of requesting Dharma and the method of promising to speak.

(Sutra) At the ear, the Buddha reported to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva: - Good man! Through the power of his original vow, he achieved the ten Buddha Wheels, lived in the Buddhaland, and lived in the five defilements and evil worlds. Nall sentient beings, withdrew from the necessarily pure good dharma, possessed the Seven Noble Treasures, far removed from the necessarily intelligent person, The stage is often spent in the net of riches, often eager to take possession of evil beasts far away, the future generations will not see suffering, often dealing with ignorance and darkness, accumulating the ten unwholesome karma paths, creating the five Non-Constraints, slandering the Dharma, destroying the noble thoughts, abandoning the good dharmas, abandoning the evil dharmas. The ego abides like a mixed bag of evil in the middle level, attains peace and stability, attains no fear, attains no fear, self-proclaimed the position of great immortal, turns the Buddha Wheel, ranks with heavenly demons, heretical heretics, destroys all sentient beings, due to the solidity of afflictions like a vajra, mocks at any time, secures the power of all sentient beings, lives in the three vehicles Bat all Ttransformation Ctransposition.
(Sutra: At that time, the Buddha told Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva: - Dear good man Death! Tathagata, by the power of his original vow, achieved the ten Buddha Wheels, in this Buddha world, in the world of five evil impurities HAll sentient beings have retreated, lost all pure good dharma, lacked all the Seven Noble Wealth treasures, separated from all intelligent and wise people, blocked by the trap of Doan Kien and Perpetual View, often preferring to ride in the evil destinies, not afraid of the suffering in the world. In the next life, I will always be in the darkness of ignorance, complete with all ten types of unwholesome karma, commit the five sins of Indifference, slander the Dharma, slander, disparage the sages, abandon good dharmas, and complete all the evil dharmas. I will live in such a mixed and evil world, be at peace, not be frightened, not be afraid, call myself in the noble position of a great immortal, turn the Buddha Wheel, subdue the evil thoughts of the demons and pagans, and destroy all evil thoughts. All afflictions are as solid as the vajras of all living beings. Depending on their desires, they place all powerful living beings in the Non-Returning position in the three vehicles).

The Buddha immediately told the Bodhisattva: Because I have made vows in the past, each Buddha made different vows, so each Buddha shows skillful means and accepts sentient beings differently. Amitābha Buddha made forty-eight vows, wanting to establish the world of Ultimate Bliss and use the world of Ultimate Bliss to receive sentient beings. Medicine Master Lapis la Light Tathagata established the world of Lapis lazuli to treat the diseases of sentient beings and take care of sentient beings. Among the one thousand Buddhas of the Sage Kalpa, Śākyamuni Buddha made a vow to stay in the five evil lives, and at a time when the human lifespan is only one hundred years. You see, Śākyamuni Buddha's lifespan was the shortest, only one hundred years. The Buddha before him was Kasyapa Buddha, whose life span was ten thousand years.

Now we say Seven Buddhas, that is to say [three past Buddhas in the Solemn Kalpa and] four Buddhas in the Hien Kiep [respectively] had lifespans of forty thousand years, thirty thousand years, twenty thousand years, and one thousand years, but Śākyamuni Buddha only lived for one hundred years. At the time when a thousand Buddhas lived in the world, Śākyamuni Buddha's life span was the shortest. He did not live to be a hundred years old. He passed away at the age of eighty, and his fate was over. That is because of the power of the original vow.

But because there are ten types of Buddha Wheels, in this Buddha world, that is, in the evil life of the five defilements of the Sa Ba world, although we see sentient beings have retreated, losing all pure good dharmas. Since there is no pure dharma, how can they keep the precepts and believe? If you don't believe, how can you keep the precepts? How can there be concentration and wisdom? No way! Can they practice almsgiving? Everyone who can practice will be a living being with all the Seven Holy Talents. For example, among the Dharma friends present here, there are many people who have received the Three Refuges and the Five Precepts. You have all the Precepts and Wealth, you have all taken refuge in the Three Jewels. Many people make offerings and practice almsgiving, and you have done Wealth Giving. So you are complete, still considered a smart, wise person, able to listen to the sutra and hear the Dharma.

Here refers to sentient beings lacking the Seven Noble Wealth treasures. At the same time, what are so many people doing? Can we think of it? What are the six relatives doing? You come here to listen to the sutra, [and what they are doing], just compare, you will see very clearly, no need to say anymore. Smart and wise people, what is a wise person? You know how to choose. A wise person knows how to choose which path to follow and what to do every day. He knows how to choose. People without wisdom will choose differently. That person chooses to sit "far away from the evil beast", which means moving towards the evil destinies. We sit in the Second Vehicle, heading towards the Three Vehicles. Completely disagree! We have no suffering in the next life. Why? Take refuge in the Buddha, take refuge in the Dharma, take refuge in the Sangha, maintain pure precepts, give alms, and be patient. This will reduce a lot of harm.

We are afraid of suffering in the next life. Therefore, in this life we ​​must practice and listen to the Dharma. We focus on light, must eliminate darkness, do not do the ten unwholesome karma, practice the ten good karma. We are disciples who believe in Buddha and achieve karma. I rarely hear Buddhist disciples loudly cursing at others. Someone said: "Old monk! You just didn't hear that!" I've heard quite a few, it's true, but [Buddhists cursing others like that] is still a minority. When Buddhist disciples curse others, they feel uneasy, in their minds they think they are speaking evilly. Buddhist disciples also have deceivers, they also want to repent: "At that time, what I did was not right." If you are not a disciple of Buddha, you won't even have incorrect thoughts. When taking revenge, "I hope you suffer a little first before speaking." They have that mentality, that mentality. So the car that takes them to the evil road in the next life, they are already sitting on it!

Anyone who is not afraid of suffering in the next life will sit on the bus into an evil destiny and fall into an evil destinies. Sentient beings fear that suffering in the next life will not be the same. Although we also live in darkness, we still recite Buddha's name, Dharma's name, Sangha's name, even reciting a holy sentence of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, reciting a holy sentence of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's name. That one thought is the light. You recite a sentence, that sentence is the light. You recite each sentence, each sentence is luminous. You will be able to gradually break through layer upon layer of obstacles and darkness. That is a person who has wisdom, can stay away from the ten unwholesome karma paths, and will practice the ten wholesome karma paths. When it comes to the five sins of non-interruption, slandering the True Dharma, defaming the sages, everyone must pay attention. As people who believe in Buddha, you should not slander him. If regarding the dharmas spoken by the Buddha, you believe in this dharma and slander that dharma, that is the destruction of the dharma. If I preach the sutras, chant the sutras, and say that reciting the Buddha's name is not good, that means I have blasphemed the recitation of the Buddha's name, that is blasphemy. I recited the Buddha's name and said that reciting sutras and preaching sutras was not good, it was also against the Dharma. If I preach this sutra and say that other sutra is incorrect, that is all defamation of the Dharma. I have no connection with that sutra, so I should make offerings, worship, and hope to get married! You must fulfill all the Dharma meanings, you must understand them, do not slander the Dharma, pay special attention to this!

Currently, among our religious friends, there are indeed those who do not know the consequences of breaking the Dharma, and just talk nonsense! Even if I am a disciple of this temple, another person is a disciple of that temple, it is very possible that both sides still fight, that is indeed the case. Temples and temples still fight with each other, let alone the lay friends! But you must know: That is slandering the True Dharma. slandering the True Dharma is a very big sin. Stirring up discord among the Sangha, or blaming another temple against this pagoda, blaming this pagoda against another pagoda, is very dangerous! That is the crime of the Five Rebellions, the Five Inconsistencies, of disrupting the harmony of the Sangha. Therefore, we should not arbitrarily criticize all the saints and sages, all the Abbots. Because we have not yet reached that realm. If we do so, we will be going in the direction of evil, not in the direction of good.

For sins, although I have repented for many years, my repentance is still not clean! When I was young, I was also like that. I studied the five teachings, as I said the four teachings are not as good as the five teachings, what comes into contact first will be the main thing. After that, I studied the four teachings, felt that the four teachings and the fifth teachings were not much different, so I did not enter them. So in the past I have created a lot of karma, I personally know how to repent. That is my experience to introduce to everyone. Therefore, at first glance, slandering the True Dharma is very shallow, "I do not defame the Dharma", in fact, you have defamed many times! This master is very good, that master is not good. Every master is good! As long as he wears the robe and is still a disciple of the Buddha, we should praise him and consider him as a sage, or as a saint. As for his personal cause and effect, he himself will have to shoulder it, it has nothing to do with me! I will not replace cause and effect!

This Ten Rings Sutra specializes in teaching about that situation, “No matter how much my disciples break or violate the precepts, they will not accept the king's sanctions”, said the Buddha. If they impose sanctions, that King Sat-di-loi is an evil king, because he will destroy the Three Jewels. Even if that person is corrupt, as long as there is a piece of the ka-sa, not the entire ka-sa, the ghosts and gods will see benefits. People don't believe, but demons believe. Because they suffer, ghosts and gods have magical powers and also know how to have beneficial relationships. People are confused, do not know the benefits of relationships, talk nonsense, everyone must pay special attention, especially towards pagodas, temples, Sangha, and disciples of the Three Jewels. Even among Dharma friends, if the Sangha praises the Sangha, then Buddha Dharma will flourish, that's what it means.

Buddhist disciples always support Śākyamuni Buddha, maintain all sentient beings, make future sentient beings not suffer, they must do so. In the past, without knowing it, we did a lot of wrong things; Now I know, from now on I won't do it again. But what if you have done wrong in the past? Repenting before Buddha and Bodhisattva, repenting before Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is fine. Because this Ten Wheels of Kṣitigarbha Sūtra specializes in repentance. The meaning of repentance is to purify our past sins. If we wear dirty clothes, we have to wash them. Once you have washed it, you must keep it clean. That is the meaning of repentance. In the past, we did something wrong, we changed it, and we won't do it again. You repent and your past sins have been alleviated. If you know how to repent, you will take measures. You have a shameful mind, that is your precious wealth.

I was just talking about shame. Shame is a treasure, always comparing yourself to others, feeling like you are not as good as others. People have merit, I have no merit. Others have wealth, I have no wealth. Why do other people have wealth? In their previous lives, they cultivated merit, I am not jealous, I am always happy. As long as others have merit, I will be happy, your crimes have been repented of. Shame is sowing treasure. The reason why all Buddhas were able to attain enlightenment [is because] when they first developed their minds in the past, they had a mind of shame. Śākyamuni Buddha said: I am in this mixed evil country, I am very stable and have no fear. I consider myself the World-Honored One, a great immortal, because I am turning the Buddha Wheel. Turning the Buddha Wheel aims to counteract the evil wheel, to subdue the evil opinions of demons and pagans, and to eliminate the afflictions of all sentient beings. The afflictions of sentient beings are resilient and difficult to tame. These afflictions are as solid as diamonds, we can destroy them. We can also make that kind of living beings happy.

For the good sentient beings among them, I make them abide in an irreversible position in the three vehicles, that is, Sravaka, Pratyekabuddha, and Bodhisattva Vehicle. Haven't talked about the Buddha Wheel yet, just speaking in general like that. I stay here, saving sentient beings without fear because of my own vows in the past. I vow to save sentient beings in this place. My lifespan is very short and quick, and my body is very small. The era is not that good, the living beings in this era are in an evil life of the five defilements. When the Buddha was alive, the Dharma was the Dharma, and the Dharma was not much better. Why? He abides in the evil life of the five defilements! However, it's still a little better than where we are now. Now we are at a time when there is no Buddha in the world, of course it is even worse. But Śākyamuni Buddha was born in the world of the five evil defilements. He abides in the evil world of the five defilements and saves sentient beings. That is the Sambhogakaya of Śākyamuni Buddha. The pure Dharma Body of Śākyamuni Buddha would not be like that. [The body appearing in the Sa Ba world] is illusory, not real. All dharmas, such as dreams, illusions, bubbles, and shadows, should be seen like that. That is called right knowledge, right view. Below, the Buddha gave an example to explain. First we talk about the country, then we talk about Buddha Wheel.

(Sutra) Good man! For example, if there is a country, there is a false military position, in the middle there are all the people, the self-rule, the foreign army, the invasion of each other, the sadness and chaos, the people are insecure, there are countless types of fighting and chanting to avoid, mutual insults, false words, false words, cruel handlers, vain chaos, all kinds of diseases, weak and dull, cold, heat, abuse, cold and pestilence, madness, dryness, food indigestion, crazy mind, all the roots are unstable. The lack of tools and limbs, the lack of food, clothing, and belongings, are necessarily unattainable. All sentient beings take refuge in the race of pagans, evil spirits, evil views, evil thoughts, malicious mockery, and will inevitably prosper, be lost in the right path, and fall into the evil realm.
(Sutra: Good man! If there is a country, then the throne is vacant, everything is gone. All the people in the country, their own army and the army of others, harm each other, are sad, disturbed, and the people are restless. There are countless kinds of lawsuits, disputes, conflicts, lies, bullying each other, flattery, lies, cruel contradictions, slander, deception, harassment, all kinds of diseases, blindness, darkness, cold, fever, malaria, pestilence, madness, withering, lack of appetite, The mind is hysterical, the senses are not enough, the limbs are lacking, the lack of food, clothes, and utensils, all of them cannot be happy. Sentient beings who take refuge in all kinds of heretics, evil spirits, evil views, evil thoughts, and evil desires, are all illustrious, lost in the right path, and will fall into the evil destinies).

It's all about visualization here. We all understand these things and have personally experienced that situation. Currently, we are in that situation. This world is at the end of the Dharma era. Nam Thiem Bo Chau is also right on this globe, there are more than one hundred and eighty countries, is there any country that is a little better? [If it's better] that's relative! “When the throne was empty” (At that time, the throne was vacant) is said according to custom in India. Currently, that country is very chaotic, the emperor of that country has no way to rule, [other than] the throne is vacant. Even more chaotic is that all the people in that country compete with each other.

“Your own army, the army of others” (Your own army, the army of others), the Buddha still spoke according to the borders [of each country], but in my experience, it is not just like that. I was born in the Northeast, at that time, bandits were very fierce. When I was a child, in the Eastern Three Provinces[21], each province had a Military Governor. At that time, it was called Quan Quan, then changed to Provincial Chairman. This province fights that province, that province fights this province. At that time, everyone vied to be President. When I was in Beijing, having become a monk, I later saw a pair of parallel sentences, referring to the Beiyang warlord period. In Beijing, it is called President North, and Mr. Sun Yat-sen in Nanjing is called President South. [The government in] Nanjing is called Nanjing Government, and in Beijing it is called Beijing Government. These couplets are: "The government of the South, the government of the North, the government is divided into the South and the North" (The government of the South, the government of the North, the government can't be divided into the South and the North). Whether it's North or South, say President, or President, President is not an item. This is one country, not many countries. Later, I went to Sichuan and helped edit documents, only to learn the extent of the chaos in Sichuan.

If anyone was born in that era, no matter what country they belonged to, wouldn't they be sad? Isn't such a country chaotic? America is very powerful, right? A few days ago, Kennedy Airport (Kennedy, also known as JFK Airport) was bombed. When bombed, many commercial buildings were also bombed. There are also storms, floods, and fire disasters. You tell me: Where is the land that is clean, without sadness, without disturbance? There is a clean land, I wonder if you can find it or not? It's your mind. You purify it, it will be the cleanest! Can you believe it? Let's look carefully! Please consider carefully and sit quietly for half an hour. Don't not believe, believe: If you are pure for a moment, you will be able to be at peace in that moment. People in general are not safe!

Currently, roughly every day I receive phone calls from friends in Taiwan, at least one, sometimes two. I won't elaborate on the content. Usually there is insecurity, everyone is insecure, is there any place that is peaceful or not? No! Please put down! Once you let it go, you will be at peace. If you don't let go, you're always not at peace. Currently, we have such a fixed time, that is, for one and a half hours [listening to the sutra], we are very peaceful. Having this hour and a half, we are very happy. If you have been calm for an hour and a half, then be calm for an hour and a half; If you can calm down for two hours, then calm down for two hours. If you want to pray for eternal peace, you must attain enlightenment. If you don't attain enlightenment, there will be no way to settle down!

Even though one is born in heaven, heaven is still not stable. Usually, when Asura fights with the Dao Loi heaven, the human world is in chaos. The heavens were chaotic first, the human world was chaotic later. Brahma is a little better, the higher he goes, the better he gets, but the blessings are over, he still has to fall down, there is no good place!

As long as you have peace of mind, according to the Ten Rings of Buddha, Śākyamuni Buddha here is very peaceful, let us learn from Him. Śākyamuni Buddha said: There are countless types of lawsuits, conflicts, disputes, truly countless! The laws of each country are different. Up to now, the maritime convention has been largely ineffective. The laws of each country are different, and in each country, there are many lawsuit files in the courts. There are fights for everything, there are all kinds of lawsuits. There's too much anti-left talk. Every day is a struggle! “Mutual Khi Khi Lang” (Deceive and bully each other): Currently, to what extent are we defrauded and bullied? Even in each individual's family, husband and wife, father and son, mother and daughter all deceive and oppress each other. I have personally experienced it, I'm not talking nonsense!

During the great Cultural Revolution on the Mainland, I don't know how many small pieces a house that big was divided into, each person cooking in a separate kitchen. You join this sect, others join that sect, the situation is like that. Now that I think about it, where can I be so pure? People are like that. If you have power, influence, and money, [others] will try their best to flatter you, praise what you say, and listen to your ears! Is that so? Nowadays, no one dares to believe it. Is what he said true? Anyone who says anything has to put a question mark! When your children talk to you, you think: "I don't know if this kid is telling the truth or not! Maybe this kid is lying to me again!" Always use question marks. Who are you? Sometimes you ask yourself, what is real? Currently, the order all over the world is in chaos, there is no such thing as order. Husband and wife, father and son, the entire nation is like that. If you want to avoid chaos, it will be impossible! In that situation, how to avoid chaos? We must rely on the Buddha's teachings to take the Three Refuges and listen to Buddhist scriptures.

Aside from that, there's also illness. Currently, there are diseases that are not found in Buddhist scriptures at all. At that time, there were still no such diseases. In Buddhist scriptures, there is no cancer, only wasting, withering, indigestion, poor eyesight, damaged limbs, fever, malaria, cold, heat disease, and pestilence, which are the most serious diseases. Is there AIDS or not? There is none. Are there different types of cancer? No! Only later did I hear about these diseases. Before, I didn't know about them. There are too many types of diseases! If I hadn't experienced that scene myself or heard others say it, I wouldn't have believed it. But I saw it myself, I can't help but believe it, I saw the truth with my own eyes!

I went to Vinh Tong hospital[22] and Truong Canh, seeing people living in a vegetative state, I believed. I saw very few people, the number of people who were scared was more than the people I saw. I have only seen two such hospitals. Taiwan has it, Mainland has it or not? America or not? I'm afraid it's a lot! That type of vegetable person, as the Ksitigarbha Sutra says, cannot live, and cannot die. There is no way to describe that agony. According to the Ksitigarbha Sutra, that person is in the Underworld, being interrogated in court, the case has not yet been concluded, so he cannot die, but he cannot live. In other words, let that person take the blame. Live to sin! If someone else suffers, they can still go; If your family member is living in a vegetative state, and your relative is not dead yet, how can you be so cruel as to leave that person alone? There are many people who are in a vegetable state, causing their family members to collapse. Because there is such a person, [family members] will have to take care of that person and cannot go to work. In general, having to leave someone to take care of you, isn't that karma?

Also “hysterical mind” (hysterical character). Nowadays, there are many crazy people! If you don't hear it, you won't be able to understand it. Insane asylum, crazy people. My sister worked as a doctor at a mental hospital and is now retired. She said there were so many crazy people. In the past, treatment was with electroconvulsive therapy. After treatment, it is considered that the person is cured and no longer crazy, he will still become an idiot. I don't understand anything and my nerves are broken. After that, it changed to acupuncture treatment. When I get mad, I get acupuncture. After being injected, they stop being crazy and are no longer crazy. In the future, when the madness gets better, he will still have memory and be able to recognize his six relatives. If you are crazy, even if you have been cured, but even your six relatives and your own parents do not recognize it, what is the meaning of living, you say?

And the roots are incomplete, lacking arms and legs. Furthermore, with such progress in the current world, there are still many places where there is no clothes to wear and no food. From TV, we all see that there are places where war continues, food cannot be produced, and food is in short supply. Living beings in those places have extremely evil views and evil hearts. Therefore, if you go to that district, the people in the mountains there see others, no matter how they see it, immediately pull out their knives, preparing to fight with you. If you don't hurt them, let it go. If not, they will prepare to fight you. I use this to prove “malice”. They are also happy, but they are “maliciously mocking” (loving evil). Their minds are filled with anger, jealousy, obstacles, and doubts, and they have long lost the right path. Wrong views, evil views, evil thoughts are extremely burning. Therefore, they are lost in the right path. So is there any other way? That's the way it is when you're alive. When you die, you'll only fall into an evil destinies. Again wandering in the three evil destiniess. When he escapes from the three evil destiniess, he is reborn in a border area. When can reincarnation like that end?

Those are the places Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and Guan Yin Bodhisattva (Avalokiteśvara) care most about. You see living beings like that. We do not have the wisdom of a Bodhisattva. Although our hearts are also compassionate and merciful, we still have love, which belongs to the great loving view. They have some predestined relationship with us, so we do it (help, save). When I went to some places, I said those people were inferior to buffaloes and horses. You can tame buffalo and horses, they have some good hearts. If you raise a dog properly, it will wag its tail happily, but not those people. You develop a feeling of being bored and separated from them, unable to generate great compassion to save them. At that time, I had no [compassionate heart for salvation], only a feeling of boredom. You hope that when they change, their good karma is discovered, they can still meet the Buddha Dharma. It will be very difficult, I don't know how many generations it will take. That is a bad phenomenon, contrasting with it is a good phenomenon. Every thing has two sides, both are relative. Having said bad things, say good things. If it's good, then you can approach the Buddha Wheel. The same is true for Buddha to save sentient beings, because it is very difficult to establish the Buddha Wheel on the evil wheel!

(Sutra) Time, center-right country period veteran, intelligent, multi-intelligent, scholarly, forgiving, dignified and dignified, thoughtful in planning, using the books, convening the people of the country, moving forward together, serving as the prince. satisfied. CThe characteristics of all beings are superior to the merits and virtues, all the organs are perfect, the body has no defects, the body is large, the appearance is good and dignified, the achievements are the most beautiful and beautiful, always respected, respected, and kind to the people without any affection. Bpure in nature, always compassionate, learned, multi-talented, skilled in all kinds of techniques, gentle, patient, dignified in mind, good for the future, good for birth and death. Because of all the wonderful fragrances and pure water, harmonizing the cold ovum and wood desire in the body, in front of the superior strains of wonderful fragrances, they protect solemnity and clean clothes, MAt-ni jewels, tri at the next Trung. Kim bao, hoa man, mandarin chess player, to practice light rising uncle u give offerings.
(Kinh: At that time, in the country there were veterans, intelligent, multi-minded, well-educated, calm, tolerant, dignified, respectable, plotting, discussing, calculating plans, immediately gathered the people of the country, together nominated a prince. First of all, he must have all kinds of [virtues]: almsgiving, self-control, quiet virtue, diligence, courage, performing difficult ascetic practices, all of them are complete and have all the signs of great merit, perfect faculties, and no defects in all limbs and parts of the body. Tall and dignified in appearance, with the most beautiful appearance and appearance, often respected and respected by all, people all over the country are close to and loved by everyone. Bhas a gentle and sincere nature, often embraces compassion, is widely learned, very talented, has all the skillful professions, is gentle and patient to dignify the mind, is a true descendant born of the queen. Use precious incense to scent the pure water, adjust the temperature appropriately, bathe his body, dress him in new clean clothes embalmed with all kinds of wonderful scents and adorn him with precious things, jewels placed in his hair bun.

Speaking in correspondence with the previous part. That country had no king and was very chaotic. There are very few people with right views, but many people with wrong views. At that time, there were wise people in that country. “Ky” are elders in the past. They are wise, very well educated, very peaceful, and treat others with tolerance. Seeing that the country was in that situation, they immediately discussed, plotted, and thought of all possible solutions. “Tr” is to draw up a plan, “book” is to promote. Currently, the national situation is like that, everyone negotiates together, there must be a solution. Together, these veterans convened the people of the whole country, that is, the “people's hamlet”. Everyone nominated and chose a prince from among the previous king's children, also choosing together. That prince must be able to control himself, be able to give alms, be able to maintain precepts, and obey worldly laws. Thi La (Śīla) is the precepts, including [virtues] “quietness, compassion, prevention, and cessation of evil”. “Silent Thi La” has such a meaning.

You must find such a prince, [he] must be able to give alms generously, control his own temperament, be able to obey the law, and must also be diligent and courageous. Being diligent and courageous means being able to perform austerities that others cannot do. All of these things must be complete. It must also have a superior appearance of merit and virtue, and an appearance that is not too ugly. It's not good for a person to be a king if he's too bad. Eyes, ears, nose, tongue, body, mind, and senses are all perfect. No part of the body's limbs is lacking. The body cannot be too short, it must be tall, and it must also have a good and dignified appearance. Accomplishing such a beautiful and mysterious appearance is often respected and revered by everyone. All the people in that country expressed their affection for that prince.

“Pure nature, always compassionate, scholarly, multi-talented, skilled by the craftsmen” means: The prince's temperament is pure and simple, often interested in benefiting and helping others, without harming or harming anyone. He is very well educated and has good professions. “Be gentle, patient, dignify the mind” (The mind is adorned with gentleness, patience): Being gentle means not being rough. Patience is being treated unjustly, and one does not compare it with others. “Thi Dai Concubine gives birth to a true child” (Is a descendant born of the Queen), meaning: If born to a concubine, he would not be a direct child (a descendant of the queen), and would be a bit inferior. Therefore, one must choose the Crown Prince born from the queen, that is, the son of the former consort.

Having such a Crown Prince, after selection, use pure fragrant water, not cold, not hot, to regulate warm and cold, to bathe the prince's body. His clothes were all embalmed with magical incense. [Clothes] are new, clean, adorned with jewels. “Ma-ni jewel, wisdom lies in the middle” (Ma-ni jewel pinned on her hair bun): I have seen this type, Tibetan people are like that. Mandarins of the fourth rank and above did not cut their hair, and in their hair wore a small Buddha[23] crown. However, they do not have the Manhini jewel, they wear a decorative Buddha image in their hair. The other king wore the Manhini jewel in his bun. In the past, it was all about wrapping your hair [into a bun], this is a figurative way of saying it. Use gold to decorate the most beautiful hair crown. These things are used “to practice light tang tang u te phat” (a light white silk tie tied across the eyelids): The hair must be rolled up and tied into a bow to worship Buddha. I saw Tibetan people curl their hair into two buns, just like our children have their hair curled into two peaches, with a Buddha altar placed in the middle. Inside the shrine, there is a Buddha statue, also encrusted with precious stones, which means using gems to inlaid the outside of the shrine to worship the Buddha. Usually, people wear a lot of statues of Avalokiteshvara.

(Sutra) They told us to spread the fortune of a wealthy person, set up a fairy-tale place to protect the throne of the Immortal Immortal, enter the throne of the Immortal Emperor to protect together,skillful encampment to the magical great hall, ascend to the throne of the Immortal King.
(Sutra: Again using precious things like Mat-ni (Ma-ni), pearls, gold, silver... are combined to form ear rings, pearl necklaces, bracelets, bracelets, seals, etc. All kinds of magical jewels adorn the body, form precious sandals to support the feet, and arrange the throne to be protected by all the heavenly gods since ancient times. Entering the majestic and beautiful main hall, skillfully built, accepted by all the heavenly emperors. Accept protection and ascend to the noble throne of the previous king).

We know that Tibetan men all wear earrings, but they are not pierced to wear on the lobe of the ear, but rather [tied] to wear on the lobe of the ear. They wear very large ear rings. People with dignity can tell at a glance what rank they are. Only mandarins of grade four or higher are allowed to wear them, those below grade four will not be allowed. Earrings are also divided into levels, using green gems (turquoise), or red gems (ruby). Head decorations are also related to rank. In addition, the horse they ride has a golden tip attached to its head, so you must give way. That is a great mandarin of the third grade or higher, or a Great Buddha[24]. I use these examples to visualize the majesty of the ancient king. In addition, underneath the horse, that is, below the horse's head, at the neck, tie a red tassel, that is, in front of the horse's sternum, tie a red tassel. Tying two tassels is a fourth-grade mandarin, tying three tassels is a third-grade mandarin or higher. In addition, saddles are also divided according to class. Therefore, the pendant and the ear ring are all made from interwoven jewels. The solemnity of the king is even more different. He sat in a palanquin, his whole body covered with jewels, and his saddle was made of carefully carved jewels. This is an image of the situation when the ancient kings ascended the throne or were on tour. Because the scriptures are based on the contemporary situation in India to describe, it is not the same as the current situation. Currently, it is no longer there. Saying these things is an example when [the king] first ascended the throne.

When the prince had not yet ascended the throne, he was chosen and decorated like that. Let him sit on the throne that was protected by the ancient sages of the past, and everyone bowed and invited him. “Entering all the heavenly emperors and promising to jointly protect and maintain them, are skillful in constructing the marvelous great hall” (Entering the grand hall is sublime, mysterious, well-constructed, approved and maintained by all the heavenly emperors): This is a metaphor, saying that the hall has been renovated very beautifully. It's the same when you go to Taiwan, it's the same when you go to the Mainland, even in Wengehua (Vancouver), the temples are also very good. Everything that is carved into a Buddha statue, up to the Buddha's seat, is a precious seat. This future great king, before ascending the throne, sat on a precious throne protected by all the immortals. These things are all legends.

Emperor, Cuu Ban Do Emperor, ancient and generous guardians. The sound and sound resonate, the pearls transform the world, the four great species of Sat-di-benefit, the countless people, wood-desire-body, before pure clothes, holding the wonderful species of precious treasures, canopy, one, field, phan, Mat-ni, true pearls, gold, silver, loa, jade, coral, lapis lazuli class, impeccable colors, immeasurable gems, worshiping The new king, the course of the family. Noble, pure, learned, multi-talented Brahmins, countless wonderful races praise, praise the truth, all good races pray to the king, and auspicious people praise the king.
(Sutra: The king has succeeded, knocking all the vast bells and drums has won all the kings Heaven, Dragon King, King Duoc Xoa, King At To Lac, King Cuu Ban Do protect. That sound echoed throughout the country, countless people of the four great natures such as Sat-de-loi, etc. bathed their bodies, put on clean clothes, held colored silk ropes, parasols, rosaries, phantoms, made of precious things,Mat-ni, pearls, gold, silver, large conch shells, jade, and sand. chanting, swallowing lapis lazuli, etc. of lovely colors, immeasurable and precious, offered to the new king, to create auspicious omens. Noble nobles, well-learned and talented Brahmins, used countless kinds of wonderful praise, chanted, recited the king's virtues and all kinds of good deeds, prayed to the king, sprinkled auspicious things on the top of the king's head).

There is also a great hall built and designed with such beautiful decorations. [The new king] ascended to the noble throne of his predecessor, inheriting the throne. After he had succeeded to the throne, he "appealed to the Thien Thien Emperor, Dragon Emperor, Duoc Xoa God Emperor, Asura Emperor, Cuu Ban Do Emperor, and all the vast and ancient guardians" (beating the vast bells and drums that were protected by all the heavenly kings, dragon kings, Yoc Xoa god kings, Asura kings, and Cuu Ban Do kings): This is a figurative saying, meaning "the bells and drums are protected by the heavenly dragons and bowls". In the past, the Manchu emperor entered the court every day with bells and drums ringing at the same time. In the monk's temple, morning and evening chants must be accompanied by bells and drums. When welcoming a Venerable, you must sound the drums and invite the bells at the same time. All monks in the monastery must put on their robes and line up to welcome them. That is the visualization of noble meaning. In fact, because the masses belong to the eight orders of ghosts and spirits such as heaven, dragon, etc., protecting the dharma, we often imagine that the emperor is protected by “hundred spirits” (hundreds of sacred species). That's because of his good fortune.

At that time, the bells and drums sounded together, making the whole country aware. Next, Brahman, Kshatriya, Vaisya, and Thudala are the four great races of ancient nature in India. There are countless people of the four great natures, everyone bathes, changes clothes, wears clean clothes, and also uses all kinds of precious substances to form ashes, parasols, mats, and phantoms. These are all figurative words: gold, silver, conch, jade, coral, vidurya (or lapis lazuli). “Contaminated Color” is a yellow person, “Born Color” is the color born from heaven (natural color), their color is naturally born, is yellow, or white. Countless rare and precious treasures were all presented to the king who had just ascended the throne.

“Vowing to the Buddha King”: In the previous part, we saw Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva praising the merits of the Buddha, and the Buddha praising the merits of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. That is the meaning of all kinds of praise.

(Kinh) The first king respected aristocrats, learned, multi-skilled, straightforward, wise, whatever he wanted. accepted, accepted various bureaucratic positions, and managed royal affairs. The immortals of the national realm are self-ruled, the foreign kings are invaded by the same army, the golden phase spirit is. Dthe spirit is necessarily resentful, evil friends, can harm those who are harmful, the stage must be destroyed, the damage to the self-country is necessarily black, and the benefit of the country is necessarily white. Good man! Kshat-de-loi seed is empowered by the great king, and achieves the status of the first royal wheel. Due to the temptation of turning the wheel, you can attain peace and happiness in your country, conquer all enemies and evil friends, protect your body, and increase your life span.
(Kinh: For noble nobles who are respected by their ancestors, well-educated, talented, upright Honest, wise, and according to their abilities, they will be assigned to bureaucratic positions to take care of the affairs of the country. First of all, in the country, all the enemies of the country and other countries that have harmed each other will now be destroyed. All the enemies, evil friends, and harm-doers will be eliminated, all the bad things in the country will be eliminated, and all the good things in the country will be increased. This good man! Kshatriya has been empowered to achieve the first king wheel like that. Because of that wheel, he can live peacefully in his own land, can subdue all enemies and evil friends, and skillfully protect the body, causing his life span to increase.)

“The first king respected aristocrats, was learned and multi-skilled, straightforward and wise, and accepted bureaucratic positions according to their preferences” (For nobles who were respected by the previous kings, were well-educated, talented, straightforward, and wise, depending on their abilities, bureaucratic positions were awarded): When the new king ascends the throne, he must bestow officials. In the past, those nobles and mandarins were talented, outstandingly educated, or handled public affairs, were wise, and worthy of holding positions.

“According to each person's preferences, they receive positions of various kinds and bureaucratic positions” [that is] giving officials positions to them [depending on their appropriate abilities], so that they can help the king handle state affairs. When the new king ascends the throne, there must be a new climate to reverse the country's disasters. "First of all, the country's self-ruled state, spared the invaders of the same country, golden phase spirit" (First of all, within the country, the troops of one's own country and the troops of other countries invaded each other, now it has all ended): In the past, the national situation was chaotic, fighting each other, either the army of our own country, or the army of another country invading and causing harm, or the princes asserting hegemony on one side, now it is all over. Because the new king ascended the throne, there was a new meteorology.

“The spirit of the heron necessarily resents its enemies, evil friends, those who harm, and is completely destroyed” (Also causes all enemies, evil friends, and those who can cause harm to all be destroyed): All are destroyed. Eliminate all the bad things in your country, eliminate bad karma, increase all the good things in your country, increase good karma. Destroy the Ten Evils, practice the Ten Goods.

“Good man! The great king of the Kshat-de-loi seed has initiated the great king and accomplished it like the first king-wheel” (Good man! The great king of the Kshat-de-loi nature has been empowered and accomplished the first king-wheel like that): This is the first king-wheel of the king. This is purely an analogy, intended to show the first point in the Buddha Wheel. Next, we will talk about Buddha Wheel.

“Due to the test of the wheel of fate, one can abide in peace and happiness” (Due to this wheel, in that state, one can abide in peace): The people in that country are peaceful, happy, eliminating resentment from enemies and evil friends. The life span of that king's people also increased, and the king protected them. That is the first king wheel.

(Sutra) Good man! Like the world contaminated by the five impurities, Sach Ha Buddha Land, not without Buddha time, in the middle period all living beings, because of the self-centered mind, are constantly entangled, self-destructive, harmful to others, oppressing, melancholy, disturbed, ignorant, restless, giving rise to countless types of attachment to permanence, fighting and avoiding, mutual contempt, giving rise to greed, anger, ignorance, delusion, stalking, and compiling the ten types of unwholesome karma. Attachment to sentient beings disrupts the world, accomplishes all kinds of afflictions and diseases, lacks the right Dharma vision, anger burns the brain, often does not think about the true Dharma, has the right taste of the Dharma, destroys good deeds, minimizes the joys and pleasures of the wrong taste, always believes that the kind of afflictions is the net of riches, takes refuge in the six kinds of heretical evil masters, is lost in the holy path, and tends to the three evil beasts.
(Sutra: O good man! The world of evil and impurities is like that, in the Buddha's world Sach Ha, enter When there is emptiness, there is no Buddha, and all sentient beings in it, due to the impurities and entanglements of their own minds, are harmed, invaded, oppressed, sad, disturbed, ignorant, dark, insecure, giving rise to countless attachments to annihilation or eternal views, disputes, lawsuits, contempt for each other, giving rise to greed, anger, ignorance, flattering speech, deceit, etc., all the ten types of immoral karma. sentient beings are attached to making troubles in the world, achieving all kinds of afflictions and diseases, lacking the eyes of the Dharma, being consumed by anger and harm, often not thinking about the true Dharma, abandoning the taste of the Dharma, slandering, destroying good conduct, lacking in enjoying the sense of joy and happiness, often being obscured by all kinds of nets of afflictions, taking refuge in false teachers of the six types of heretics, losing the holy path, and heading towards the three evil destiniess).

This is an image of Buddha benefiting sentient beings. Therefore, first talk about the appearance of living beings. What is the general status of this country?

Like an evil life with five impurities! Book Ha (Sahā-loka-dhātu) is the land of Sa Ba. In this country, when there is no Buddha [in the world], the previous Buddha has passed away, the next Buddha has not yet been born. Currently, Śākyamuni Buddha has entered nirvana, Maitreya Buddha has not yet been born, that is when there is no Buddha. This Sa Ba world includes many countries. “The mind depends on the mind”: The mind depends on the mind[25] is the basis of afflictions, arising according to the minds of living beings. “Construction” binds, covers, is impure, “structure” is impure. “Tu quan” (one's own army) is the affliction within the mind, “tha quan” (other people's army) is the affliction caused by the appearance of the external realm. Internally and externally attacked, harmed, invaded, and oppressed, sentient beings live in a state of sadness and affliction. Society is in turmoil, and sentient beings are also insecure. Again, stupid, dark, stubborn, and not smart. The mind is not alert, nor can it have intelligence. “Minh” is darkness, often in darkness it is “ignorance” (not clear). In an uneasy mind, it cannot be pure.

At the same time, they give rise to countless attachments to the Endless View and the Eternal View. Regarding the views of Doan and Thuong, you always consider yourself reasonable, like to fight, and like to sue. “Chanting” means going to court. Fighting couldn't solve the problem, so they took each other to court. Or resent each other and kill each other. Everyone does not find others pleasing to the eye, they are arrogant, conceited, and their arrogance is especially strong. We just thought we would know this right away, there's no need to say more. Always feel like we are terrible, despise each other, look down on others. Full of greed, anger, ignorance, deceit, deception, and flattery! The words spoken were all words of flattery, sarcasm, and arrogance towards the subordinates, not a single word could be found that was true, not telling the truth at all. In general, all ten types of unwholesome karma! Lying, embellishing, evil speech, double-talking are verbal karma, “killing, stealing, sexual misconduct” are physical karma, “greed, anger, ignorance” are mental karma.

Therefore, in this Saha world, the beings with attachments in this world achieve all kinds of diseases and afflictions. Illness comes from the mind, we suffer a lot, what kind of illness is that?
