Disease of affliction. Ordinary worldly illnesses can be treated by a doctor, but afflictions must be cured by oneself. Looking at problems without the eyes of the Dharma will not see clearly. What was done was completely evil, “evil” means unrighteous. “Anger burns the brain” (Anger burns, the brain harms) means to be disturbed and restless, never thinking about the Dharma. Often do not think about the true Dharma. What is Dharma? Such as not being greedy, not being angry, not being ignorant, not telling lies, not making false statements, not being cruel, not saying double-minded things, not "killing, stealing, or committing sexual misconduct" is right speech, right view, right livelihood, and right thinking. That is the Dharma.

Because they do not think about the Dharma, regarding the beautiful things of the Dharma, they cannot give rise to Dharma joy. Using taste as an example, [dharma joy] is like taste. Because they do not attain the taste of the Dharma, they do not give rise to the joy of Dharma. How to achieve what symbolizes dharma joy? If you meditate quietly, you can achieve peace; When you come out of Samadhi, you will feel that all the disturbing things have completely stopped. All the worries and thoughts in your mind will not arise, you will achieve peace, you will achieve that joy. When you read and recite Mahayana sutras, you feel extremely joyful and extremely happy in your heart. That is achieving the Dharma of joy.

Furthermore, when reading the sutras and reading this passage, I felt it was very useful to myself. In my mind, joy arose in my mind. I felt that I had many bad habits, so I changed them. These are all considered “feeling the taste of dharma joy”. If contrasted, is it not like that, there is no true Dharma thinking, but thinking is completely evil, how can it be called “Dharma thinking”? We use examples to talk. Like the Four Foundations of Mindfulness, [contemplation of] body, feelings, mind, dharma, those four types are called the Four Foundations of Mindfulness. Contemplating the impurity of the body, the nine holes often flow out [impure]. Contemplate that our flesh body is not clean at all! Two eyes, two nostrils, two ears, one mouth, that's seven elements, plus urination makes nine holes. The nine holes often pour out impurities and are not clean. Even if we sweat all over our bodies, if we don't shower all day, others will smell the stink. Your pores secrete sweat. It's not pure. You yourself feel troubled.

If you often smell a strange fragrance, you will feel free from afflictions. If you have those realms, all kinds of afflictions will be eliminated. Like a fishing net, your true mind is covered by that net [of afflictions]. There are many beliefs in evil sects and pagans nowadays. Learning magical powers, learning Qigong, and taking care of your body is a good thing, but you cannot take care of this body! No matter how you maintain it, if you get into a car accident, everything will be gone! Flying on a plane is often risky, can you maintain it? Often things happen that are beyond your expectations. That is something you cannot maintain, so you must have the right view.

Right view is observing this body as impure, that is, “contemplating the impurity of the body”. Contemplating feeling, Feeling is Kho Tho, meaning “receiving”. Cold, warm, luxurious, you just come into contact with it, as we just mentioned about the empowerment ritual, you have to determine the appropriate water temperature. It's too cold, that person will shiver. If it's hot, the person will jump. It must be a moderate cold and hot temperature, it will be very suitable. If you listen to the Dharma, the Dharma's joy is abundant, corresponding to your mind, very compatible, you will have a joyful mind, and will receive it. Tho (reception): If it's too hot, you won't be comfortable. If you are beaten or punished, it is even more unpleasant. If you fall ill, that kind of suffering, let alone your head will ache and you will sweat. Stomach pain is as painful as dying. No matter how good the doctor is, sometimes he has to give up. Karma has been discovered, no matter how good you are, you can't bear it. So for Tho, no matter how happy it is, you know it is all suffering. Pleasure is the cause of suffering; In the end, it's still suffering. Contemplating the impermanence of the mind, every day is full of delusions. Contemplating the dharma without self is called the right path.

If you do not meditate like that, you will lose the right path. We spend every day for this body, we don't know how many brain cells we spend: What clothes to wear, what to eat, how to live comfortably. When the body comes into contact with Feeling, how should one enjoy it? With all my heart and attention, I have so many delusions that I can never calm down, just like a monkey, but my mind is also like an ape. That is called the Four Foundations of Mindfulness. That is the basic right view of a student of Buddhism, one must constantly think like that. That is called the right path. If you don't think like that, you will lose the right path, called "lost thoughts". There are also those who have received the Three Refuges, the master tells you: "For twenty-four hours, you must recite Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha." If you have lost your mindfulness, that is, you have lost sight of the right path and followed an evil destinies. Where will the evil destinies lead? Hungry ghosts and animals are born towards the three evil destiniess. [What was just said above] is to visualize this Sa Ba world, Śākyamuni Buddha is in this Sa Ba world. In an era where there is no Buddha in the world, what will the world be like? That's just such a realm! There is very little right path and mindfulness, too much wrong knowledge and wrong views. Especially in times when there was no Buddha, [those wrong knowledge and wrong views] were especially flourishing. I don't need to say much about this, everyone can understand. There are still so many left! They don't believe in the right path at all, they strongly believe in the wrong path, and believe very sincerely, why? Due to the combination of past karma and present circumstances, karma and scenes, their holy path and past karma are not very compatible! Therefore, the Diamond Sutra teaches: One who can hear the name Vajracchedikā Prajñāpāramitā does not have to sow good roots in one, two, three, four, five Buddhas, but rather has sown good roots in Buddhas many times, many lives in the past, only then can he hear Vajra Prajñāpāramitā, until after hearing it he can believe deeply without doubt. This is also true of the Ten Wheels of Kṣitigarbha Sūtra.

The Ksitigarbha Dharma, except for the Ksitigarbha Sutra, which is known to many people, but the Contemplation of Good and Evil Karma and the Ten Rings Sutra, very few people have heard of, even the name of the sutra has never been heard of! Why? Because they don't have that cause and effect with Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, they don't even have that cause and effect to hear his name! What's more, listen to all the principles in this sutra. That's what it means! “Being lost in the holy path” means losing the right path, leading to the three evil destiniess. That is the image of this country, when there is no king, what situation the country will be in. Then, there was a wise king, and the country immediately changed. That is referring to Buddha's Buddha Wheel. If at that time there is no Buddha in the world, sentient beings will suffer, have lost the right path, and move towards the three evil destiniess.

(Sutra) Trying to be loyal, possessing Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas, in the past, being close and making offerings immeasurable Buddhas, to enter the great ocean of merit and virtue of the Buddhas, to abide in the Buddhas' original practice of the path, to gather together, to come to the self, to say the same thing: “The past, to practice immeasurable generosity, discipline, tranquility Thi La, diligence, courage, difficult asceticism will necessarily be satisfied, All the wonderful blessings and wisdom of expediency, great compassion and great compassion, together with adorning the great merit-garbha, all the Dharma-holding and forbearance of all the merit-filled grounds of great ocean, without fear, without roots, with a great body, perfect appearance, patience, gentleness, correctness and wonderfulness”.
(Sutra: In this world there are Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas who, in the past, were close to them and made offerings to them. Countless Buddhas, who have entered the ocean of merit of Buddhas, have remained in the path of Buddhas who have practiced, all come together and tell me: “You in the past have practiced immeasurable almsgiving, discipline, tranquility in Thi La, diligence, courage, all asceticism and hard practice have been completed, are a storehouse of great merit adorned with the wonderful means of blessings, wisdom, great compassion, etc., the ocean of perfect merit of all. All Dharma maintains peace and patience in all positions, does not flatter, does not deceive, has a tall body, perfect appearance, patience, gentleness, decency and mystery of victory.

Ma Ha translates as Great. There are great Bodhisattvas in the past who have been close to and made offerings to countless Buddhas, entered the ocean of merit of the Buddhas, and stayed in the path that the Buddhas originally practiced. That is to say, those great Bodhisattvas are like the veterans of the land, with the same meaning. The Buddha used an example to say: The Buddha attained enlightenment because of the advice of the great Bodhisattvas. “Giai plus gather, lai will ta so” (All gather together, come to my place): “I” is Śākyamuni Buddha's self-proclaimed name for Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. They all came to my place. At the same time, everyone told me: "In the past, you have cultivated immeasurable generosity, discipline, tranquility, Thi La, diligence, courage, the Six Paramitas, and ten thousand virtues. You have all practiced very well and have achieved success." "If you practice asceticism, you will definitely be satisfied" (All austerities that are difficult to practice are complete): Being able to practice asceticism is a storehouse of great merit adorned by the means of miraculous wisdom, great compassion, etc., complete with merit, that is the meaning!

“The absolute Concentration maintains the peace and patience of all the great oceans of perfect merit and virtue” (It is the ocean of perfect merit of all the concentration, the total concentration maintains peace and patience in all positions): “The places” are the Ten Grounds, Equal Enlightenment and Wonderful Enlightenment. “General maintenance” is like Xa Ma Tha (Śamatha), the wonderful Lang Gia concentration mentioned in the previous section. General Tri is also called Samadhi. Therefore, the merits of all levels are completely complete and fully achieved.

“Immortal, stemless, great body” (No flattery, no lies, tall body): Thirty-two generals and eighty types of goodness.

(Sutra) If you do not follow the Bodhi path, you will attain complete wisdom and perfection, achieving the supreme beauty and wonderful content. Form and ability are necessarily Thanh Van, Unique Enlightenment is a great teacher, has the ability to comfort life and death and protect sentient beings, act as friends, great compassion and immeasurable merit and virtue, together with solemnity, is Yet Lac Ca, Ton Da Yet Nac Ca, Mau Ni Ca Diep Ba Tathagata is the true father of the father.
He possesses supreme beauty, can be a great teacher for all Sravakas and Pratyekabuddhas, can also comfort all sentient beings who are afraid of birth and death, be a close friend to them, has immeasurable merits such as great compassion, etc., and is dignified, is the true son of fathers such as Yet Lac Ca, Ton Da Yet Nac Ca,Munikasyapa Tathagata, etc.)

“Do not rely on others to practice the Bodhi path” (No longer rely on anyone else to practice the Bodhi path): Having fully achieved Bodhi, attained Bodhi, no longer rely on Buddha or teachers to practice the Bodhi path. Why? Because he has fully achieved the ocean of All-Wisdom, achieved the supreme beauty and beauty, which is also the solemn and wonderful beauty of the Buddha. Any evil person, whenever they see the Buddha, will still respect and worship. "Ability to be a great teacher for all Sravakas and Single Enlightened Ones" (Can be a great teacher for all Sravakas and Single Enlightened Ones): Leading the Second Vehicle to enter the Mahayana, until becoming a teacher for all sentient beings.

“The ability to comfort all living beings, to protect all sentient beings, and to act as friends” (Can also comfort all sentient beings who are afraid of samsara, to be their close friend): That means that in the midst of samsara, where there is fear and fear, you can be close friends and can teach those living beings. This is the Buddha who can manifest as the embodiment of all living beings, in the Four Dharmas, i.e. Collaboration, Beneficial Action, Almsgiving, [Love Speech] can manifest and practice compassion for fellow beings. “Great compassion and immeasurable merits combined with adornment” (The same adornment by immeasurable merits as great compassion, etc.), can all be achieved.

“Thi Yet Lac Ca, Ton Da Yet Nac Ca, Mauni Kassapa Tathagata of the true fathers” (The true children of fathers such as Yet Lac Ca, Ton Da Yet Nac Ca, and Muni Kassapa Tathagata etc.): These are the three Buddhas in the Human Sage Kalpa, in which there were a total of one thousand Buddhas. The three Buddhas accomplished things in the past. Śākyamuni Buddha is the fourth Buddha. In the Human Sage Kalpa, there are nine hundred and ninety-six Buddhas, Maitreya Buddha is the fifth Buddha. Nhan Hien Kiep is the Eternal Tribulation. During the twenty small kalpas of the Eternal kalpa, one thousand Buddhas appeared in the world.

Currently, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva has made this vow. It's the same in the Ksitigarbha Sutra, it's the same in the Contemplation Sutra, it's the same in the Ten Wheels of Kṣitigarbha Sūtra. As long as [you] in the Dharma-Ending Age, have the merits of a grain of dust, a grain of sand, or a drop of water toward Buddha Dharma, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva will save you. Maitreya Bodhisattva also made this vow. When Maitreya Bodhisattva becomes a Buddha, in the Dragon Flower Three Assembly, he will save all remaining disciples in the Dharma-Ending Age of Śākyamuni Buddha, causing them to escape the sea of ​​suffering. But we must sow that cause even deeper, so that when Maitreya lives in this world, we will be able to attain salvation, and even Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva will take us to all the Pure Lands in the ten directions. Depending on which Pure Land you wish for, you can [be born there].

Three Buddhas are mentioned here. Kanakamuni is Kāśyapa Buddha, Krakucchanda is the Venerable Buddha, Kāśyapa is Kāśyapa, also among the fifty-three Buddhas that we often worship. They are also the three Buddhas in the past. Śākyamuni Buddha is the fourth Buddha in the Sage Kalpa. Here it is said that Śākyamuni Buddha is the true son of the three Tathagata, that is, like a prince, also the true son, that is, the true son of the Buddhas, but also a Buddhist.

(Sutra) Trying Hien Kiep, attaining Buddhahood, Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat is absolutely supreme. clinging. Dis the meritorious seed of the wonderful fragrance, Huan Xa Ma Tha, the pure water of Bhikkhu, the wood of desire, in front of the precious robe, the pure dharma realm for the central continent, the power of the Buddhas to practice the vast and wild realm, forcing the release of wonderful and wonderful elements.
(Sutra: In this Sage Life, one will become a Buddha, the foremost of all Bodhisattvas Sat Ma Ha Tat. Use the miraculous merit incense to steam the pure water of Xa Ma Tha and Bhikkhu Pāsāna to bathe yourself, put on the shame robe, use the pure Dharma precepts as a pearl in your hair bun, use the vast flower garland "of the Buddha's realm of practice" to make a crown, use the white silk of miraculous liberation to tie it).

“If you try Hien Kiep, you will attain Buddhahood” [meaning] in Nhan Hien lifetime, you will become Buddha at that time. He is the fourth Buddha. “Nevertheless Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat is the supreme leader” (The highest leader among the Bodhisattvas Ma Ha Tat): The supreme leader is the monk who is the head of the temple, the monk is the Buddha. That is the monk's preparation. When the monk [abbot] is not present, the head monk will represent the monk. If [the head monk] has something to do and needs to go out, the head monk will take care of the work on his behalf. Just like the President has a Vice President. If the President has temporary work, the Vice President will take over. That is called the Supreme Master, the most superior among the disciples of the Buddhas. “Due to all the merits and strains of wonderful fragrance, the pure water of Xa Ma Tha and Bhikkhu Pārāna is pure water” (Using the mysterious merit incense to inhale the pure water of Sāma Tha and Bhikkhu Pāsāna): That water is not water in the world, but is Concentration of Wisdom, which also means Contemplation. Xa Ma Tha (Śamatha) translates as Concentration, Bhikkhu Pāsāna (Vipaśyanā) translates as Contemplation. Chi Quan water is Dinh Hue water, use that water to bathe.

“In front of your heart” (Wearing clothes of shame): Clothing of shame is the ca-sa. The word Ca-sa (Kāṣāya) includes many meanings. Here it is said “tam noble clothing”, because wearing that shirt, you will always be ashamed. Shame (embarrassment) because of the above comparison with virtuous people, one becomes ashamed because one lacks merit. Precious (embarrassed) is ashamed of the people below me, I cannot be compassionate and save them. Often have that mind, considering it as clothing, using shame as clothing. In his precious bun, that is, in the middle of his hair crown, is the pure dharma realm. The pure Dharma realm is immaculate, unblemished, and formless, using these things as jewels in the bun. “The power of the Buddhas operating in the vast realm of flowers and man” (Using the large flower garland “the realm of the Buddhas' activities” to make the crown): Don't consider this as a specific appearance, but use it to visualize the merits of the Buddha. These are all formless dharmas. "Entering the miraculous liberation of the secret of liberation" (Tie with white silk to achieve the miraculous liberation): "Liberation" is to attain the three doors of liberation, Emptiness, Formlessness, ultimate liberation, eighteen dharmas of Non-Composition, Four Non-Fulfilling Dharmas. Those are all signs of liberation, like the king's brooch, which has such a meaning.

(Sutra) Of the All-Wisdom of the All-Knowing Race, Infinite Samsara-Forbearance, meritorious virtues, jewels, and adornments, Compassion, compassion, joy, equanimity, the teachings of the three realms, the three realms of wonderful conduct, the perfection of the saints of the universe, the one, the ancient Buddhas of heaven and earth together to protect the Vajra Dharma seat, enter the all-sravakas, the Single Enlightenment respectfully protect the four pillars of mindfulness, sit on the throne of the Buddhas, attain the Supreme Perfect Bodhi All-Wisdom position.
(Sutra: Again use meritorious treasures such as Omniscience, Non-Born Forbearance, etc. to adorn oneself, use love, compassion, joy, and equanimity as precious sandals, use the three types of perfect perfect conduct that are the causes of saints that can cover the three realms, make canopies and parasols, arrange the Vajra Samadhi throne that has been protected by the Buddhas since ancient times, enter the four types of mindfulness and are respectfully and maintained by all Sravakas and Pratyekabuddhas, sit on the seat of the Buddhas who have experienced it before, attain the status of Supreme Perfect Bodhi, Omniscience).

Again, using merits such as Omniscience, Non-Born Forbearance, etc. All Sravakas, Pratyekabuddhas, and Bodhisattvas achieved Omniscience. The Buddha is the wisest of all wisdoms, so he is called “Universal wisdom”. Non-Birth Dharma Forbearance is “forbearance” of all non-born dharmas. Putting the word Forbearance first means “accepting all dharmas as non-living”. Without birth there will be no destruction, which is the tranquility of Nirvana, which includes this meaning. In Buddhism, when talking about merit, it is often said that we should understand it a bit. What is merit? It is what we inherently have, confident that we are Buddha. Speaking from our side, confident that we are Buddhas, that merit is inherent. But on the one hand, we have to go through practice to make it right, on the other hand, it is inherent, buried in defilements, in hindrances, and obscured by ignorance. Buddha has finally attained and understood. Now we do not have that awareness of all dharmas, nor do we consider them as non-living. If we perceive all dharmas as Emptiness, they will have full merit and emptiness. What is the nature of anasrava? No more leaking, falling into the six realms, no more falling into the Sravakas and Pratyekabuddhas!

In the process of Buddhist practice, judging by the Avatamsaka sect, there will be fifty-two positions. The first is the Ten Faiths, [which refers to cultivating] our faith. The Ten Faiths have completed, they still do not participate in the position of [Three Sages, Ten Saints], just the position of Ten Faiths. Thap Xin has not yet entered the [sage] position, because he is still regressing. In this life, trust is born, in the next life it is reversed. Just going back and forth like that, it's not certain. Unless you stay in the state of Seven Pillars, you will not retreat to the status of Thanh Van and Duyen Giac. The First Pillar does not retreat and falls into the six paths, the First Head is equal to the Arhat. In the Yuan Sect, this position is called the Unrelenting One. If it is Non-Regression, it is even more difficult. Non-regression means reaching the status of Seven Grounds Bodhisattva. Achieving the Eighth Grounds is a useless practice, there is no need to diligently practice anymore, that Bodhisattva will forever be like that, that is called Non-Regression.

If we have not reached those positions, the Faith position is not yet complete, the Ten Faith positions are very difficult. At present, we feel that the previous recitation is not right, but we still let it continue, knowing clearly that it is not right but still keep doing it, so we don't even have faith! As soon as the Sister Tin heard the Dharma, her skin got goosebumps, she immediately entered it, knew what things were evil, and would not do them again. Knowing that you are thinking incorrectly, you will be able to stop immediately. Recognizing evil pre-thoughts will prevent future thoughts from arising. Once you enter the position of Faith, what realm will you have? That person's merit can only grow higher, not decline. Believe in Buddha, believe in Dharma, believe in Sangha, absolutely cannot waver. It is better to give up one's life and life and never abandon one's beliefs, that is to enter the Faith. For now, use that credit to test yourself personally. Do we have such faith now? Just be able to not let go of your thoughts. The second mind of faith is Remembrance of Non-Regression, every thought is reciting the Three Jewels, the condition of reciting the Three Jewels, reciting the Buddha, reciting the Dharma, reciting the Sangha, [that is] Contemplation of Non-Regression. If a Bodhisattva is in the position of having faith, that is, the Three Faiths, the Four Faiths, up to the Tenth Faith, it will be an Unreturning Vow, we have not yet achieved it! However, these things are about Buddha, so I'll just add them!

Unborn Dharma Forbearance is “forbearance” of all unborn dharmas. As for the meaning of No Birth, even though I have heard it, I still don't understand it, the explanation is still not enough! If you have solved it, you still can't practice it, you can't do it! If it were possible to know all non-living dharmas; There is no birth and no death, it is calm, you will not create any more karma. Reaching the status of No Birth Dharma Forbearance will put an end to ignorance. The status of Tam Hien Bodhisattva is not enough. Must be a Bodhisattva in the Dharma Ground, realizing the Dharma Nature. If you prove one part, you will advance one more level. If you attain ten points, you will be called Equal Enlightenment. The ultimate realization, that is, Miraculous Enlightenment, is Buddhahood. Because we cut off the current Or is very easy, but cutting off habit energy will be extremely difficult. Do you want to know what your previous life was like? You can know for yourself. Right now, whichever habit you have is the heaviest? That is it. What you did in your previous life, you know right away, you understand very clearly.

If you still don't know what you did in your previous life, from what path you were born into this life, use the Contemplation Wheel as the Contemplation of Good and Evil Karma Sutra teaches to contemplate, from one to ten numbers the first number will be your past life, from what path you have now become a human. If you want to know where you will go after death, use the present moment to contemplate and you will know which path you will take. In the future, will you still be able to listen to Buddha's teachings? I know it very well myself. If you don't understand clearly, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva will tell you. If you sow the Wheel of Contemplation and it does not come true, recite the holy name Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva many times. Every day recite ten thousand times, recite and then sow. Sow again, [know the result] transform. [If because of sowing the Contemplation Wheel, you know] that you deserve to fall into the three evil destiniess, that's no good! Should ascend to heaven without ascending to heaven, ascending to the world of Ultimate Bliss. You can transform yourself.

You must attain the Unborn. Even though I didn't deeply understand and attain No Birth, I understood and believed it myself. You also have all this merit and virtue, using the precious treasure of No Birth Dharma Forbearance to adorn yourself. The four immeasurable minds are love, compassion, joy, equanimity, immeasurable love, immeasurable compassion, immeasurable joy, and immeasurable equanimity. Kindness, compassion, joy, and renunciation are to eliminate the suffering of all sentient beings and give joy to all sentient beings. Hearing the Dharma, meeting the Three Jewels, always gives rise to joy. When Dharma joy is abundant, you can let go of anything, even your own body can be let go, let alone things outside your own body! We can all let go, making our body, mouth, and mind become perfect, superior causes.

Use those things as “protectors” ( treasure slippers). Using the precious principles to bring to the feet, in the three realms, that is, the Desire Realm, the Form Realm, and the Formless Realm, that person's body, mouth, and mind are wonderful, completely free from evil. Do good deeds, perfect all the superior causes to destroy ruins and parasols. “An account of the fairy tale of the Buddhas of Heaven and Earth who together protect the Vajra Dharma seat” (Arrange the throne of Vajra Samadhi which has been jointly protected by the Buddhas of heaven and earth since ancient times): Vajra Bodhi seat, sitting there, will become a Buddha. Śākyamuni Buddha sat on the Bodhi throne in Bodh Gaya ashram in India. Now anyone who goes there can see it. It was like that more than two thousand years ago, and it's still like that today. A square block of land like that, going through so many waves of wind and rain, may be slightly reduced. That's how I see it, I think it's possible that I haven't been shaken at all. That is the Diamond Court.

Śākyamuni Buddha sat still on that throne. Sitting there, he attained Supreme Bodhi, attained the seat of the Four Pillars of Mindfulness and was respectfully protected by all the Sravakas and Pratyekabuddhas, until he attained attainment at the Vajra Bodhi seat where the Buddhas once sat. What are the Four Pillars of Mindfulness? As mentioned in the previous section, [it is] body, feeling, mind, dharma, that is, the Four Foundations of Mindfulness. That is the first cycle of the Buddha. Sitting on that throne, attaining Supreme Bodhi, is the position of Omniscience, the fruition of Omniscience.

(Sutra) The absolute spirit of the Three Jewels of unbroken nature, turning the wheel of dharma, triggering the eternal dharma, wonderful dharma sound, pervading the three worlds, the spirits of the gods, dragons, Yaksha, Rakshasa, Asto Lac, Yet Lutu, Khan Nai Lac, Mo Ho La Jia, Cuu Ban Do, Be Le Da, Tat Xa Gia, Bo Da Na, Yet Tra Bo Da Na, non-human beings, the Four Noble Truths attained enlightenment, the three-turn and twelve elements of the Dharma wheel, necessarily the world possesses monks, weak Brahmins, gods, demons, Brahmas, humans and non-humans, all cannot be transformed, for the sake of desire, the world's peace and happiness are immeasurable, the spirit of victory is vast and generous, the accumulation of taste is transformed, and the children are transformed. Good man! Self becomes like the first Buddha wheel.
The sound of the Dharma drum pervades the three realms, causing the heavens, dragons, Yak Xo, Rakshasa, Ato Lac, Yet Lo Do, Khan Nai Lac, Mac Ho Lac Gia, Cuu Ben Do, Be Le Da, Bhi Xa Gia, Bo Dat Na, Yet Tra Bo Da Na, non-human beings, etc. to clearly understand the Four Noble Truths, three times turning the wheel of dharma and twelve manifestations that all monks, or Brahmins, gods, demons, Brahmas, non-human beings, etc. in the world cannot be converted, for the sake of benefiting and bringing joy to countless gods and people in the world, allowing them to achieve immense benefits that have not been converted before, but now, good man, I have achieved the first Buddha Wheel.

Thus, the Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha will never be cut off forever. This is an era where there is no Buddha, where will Bodhisattvas come to visit? When the Buddha had not yet come to the human world to become a Buddha, he first went to Tushita Thien's inner courtyard. Currently, the person who will succeed the Buddha, Maitreya Bodhisattva, is also there. Those Bodhisattvas came to Tushita's inner courtyard and invited him to be born in the human world to become a Buddha. In this way, the nature of the Three Jewels will not be cut off. When turning the great wheel of dharma, the first turn of the dharma wheel will speak of the Four Noble Truths, three turns of the dharma wheel in the great thousand. At that time, the Dharma bell and drum will be sounded. Who plays the Dharma bell and drum? The first time the Buddha preached the Dharma, when the Buddha first attained enlightenment, he did not want to preach the Dharma. He was invited by Maha Brahma. Therefore, the bell and drum are knocked by Emperor Thich Thien and Great Brahma.

That drum bell resounded the magical sound, throughout the Desire World, the Form World, and the Formless World, causing the demons and gods of the heavenly dragon eight classes such as gods, dragons, Yakṣa (Yakṣa), Rakṣasa (Rākṣasa), Asura, Asura, and Yeti. (Garuḍa, i.e. Ca Lau La), Kiṁnara, Kiṁnara, Ma Ho La Gia (Mahoraga), Cuu Ban Do (Kumbhāṇḍa), these are the eight groups of ghosts and gods. Preta, Piśāca, Pūtanā, Kaṭapūtanā, non-human beings, etc. From Belida down there are demons, there are beasts, there are cannibals, there are hungry ghosts. “Demon” here means the demon king.

“Human and non-human equal”: Rakshasa and Yaksha sometimes resemble humans, but are not humans. When said to be heaven, they are not heaven, but have supernatural powers. Like people? Chicken feet grew on the top of his head, so he was not human. Human-like but not human, so it is called “non-human”.

The Four Noble Truths are Suffering, Origin, Cessation, and Path. The Dharma of the Four Noble Truths, the three turnings of the wheel of dharma the “twelve manifestations”, all the monks, brahmins, gods, demons, Brahmas, non-human beings, etc. in the world cannot change! Except for the Buddha, all other living beings cannot move or speak. It's not that they can't speak, [it's actually] because they don't know how to speak. They don't recite it, and they don't understand it either. After the Buddha attained enlightenment, "for the sake of benefiting the world's peace and happiness to countless gods and humans, the spirit attained great and great benefits" (for the sake of benefiting and peace to countless gods and people in the world, allowing them to achieve vast and superior benefits), in the past he did not preach the Dharma, but now he preaches the Dharma.

“Nhi kim turns chi. Good man! I have become like the first Buddha wheel” (But now turn. Hey good man! I have achieved the first Buddha wheel like that): What is the Buddha wheel? That's the meaning. First of all, use the king's wheel to visualize the Buddha wheel. First of all, use the world to visualize the world.

(Sutra) Through trial and error, as it really is, try the world, the world, the world, the land, attain peace and stability, attain Without fear, without fear, he overcomes heavenly demons and heretical heresies, transforms the great wheel of dharma, and becomes the great dharma. The ego is trying to pollute the world, the five defilements and evil times, deal with the great assembly, correct the lion's roar, destroy all sentient beings of the Five Infinite Karmas, widely preach the unwholesome roots, destroy all sentient beings of all kinds, steadfastly like a vajra's continuous afflictions, completely establish, permanently end all defilements, and achieve wonderful liberation. Depending on the time of ridicule, the mind must necessarily have the power of sentient beings, the spirit abides in the three vehicles and does not change position.
(Sutra: Due to this cycle, knowing clearly the truth of this life, other lives, right and wrong, can be established. stable, not frightened, not afraid, subdued the evil thoughts of the demons and heretics, transformed the wheel of great Brahman, became the great holy life. I dwell in this impure world, in the evil time of the five impurities, in the great assembly, performing the lion's roar, destroying the Five Uninterrupted karma of sentient beings, in general even with regard to the unwholesome roots, eliminating the continuous afflictions as solid as diamonds of all living beings, establishing all, forever pure. the defilements, attain the wonderful result of liberation. Depending on their wishes, they put all sentient beings who have the power to rest, causing them to abide in the unchangeable position of the three vehicles).

Therefore, the Buddha attained the Ten Powers. Here, only one type is mentioned, which is Thi Xu Phi Xu Luc. "Try it as it really is, try it, forgive it" (Know clearly the truth of this life and the next): What is "Town place, non-place"? If you were born in any world, would that place correspond to your cause and effect? ​​Would you be reincarnated in the wrong place? There are also cases of wrong reincarnation, sometimes a Bodhisattva appears, not just being born in the wrong place! “Knowing as it really is” (Knowing clearly as it really is) is the True Truth Body, also the realm of One Truth. Because of relying on the One True Realm, because of [relying on] the nature of the dharma, knowing that it is compatible with the nature of the dharma, so one can stay calmly in this world, without fear, without panic, and without fear. Not only do we not fear ourselves, but we also make all sentient beings fearless. “To overcome the evil opinions of heavenly demons and pagans” (To overcome the evil opinions of heavenly demons and pagans): Buddhism is the correct theory, destroying the evil opinions of pagans. In the Dharma-Ending Age, evil can overcome righteousness; Right now, evil wins. Why? Due to karma. Whose karma attracts? Due to the karma of all sentient beings.

There are too many things that do not conform to Buddha's teachings, I won't say much about this point. If I talk too much, it won't be very good! Please distinguish for yourself what is evil and what is right? It is necessary to have wisdom to distinguish and identify evil. As for Buddha's teachings, I only point out one thing: the Four Foundations of Mindfulness. Anyone who contemplates an impure body, if we say this body is pure, we are Buddha, but the nine holes in the body often pour out impurities, what kind of Buddha are you? There is no such Buddha! Śākyamuni Buddha is not like that. Śākyamuni Buddha manifested a pure [body]. Until the physical manifestation of the body, there are always thirty-two generals and eighty good things. You cannot stay in Right Concentration, your mind arises many times, many times it is impermanent. In everything we put ourselves first, we cannot contemplate all non-self dharmas; I can't do even the bare minimum! That is called “evil wheel”, not a pure wheel.

“Converting the great Brahma wheel, into the great Brahma virtue”: Use “Great Brahma Virtue” to visualize the pure Brahma wheel and the pure Brahma virtue. Therefore, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva asked: "Buddha! Why is this world so polluted and impure that you can live peacefully in the world of evil and impurities?" The Buddha immediately taught: "Very peaceful! Therefore, in this impure world, facing the five impurities of the evil world, I emit the lion's roar, speak the Dharma, destroy all the Five Immortals karma of all sentient beings, destroy all karma of killing father, mother, killing Arhats, causing the Buddha's body to bleed, disrupting the harmony of the Sangha. At the same time, widely speaking about unwholesome things, causing them to gain good roots, destroy bad roots, and eliminate all inherent afflictions. yes, continuously and unceasingly, as solid as diamonds of all living beings, I will destroy them."

“Essentially establish, permanently end all defilements” (Establish all, permanently end all defilements): Cause all sentient beings to become Buddhas, to attain liberation, to attain the ultimate and inconceivable fruition; that is Buddhahood. Follow their pleasure, but where will they rest?

“Spirit to abide in the Three Vehicles without regressing” (Causing them to abide in the irreversible position of the Three Vehicles): Abiding in the Shravakas, they will not regress into the six paths. After ending life and death, one can gradually become a Buddha. Can people from the Second Vehicle become Buddhas? At a certain point, they will turn Small towards Big. There is no living being who does not become a Buddha, and there is also no person of the Second Vehicle who does not become a Buddha! When the Buddha reprimanded Arhats, he scolded them for not developing a great mind, not developing Bodhi mind; That's because it's not yet time. If everyone recites the Ksitigarbha Sutra and recites the Universal Gate chapter, they will immediately know. In the Universal Gate chapter, the originator is Infinite Mind Bodhisattva. In the Ksitigarbha Sutra, when Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva incarnated as Ms. Quang Mu, a lay woman, the person who saved her was [an Arhat, the forerunner of] Infinite Will Bodhisattva. That Arhat is the Infinite Mind Bodhisattva. In countless past lives, Infinite Mind Bodhisattva attained Arhatship. Arhats do not develop their mind because the time has not yet come.

Now I tell everyone about “three turnings of the wheel of dharma in the great thousand” (three turns of the wheel of dharma in the great thousand). People often hear this noun, but it is rarely explained in detail. Now that we have this opportunity, we take advantage of this opportunity to preach. One thousand Buddhas in the Dignified Kalpa, one thousand Buddhas in the Noble Kalpa, one thousand Buddhas in the Stellar Kalpa. One thousand Buddhas in the Dignified Kalpa have passed, from Hoa Quang Buddha to Vaisha Buddha. When we worship, [the scriptures] only list Bhikkhu Thi Buddha, Thich Khi Buddha, and Vi Xa Phu Buddha, we say they are the three Buddhas of the past. The four Buddhas, World-Honored Ones, in the current Sage Kalpa [along with the three Buddhas of the past], make up the Seven Buddhas, World-Honored Ones. One thousand Buddhas in the Good Kalpa include the Venerable Kou Luu that we just read about [in the scriptures], Ku Na Ham Muni Buddha, Kasyapa Buddha, Sakyamuni Buddha being the fourth, Maitreya Buddha being the fifth. The last one is Vida Bodhisattva [in the present]. The first Buddha among the thousand Buddhas of the Stellar Kalpa is Nhat Quang Buddha, the last Buddha is Tu Di General Buddha. At the end of the eighth chapter of the Ksitigarbha Sutra, the demon king Chu Mang attains Buddha's Samantabhadra. That is the last Buddha in the Star Life.

Now based on this text to say “three turnings of the wheel of dharma”. The first turning of the Dharma wheel is to preach the Truth of Suffering. If you are ignorant of this Truth, you will suffer. If you don't fall in love with this Emperor, that's fine. The Buddha preached the Truth of Suffering to us. The first turning of the Dharma wheel is to tell us the appearance of suffering. He said: "This is suffering, with an oppressive nature". The turning of suffering is Thi General Turning, saying "this is suffering, with an oppressive nature". As soon as sentient beings hear this, they will say to themselves "Suffering has an oppressive nature", we must end Suffering. Where does suffering come from? Then find the cause. The reason is because of Xi. That is Suffering, it is oppression, it is the First Movement, it is the Market Transformation.

The first step is to advise practice, to say “this is Suffering, you should know”. You should know that this is suffering. The Third Turn is the Effect Turn, “that is Suffering, I already know”. As soon as he turned, the person with good faculties became enlightened. There are sentient beings whose faculties are not so sensitive, so we must add “but knowing” (you should know). Why say Suffering? This is the Second Transfer, for intermediate level. Yet you still haven't realized it, the Buddha immediately testified (Act of Evidence), that is, Visual Evidence Transfer, saying: "That is Suffering, I know it, you should believe it". That is the Three Transformations of Suffering. “The three turnings of the wheel of dharma are great heavens”, [that is] to say Suffering, Origin, Cessation, and Path, for each Truth, go through three turns, that is the meaning.

This is the Noble Truth, [to answer the question] “Where does suffering come from?” Speaking of worldly results, the suffering results are caused by you and gathered together at the same time. Suffering results are achieved by suffering causes. That is also So Chuyen, Thi Tuong, [that is, saying]: “This is Tap, has the nature of appealing”. The causes of suffering accumulate too much, naturally you have to suffer the consequences. That cause can feel the effect, has the nature of induction. When people with good sense hear something like that, they immediately know and understand. The second transfer is for people of intermediate ability, that is, advice to practice. “This is Xi, you should cut it off”. You don't want to suffer, you have to cut off the cause of that suffering. That's called Transfer. If you still haven't enlightened and still don't understand the First Turn, then you have to turn into the Three Turns. The Three Turns are still the Turn of Evidence.

Those Four Noble Truths are all Market, Exhortation, and Evidence. One side is worldly cause and effect, the other side is extra-worldly cause and effect. Saying “this is the Practice, I have broken it”, you should also cut it, [that is the Transfer of Evidence]. Explained like that, it is called worldly cause and effect. If one has truly cut off the Karma, naturally there will be no suffering. Without suffering, you will escape the three realms. Overcome the three realms, end suffering, then attain enlightenment. Next, if you want to end suffering, you must practice the Way. Cultivating the Way will be able to attain fruition. The cause and effect in the world is the Origin of Suffering, Suffering is the result, that is, the result in the world. Practice is the cause of feeling and suffering in the world.

That must be reversed! From the mundane to the beyond-the-world, one must practice the causes beyond the world in order to attain the results beyond the world. Suffering and happiness are relative. According to cause and effect beyond the world, the result of happiness is called Cessation, also the First Turn, the Second Turn, the Three Turns, that is, the Form, the Enhancement, and the Effect.

“This is Cessation, with a nature that can be witnessed”, [meaning] “the cessation of suffering, you can surely realize”. Once realized, there will be no suffering. That is the nature that can be witnessed. The second step is to advise them to practice, to advise them to practice the Way. “This is Extinction, you should witness it”. You should attain it. Death is birth, if you are not born, you will not be destroyed, if you are not destroyed, you are also not born. Birth and death cycle, once destroyed, it will not cycle again. Say it like that: You should witness. Advising them to practice means speaking to people of intermediate capacity. “This is Death, you should realize it”, you should realize it. The three steps, that is “this is Nihilism, I have attained it”, implies: “I can prove it. You can do the same, you can also attain it”. That is the fruit of enlightenment. The cause of enlightenment is the Truth of the Path. In Suffering, Origin, Cessation, and the Path, the Tao is the cause [of Cessation], the cause of enlightenment. The result of suffering is the result of delusion, the result of happiness is the result of enlightenment. A person of suffering is a person of delusion, a person of happiness is a person of enlightenment. That's relative.

The first stage of the Noble Truth is the Manifestation: “This is the Way, has the nature that can be cultivated”, you should practice it. People with superior ability can understand as soon as they hear it. Once enlightened, you can practice, and once you practice, you will attain enlightenment. If you are a person of intermediate ability and still have to advise, the Buddha immediately used himself to prove, to advise you to practice, to teach: "This is the Way, you should practice". You should practice Suffering, Origin, Cessation, and Path. We give an example, talking about the Four Foundations of Mindfulness, which is cultivating the Way. You contemplate the body as impure, contemplate feelings as suffering, contemplate the mind as impermanent, contemplate dharma as non-self; That is cultivating the Tao. “You should practice” There are many dharmas, I will only give this example. The Three Transformations are the Evidence. “This is the Way, I have practiced it”, I have practiced it, I have attained it. Once you practice, you will attain enlightenment.

“Three Steps and Four Noble Truths” in the sutra speaks in such a sense. Practice is the gathering of karma, so consider this matter carefully. Afflictions, Or, Our karma will attract and gather the suffering of birth and death in the three worlds. The Noble Truth is related to this world. Why will suffering arise? What you have done is the cause to arise, the root of accumulation. The root is the truth. Truth does not exist. Due to your actions, suffering arises. Annihilation means “death”, please consider carefully: What is the basis of suffering? It's desire and love. If desire and craving are eliminated, suffering will be eliminated. Suffering has been eliminated, there will be no more rebirth, you will enter the realm of Nirvana. What is Nirvana? Is unborn, immortal. The cause, the Origin of Suffering, has been completely destroyed, and naturally the results of suffering are also destroyed. That is the truth, but the Noble Truth of the Path and the Noble Truth of Cessation are beyond the world. Nitchi means cessation. Because desire and love are the causes, you cannot attain the result of Nirvana. If you cut off desire and craving, you will attain Nirvana. Paragraph how? We must practice and contemplate all non-self dharmas. You should practice like that.

The thirty-seven Buddhist teachings and the Noble Eightfold Path are all Truths for us to practice. Therefore, after the Buddha became Buddha, he observed, according to his base, went to Deer Park, and spoke the Four Noble Truths to the group of five monks Kieu Tran Nhu. This is the most basic dharma in Buddhism, the most basic teaching. In addition to talking about liberation from birth and death, we also have to talk more deeply about the Four Noble Truths, which is the explanation in the Mahayana. The Mahayana scriptures also have Suffering, Origin, Cessation, and the Four Noble Truths, but they are said to be deeper than the Hinayana, promoting the principles even deeper. Understanding these principles is called the Three Transformations and Four Truths.

If nouns like this were explained [so thoroughly], our time wouldn't allow it. I'm just explaining this one case. As for the Four Foundations of Mindfulness, the Four Fulfillments of Mind, the Four Right Efforts, the Five Faculties, the Five Strengths, the Eightfold Path, and the Seven Factors of Enlightenment, they all belong to the thirty-seven dharmas.

(Sutra) Good man! Just as Sat-di-loi initiated the great king, ascended to the throne for the first time, assumed the position of the emperor, contemplated the past, future, and present of the kings' dharma, the karmic wheel of the king's species, the good person contemplated the wisdom of cause and effect, and according to his wishes, established all the gods and goddesses, popularizing the wisdom of the country and the people of the three karma wheels. Due to the test of the wheel of karma, sentient beings have a long life and a long life, possess a variety of pleasant wishes, increase joy and happiness, and destroy all enemies and evil beings. Ha class fame because of three types of karma? The one who established the king of karma, the good teacher, gathered troops for battle, conquered the soldiers, and educated the people. The second person, establishing a field and karma wheel, a good teacher practices creating a hut, farming, has peace and prosperity, and has abundant food. The three monks, establishing the wheel of wealth and karma, the good teacher practices industry and commerce, cherishes the spiritual species, is wealthy, uses it at will, and monks enjoy it. Good man! The king of the Kshat-de-loi was empowered and accomplished like the second wheel of kings. Due to the temptation of turning the wheel, you can attain peace and happiness in your country, conquer all enemies and evil friends, protect your body, and increase your life span.
(Sutra: Good man! As the great king of the Kshatriya nature has been contemplated. When he was crowned king, after accepting the position of king, he observed the teachings of the kings of the past, future, and present, from the karma wheels of kings, using wisdom to observe the causes and consequences, according to the right reasons, he established all the ministers and assistant officials, popularizing the three types of karma wheels for the people, whether foolish or wise, in the country. Because of those karma wheels, all living beings throughout the country were able to enjoy all kinds of things that should be used in a pleasing way. grow happily, can destroy all enemies and evil friends. What are the three types of karma? One is to teach and train the army to fight, defeat other armies, and comfort and nurture the people. The other is to build the karma of land and houses. that is, skillfully teaching and training them in work, love, and professions, allowing them to attain all kinds of treasures and things for living, increasing their joys. O good man, the great king of the Sat-de-loi nature has been empowered to achieve the second king wheel like that, [the king will] live securely in his own kingdom, be able to subdue all enemies and evil friends, preserve his body well, and increase his life span.

This passage says that the king received initiation after inheriting the throne, and observed the laws and all policies for governing the people established by past kings. After he observed, [realized] there was good and evil in it, good and bad. Why did the country have so many disasters in the past? That is because the law is not perfect, or even does not comply with the law to implement. Using his wisdom to observe all kinds of cause and effect, [realizing] what should be reformed, he changed it. Therefore, for mandarins, ministers, and even for all employees, the king established three types of karma.

“Karma” is what is done, “Luan” is an example. “Luan” can eliminate all the karma of sentient beings. Here we are speaking according to Buddhism. According to lay people, it means destroying unrighteous things and establishing correct things. In each country, the vast majority of kings at the beginning of the country's founding were good, but gradually corrupted, declined, and fell into ruin. A new dynasty arises again. A new dynasty has arisen and will be established again, but the karma of Buddhism is not like that. We were like that in the past, like that now, like that in the future, like that forever.

That initiated king established three types of karma, that is, performed karma. Those karmas are good and bad. He led all living beings to live very comfortably, very satisfied, and very enjoying. Creating three types of karma is to help the people in his country live peacefully and happily. If external enemies or evil friends are crushed, then he can establish his imperial career. The first thing is armed training. Any country, if there is no force to protect it, others will oppress it. Great nations all have armed strength. Everyone who reads the news in the press [will see] that France, regardless of opposition, still tests nuclear weapons further. Why? They want to personally explore so they can grasp it for themselves. Without probing, when others bully them, they have no choice! But usually between countries, I already have it, but I still don't approve of you having it. That is a big country oppressing a small country.

Currently, from a weak country transformed into a strong power, a new king has changed, the first thing is to teach his people to practice fighting, pacify, and educate his own people. That is the first type of karma, aimed at protecting the nation. I remember when I was a child, in the district we often built walls because we were afraid of being attacked by gangsters or bandits. Nowadays, I'm afraid even the city wall won't have any effect! Currently, [the city walls] are all destroyed, because [bombs] can fall from the air. Later on, the more it develops, the more intense it becomes, just like the life of sword soldiers as Buddha said: "[Whatever] is convenient to hold are weapons. All plants and trees are weapons, they can kill people". It's almost like that now. Isn't that what chemical weapons are like? This kind of wheel must be established.

The second type is to first build a house. Having a place to live is also a karmic cycle of land and housing. There is land to explore, there is land to farm, grow crops, and build houses. Therefore, he (the initiated king) must have methods and teach them how to build houses. We saw [many types of] houses, there were so many different places. I was in Sichuan and saw Sichuan people building thatched houses. I said: "Now that you have tiles and bricks, why don't you build a house?" They said: “It is not comfortable to live in a house built of bricks and tiles!” I asked: "What's wrong?" They said: "We build cottages, warm in the winter, cool in the summer. Houses built with bricks and tiles are not suitable. We can dismantle these things every few years and renovate them. Houses built with bricks and tiles are very difficult to replace." Thatched houses in Sichuan have bamboo ridges that, after harvesting, will be covered with new grass roofs. Their houses certainly have a new taste. Every few years it will change, it will be a cottage. Tibet is even simpler, all [materials] are taken from cow bodies[26]. Using cow's hair to weave canvas and assemble it [into a tent], no matter how thick the snow falls, they are not afraid. In the blink of an eye, the snow will slide away. When they moved house, they took the tent apart, put it on oxen and took it anywhere. Their house can change at any time, because it is a canvas tent woven from cow's hair. Building a place to live is the most necessary thing in human life. Currently, when we move to someone else's country, the first thing we need to do is buy a house to live comfortably. Without a home, you will not be at peace.

The second step is that the house has been built, but there must be land. Without land, how can we survive? Everything we eat comes from the earth. This will make the people in the country feel safe, well-fed, well-fed, clothed, and look forward to enjoying themselves. Therefore, when it comes to “establishing wealth and career protection”, skillfully teaching and training in industry, commerce, and arts (different professions). “Miscellaneous” includes many [different types]. Now we see toys, tools, or machines for exercise, sports, and vehicles, all [collectively referred to] as “miscellaneous industry and trade” .

In history, most of the protectors of Buddhism were merchants. These people have good fortune, they want to sow good roots. The king also protects the law, but very few. The Dharma protector king is a king of the Sat-loi (Kat-de-loi) nature. There are evil kings who not only do not protect, but on the contrary, destroy, depending on whether [they see] Buddhism as beneficial to them or not? Merchants sow blessings. Everyone looking at the history of Buddhism will see the vast majority of merchants protecting the dharma. Why must we teach people to practice martial arts, crafts, and miscellaneous arts? Everyone wants to enjoy, to have all kinds of treasures to enjoy at will, to increase pleasure in life, to increase joy in life. Therefore, this initiation by King Kshatriya must achieve the second king wheel. The second king wheel includes three karma wheels.

After establishing the second king wheel, the king's country can be happy. “Able to subdue all enemies and evil friends” (Can subdue all enemies and evil friends): Skillfully can protect their property, protect the nation, protect the stability of the nation, making all people increase their lifespan. That is the second king wheel. This is a simile, does not contain any deep meaning, so I will summarize it. Use this story as an example of the Buddha Wheel.

(Sutra) Good man! Tathagata initially attained Buddhahood, attained Supreme Wisdom, observed the eyes of the past, future, and present of the Buddhas' dharma, skillfully observed all karma, received the wisdom of cause and effect, and established the three karma wheels of all sentient beings. Due to the test of the wheel of karma, the energy of the Three Jewels, the nature of the dharma eye is immortal, the supreme Dharma eye is prosperous, the souls of all sentient beings, the race has a long life, the species is born in heaven, Nirvana, peace and joy, and the spiritual awakening must be impossible to subdue the ego of the heretical dharma eye, and the child's energy is like the bad dharma and evil talk.
(Sutra: O good man! At Tathagata new to become Buddha fruit like

So, attaining Supreme Wisdom, observing the dharma eyes of the past, future, and present like Buddha, using wisdom to skillfully observe karma to receive causes and consequences to establish three types of karma for all sentient beings to be saved. Due to those karma wheels, it is possible to make the dharma eye of the Three Jewels' nature immortal in the long night, the supreme Dharma to circulate and flourish, allowing sentient beings to forever enjoy the joys and peace due to natural birth or attaining Nirvana, and causing the evil views of all heretics to not be able to subdue my right dharma eye, and it is possible to destroy those evil views in accordance with the dharma.

“Tathagata first attained Buddhahood” (Thus did the Tathagata attain Buddhahood): The Buddha attained Buddhahood, achieved Supreme Wisdom, wanted to see the past Buddhas, and the future Buddhas. Currently, all Buddhas in the three worlds have attained pure Dharma eyes. The Buddha's eyes contemplate everything, can see everything clearly, wisdom observes karma, the causes and consequences received [due to creating those karmas]. Due to the wisdom of “cause and effect retribution”, three types of karma were established for all sentient beings to be saved. [Those three karma wheels] are the same as the three karma wheels mentioned in the example [about the second king wheel] above.

If you build three types of wheel, you will be able to make the seed nature of the Three Jewels always present, not cut off, making the dharma eyes of all living beings pure and immortal in the long night. “Immortal” means light, the light of the dharma eye. [Due to the light], it is possible to know what is dharma and what is illegal, allowing the Buddha's supreme dharma to circulate and flourish, allowing sentient beings who have been taught by the Buddha in the Buddha's world to be born in heaven, until they attain Nirvana. Heavenly birth is much happier than the three evil destiniess and the human world, but to enjoy [true] happiness, one must ultimately attain the happiness of “ultimate non-birth, never-ending”, [only then can one truly enjoy] peace and happiness. Regardless of all the harmful heretical opinions of pagans, the evil opinions of pagans competing with the true Dharma vision, the Buddha Dharma can subdue all evil opinions, it can be true to the Dharma to dispel the evil opinions.

(Sutra) Good man! Ha class fame because of three types of karma? One person, establishing and cultivating the wheel of karma. Second, establish the practice of reciting the wheel of karma. Tam fake, establish a wheel of merit and karma. Good man! Cloud Ha Tathagata cultivates the wheel of karma? Ten types of concentration, ten different levels? The right person contemplates the consciousness body, the six realms, the self, the self that is attached to the strange cause. Karma is filled with food, Ignorance is rich, Love is self-fulfilling, non-existence is free, dependent on others, it belongs to all conditions, desire destroys Karma, Affliction, Suffering, three types of remaining roots. As you observe, the clouds and rivers of Nghiep Luu? All sentient beings practice virtuous actions. Weaknesses of all actions, due to Ignorance and Love as a cause, can give birth to Beings, the name of Affliction. Weakness due to afflictions, consciousness is a strange cause, they harmonize, name and form arise. Name and Form are the cause, they harmonize, the Six Lands arise. Because of the cause of the Six Lands, they are in harmony, Contact, Feeling, After Existence, Birth, Aging, Death, and the second generation arise, called the Stream of Suffering.
(Sutra: Good man! What are the three types of karma? One is establishment. practice the wheel of karma, the second is to establish and recite the wheel of karma. Good man! How is Tathagata cultivating the wheel of karma? There are ten types of concentration, what are the ten? That is, rightly observing the six realms of consciousness and body in the Three Realms, caused by the Self and what we are attached to. Because we want to eliminate the three types of Karma, Affliction and Suffering, we observe how Karma is saved. If these actions are caused by Ignorance and Love, then they are called Afflictions and Consciousness as their cause, then Name and Form arise The Six Origins are the cause, Contact, Feeling, After-Existence, Birth, Aging, Death, etc. in the order in which they arise, it is calledSuffering.

The Three Streams include the Stream of Karma, the Stream of Sorrows, and the Stream of Suffering. We must observe how they grow and grow. What is Karma Liu? What is Affliction of Affliction? What is Suffering? Each noun contains many meanings. If you understand, you will enter the Buddhist scriptures. Not just this one sutra, but many sutras, you can all understand. Here, three types of Karmic Stream are mentioned. What is Karma Stream? It's everything you do in your daily life, including sleeping, even from birth until death, you cannot escape. Even if you separate it, you can't separate it. It always belongs to those three types of karma. Saved Karma is the karma that you have created. All sentient beings, including animals, animals, horses, buffaloes, goats, chickens, dogs, pigs, all belong to it, but do not count plants. However, humanity's Karma is the heaviest. You create karma, what you have done is called Karma Save. Save is “forever without end”. Save is karma that is always moving, moving forever without stopping, forever flowing like that.

Defilements are ignorance and craving. “Love” is the desire of living beings. The desires of living beings are the basis of our birth and death, with love and infection. Ignorance and love are the cause, and from that cause, actions are born. Because of your actions, you have created karma, good or bad karma, so you can ascend or descend. “Ascension” means being born into heaven, “descending” means falling into hell.

When I was in Beijing, I met some coal mine workers. I asked them: “What do you do?” They say: "Maybe I will go to hell." I said: “Can you really go to hell?” They replied, "I'm going to hell." I asked: "Go to hell? Don't you suffer when you go to hell?" They say: “I [go to hell] to work.” I said: “What are you doing?” They said: "I dig coal with the King Yama." I said: "Is your job a coal miner?" They said: "That's right! Every day we go to hell. We have to go there every morning when we open our eyes." They work at Mentougou[27] in Beijing. They don't leave the mine until dark. They easily encounter the mine collapsing, the ground above collapsing, or the mine collapsing. That's the term for their mines. The Mentougou mine in Beijing has dug nearly dozens of miles deep, and they exploit it below the Xishan. "Sometimes we also have the opportunity to be born in heaven." I asked: "In this life can you be born in heaven?" They said: “That's right!” I asked: "How were you born?" They said: "Take us to Zhongnanhai[28] where the big mandarins live. I consider them the Jade Emperor the Great, [go there] to patch bricks and roof tiles. Their house is leaking, send us to patch bricks and clean roofing tiles." I said: "Your ability is so great, you can ascend to heaven and enter the earth!"

Actually, everyone's life is like that! Whenever you do good karma, you will ascend. With blessings, life is very comfortable. Don't forget the suffering, [don't forget] we have also suffered. The sentence “can give birth to Beings” (can give birth to Beings) contains many [meanings] in it. The Three Streams are the Stream of Karma, the Stream of Sorrows, and the Stream of Suffering. Suffering is affliction, Consciousness is its cause. “Consciousness” includes six consciousnesses, namely Eye Consciousness, Ear Consciousness, Sick Consciousness, Tongue Consciousness, Body Consciousness, and Consciousness. Eyes belong to the Root. When the Eye Base contacts the outside world, it makes no distinction. What can be distinguished is Eye Consciousness, using Eye Consciousness to distinguish. “Consciousness” here is the six consciousnesses; Collectively speaking, there will be eight consciousnesses. When there is affliction, Consciousness is the cause, and there are many causes and conditions to promote achievement, so it arises in that order.

What are the five results in the present and two results in the future? All of these things are called Suffering. Ignorance and Action, Action means “movement”. If it is greed, anger, ignorance, arrogance, doubt, accompanied by Body View, Boundary View, Precepted View, Holding View, and Wrong View, these ten types are called afflictions. These ten types are also called Conjunctions, they motivate you to create karma. That's Hanh. These are internal things, belonging to Humanity. In the mind that creates karma, reality has not yet been born. The movement of Thought in the mind is psychological activity because you do not understand it clearly. Because we do not understand clearly, we keep doing activities, not activities based on wisdom, but activities of ignorance, purely activities that create karma, commanded by the ten karma. Karma for reincarnation, we often say that these Conjunctions are the seeds of the eight consciousnesses. That is the evil part, not the good part. In consciousness there are two parts: Good and Evil; History belongs to the evil side. Having created that karma, because of creating that karma, one is reincarnated.

Because of these two types of causes in the past, karma is created. The eighth consciousness is also called Stored Consciousness, because they (seeds, bonds) contained in that consciousness create that karma. Because of past karma, you receive retribution. “Retribution” means receiving retribution depending on the karma you have created. Sometimes one is born in heaven to enjoy, that is also one's Consciousness [born in heaven]. Thus, reincarnating in the six paths, reincarnating as a human is the best. If you create a lot of good karma, you can be born as a human. Normally, sentient beings cannot be born into humanity. You fall into the realms of hungry ghosts, animals, and [hell], which are the three evil realms. If you fall into the animal path, you will suffer even more.

No matter which way you fall, when karma is about to enter the womb, it will change every seven days. When about to enter the womb, the six senses have not yet developed, even the eyes, ears, nose, tongue, body, and mind are not there, there is only the form of the fetus, the six senses are not enough. After coming out of the mother's womb, craving comes into contact with the scene, the eyes see colors, the ears hear sounds, the body comes into contact, in the mother's womb it is very warm, now being born, the air causes each of your pores to be stimulated. You can't talk about that suffering, you just feel pain. We don't know that suffering.

In prison, when subjected to all kinds of torture, your mouth is sealed, your eyes are tightly covered, you cannot see, you cannot hear, your six senses are closed, you can only suffer, you cannot speak. I think the suffering at initial contact with reincarnation is probably not much different. There's no way to express it! How to express this? That is the result of suffering. Once in contact with the outside world, it will be completely different, giving rise to feelings of suffering and happiness. Also when a child cannot speak, if he is not satisfied, he will use crying to express everything. When children cry, adults should not comfort them too much, they cry to express themselves. When it cries, it's when it grows older. All its movements are just crying, crying is its movements. Cry a lot, it's okay! It just shows that it's uncomfortable, young children don't know how to talk yet. If you answer it correctly, it will laugh. If you take care of children a lot, you will feel it. I know very little, you know better than me, I just rely on the sutras to speak.

When it gives rise to feelings of suffering or pleasure, karma is reincarnation; that's the fruit. Until it gives birth to six senses, that is the result. Coming out of the mother's womb, contact with the outside world is also a result. As soon as you come into contact, you will receive a feeling of suffering or pleasure. From then on, I received it, and I had to receive it for the rest of my life. Life and reincarnation, or death, will never end. Therefore, it is called Liu. Luu means “motion”, constantly moving. These are Ignorance conditioned by Actions, Actions conditioned by Name and Form, Name and Form conditioned by Six Entrances, Six Entrances conditioned by Contact, Contact conditioned by Feeling. Those are two causes in the past. Due to those two causes, five results [in the present] are formed, namely Consciousness, Name and Form, Six Senses, Touch, and Feeling are the five results.

Due to two causes in the past, five results are received in the present, it does not stop there. Craving, Attachment, and Being are the three causes in the present. “Confronting the scene” means facing all the realms, then craving arises: “This flower is so beautiful, I want to buy one.” I saw many beautiful flowers in the garden, but no one saw them, so I picked one. That is a violation of the precept of theft. Seeing [something] very expensive, [dreaming] if I took that thing, it would make a lot of money, the world of theft has become established. Even though it says "I don't do it", as long as the mind is born, it all counts! Because I created that cause! Having created the cause, craving arises for the scene, giving rise to desire. Once a desire arises, one will hope to achieve it. The good things we want to achieve, the bad things we want to throw away, not wanting to receive. Because you pursue this, you will create karma, that is, you will create things. Whenever you create something, it becomes karma! Because of that karma, you will receive retribution. Now we do it, now we are receiving the reward. The retribution that is being experienced in the present is only a temporary retribution.

If we rob someone of anything, of course we will be punished, immediately arrested and imprisoned in prison. Already locked up, then the punishment will be decided. That is the present report (report in the present), but it is not over yet, because it is only human law. Having suffered [the punishment of human law], you still have to suffer karma. If you rob others, or kill others, if you kill someone, you must pay for it with your life. National laws have been complied with. If we rob others, we get caught, we get shot to death, is that over or not? It's not enough! That is the law of the human world, you still have to receive retribution. That person still comes looking for you to collect your life debt, you still have to pay the debt. Now you create the cause, in the future you will still have to suffer the results of suffering in the Five Aggregates, that is, Sight, Sound, Smell, Taste, Touch, Dharma, suffering results. Return to receive life, be born again. [Therefore], Birth again becomes old age, old age becomes death again. Death then creation, creation then birth, birth then death. Just keep changing back and forth like that; That is called the Dharma of the Twelve Causes and Conditions.

From there, the Buddha established the third wheel, that is, established the wheel of meditation, explaining that there are ten types of concentration. You must observe ten types of bodies and six types of realms. “The self, the ego, is the cause” (The self and what we are attached to will be its cause): We accept it as really us, but as we said in the above section. The karma you have created is the land, a good field, covered by ignorance, but also watered by Love, so you cannot be at peace. Being bound by that cause and karma, it all depends on conditions to establish itself, that is, “establishing the other person” (depending on something else to establish). That is called “dependent birth”. All dharmas are born of conditions! Whenever one is born through causes and conditions, there will be no self-entity, birth and death, death and birth, birth and death, death and birth. Because there is no self, it is dependent origination, so it has the meaning of “cannot last long”, but also has the meaning of “rotation”. Suppose you want to observe that Karma Liu, you have already observed it clearly; After that, [will understand] all actions performed by all sentient beings will all be karma. Those created karmas become afflictions and sufferings, because the created karmas depend on conditions to achieve their success. Once you achieve it, you will suffer, suffer afflictions and suffering. If there is affliction, there will be suffering. You must constantly observe those three types of streams, which are the Stream of Karma, the Stream of Sorrows, and the Stream of Suffering. Everything sentient beings have done cannot go beyond the Dharma of the Twelve Causes and Conditions! According to your thoughts and actions in the past, you will receive [the results of those things] in the present and future. Presently receive [the result of] past causes. [In other words], experiencing the five results now is experiencing the results of the cause in the past. Whether your appearance is beautiful or ugly, whether you have wisdom or not, is all related to your Ignorance and Actions in the past, and is also related to your good karma. So we receive disagreements from Ignorance and Action. Ignorance is first, Action is second. It is also due to the addition of Love that “Beings” is born.

“Chu Huu” are all sentient beings, we all have emotions. Do animals have feelings or not? Any animal species has emotions. Please see the rhododendron. If you pay attention, study carefully, look at their actions, you will see that they also have love, hate, take, and abandon. You have to observe like that to know. In a house that raises chicks or azalea birds, you will see the females surrounding the males. If the females do not like the males, they will not bond. The female likes the male and will bond. Isn't that Ai? Isn't it take or leave? All animals, all people are like that.

Twelve types of causes and conditions that give rise to consciousness, constituting twelve conditions for the existence of sentient beings, this is called the Twelve Limbs. Because of ignorance, lack of wisdom, and lack of insight, that is why there is Action. Because of Action, karma is created. According to Mahayana Arising Faith Commentary: “One thought unconsciously, gives birth to the three systems of appearance in the three manifestations, that is the basis of affliction”. It will never stop, it will always change. Due to change, it will pursue the current realm. That realm is still the mind, conditioned by that Action. Because it moves, it will search for objects and accept the scene. Because of the desire to hold on to the scene, Consciousness will be born, but Consciousness has distinction. Consciousness means “discrimination”, he will discriminate. Due to Consciousness, it is conditioned by Name and Form, Name and Form are conditioned by Six Entrances, Six Entrances are conditioned by Contact, Contact is conditioned by Feeling, Feeling is conditioned by Love. If it's good, that person will love it. If you use a whip to hit someone, it is Contact, they will not accept it, because it is too painful, they have suffering. Too hot, will suffer. Too cold, also miserable. That suffering belongs to the feeling (sensation) of Contact. Fate follows Love like that, there will be take or leave. Whether you take it or give it up, fate follows Existence. Because of grasping, there is existence. With fate, there is Birth. Due to the fate of following the Prime is Being.
