That is the self-proclaimed Buddha's teaching: "I will deal with the great immortals, turn the Buddha Wheel, banish the heavenly demons, evil heretics, deal with the masses, rightly cause the lion's roar" (I am in the position of a noble great immortal, turn the Buddha's wheel, suppress the evil chaos of the heavenly demons and heretics, perform the lion's roar in the midst of the masses): Have no fear, initiate the lion's roar, speak the true Dharma. “Lion's roar” (lion's roar) is a figurative word. The lion is the most noble of the hundred beasts. The lion roared, hundreds of animals heard it and their brains cracked! That's a way of saying, we shouldn't be too attached.

When I was in Beijing, a Dharma friend asked me: "Buddhist scriptures say that the lion's roar seems to be very formidable, but master! The roar of a lion in the zoo is still not like that!" How to answer that person? There are so many headache-inducing questions! I said: "Do lions roar or not? I've been to the zoo many times, but I still haven't heard it roar." He said he had heard it before, but it didn't matter at all! I said: "What can he do now that he is locked in a cage? Let him out and try to see. In Buddhism, we use lion's roar as a figurative expression, indicating that the Buddha in the midst of the crowd preaching the Dharma has a very powerful power. You cannot make such a [crude] comparison. Such a comparison is not correct, this is what the Buddha himself said." If we speak for ourselves, we will not dare to compare animals with Buddha. Lions are animals!

Like generals or marshals in the past who were called “tiger generals”, we always use tigers to compare. If you say [they are brave] like tigers, then it's okay, but if you say they are animals, I'm afraid they will remove their skulls! Kings are all dragons, China often draws dragons, dragons represent the most noble. But dragons are animals. If you see the king and say "Your Majesty is an animal", your head will immediately "clean the house"! I said: "You can't say that! That's a simile, a descriptive word, intended to visualize the Buddha's power. Don't compare this matter. If you compare it, it will become lame!" If you say that the great marshal is as majestic as a tiger, he will be so excited that he won't stop laughing! Therefore, sometimes there are attachments everywhere, there are many places where attachments manifest, that is, they are tightly attached to them. Not speaking according to the Dharma means looking for flaws in the words.

Enter merit (take care to cultivate merit), you do good deeds, see monks, don't slander them, treat them as professors, treat them as monks to respect them, you will accumulate merit. It's okay to be respectful in your heart. Also, when reciting, first of all, offer a flower and a stick of incense. Here, I also want to add a few sentences; otherwise, there will be defects. A Dharma friend asked me: "I'm a worker, many people live together in the same place. I really want to recite sutras, not burn incense, not arrange flowers, it seems very uncomfortable in my heart. The house I live in can't burn incense, can't worship Buddha, only has a bed, where should I put it?" I said: "Okay! You spread the sheet over that bed, the fabric of the pillow must be a little clean, put the prayer on it and then meditate." If you recite the Ksitigarbha Sutra, you visualize Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva coming there and sitting right there. Again visualize packing things from a department store or supermarket.” He said, “How dare you?” I said: “That's not true! You use your mind to clean, but if you don't pay and want to actually clean, how can you do that? You don't have anything, just use your mind to make offerings. He clasps his hands together, flowers are offered, incense is offered, everything is there, there will be a feeling of dharma. He opened the scriptures to recite, so it was okay. Others think he is reading a book, but it's okay if he doesn't read it out loud.

You can also use Vajrayana method to recite sutras. What is Kim Cang Tri? Think it yourself, listen it yourself. You just need to move your tongue and ears to hear it. You can hear it yourself, but no one else can hear it. That style is called Kim Cang Tri, which means silent chanting. This is called "not being attached", don't delay your righteous conduct because of formality. That is called skillful means, righteous means. It's okay to recite like that. If you can't bow, just bow in your mind! With such a narrow house and bunk beds, how can you bow? I was in prison, I couldn't even bow my head in obeisance, so I bowed in my heart, the prison guards didn't know. When you [prostrate silently in your mind], it's okay if you don't clasp your hands, there's no need for others to see your appearance. If your mind is pure, you can do meritorious deeds internally. That is called skillful means.

You should not be attached to what you want to do as long as it reaches your goal. If you cannot recite any sutra, reciting the Buddha's name can cover it all. Reciting the holy name can be all-inclusive. You sit there, the incense and flowers have all been offered. Samantabhadra Bodhisattva's third great vow is "widely practice and make offerings", you have made offerings everywhere, cleared away all the things from the places you have been to in the world, it's okay. You make offerings there, and after you finish praying, recite. If you cannot present the original sutra, you can clearly remember the ten great kings of vows, from “the one, pay homage to the Buddhas” to “the ten, the universal level dedicates”. If that's not possible, then reciting Amitābha Buddha is also okay! As long as you are willing to develop Bodhi mind, you can do whatever you want. You don't care, just keep making excuses! Nowadays our Buddha hall is very good, some people preach sutras and sermons, but you don't even bother to come and listen. Karma is created by oneself, merit is cultivated by oneself. Evil karma is done by oneself, good roots are sown by oneself.

Everyone should study blessings like that, study recitation like that, learn to practice concentration like that. If you want to wait for all four conditions to be complete, you will have to wait a long time! If you want to wait for everything to be well prepared, if you want to wait for the East wind to blow, then the East wind will never blow, and there is no Zhuge Liang calculating. It's okay for you to create Zhuge Liang yourself, just do it yourself! Wait? You should not wait. Life is impermanent, what are you waiting for? There's really no way, it's okay to recite the holy name, the merits are equal, in your heart you must be equal. In the Buddha hall, it is very solemn. If you think that way, your merit will be great. In fact, at home, if we [practice wholeheartedly] like that, it is exactly the same. Inequality is due to your mind. If you develop a discriminatory mind, of course there will be inequality, it will be completely different. Your mind is equal, you can temper your afflictions. Don't get upset at all times, no matter how others curse or irritate you, you still won't get angry or angry, they won't have any choice. When people practice chanting and reciting, the requirements I mentioned above are very strict. When you hear me say that, you complain: "I'm not qualified, I can't read!" So I have committed a crime, so after that, I have to explain a bit. As long as you can do it, it's good. You can't do too much, you can't do too little, so recite a Buddha's name. Reciting ten hours a day is enough, just see how you recite those ten hours!

(Sutra) Good man! Just as the Great King Kshatriya initiated the teachings of the world, immeasurable sentient beings, Buddha, took refuge in the race of evil gods, pagans, gave rise to evil beliefs, arose to wrong views, learned wrong forbidden precepts, attachments, cultivated and cured the evil, good and evil signs, he received the seed without benefit and suffering. The great king knows and summons, the immortal king governs the country with the correct dharma, enlightens, manifests, teaches, precepts, and the spiritual period to let go except to reverse faith and view, to study the ancient king's righteous and upright dharma, the spirit of the country must be sentient, one animal, one refuge, one mind, one desire, must be in harmony, in the same way as the immortal king's true dharma, listen to the destiny, serve according to the order, be sociable, and act in accordance with the law. At that time, the great king Sat-di-loi initiated the initiation, often attended the gathering of his ministers, joined the family, enjoyed the pleasures of the kings, traveled with joy, did not have the same duality, functioned together with the thoughts, and was responsible for the kings. Good man! The king of the Kshat-de-loi is empowered and accomplished like the fourth wheel of kings. Due to trial and error, the spiritual self of the country increases in peace and happiness, conquers all enemies and evil friends, good friends protect the body, and the spiritual life increases.
In his country, there are countless sentient beings in Bo Dat Gia La who take refuge in all kinds of evil gods and pagans, arousing false beliefs and wrong views, learning the precepts prohibiting evil deeds, being attached to practice, dealing with evil and evil signs, and experiencing all kinds of suffering that are not beneficial. The Great King has summoned many times and used the righteous method of ruling the country of the previous king to enlighten, demonstrate, teach, and warn them, causing them to get rid of crazy beliefs and crazy views, and practice. learning the old and upright Dharma of the previous king, causing all sentient beings in his country to follow one path, turn to one direction, have one intention, have one wish, all in harmony, rely on the previous king's Dharma to apply, listen to the edicts and orders, and follow along in harmony, doing what should be done. At that time, the great king Sat-de-loi was often empowered with his ministers to gather together to taste delicious food and enjoy. The joys and pleasures of traveling, without doubting each other, plan and deal with the affairs of the country together. O good man! Great King of the Sat-de-li nature has been empowered to achieve the fourth king wheel like this, making his country more peaceful and happy, able to subdue all enemies and evil friends, preserve his body well, and increase his lifespan.)

This part is like the previous parts, talking about King Wheel first, then talking about Buddha Wheel. The great king of the Kshatriya nature has been empowered to know all the Bodhāra beings in his own country, that is, all the beings in his country. Bo Da La sentient beings, there are roughly ten types. One type is Bo Dat Gia La not sowing good roots, in the past there were no good roots, but in the present he does not cultivate good karma, which also means not cultivating good karma. Furthermore, the karma they have practiced is continuously contaminated. Another type is those who do not meet good friends, but always encounter bad friends. The whole country is made up of that kind of living beings. At the same time, they do bad things without fear of consequences. Even if they have to suffer retribution in the future, they are not afraid of the consequences. Greed, anger, and delusion are extremely strong, because their minds are confused and cling to wrong views. Roughly speaking, there are ten types of situations. The Bo Dat Gia La type takes refuge in evil religions, that is, evil gods and improper heretical religions. There are all kinds of evil gods and pagans who do not cause great evil; Here we are talking about evil creation.

Give an example such as worshiping fairies, flattering demons, killing living beings to make offerings to demons, thinking that this is asking for blessings. In fact, by doing so, not only will you not seek blessings, but on the contrary, you will also sow a lot of suffering in the future. That is called “wrong belief”. Even I see feng shui masters as "evil beliefs"! They say this building of yours is good or bad, saying it's good, bad, unfortunate, or blessed. According to Buddhism, these things are all wrong knowledge and wrong views. “Forbidden precepts”: India has many pagans. From India, many pagan things were transmitted to China, some people did not eat oil, some did not eat salt. Speaking in China, there is no such thing as worshiping dogs or worshiping cows. In India, there is a saying like this: “This cow has attained miraculous powers”. They saw a cow that was later born into heaven, [not realizing that the cow was born into heaven] because it had merit for humans, so they worshiped that cow. I just passed through Calcutta, India, walking on the streets. On many roads, I saw cows all very big and fat. Their heads are covered with green, blue, red and red jewelry. I saw drivers who, whenever they saw a cow, immediately stopped their car and waited for the cow to leisurely pass by before continuing to drive on that road. That cow is also very intelligent, it walks on that street, does not go to another street, because [people on] that street all believe in worshiping it. That type of belief is called “evil forbidden precepts”. Someone also lit a bonfire. Brahmins worship fire like that. Everyone gathered around and bowed, then recited their mantras and scriptures. These things are called “evil forbidden precepts”.

Sometimes [those pagan things] are very similar to Buddhism. They said: "You are monastics living in graves, in the wilderness, we are suffering more than you." There is also a type of person who sleeps on a raised bed. They also sleep in the wilderness, [bragging] "I am more ascetic than you, and will attain greater enlightenment than you". That is called “wrong view”. Practicing asceticism and attaining enlightenment is not such an achievement at all! Whenever there were all kinds of useless suffering, the king who was initiated into Sat-di-li saw that situation and often summoned his court officials and famous people in the country to study the dharma of ruling the country of the ancient kings for the people of the whole country to study. If anyone causes trouble, they will be punished: For light crimes, they will be punished and educated; Serious criminals can be imprisoned. For example, there are many people with wrong knowledge and wrong views. Sometimes they will harm people in the country.

It happened fifty years ago, in 1940, when I went to Calcutta in India, I heard them say: "You must be careful on the road in Calcutta, don't go alone. They see that you are an outsider coming here, and don't understand the language, and will persecute you. They take you to a dark room, take you there, and cut off your limbs to make offerings." The eyeballs are used to worship that god, and the genitals are used to worship that god. That is wrong knowledge and reversal of views. If the country doesn't stop these things, if the king's laws don't prohibit them, I don't know what level it will reach! That is wrong knowledge, wrong view. This type of wrong knowledge and wrong views is also very common in China!

The king's dharma was that when the country was first established, the ancestors were very compassionate. A nation's ordinances are its morality. In the past, we often studied the morals, ethics, filial piety, kindness, loyalty, trust, propriety, righteousness, integrity, and shame of the country. In the past, I studied a lot about those ethics subjects. When I was a child, I still had to study. By the time I was in high school, it was gone. Nowadays, no one talks about morality and ethics! We are also not antiquities. The past also had good things, but the present also has good things. The so-called “progress and reform” must correct the bad things in the past, and eliminate the old things that are harmful to the people, to be worthy of being called “reform”. Nowadays, I'm afraid it won't be like that, all the good things in the past will be changed due to different times, we often hear those words. Reforms that "kill, steal, commit sexual misconduct, and lie" rage unhindered! In the past, the population was small. If they were killed like that, I'm afraid the population would be reduced. It wouldn't be worth dying to die. That is a wrong view (wrong, crazy view). Studying the Dharma is studying things that have been implemented in the past, studying the politics and laws applied by previous kings in the past. After studying, everyone agreed to follow the dharma of the previous king. If anyone does not listen, it means violating the emperor's decree. The emperor established the new law and commanded all subjects in the country to follow suit. Do what they should; Things that should not be done will not be allowed to be done. That king who initiated Sat-de-li often gathered with the masses to discuss these issues. The country and people are peaceful and everyone can enjoy it, not like in the present: Using public money to invite guests and give gifts! Therefore, everyone drinks together, has fun, enjoys joy, and has fun. Both sides do not doubt each other, have no double-mindedness towards the country, are not suspicious, are not jealous of each other, and together with one mind and one mind plan together in order to handle the country's affairs with integrity. That is the king's empowerment to attain the fourth king wheel, using this to display the Buddha's true wheel.

The king defines the laws that make that country grow in peace and happiness, and can subdue all enemies and evil friends. Therefore, you can skillfully protect your body. The word Than means that each person can protect themselves, but can also love and protect others. Only then can one increase one's lifespan, accumulate blessings, and increase one's lifespan, until one does not harm others. That is the fourth wheel of the king.

(Sutra) Good man! Tathagata has accomplished skillful knowledge of overcoming entertainment, seeing all kinds of evil refuges in the world, wrong views, evil intentions, mocking evil dharma, and practicing evil karma. Due to causes and conditions, one experiences immeasurable suffering. The Tathagata sees the truth, summons the book, the great assembly, of the past Buddhas, World-Honored Ones, the Three Jewels of the nature of cause and effect, the six strains of Paramitas, the Yogācā, the three rules of doubt, the dharma of cause and effect, enlightenment, manifestation, inauguration committee, precepts and forms all assembled together, miraculously liberates all crazy views, establishes right view, settles on the old path of the Ten Virtues and uprightness, together All sentient beings together practice the Dharma, the Dharma, the means to lead the stream of cause and effect. The sentient beings, the four assemblies are in harmony, the same cultivators must necessarily surpass the virtues, it is convenient to join the four pillars of mindfulness, the samadhi of liberation and knowledge, the middle level of enlightenment, the joy and happiness, the holy teachings of the eternal life, introduce the Three Jewels without stopping, it is convenient to travel with the Four Right Efforts, the Four Spiritual Supplies, the Five Faculties, the Five Strengths, the Seven Levels of Enlightenment, and the Noble Eightfold Path. The U Ky race overcomes the samadhi, liberates the knowledge and visions of the middle stages, and enjoys the bliss of ignorance. Good man! Self becomes like the fourth Buddha Wheel. Due to trial and error, all sentient beings know the Bodhisattva Jāla, the race of winning prizes, returning to beasts, mocking the mind, receiving the dharma of all karma, according to the season, the benefit of peace, attaining peace and stability, attaining fearlessness, attaining fearlessness, claiming to be a great immortal, turning the wheel of Buddha, evil gods, evil heretics, dealing with the masses, right lion's roar.
wrong views, evil intentions, love of evil dharmas, and evil deeds in the worlds. Because of that cause and effect, [living beings] suffered immeasurable suffering. After seeing this, Tathagata repeatedly summoned, in front of the assembly, used the nature, cause and effect of the Buddhas of the past, six types of Paramita, three types of doubts based on the cause and effect of Yogācā, etc., to enlighten and enlighten them, to make them happy, and to command them all. Assembly, so that they can escape from crazy views, establish right view, firmly establish the old path of the Ten Virtues and uprightness, together with other sentient beings practice the Dharma, practice the Dharma, use means to guide, receive all kinds of cause and effect, for the sake of all sentient beings to be in harmony, cultivate all the superior virtues, then enjoy together in the four types of Mindfulness, rejoice and be happy in the path of right concentration, liberating knowledge, so that the holy teaching can exist for a long time in the world. Because of continuing the nature of the Three Jewels without interruption, I wandered in the Four Right Efforts, the Four Spiritual Powers, the Five Powers, the Seven Paths of Enlightenment, and the Noble Eightfold Path, delighting in all kinds of enlightenment, superior concentration, and liberating knowledge. Because of this wheel, I have attained the supreme knowledge, guidance, love, and karma of sentient beings. Bo Dat Gia La's feelings, according to the right reasons, bring benefits, peace, be stable, not be frightened, be not afraid, declare yourself "I have reached the position of a great and noble immortal", turn the Buddha Wheel, dispel the evil arguments of the demons and pagans, and perform the lion's roar in the crowd).

This is the fourth Buddha Wheel of the Buddha. Currently, most of them have evil refuges, wrong views, love evil dharma, and practice evil deeds. Current jobs are chosen by the people themselves. If you choose a bad career, in that job, killing is required, but that job is not deceitful at all. Every profession requires speaking the truth; However, business people cannot speak the truth! In Mainland China, there are friends who ask: "If you don't lie, there will be no way to do business!" When I came to America, I found the situation was not like that at all. In supermarkets, on the counter they state how much the price is, and they will sell for that much. Because they charge real prices, there is no need for service staff, nor do they talk to you. Therefore, it is not necessary to lie! Why do you have to lie to do business? I just give one such example. That is evil karma. Evil karma is doing evil deeds, you don't have to do it like that but still do it!

In addition, if in the past, you did not have such great blessings, no matter how much you deceive, how much you pressure, or how cunning your tricks, even if an opportunity to take it falls into your hands, you will immediately fail. There are robbers and robbers who are more powerful than him. The bandits rob the bandits, and there are bandits with even greater power, defeating you! [Insisting on practicing evil deeds is due to] not knowing the relationship between cause and effect. There are all kinds of wrong views, wrong actions, and too much love for evil things. As a result, you are bound to suffer immeasurable pain. Taking refuge in God is an evil refuge, an incorrect view. We can all see that their disciples are extremely numerous. How should you say this? That is "methods will gather together, things will group together" (methods will gather according to each type, things will be divided into groups according to each separate nature). That kind of fate is because that demon king wants to reincarnate, his demon children and grandchildren will follow him, of course they believe in him, they don't believe in your true religion!

Every type will be worshiped according to that type. According to any conduct, any karma, you will associate with people of the same conduct and karma! Merchants will not go back and forth, making friends with politicians. If you make friends with them, something bad will definitely happen! People say: “If you hang out with officials, you will get rich” (If you hang out with officials you will be poor, if you hang out with merchants you will be rich). If you want to hit a judge, you will definitely be miserable. That is the ancient teachings of China. Whoever you hang out with, whether you hang out with evil people or with good people, will have a very great relationship, as the Chinese say: "Close to pearls, fake red, close to black clothes" (Close to lipstick, it's red, close to ink, it's black), that's the meaning.

The Buddha only taught his disciples to follow the cause and effect of the Three Jewels' nature, the precepts, or use the Six Paramitas, that is, use almsgiving, precepts, patience, love, and the Four Noble Truths to educate sentient beings. Or rely on the Three Laws of Doubt in the human world. The Three Laws of Doubt are the Three Convergence Pure Precepts, which are also the Niet Thien Dharma Precept, the Many Useful Friendship Precepts, and the Nie Lua Nghi Precepts. These three laws of doubt are all dharmas of cause and effect. Good is rewarded with good, evil is rewarded with evil. “Enlightenment manifests”: The word Enlightenment can be explained as “understanding”. After clearly understanding the cause and effect of retribution, it will cause them to take refuge in the Buddha, take refuge in the Dharma in the Three Jewels, and sow the seeds of good nature. Sow good causes, you will get good results. Or if there is a corresponding cause, there will be a corresponding effect. Based on the cause to verify the effect. Yoga means “corresponding”, also means the dharmas of cause and effect belonging to the three types of ritual laws, etc. That is called “retribution of cause and effect”. Make them clearly understand this principle. Sometimes the Buddha comforts sentient beings, making them happy because they are comforted, sowing blessings in the Three Jewels, so they will not suffer in the future. In Buddhist scriptures, there are many comforting words. After you have heard the Dharma and taken refuge in the Buddha, in the future you will enjoy all kinds of blessings and will no longer experience suffering. Those are comforting words.

Next are the words of commandment. The words of commandment are the precepts. You have broken the precepts and cannot help but fall into hell and into the three evil realms. There are many words of this type. The Buddha often advised his great disciples how to benefit sentient beings, how to eliminate sentient beings' crazy views, causing them to be liberated. The view of liberation and the view of insanity are completely opposite to each other. How can we be liberated? You must establish right knowledge, right view, and do not follow wrong livelihood. For the sake of your own survival, you should not build your own happiness on the suffering of sentient beings! Even for the sake of living comfortably, in general, for limited material things, we compete for them. There is legal competition and illegal competition. There are things that follow cause and effect. If you should have them, you will have them. If you don't deserve them, you won't be able to achieve them! If we work hard, people will reward us with a salary, that's something we should have. If you exploit, steal, or deceive people, that is something that is not worth having. Everyone knows what should be done and what shouldn't be done, in their hearts they know it very clearly, but for profit, or for fame, it doesn't matter what should be done or what shouldn't be done, as long as we get benefits in exchange for the fake name, that's fine! Knowing clearly that it cannot be done, they still stubbornly want to do it, knowing clearly that this thing should be done, but it has no benefit for us, they will not do it.

At that time, the Buddha taught all sentient beings, causing them to have the Ten Virtues, which was the old and righteous path. All Buddhas teach like this: "Do not kill, steal, commit sexual misconduct, do not create greed, anger, or ignorance, do not lie, embellish words, double-talk, or speak harshly." That is the Ten Good Karmas, that is the right path, that is the old path. Together with all sentient beings, all the Bodhisattvas, many times they practiced the Dharma together. Whatever dharma you practice, you will practice according to that dharma. When we practice the Ten Good Karmas, we will practice according to the Ten Good Karmas. Practicing the Six Paramitas, one will practice according to the Six Paramitas method. Almsgiving is not simply material. We often use a happy face to treat all living beings, making them happy when they see you. You see Maitreya Bodhisattva, he sits there smiling, he gives alms happily. Even when using alms, there is also a way to preach Dharma to others, that is, Dharma of Almsgiving, advising others to do good things, all of which are alms giving. I just give one such example to say.

Anyway, that is a skillful means, using those cause and effect dharmas to guide and receive, that is, in good and evil cause and effect, there will be shallow and deep. The deepest is to develop the Bodhi mind, practice the Bodhi path, until you will naturally attain Buddhahood, that is very profound! For ordinary people, either advising others to recite Buddha's name, advising people to believe in Buddha, what is the benefit of believing in Buddha? Accident exemption. Advise others to take cause and effect a little more seriously. Knowing that we give rise to bad thoughts, in the future, we will definitely reap bad consequences. That is speaking according to the Bodhisattva level. Speaking according to ordinary beings, there must be truth. [You have to tell them]: Doing that will really cause harm; That's the punishment. For Bodhisattvas, starting the mind to meditate is not enough, we must understand that cause and effect. We Buddhist disciples, the four disciples, harmonize together to practice good dharma.

The most excellent good dharma is to develop Bodhi mind, practice the Bodhisattva path, benefit sentient beings, and be generous to sentient beings. We must practice superior virtues together, recite Buddha's name together, beat that Buddha together, and worship together. Considering Dharma practice as fun, the four types of Mindfulness Pillars, that is “body, feeling, mind, dharma”, enjoy themselves in those four types of Mindfulness Pillars. Samadhi is Concentration. The knowledge of liberation can achieve your Dharmakaya's wisdom and life. As for the spiritual products, they include many things, such as the Four Right Efforts, the Four Spiritual Sufficientities, the Five Faculties, the Five Powers, the Seven Factors of Enlightenment, and the Eightfold Path. Faith, Diligence, Mindfulness, Concentration, Hue. Just having faith in Buddhism is not enough, you must be diligent. Diligence is diligence. Only if you are diligent can you achieve good things. Always think about the Three Jewels, think about the dharma you are practicing, without letting go of mindfulness. You keep cultivating like that, keeping your breath steady, gradually attaining Concentration. Due to Concentration, Hue can be born and contemplation can begin. In Concentration, contemplation is contained. Contemplation contains Concentration, but because you have practiced for a long time, it will have strength. Five Roots and Five Strengths are that power. As for all types of Samadhi, you will attain all types of Concentration and attain all types of Wisdom.

Buddha told Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva: Because of this cycle, I am not in the Saha world. I belong to the position of a noble great immortal, turning the wheel of Buddha, the evil teachings of all demons and pagans are destroyed, like a lion's roar. That is the fourth Buddha Wheel. First, talk about all the dangers in the world, how the king deals with them. After that, the Buddha also taught his disciples how to deal with mistakes and calamities.

(Sutra) Thien Son! Nvoid Kshat-de-loi empowers the great king, knowing the realm of the country, or the realm of other countries, of countless sentient beings Bo Dat Gia La, from the word of wealth, greedy and indifferent, greedy for wealth, greedy for love, that is, conveniently placed in a solid city, quach, village, ward, beast la, country hamlet, royal palace, Quang Thuat Nai Chi Sā-la, Anh Vu, protects the people, the spirit is not damaged. Good man! The king of the Kshat-de-loi initiated the great king, achieving the same as the fifth wheel of kings. Due to testing the wheel, the spirit of the country will increase peace and happiness, overcome all enemies and evil friends, good hands will protect the body, and the spirit will increase life span.
In his own country, or in other countries, there are countless sentient beings. Bo Dac Gia La is not tired of his own talent and beauty. He is greedy for it, pursues it, loves it, and immediately arranges citadels, villages, precincts, and strict patrols, [defends] the country, and the royal palace. In general, he even places [warning birds] such as sala, blackbirds, and defense equipment, so that there will be no loss of the nature of Sat-de-loi has been empowered to achieve the fifth king wheel like that. Because of that wheel, one's own country will increase in peace and joy, can subdue all enemies and evil friends, protect the body well, and increase life span).

These are all about the monarch. During Buddha's time, there was absolutely no democracy, [a country] could not have no king. It's been like that in history. If a country does not have a king, it will be like a flock of dragons without a leader, immediately in chaos! Currently, we are ruled by the people, by the rule of law, not by humanity. Democracy means following the law and acting. The current era is not the same as that era, whether it is chaotic or not, we all know very clearly, but we are not qualified to comment. The Buddha gave examples, based on all the situations of the time he lived. All sentient beings, regarding their own talent and form, “form” includes all kinds of enjoyment, they indulge in it without getting bored. The word Dam (infatuation) originally refers to a poisonous thing, sentient beings do not know that it is poisonous, they are so attached to it that they cannot give up. I refuse to let go, but I still want to protect and pursue things that belong to others. For this reason, the king must protect that country and make the life of the nation peaceful. Or repair the wall to make it stronger. In the past, cities and hamlets were renovated like that. That era used swords and spears. If we build the city walls higher and thicker and close the city gates, the enemy cannot enter. The same is true for villages.

I remember when I was a child, living in a village in Northeast China, building four blockhouses (blockhaus, blockhouse). There, there were either eighty families, or one family of a hundred people. All four bunkers had artillery[40] placed, because at that time, the Northeast had a lot of bandits. Bandits attack, the walls are very thick, [people in the blockhouse] will shoot from above. They called that place Huong Dao [41], that village was called Huong Dao, indicating that there were explosives, guns, and artillery in there. If bandits want to rob that village, they must gather a lot of people. First, use artillery to destroy the citadel before you can enter. Every ancient country was like that. If you go through, [you will see] every city has walls built this thick. Even Qin Shi Huang wanted to protect his country and built the Great Wall. The Great Wall was used to block the Huns from the North. At that time, if there was a wall to protect it, it would be very good, even every town and every village had to be protected.

“Royal Palace”: Everyone who visits Beijing, [will see] the suburbs, the inner city, and also a Forbidden City. We visited the Forbidden City in Beijing's Imperial Palace. [If] you close the door tightly, you won't be able to enter. Currently, there are helicopters flying straight in, dropping infantry, and they will immediately capture it. Times are different, equipment is different. This is said in the sense of “protection”.

“Sā-la, the Vu”: The empty parrot is called Sāra, the roof parrot is called Sāra. The female bird is called Sārikā, the male bird is called Sārikā. Xa La specializes in protecting female birds, it does that task. Everyone saw the swallow, and the swallow was afraid of being alone. One day, when he is alone, he will think about suicide. Why? Lonely. If a flock of swallows lands, you must guard the odd swallow. In a flock of swallows, there is often a single swallow. The swallow hunter will catch the odd swallow first. It's been caught, it won't cry anymore. The odd swallow doesn't call anymore, he can catch a lot of swallows, because the other swallows are all sleeping. I was in Tibet and saw that Tibet has many protected Yak herds. You see, cows are usually afraid of wolves, afraid of leopards, and also afraid of tigers. But in a herd of cows, there will be one or two leaders, called “ox head” (leading cow). When it's dark, they eat especially well and don't need to go out to graze. The owner always feeds it tsampa[42]. Whatever the owner eats, he gives it that to eat. Even cook food for it. What will it do? At night, the owner goes to bed, releases the dog, and the dog cooperates with the leading cow. The leading cow walked around the herd a few times. Cows are afraid of the leading cow; If the owner of the school personally herds the cows, the cows will still run haphazardly. But the leading cow walked around a few times, and the herd of cows all lay down, not daring to move. He then patrolled to see if there were any wolves or leopards? The leading bull exerts that effect. I give this example, [to show] that even animals and birds need protection, let alone humanity? Nowadays, humans are intelligent and complex, unlike the past, with rockets and fighter planes. There are also attacks from the sea, flying from the continent, too many. Nowadays, it is even more different than before. That is to subdue all enemies and protect the lives and property of yourself and your family.

(Sutra) Good man! Tathagata accomplished the skillful knowledge of all wisdom natures, the knowledge of evil demons, the ninety-five evil beings of heretics, and the immeasurable residue of all evil beings of heresy and sentient beings. Desperate for wealth, intoxicated with indifference, desirous of other wealth, covetous, lustful, egoistic, self-involved with others, deeply engendered by illness, harming self-will, hypocrisy, mixed with poisons, hidden fire, lying on the throne, or forsaking mountains and rocks, or going crazy with statues, chasing away with the sword, scattering impurities, profaning lust, destroying unmanly people, or being inhumane, or using illusory words, indicating the evil children are compatible with each other. cancel.
(Sutra: O good man! Tathagata has accomplished skillful wisdom, knowing such natures, knowing evils Demons, and ninety-five types of evil, pagans, and countless other demons and pagans fascinate sentient beings. As for their own talent and beauty, they are not satisfied with it. They are greedy for other people's talent, passionately pursuing it. They are deeply jealous of themselves and their followers. Because they want to harm us, they either pretend to prepare delicious food mixed with poison, secretly set up fire pits, pretend to spread beds and thrones, or push rocks down from mountains, or release elephants. crazy, drew his sword to chase, spread dirt, blasphemed me to do lewd things, slandered me for not being a man, or said I wasn't human, or said I was an illusion, using such evil things to slander and slander).

Beings in the current Dharma-Ending Age are seduced and bewitched by fame and profit, and are also seduced and bewitched by external circumstances, [so] greed, anger, and ignorance within are especially serious. As for their own property, they will protect. Property belongs to profit, they are very careful in protecting it, they are not tired of being greedy, but they want to deceive and deprive others of their property. One person is not enough, how many people are involved! Nowadays, there are a lot of stories like that. There are also people who pursue wealth and beauty and are suspicious of each other. How should sentient beings in the present time, especially Buddhist disciples, deal with evil spirits? Outsiders seduce and bewitch with nothing but talent, beauty, benefit, and harm. At the same time, for ourselves, even for our people, we are also insecure here and there. Non-Buddhists are jealous of the Buddha's righteous path. Currently, not only are pagans jealous, but Buddhist disciples are also jealous of each other. Therefore, we four disciples must praise each other, not attack each other, or slander each other. That is not recommended!

They deceive you, invite you as guests, you must be careful, they put poison in it. Or dig tunnels to trap wild animals. Everyone who goes to the mountains will know. Like when I was in the Northeast [China], they were about to go into the mountains and told you to be careful on the road: "You see this road, in fact, below is a trap pit, above is covered with grass. Wild animals run up there, and the trap will fall." There are also traps hung on trees, tied with thick ropes. If you step on it, you will be shot, or hung upside down. Then someone will come and arrest you. That's how to trap wild animals. Some people mistakenly stumble into those places where wild animals are trapped, most of them are in the mountains and forests where very few people go. The Ksitigarbha Sutra says: If you have something to do and cannot help but enter the mountains and forests, for fear of encountering danger, recite my holy name a lot. That is the case of entering this type of danger.

Or they invite you, spread out the court bed, and [pretend] to be very respectful and respectful towards you. “Either let go of the rocks, or let go of the statues” (Or push the rocks, or let go of the crazy elephants): In India, there are also crazy elephants; Here (China) there is none. Sometimes they give the elephant alcohol to make it crazy. Elephants trample you, use their trunks to sweep you away and throw you away. Or use weapons, draw swords, raise guns to oppress you. “Scattering about dirt and dust” means slandering you, using slanderous words, harming you, spreading harmful rumors. You are obviously pure, they immediately spread rumors.

“Profane lewdness”: Blame you for breaking the precepts. Or destroy you, doubt that you are not a man. In Buddhism, there are five types of “non-men”, neither male nor female. To give an example, eunuchs are not men, they are a type. In the precepts of the Buddhist scriptures, there are five types of immaturity[43]. They are either half male and half female: When they are with men, they are female. Living with women, they are men. This type is called Variable Realm. It is impossible to accept such people as monks. They slandered that person. Seeing that he was virtuous and had many followers, they immediately slandered him, saying that he was not a human being, but a ghost that had appeared, so don't believe him. These are all defamatory words.

(Sutra) The Buddha, the Dharma, the Sangha, and the herons raise up countless races to slander, curse, and destroy. The self-centeredness of the Thanh Van disciples, the habit of being jealous of causes and conditions, causes blasphemy. The Tathagata is knowledgeable, has good hands on the six faculties, is equipped with the four pillars, is equipped with the four eloquences, and is a Shravaka who preaches the essence of the Dharma, establishing the pure three doors of liberation. born, of immeasurable species of different natures, depending on the season, they create many benefits.
(Sutra: For Buddha, Dharma, Sangha, countless defamations, curses, and destruction also arise. As for my near-abiding Shravaka disciples, because of the cause of jealousy, all kinds of slander arose. The Tathagata skillfully maintained the six senses, relied on the four pillars of eloquence, and for the sake of the Shravakas, he proclaimed the essence of the Dharma, establishing the three pure doors of liberation, knowing as they really do the countless different natures of all sentient beings, according to reason. benefit them).

Next, it's all defamatory language. Using all kinds of evil to slander you, what slander? Destroy Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha. It is clear that it is the true dharma, they say it is not the true dharma, [their dharma] is the true dharma. Or if you keep the precepts and keep them pure, they will come up with all kinds of tricks to cause trouble, even defame you, making it impossible for you to live in peace. This kind of situation exists in temples and shrines, and all four groups of disciples have it. We must have wisdom, we must recognize that type of person. More broadly speaking, [there will be] countless types of defamation, cursing, and humiliation. That's speaking broadly. Or for my Shravaka disciples, “near abiding” means being next to the Buddha, that is, the Sangha of one thousand two hundred and fifty people is next to the Buddha. Due to the cause of jealousy, because they are jealous, they begin to despise. This is something that only happened when the Buddha was in this world, those who were next to the Buddha were called “close disciples”. The Buddha entered Nirvana and there is no more. Big temples have great wealth, seeing that the temple is rich, they also start to slander, this happens a lot. The Buddha reminded us to carefully protect the six senses, that is, eyes, ears, nose, tongue, body, and mind. Skillfully protecting the six senses is also "preventing the mind like a citadel" (preventing the mind is like protecting a citadel), especially the consciousness, like building a wall to guard against it, because it (consciousness) will, at any time, not follow the rules, and make mistakes at any time.

“Relying on the Four Brahma Pillars” (Relying on the Four Brahma Pillars): The Four Brahma Pillars are pure. What does “Pure” refer to? That is, the Four Immeasurable Minds, loving kindness, compassion, joy, and equanimity. Stay with kindness, compassion, joy, and equanimity. Must have all four types of eloquence. Only by having eloquence can one protect the purity of Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha, the Three Jewels, and debate with heretics. When Kāśyapa Mātaṇga and Dharmaratna came to China to spread the Dharma, Taoists argued with them, saying [Buddhism] was an evil dharma, [because], "the races are different, the countries are different. If they come to China to propagate the dharma, they will be evil." The emperor said, "There is no other way," so he brought the scriptures brought by Kasyapa Ma Dang and Truc Phap Lan, placed them on one platform, put the Taoist scriptures on another platform, and set them on fire. Taoist scriptures were all burned. The sutra brought by Kasyapa Ma Dang and Truc Phap Lan at that time was the Forty-Twelve Chapters of Sutra. The Forty-Twelve Chapters of the Sutra radiate light and are not destroyed. At that time, temples and pagodas were established.

The Four Talents are unobstructed eloquence, unobstructed dharma, unobstructed mind, and unobstructed words. The qualifications of a true magician are to fulfill the Four Immaculate Constraints. If a true holy monk does not have samadhi in speech, he will not be able to achieve great benefits when propagating the Dharma, and cannot be called an all-talented magician. At that time, the Indian monks arrived in China not long ago, so they learned to understand Chinese, mastered the language and writing, and achieved the means to benefit their lives. It's a shame that we don't have that wisdom. Going to another country, not understanding the language, not knowing their customs and practices, how can one translate the scriptures? A truly great virtuous or great Dharma Master must have pure conduct, love, compassion, joy, complete equanimity, must have perfect dharma, intention, compassion, and eloquence, and be skillful in preaching the Dharma to others. The Buddha only taught his disciples to know the above causes and conditions, that is, the blasphemy mentioned above. He advised his disciples to carefully protect the six senses, to be diligent, not to be careless, to rely on the Four Foundations of Mindfulness to stay, to often think about impermanence, think about non-self, think about suffering. Tuyen said such a basic Dharma to the Shravakas, establishing the three pure doors of liberation.

The Buddha knew about the above slanderous pagans, so he immediately advised his disciples to carefully protect the six senses and keep the sense doors carefully. “The sense door” is the eyes, ears, nose, tongue, body, and mind. It must be based on love, compassion, joy, and equanimity to stay, and must learn all four types of eloquence. The Buddha preached the essential Dharma for his disciples, the Shravakas. In general, the three doors of liberation must be established. The three main doors of liberation are Emptiness, Formlessness, and Desirelessness. Below are all the Buddha's teachings.

“The self is like the world, transcending the world knows the natures of wisdom” (I use wisdom to know the natures of the world and beyond the world like that): I know the nature of the dharma, know the essence of the dharma, know the causes and conditions of the dharma, know the consequences of the dharma. Having that kind of wisdom, one will know clearly that sentient beings have countless different natures. It can be said that this nature is a temperament, each person has a different temperament. Saying so is absolutely not speaking in terms of “essence” (the essence of nature). There is no difference in nature. The nature mentioned here will be their good nature, the types of nature of the past, future, and present. Each person has a unique personality, which also means habits in your life. Each person has their own living habits. Sometimes they believe in Buddha, take refuge and become Buddha's disciples, obey the precepts taught by the Buddha, live with the Sangha, subdue their own personality, and do not dare to be unruly. Living together with a large assembly of monks, we ourselves are disciples of the Buddha, we cannot be arbitrary, we cannot let ourselves be influenced by our own personality. The Buddha knew the completely different personalities of all his disciples and all sentient beings. The Buddha responds to opportunities, [meaning] depending on what you like, He will enlighten you about that, and will teach you based on that. We do not know that when the Buddha preaches a sutra, such as the Ten Wheels of Kṣitigarbha Sūtra, sentient beings corresponding to this dharma will all gather, all come together, all praise, and rejoice. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva finally sensed this Dharma assembly and came to attend it. When everyone gathered, he would, according to the opportunity in that assembly, preach all kinds of Dharma.

Currently, the usual situation is to study a sutra and ask about that sutra. Like us at the Southern Buddhist Academy, or the Chinese Buddhist Academy, I only teach about Dharma Forms, only teach about the Five Teachings, only talk about the Four Noble Truths, I don't talk about other things, based on what they are learning to contribute. Buddha is not like that at all, Buddha based on the basis: "Whatever you need, I will tell you." Nowadays, it's the exact opposite. I don't care whether you have that foundation or not, I'll just say this! Why do we wish to be born at a time when the Buddha was in this world? Because it is easy to become enlightened, easy to attain enlightenment, and sow good roots, we want to be born at the time when Buddha will appear in this world. Consider that we belong to the eight tribulations. One of the eight misfortunes happened when there was no Buddha in the world, which was very different. There are also all kinds of wrong knowledge and wrong views that interfere with you. How can you be liberated? Cannot be liberated! Therefore, the Buddha can truly know all kinds of living beings' personalities and all kinds of differences.

(Sutra) Good man! Self becomes like the fifth wheel of Buddha. Due to the trial of the wheel of existence, in this world, one knows the wisdom of all natures, knows all sentient beings, Bodhisattva Jāla, the immeasurable species of different natures, depending on the season, benefit, peace, attaining peace and stability, attaining fearlessness, attaining fearlessness, claiming oneself to be a great immortal, turning the Buddha wheel, bad gods and devils, heretical heretics, dealing with the masses, right lions. roar.
(Sutra: Good man! I achieved the fifth Buddha wheel like that. Because of that wheel, use wisdom Knowing the worldly and supra-worldly natures, knowing the different natures of countless Bodāra beings, according to what should be, benefits, peace and joy, being able to live in a peaceful place, not being frightened, not being afraid, calling oneself "I am in the position of a great and noble immortal", turning the Buddha Wheel, dispelling the evil opinions of the demons and pagans, in the mass, realizing the lion's roar).

“Good man! I have become like the fifth Buddha wheel” (Hey good man! I achieved the fifth Buddha wheel like that): This is the achievement of the fifth Buddha wheel. Because of this Buddha Wheel, we can speak according to reason about the dharma nature of worldly and extra-worldly dharmas, either speaking according to the Truth, or using precepts to speak, because we can clearly know worldly and supra-worldly dharmas, and have that kind of wisdom to deal with all kinds of Bodhisattvas, that is, all kinds of sentient beings. They have countless different natures, countless needs, we will follow the right way to benefit and comfort them, so that after hearing that Dharma, practicing it, we will be liberated. Even if you don't follow it, you will still be safe. They have clearly understood and understood, and will not be afraid, [saying to themselves], "Either I don't go there, or I avoid it." We understand that ahead is dangerous, there's no need to go there, don't you avoid it? Obviously you know it's dangerous, but you can't help but go. What will you do? What should I do if I need to go through a country's territory, through mountains and forests? If you have recited the Ksitigarbha Sutra, you will know that you need to recite Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. In the above section, it has already been said: Reciting the holy name Ksitigarbha has all kinds of merit, and can abide in peace. Only then can you be at peace, without fear, without panic, without fear.

“Claiming myself to be a great immortal, turning the Buddha Wheel, bad heavenly demons, evil heretics, dealing with the masses, right lion's roar” (Self-claiming I belong to the position of a noble great immortal, turning the Buddha Wheel, dispelling the evil opinions of heavenly demons and pagans, among the masses, performing the lion's roar): Part This is similar to the scriptures in the above section. As for the Ten Wheels, in each wheel, the scriptures say the same thing.

(Sutra) Good man! As the Great King Sat-di-loi empowered the king, he set up a completely solid citadel, village, village, country hamlet, royal palace, spread the word of Nai Chi Sāla, Ying Yu, defense instruments, the middle of the palace, the data of his relatives, the concubine, the mother-in-law, the children of the monastery, the five desires, all kinds of musical instruments, released the four six senses, and received joy and happiness. Good man! Sat-di-loi initiated the great king, achieving the level of the sixth king wheel. Due to trial and error, the spiritual self of the country increases in peace and happiness, conquers all enemies and evil friends, good friends protect the body, and the spiritual life increases.
(Sutra: Good man! As the great king of the Kshatriya nature has been contemplated. He arranged all the fortified citadels, villages, strict patrols, country hamlets, royal palaces, and in general [arranged warning means] such as sa-la and anh vu. Once fully defended, he stayed in his own palace, surrounded by his relatives, concubines, and daughters, playing with the five desires and musical instruments, relaxing the six senses, and enjoying the joys of the good king! Kshat-di-li has been empowered to achieve the sixth king wheel like that. Because of that wheel, his country will increase in peace and joy, he will be able to subdue all enemies and evil friends, he will be able to preserve his body well, and his life span will increase.)

The sixth and fifth circles are similar. Because the king had good protection, specialized in preventing and preventing enemy resentment. Things are good at home, so we defend overseas. There can be unity in the country, no two hearts, everyone agrees, no more internal fighting. After that, fortified cities were built, and even villages and towns had prevention and protection. This is the same as in the previous section [said] “nài chi sà-la, anh vu”. Once you have carefully defended yourself, only then can you be happy and have fun in the palace. “Release the four six senses, enjoy the joys and pleasures” (Let go of the six senses, enjoy the joys and pleasures). That's an example. Outside there are no solid citadels, no villages or wards. “Thu la” means “patrol”. We know that the commanders of the defense squads are dedicated to defense. “Thu” means defense, “la” means patrol, to see if there are thieves or not. As for the royal palace, the country hamlet, “hamlet” means urban or urban area, or a village. “The palace” is where the king lives. [Those places] must be carefully defended, which means they must be very safe. Only then can we enjoy, can we be happy. “Enjoying all the joys” (Enjoying all the joys), I like to listen to music so I listen to it. That is the king's empowerment of the Sat-de-loi nature to achieve the sixth king wheel.

(Sutra) Good man! Tathagata, the assembly of Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas, reached the great Sravakas, firmly established the defense of the holy teachings, that is, they appeared to enter the first Tranquility, they appeared to enter the fourth Tinh Lu, they entered the Boundless Void Land, and the vast majority of them appeared to enter the Concentration of Non-Perception, Non-Contemplation. Such as Thi Nhai Chi appears to enter all Buddha's practice. Entering the test of Samadhi, immeasurable hundred thousand verses of na-du-da heaven, dragon, Yak Xo, Raksha, Jian Dat Phuoc, At To Lac, Yet Lo Do, Khan Nai Lac, Mac Ho Lac Gia, Be Le Da, Tat Xa Gia, Bo Dat Na, Yet Tra Bo Da Na class, all sentient beings, are always cruel, damaging the mind, unkind, uncompassionate, so that future generations will suffer endlessly. The view of the father, the view of the self, and the view of the self enter the Buddha's practice of concentration, the stage of the self, giving birth to great joy and pure faith. In the midst of the Three Jewels, the highest stage of birth is filled with joy, pure faith, respect and reverence, and attains the position of a friend. You are necessarily evil, your pride is revealed, your heart regrets it, and you swear forever. Due to cause and effect, in a single moment, immeasurable and countless afflictions, karmic obstacles, and dharma obstacles are eliminated. Countless blessings,satisfaction, attain fulfillment, be free from birth and death, enjoy Nirvana, and protect the Tathagata's supreme Dharma. Good man! Self becomes like the sixth wheel of Buddha.
(Sutra: O good man! Tathagata and the Bodhisattvas Ma Ha Tat and the great Shravakas In the same way, setting up all the defenses with a solid holy teaching, immediately appearing to enter the first Tinh Lu, until entering the fourth Tinh Lu, appearing to enter the Boundless Void Land, in general, until entering the Concentration of Non-Perception, Non-Contemplation. Thus, until the manifestation of entering all the Concentrations practiced by the Buddha, countless hundreds of thousands of na-du-da verses, dragons, Yoc Xa, La Sat, Kien Dat Phuc, A To Lac, Yet Lo Do, Khan Nai Lac, Mac Ho Lac Gia, Be Le Da, Tat Xa Gia, Bo Dat Na, Yet Tra Bo Da Na, etc. towards sentient beings often hold cruel, harmful, unkind, uncompassionate hearts, and do not feel fear towards the suffering in the next life, but they see that I have entered into all the Concentration disciplines practiced by the Buddha, so they have feelings towards me. Great joy, pure faith arises. For the Three Jewels, all give rise to pure faith, supreme joy, respect, respect, and achieve unprecedented things. For all evil things, all are ashamed, express deep regret, vow to forever eliminate them, in the span of one moment, countless afflictions, karma, and dharma obstacles are all destroyed complete, leaving birth and death, moving towards Nirvana, upholding the supreme Dharma of the Tathagata. This is how I achieved the sixth Buddha Wheel.

Tinh Lu: There are four types of Tinh Lu. What is Four Tinh Lu? These are the four types of Meditation. Use the Four Meditations to treat your Or (defilements). With that Concentration practice, it is even possible to prevent Or infection. These are the First, Second, Third, and Fourth Zen in the Form Realm. Therefore, it is called the Sac Realm Concentration. Tinh Lu is “introspection” (consideration), truly knowing clearly the nature of the mind. Concentration is to firmly abide in one type of scene, it is also to contemplate the mind to concentrate and abide in one kind of scene.

The person who can penetrate [that Meditation], after being able to leave the Desire Realm, feels can correspond to the visualization of the Form Realm. In the process of cultivating Concentration, the first three Zen courses (First Meditation, Second Meditation, Third Meditation) are steps of means, activities in the mind that gradually develop, forming the spiritual world. Entering the Fourth Zen is true Meditation. This is talking about the First Fruits saint, the Second Fruit saint, and the Third Fruit saint. In the process of being born in heaven, the Saint of the First Fruit, after being born in heaven, returned to the human world. The Saint Sister Sr. still has to be reborn in the human world seven times. Saint Two Fruits must once again return to the human world. The Third Stage does not return [to the human world], always remains in heaven, always abides in the Four Heavenly Meditations. Because they practice this type of Concentration, they will gradually be able to achieve, end the afflictions of Views or Thoughts, end the afflictions of Thoughts and Sorrows, gradually cut off the afflictions of Views and Sorrows, and also get rid of the afflictions of Thoughts and Sorrows, and will attain Arahantship. First Meditation Leaving the Land of Joy and Bliss, leaving Vipassana and Sutra.

The second type of Meditation is due to Concentration arising, the afflictions in the person's mind become pure. Unlike us, whenever troubles arise in our hearts, we immediately feel very restless in our hearts, and our internal fire flares up very loudly. At that time, he [in his mind] has nothing, the internal View or Or has been destroyed. It is also possible to cut Tu Or. Reaching the Third Zen Heaven, gradually arises Concentration, giving rise to a feeling of joy and happiness. Having reached the Three Zen Heavens, one then separates from joy, [that is] the Third Zen Heaven is separated from the joy (joy) born of Concentration. That is also the coarse pleasure that turns into the subtle pleasure, so it is called the Wonderful Land of Bliss. At that time, right knowledge and right view are born. The Four Thien Thien are the Pure Land of Equanimity and Remembrance (a state of purity, of letting go of thoughts), each of which is superior to the previous position. The next heaven not only lets go of the things [the practitioner] has already let go of when attained in the previous heaven, but also goes one step higher and lets go of [the realms] in the previous heaven. Like us cultivating the Way, when cultivating Concentration, you go one step further, no longer feel afflicted, and have conquered the roughness. If you practice the Book of Contemplation, you will feel that your exhalation is very coarse, until it becomes very still, and there is no longer any predestined thoughts according to the realm you practiced when your breath was still coarse. This is entering the realm of the subtle world, and the next stage is superior to the previous stage. When you have made progress in the next stage, you can ignore the things in the previous stage and no longer remember the previous things!

We often say “Once we've crossed the river, we don't need a boat anymore”. Don't remember the previous things, let them go! Then, study the dharma. Having studied deeply, if you have attained Concentration, you are not required to read the text, nor do you need to hold the original sutra to recite. You can practice Concentration single-mindedly. While practicing, you will definitely have this kind of realm. Only after you have attained this type of Concentration will you be able to subdue it. Or, the same goes for temptations from the outside realm, as well as for [the afflictions] that arise within, you can subdue them all. If you don't have Concentration, you won't be able to conquer it. After the four types of Stillness, next, the scriptures talk about entering the Land of Boundless Void, until now entering the Land of Neither Perception, Non-Perception. These are called the Four Zen and Four Emptiness Concentrations, i.e. the Concentration of Boundless Emptiness, the Concentration of Infinite Consciousness, the Concentration of Nothingness, and the Land of Neither Perception nor Non-Perception; That is the Four Emptiness. Until he appeared to enter all the Concentration disciplines practiced by the Buddha, each step involved a lot of effort.

After you have entered Samadhi, you can prevent all demons and pagans, they will not be able to disturb you. Prevent what? “Concentration is like a citadel” (Concentration is like a citadel). “Fortified” means fortified citadels and villages. That is to say, after entering Concentration, you will attain enlightenment. As for internal and external bandits, all can be subdued and will not be harmed by the enemy. Next, [the main sutra] sets out countless hundreds of thousands of na-du-da verses, that is to say “millions of millions”, as many gods, dragons, Yoc Xa, Rakshasa, Kien Dat Phuoc, A To Lac, Yet Lo Do, Khan Nai Lac, Mac Ho Lac Gia. These are the eight groups of ghosts and gods.

After that, there were all the demons, Be Le Da, Tat Xa Gia, Bo Dat Na, Yet Tra Bo Da Na, etc., a total of twelve types. Those demons have good and evil. Sometimes they are protectors of the Dharma, sometimes they are evil beings, often embracing cruelty and harm, without compassion. Because the practitioner attains the four types of Tranquility, enters the Four Meditations, Eight Concentrations, up to the Nine Concentrations, and even enters all Buddha's Concentrations such as Shurangama Concentration, ghosts and spirits will not be able to harm the practitioner. The ghosts and spirits saw practitioners and saints practicing the Concentration disciplines practiced by the Buddha. Not only did they not harm them, but they also gave rise to joy and pure faith. Pure faith does not arise easily; That is pure faith. At that time, those ghosts and spirits will have pure faith and supreme joy towards the Three Jewels, Buddha, Dharma and Sangha.

If we develop pure faith in the Three Jewels, we will not interfere with any famous literature anymore, and will not care about beneficial relationships. What is a harmful relationship? If you get sick, you hope to be cured. That's called a beneficial relationship. Right now, you are so miserable and needy, you are looking for the things you need for a slightly prosperous life, praying to Buddha and Bodhisattvas for blessings. Even when it comes to business, it is called beneficial relationships, not called “faithful”. That is having a wish. “Pure faith” is not wishing, but when we develop Bodhi mind to pray to Buddha, does that count as wishing or not? That is following the right path, a pure mind, and cannot be compared with worldly dharma. Definitely have to solve it. After understanding it, you must understand it clearly. Having clearly understood, when you pray, there will be two types of prayers. Making a vow is the best. Reciting the Pure Hanh chapter, [you will see] a total of one hundred and forty-one types of vows, but in summary, there are still only two vows: To save sentient beings and to become a Buddha, even to make all sentient beings become Buddhas. When you make that vow, it will be pure. Because you hope your mind will turn into Buddha's mind, and at the same time, you hope to restore the existing appearance of sentient beings, and also purify their inherent Buddha Nature. That's called pure faith.

Therefore, it is necessary to clearly distinguish pure faith and impure faith. However, we have just entered Buddhism, what should we do when we encounter unbelievers? You must advise them: "Believing in Buddha will be beneficial, there will be peace in the house." You can't immediately have too high and deep expectations, they won't be able to enter! First of all, use desire to entice and gradually make them enter the Buddhist path. At first, use the things they like the most and need most urgently, you tell them, they will like and trust you. Is there blessing or not? There are blessings. After being blessed, it will gradually cause them to develop pure faith and supreme joy, causing them to have reverence for the Three Jewels, only then will they be able to cut off all evil. Gradually, they will be able to recognize it. After knowing, you will feel ashamed and repent. Since you know how to repent, you need to complete your body and mind, purify your faith, and only then can you vow to permanently end all afflictions.

In the sixth Buddha Wheel, the Buddha taught: Make all my disciples practice the methods of Concentration, enter the Four Meditations and Eight Concentrations, up to all the Concentration subjects of the Tathagata. This is to prevent and prevent external enemies from harassing and internal thieves from stealing. Robbery in the house is difficult to guard against! Remember the ancients said: “It's easy to prevent mountain bandits, it's difficult to guard against family bandits” (Enemies in the mountains are easy to prevent, enemies in the house are difficult to prevent). It's easy to [prevent] thieves outside, just pay careful attention, but you won't be able to take care of thieves (thieves in the house). Enemies in your home are very difficult to guard against! We can subdue the external realm immediately, or not get involved or participate. If your foundation is not thick, it is easy to get infected. We can't go to tea houses or taverns, and we can't even go to the ballroom. Any place you shouldn't go to, I just don't go there. Having received the Eight Precepts, [the precepts] do not allow you to go to those places. That means “protection”. The Buddha has protected you well, so he can eliminate your afflictions.

Due to this cause and effect, countless afflictions, karmic obstacles, and dharma obstacles are destroyed, all causes and conditions that hinder the path are destroyed, the causes and conditions of the holy path increase, and countless thoughts of merit and blessings are fulfilled. In this way, we will go against birth and death, leave birth and death, be close to Nirvana, and move towards no birth and no death. Birth and death are birth and death. Where there is birth, there must be death; That is a natural rule. We are all afraid of death, we don't know how to compare birth and death, the suffering is not much different! Ghosts are afraid of reincarnation, people are afraid of death! Demons have supernatural powers, they know how to sustain pregnancy, conceive, give birth, and all kinds of endless suffering. Demons are afraid of reincarnation, do not wish to be reincarnated, it is better to be a ghost. Devils also want to be devils for a long time.

Same principle, people are afraid of death, do not want to die. Ghosts are also afraid of death. If they are afraid of death, they will know that after death they will be born. When faced with the pain of death, people only know that they will be separated, separated from their loved ones, forever separated. Wealth and house are created by yourself throughout your life, you can't take anything with you. Just as you came into [this world], so you will leave! When you are born, you cannot hold anything. Born from the mother's womb, naked, nothing exists. When you die, put on a shroud and cremate, nothing remains, not even the bones. That is called "the fruit of leaving birth and death", you must understand this principle. Do you wish for immortality? Nirvana will be immortal, Nirvana is immortal, immortal.

Someone must have said: "You're wrong! Śākyamuni Buddha isn't dead either!" Didn't He also take birth? Whenever you are born, your physical body must die. That's called "no birth, no death", but you think he has to endure birth and death. Actually, He appeared. Until you attain enlightenment, you will know that He has appeared. Present time is also manifestation. This physical body is composed of the Seven Elements, i.e. earth, water, fire, wind, emptiness, base, and consciousness, and is essentially non-existent. If it is true, of course it will be immortal. Because it is not true, it will be illusory and destroyed.

“Protect the Tathagata's unsurpassed Dharma” (Protect the Tathagata's unsurpassed Dharma): The eight groups of ghosts and spirits saw the Buddha cultivating those Concentrations, giving rise to great joy, giving rise to pure faith and joy towards the Three Jewels, achieving something unprecedented, no longer doing all evil things, until tigers. feel ashamed, reveal and repent for the things you have done in the past, deeply repent of all your evil mistakes, and immeasurable blessings and wisdom will increase, moving towards Nirvana. After that, not only will you not harm sentient beings, but you will also protect the Three Jewels and protect sentient beings. Even ghosts make a vow: Whoever cultivates the Way will protect them!

Why do we have to protect the Three Jewels? If there are good ghosts and spirits, [if they see us] chanting sutras or doing Buddhist work, they will protect us, we must bless them. They pray for our blessings. Therefore, when we do many things, we must be sincere and pure. Even entering the Buddha hall, we must be respectful. These are all responses to ghosts and gods. If we do wrong, ghosts and spirits will have anger. Buddhas and Bodhisattvas are compassionate and do not reprimand you. They know that your karma is heavy, and due to the flow of karma, disagreements appear. Demons are not like that. Therefore, we have many precepts to protect greed and prevent anger from arising. That is the sixth Buddha Wheel.

(Sutra) Due to trial and error, Tathagata travels to Tinh Lu solve escape, equal

maintaining, level-minded, immeasurable hundreds of thousands of wonderful, profound concentration, pure wisdom, freely moving, destroys all sentient beings, immeasurable afflictions, according to their desires, benefits, peace, attains peace and stability, attains no fear, attains no fear, calls themselves great. Immortal position, turning the Buddha wheel, evil gods, pagans and heretics, punishing the masses, the lion's roar.

only[44], immeasurable hundreds of thousands of profound and wonderful Concentrations, using pure wisdom to transform and eliminate countless afflictions for sentient beings. According to what should be, it is beneficial and peaceful, to abide in peace, not to panic, not to be afraid, to declare myself in the position of a great and noble immortal, to turn the Buddha Wheel, and to dispel the evil thoughts of The heavenly demons and pagans, in the mass, perform the lion's roar).

These are the same as in the previous section, no need to say more.

(Sutra) Good man! As Sat-di-loi initiates the great king, all the officials, leading the four soldiers, the patrols observe all the country cities, hamlets, gathering places, mountains, Xuyen, Khe, Gian, Vien Vien, Dien Trach, Pha, Ha, Tri Chieu, mineral wild, pine forest, town la class lands. Depending on the place, the country in all directions has many dangers, no business, no doubts, no enemies, no tolerance for external enemies, evil friends to surrender, to hide. Thusat-de-loi empowerment of the great king, depending on the ability and means to arrange the species, practice, solidly defend, and be flexible. local, calm, untroubled, able to handle the business, without doubt, without fear, without any external enemies, evil friends surrender, hidden, safe from the country and the people, free from suffering, enjoy happiness. Good man! The king of the Kshat-de-loi initiated the great king, achieving the level of the seventh king wheel. Due to the test of rotation, the spirit of the country increases in peace and happiness, conquers all enemies and evil friends, good friends protect the body, and the spirit increases life span.
The officials, commanding the four types of soldiers, patrol everywhere, observing all cities, hamlets, villages, mountains, rivers, creeks, streams, gardens, fields, houses, mountain slopes, rivers, ponds, fields, forests, towns, etc. in our country. Any place that is dangerous, full of accidents, impossible to do business in, suspicious, scary, can be a place for foreign enemies and evil friends to hide and hide. I, the great king Sat-di-li, who has received that empowerment, will, according to his own strength, use means to arrange repairs, rectifications, and solid defenses, making the places peaceful, free of trouble, able to trade, without doubts, without fear, to prevent foreign enemies and evil friends from lurking and hiding, and to reassure all the people in our country to leave suffering and enjoy happiness. O good man, the Great King of the Kshatriya nature has been empowered to attain the seventh wheel of kings. Because of this wheel, his own realm will increase in happiness, he will be able to subdue all enemies and evil friends, and he will be able to protect his body and prolong his life.)

This is the seventh royal wheel. In the previous section, four types were mentioned

Meditation, that is, the Four Formless Concentrations. Nouns like that are used in many sutras in the same way. When you really study, you will understand many Buddhist scriptures. The Four Formless Concentrations are beyond form, there is no form that can be expressed, so they are called Formless. These four types of realms are all realms of thought, not physical form or form. Unlike the six heavens in the Desire Realm and the eighteen heavens in the Form Realm, [the Four Emptiness Heavens] have no form, and only through thinking can one attain Concentration.
