From the time he went to the Soviet Union until he returned home, the Soviet Union did not confiscate it, the [Chinese] government did not confiscate it, but still let him keep it, and he could sell it to anyone he wanted. Later, he donated everything to the state. Last year, I returned to Nam Putuo and met him. Now he is studying painting, his last name is Ai Tan Giac La[48], becoming a painter.

After Pu Yi died, the [Chinese] government treated him quite leniently. After graduating from the art academy, he worked as a painter. In Nam Putuo, I met him and said: "Returning to the Imperial Palace, how do you feel?" If Pho Nghi did not die, he would still be emperor, as if he were the Crown Prince. When Pho Nghi dies, it will be him who takes over [the throne]. He said: "Everything is impermanent and does not belong to us. In the end, who will it belong to?" He has studied Buddhism for a long time and understands that principle. I use him as an example, because many people yearn for wealth, saying that something is a treasure, worth a lot of money. Immediately, you will have a different perspective and will especially protect that item, afraid of losing it. Actually, you cannot protect that item. Currently, the treasures of the Imperial Palace are scattered all over the world. Where do these precious treasures come from? When an emperor's dynasty is blessed, there will be people who exploit treasures from the sea, and there will also be items donated by foreign countries. The Dragon King and the ghost gods all turned into ordinary people to offer treasure. When the blessings are gone, everything is gone, I'm afraid the bowl of rice will become a problem. What is Tran Bao? Eating your fill is a treasure!

Big Brother Pu Yi, in Beijing, [people] often call him Big Brother[49]. In the past, he smoked opium and heroin. He was still able to hold on and not collapse so quickly. But he gambled, in one night he lost ten thousand, twenty thousand dong. Toan took big gambles, selling out both the royal palace and the mansions. Having lost everything, what should I do if I have no money? At that time, Beijing said "pulling carts". He had to go tow the cart. Everyone knows that it is Dai A Ca pulling the cart! At that time, he was a prince, when your blessings were gone, there was nothing left! You cannot use your brain to accumulate wealth, you must understand this principle!

“Wonderful appearance” (Full of miraculous appearance): Mature is very beautiful, everyone who sees it is happy, and even respectful. There are people who are ugly and rough, so they are looked down upon by others. If that person has internal virtue, it's okay. If you don't have internal virtue, you won't be respected by others. “Wonderful appearance” is a marvelous appearance, not ordinary! It means that if that king can do those good deeds, that is, perform the Ten Good Karmas well, and even practice almsgiving, then in this life, he will receive ten types of benefits: Full of great fame, full of great wealth, full of magical appearance, and many relatives. Everyone, don't think that "relatives" are just your own children or relatives, that's not the case at all. We are disciples of the Buddha, all relatives of the Buddha, that is, relatives of Śākyamuni Buddha. If we are born in the world of Ultimate Bliss, we will change again and become relatives of Amitābha Buddha. They are also Buddha's relatives and disciples of the Three Jewels. Regardless of breaking the precepts, even going against the Three Jewels, the Buddha still accepts you, and you are still a relative of the Buddha. If you maintain pure precepts, rely on the Three Refuges, and practice the Ten Virtues, you will be a good relative. The Buddha's relatives do not necessarily mean that everyone is a great Bodhisattva. During the Dharma-Ending Age, the Buddha's relatives were the four disciples. There are many bad people, but Buddha did not throw them away. In general, because of good roots, in the future, one will also be accepted. Therefore, that king did so many good things, and the king's relatives were especially numerous. The people in their country are all relatives of the king.

The fifth type of merit is less illness and less suffering. Very few illnesses, very few afflictions. Even all the external realms could not make the king angry, they made him less troubled. If a king has present mindfulness, of course he will have fewer illnesses and less afflictions. The king's friends and relatives also have wisdom. There is also multiliteracies, multiliteracies refers to listening to the Dharma. If we expand a little more, we will be talented in worldly technology, all kinds of techniques can be learned. He is intelligent, "multiliterate" means he has heard many dharmas. Right wisdom, right conduct, he does all good things, all are normal actions, all do not depart from the Ten Virtues, in general that is how it is. Being close to Buddha, Bodhisattva, offering to the Three Jewels, even making offerings, giving alms to everyone.

“Beautiful beauty and honor, resounding in the ten directions” (The vast and beautiful reputation resounds throughout the ten directions): [The reputation of] that good king is still handed down to this day, like King Asoka (Aśoka Maurya) creating eighty-four thousand Buddha stupas, throughout the entire Sa world. Mrs. In heaven, in the human world, and in dragon palaces, they all exist. The human world is still very small. In China, there is only Ashoka Pagoda in Ningbo. Other places also say that there are relics of the Buddha, which cannot be researched at all. At present, Buddha's tooth[50] can still be verified. Buddha's finger bone relics at Phap Mon Pagoda can still be examined. As for [places of worship] of Buddha's relics [in China], only the Ashoka Pagoda built by King Ashoka has one, but in the Buddhist halls of the human world, there are too many Buddha relics. This is also Buddha's relics, and that is also Buddha's relics.

When I was in Taipei, a disciple said: Someone took Buddha's relics to sell, he bought a lot of Buddha's relics, filled an entire vase, and worshiped them there! You can consider them as Buddha relics to worship, even the images drawn on paper are Buddha relics. However, the Buddha's relics actually only have one. As for fame and fortune, I give King Ashoka as an example. Like Emperor Thai Tong, everyone called him “gentle lord” (gentle king) or “holy monarch”. During the Tang Dynasty, Buddhism was especially prosperous. The most recent emperor who enjoyed relatively good fortune was King Qianlong, who served as Prince of Peace for sixty years. There's nothing to do, just worry about writing poetry, having fun, and admiring the scenery. That's what he had to do! Being an emperor like that is very happy. After him, two or three generations of kings were still quite good. That is a vast and beautiful retribution for reputation!

“ Ninth, great and majestic angels often guard him” (Nine are angels with great majesty and virtue who often follow their guards): That person cannot see. In Beijing, [people] often tell stories about Qianlong. Quan Thanh De Quan has shrines everywhere; was issued by Qianlong's chief decree, setting it into national law: "Every district, every village must build a temple to Quan De". Why build the Guan Di temple? When Qianlong first started [construction], before, there was none. Later, every village and town you go to will have a Quan De temple. Guan Di's holy army also became a saint, because Guan Di's holy army protected King Qianlong. [The story goes]: One day when the king was in court, he heard the sound of weapons behind him. He did not think it was someone assassinating him, but knew it was a god coming to protect him. The king asked: "Who will protect me? Who will protect me?" Behind the king, a voice replied: "Second brother Van Truong." He knew he was Liu Bei reincarnated. The emperor was very smart, so he asked: "Where is the third brother (Truong Phi)?" Quan Cong replied: "Defend Liaoyang", which is also Liaoyang in the Northeast. However, the general defending Liaoyang had no luck. When Qianlong heard about it, he immediately sent him to the capital. Because the king's heart was impatient, he used gold cards to play cards. After receiving the gold medal, that [general] immediately had to set out, traveling day and night. That's called “Kim Bai Cashew”. Being mobilized, the general believed that he had made a huge mistake. Otherwise, why would [the court] use gold cards to mobilize? He drank poison and committed suicide. This is an old story. That is “the mighty and virtuous angel who always protects him”.

When we receive the precepts, you take the Three Refuges, take the Five Precepts, there will be a good Dharma guardian to protect you. As soon as you break the precepts, they immediately leave you. Anyone who has received the Three Refuges and the Five Precepts will encounter very little danger. In Beijing at that time, there was a monk who smoked opium, and when he died, he still died in that temple. At that time, Japan invaded [China], after they occupied Beijing, I was still in Beijing, there were many monks who smoked opium. As long as there is money in the temple, it doesn't matter. When the money runs out, they sell the temple one by one. Those temples are all very large. They arbitrarily sell a little land, enough for them to smoke for a year or two, but they don't die on the streets!

In my hometown, there are rumors that in the winter it is dozens of degrees below zero and the onions are frozen, but they do not die, they still live as usual. There have been so many disasters, so many accidents, yet we still haven't seen any monks having to drag themselves around on the streets. There is a proverb that says: “ Hung never dies Tang, pile never dies” (Monks do not die of hunger, onions do not die of cold). That's why some people say: "I had no food to eat, so I became a monk!". In the North, this custom is very heavy. At that time, at the temples in the countryside, the monks were not vegetarians, but only ate salty foods. Although the temple does not allow monks to marry, they also do not receive precepts, and there are “foreigners”. What is foreign affairs? Their house is outside, not inside the temple. That's called “foreign family”. That's what the Dharma Ending Times is like.

Faced with this phenomenon, the Buddha did not allow defamation of them, did not approve of executing them, and did not approve of using water magic to punish them, because they belonged to the Three Jewels. If you do good karma, a mighty god will come to protect you. When your body breaks down and dies, you will be born in heaven, always in a good path. “The peaceful land” is on earth or in heaven. That is how the great king Kshat-di-li was empowered to achieve the ninth king wheel.

(Sutra) Due to trial and error, the spirit of the country increases in peace, overcomes the enemy, evil friends, and good guardians. body and spirit increase life span. Good man! The Tathagata knows as it really is that all sentient beings die and are born in the same way, knowing as they really are: Weakness of sentient beings, bad deeds in the body, bad deeds in the body, bad deeds in the idioms, sincere intention in evil deeds, defamation of the sages, wrong views, wrong views in the cause of karma, body destruction, death, falling into the evil beasts, or being born in hell, or being born in the animal realm, or being born in the realm of hungry ghosts. Weakness of sentient beings, good physical conduct, good idiom, good intention, non-blasphemy of sages, right view, right view of karma, destruction of body, death, promotion to good destiny, or rebirth in heaven, or rebirth in the middle, or end of defilements. The Tathagata knows as it really is, cares for sentient beings, creates great compassion, is courageous, is diligent, manifests the three divine transformations, is gentle with sentient beings, returns to the Buddha Dharma, attains enlightenment in the teachings, establishes the worldly, and transcends the worldly faith.
(Sutra: Because of this wheel, one's country can grow happily and conquer everything. All enemies and evil friends, skillfully protect the body, making life span increase. Good man! Tathagata clearly knows the true story of death and birth, etc. of all sentient beings like that, that is, knowing as it really is: If sentient beings accomplish evil deeds in the body, accomplish evil deeds in speech, achieve evil deeds in the mind, slander the sages, be full of wrong views and wrong karma, their bodies will be destroyed, their lives will be destroyed, or they will fall into evil destiniess, or be born in the evil realms. Hell, or being born as an animal, or being born as a hungry ghost. If sentient beings achieve good deeds in the body, achieve good deeds in speech, achieve good deeds in the mind, do not defame the saints, have all the right views and karma of right views, their bodies will be destroyed, their lives will be gone, they will ascend to the good paths, or be born in heaven, or be born among humans, or the Tathagata already knows the truth, and will show great compassion, courage, and purity towards those sentient beings attack, three types of miraculous transformations appear, causing those sentient beings to turn to the Buddha Dharma, arrange all kinds of teachings, and achieve faith beyond this world in the world).

“Due to the test of rotation, the spirit of the country increases in peace, overcomes all enemies, evil friends, good guards protect the body, the spirit increases the life span” (Due to that rotation, the country grows peacefully and happily, can subdue all enemies and evil friends, protects the body well, causes the life span to increase): That king is very good, not only good for oneself, but also so that there are no evildoers in that world! "Good man! As it really is, the Tathagata clearly understands all sentient beings, all sentient beings, birth and death, birth and death" (Good man! The Tathagata truly knows clearly the birth and death affairs of all sentient beings): Things like that, thanks to his wisdom, the Buddha knew clearly as they really were, that is, he understood the proper nature. Regarding life and death, whether to do good things or do bad things, the Buddha knows everything. Among the ten types of Wisdom, [the Buddha] skillfully knows the birth and death of all living beings. If all sentient beings do evil with their bodies, speak evil with their mouths, and think evilly, then the three evil deeds of body, speech, and mind have all been accomplished, and evil karma has been accomplished. There are evil beings who slander the saints and sages. As for the virtuous saints, they all slander and are full of wrong views. Due to that wrong view, after they die, they will fall into the three evil realms, will fall into hell, hungry ghosts, and animals. “Or being born with animals”: Being born with animals means being born with animals. Or be born as a hungry ghost, which is the three evil destiniess.

If we say the opposite, those beings “achieve good conduct in body, good speech, good mind”, that is, they have achieved good conduct in the body, accomplished good conduct in speech, achieved good conduct in the mind, and have not blasphemed the sages and saints. This is also right knowledge, right view, not wrong knowledge or wrong views. Due to those karma, when their bodies break down and die, the place they are born in will be completely different: Born in a good path, born in the human world, enjoying wealth and honor. What about being born in heaven? Even better than being born in the human world! “Either be born in heaven, or be born in the middle” (Either be born in heaven, or be born among humans): This sentence has an uncertain meaning, depending on whether the person's good karma or bad karma is large or small. Tathagata knows it all as it really is. "If sentient beings arise great compassion, courage, diligence, and manifest the three divine transformations" (For those living beings, arouse great compassion, courage, and diligence, manifest three miraculous transformations): Buddha knows exactly what it is. This class of sentient beings do good karma, and Buddha gives rise to compassion and accepts and protects them. How to receive and protect that person? Cause those sentient beings, that is, those good beings, those beings whose good karma has ripened due to the divine power of the Tathagata, to move towards the Buddha Dharma. How did the Buddha arrange to teach them? Establishing faith in the world beyond the world, that is, even though you are in the world, you believe in dharma beyond the world, establishing faith.

(Sutra) Ha level vi tam? One person, magical powers appear. Second author, the theory of change appears. Tam, the teaching world appears. Due to the power of the three transformations, sentient beings are promoted, taught, and wise, established in the world beyond the world, and the spirit must necessarily attain liberation from animals, animals, and beings.
(Sutra: What are the three? One is magical manifestation. Two is the doctrine of manifestation (when sentient beings remember a dharma, they manifest themselves and speak that dharma). Third, the doctrine of manifestation (transformation of teachings). Due to the power of these three types of manifestation, it exhorts, arouses sentient beings, admonishes, and establishes faith in the world, causing those who have died in all paths to be liberated).

Three types of magical transformations, “all three levels?” The first, the supernatural powers appear. The second, the teachings appear. The third, the precepts appear” (What are the three? One is the supernatural powers appear, the second is depending on what they think, they will appear and speak that dharma, the third is the teachings): Teach them to skillfully increase their good deeds, excel at the ten good karma, practice Meditation, to the point of receiving predictions, manifesting supernatural powers, predicting them in the future, manifesting Divine Powers and Divine Realities, causing their faith to grow. If we have an illness that cannot be cured, if we recite it sincerely and pray like that, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva will heal us. Not only you alone will have pure faith, but your friends around you will also have pure faith. There are also people who see that realm and still slander it because they are sentient beings with bad and vile nature. They are that kind of people. If you say that someone, by reciting the Ksitigarbha Sutra, is blessed by a Bodhisattva, is cured of an illness, or changes his or her life situation, those who do not believe will say: "How could such a thing happen? That illness can be cured." There are also people who do not believe, the reason for not believing is because of their evil nature. People who believe well have a reason to believe well. Therefore, [there are people] who use supernatural powers or strange appearances to deceive others, because there are sentient beings who are interested in it. But a person of righteous faith will not fall into wrong knowledge or wrong views. Although they also praise and rejoice, they think that this is not the end. We must understand this principle. We must advise and arouse such sentient beings, so that they can establish faith beyond this world in the world, so that all “sentient beings” are liberated. “Beasts” are the six realms of sentient beings with the suffering of birth and death, including gods, humans, Asura, hell, hungry ghosts, and animals. “Beasts” have six paths, here, it refers to the evil destinies. If there is birth and death, they are not yet liberated, it all makes them liberated.

(Sutra) Thien Son! Nhe became like a disciple of nine Buddha Wheels. Due to the trial of the wheel, I benefited the peace and happiness of countless sentient beings, attained peace and stability, attained no fear, attained no fear, proclaimed myself a great immortal, turned the Buddha wheel, bad devas, pagans and heretics, dealt with the masses, and rightly roared the lion.
(Sutra: Good man! I achieved the ninth Buddha Wheel like that. Because of this wheel, the benefit Infinite peace and happiness for all sentient beings, to abide in peace, to be free from panic, to be free from fear, to claim that I reside in the position of a great and noble immortal, to turn the Buddha Wheel, to dispel the evil opinions of demons and pagans, to live among the masses, to realize the lion's roar).

The Dharma I speak is the correct Dharma. Like a lion roaring, evil spirits and pagans who hear it are all subdued. It has that meaning!

(Sutra) Good man! Like the Great King Sat-di-loi empowerment, the person who eliminates the four continents, countless sentient beings, all kinds of physical illnesses, and the king of equanimity. The body of all the fragrant ladders, first of all, purify the robe, meditate correctly, all sentient beings, with an equanimity of mind, compassion and protection, the spirit frees all diseases, of different varieties of incense, flowers, musical techniques, makes offerings to the instruments, and makes offerings to the most majestic and virtuous angels. At that time, the Heavenly Emperor, the Dragon Emperor, the Divine Emperor Macho Lacjia, understood the matter, and similar sayings: "Try the Great King to initiate the Sat-di-loi empowerment, all the meritorious ones, possessing great majesty, the Eagle King, and the four continents. I, the Ying Ying, will jointly establish and restore the throne, to rule the four continents, and the spirits of all sentient beings will be free from illness and peace." At that time, all the heavenly emperors, the great emperor Mac Ho Lac Gia, who was convenient to come together, established Sat-di-loi as the great king of the Wheel-Turning King, seven-jeweled spiritual tools, commanding the four great continents, attaining freedom, the son of heaven is complete, strong, upright, able to resist evil and enemies, lock up the great king of the earth, constantly practice with the sea, punish the family, unsurpassed sword and staff, practice the Dharma, and live a peaceful life. Good man! The king of slaying-de-benefits was empowered and accomplished as the tenth king wheel. Due to the test of the wheel, the four great continents, the eighty thousand four thousand and four small chūtras, are established in the midst of sentient beings, the Ten Good Karmas, the good hands protect the body, the life of the spirit increases, the body decays, the life ends, while being born in the heavens, one receives wonderful joys.
sick to countless sentient beings in the four continents, he abandoned his throne, bathed his body and head with fragrant water, put on clean clothes, sat upright and thought, towards all sentient beings, his mind was equal and compassionate, in order to liberate all diseases, he used all kinds of incense, flowers, musical instruments, and other offerings to make offerings to all the gods of great virtue. At that time, all the heavenly kings, dragon kings, up to the god Mac Ho Lac Knowing this, they all said to each other: "This great king who is empowered with Sat-di-li, has all the merits, has great power, and is worthy of being the King of Luan to rule the four great continents. Let us come together to establish and restore the throne, making him rule the four great continents, so that all sentient beings will not get sick and be happy." At that time, the heavenly emperors up to the Divine Emperor Macho-de-li came together and established the great king who initiated Sat-de-li. Ascended to the throne of the Chakravartin King, making him complete the seven treasures, ruling the four great continents, all at peace, with a thousand sons, strong, strong, righteous, able to crush enemies, to be the king of the entire earth, reaching the very edge of the sea, all kinds of punishments are stopped, swords and sticks are not used, [the people] all practice the Dharma, and enjoy peace and happiness everywhere! This great king of the Sat-de-li nature has been enlightened The tenth king wheel is like that. Because of that wheel, in the four great continents, along with eighty-four thousand small continents, placing sentient beings in the Ten Good Karmas, skillfully protecting the body, causing the life span to increase, when the body breaks down and dies, they will be born in heaven, enjoying mysterious joys.

This is the tenth king wheel, the best worldly dharma. The great king who initiated the Sat-di-loi empowerment, in order to eliminate the diseases of living beings in the four great continents, "relinquished the king's throne" (threw away the king's throne), used fragrant water to bathe his body, and put on new clean clothes. The king immediately thought, thinking was also contemplation: For sick beings in the four great continents, how should they eliminate their illness? Why do we have a sick body? The body's illness is due to their heavy karma of killing in many past lives, so the body is sick. Also, illness of the body is easy to cure, illness of the mind is not easy to cure. How to do this? Preach the Dharma to them, because they eliminate all kinds of physical illnesses of all sentient beings in the four continents. After thinking, the king then made offerings to the angels with great dignity. This is referring to the Jade Emperor the Great, and also referring to the fourth heaven, which does not include Brahma at all. Because “offering to the heavenly king” refers to the fourth heaven [king].

There are also the dragon emperors of the dragon kings, up to the eight orders of ghosts and gods, up to the god emperors of the great python god. Mac Ho Lac Gia is the python god (great python god). He made offerings to those gods, hoping that those gods would use their divine power to eliminate the diseases of all sentient beings. It's just a physical illness, it doesn't preach the Dharma at all.

That great king's initiation was full of merit, had great majesty, and was worthy of being the Holy King of the Chakravarti. The Holy King Turning the Wheel here refers to the Golden Wheel Holy King, who will be the king of the four continents. Kim Luan Thanh Vuong is the king of four continents. Ngan Luan Thanh Vuong became the king of three continents. Dong Luan Thanh Vuong became the king of two continents. King Thiet Luan can only be king of one continent. Currently, in this world there is no holy king. In this era, there seems to be no karma wheel of the holy king! The nation is ungodly, many disasters arise. Everyone who recites the Human King Protects the Nation Sutra will know. Because of the king's merits and virtues, the angels, heavenly emperors, dragon emperors, up to the god-emperors of the python gods, the god-emperors of the eight classes of demons, all gathered together, discussed and studied this Wheel King, to see [how to] restore his throne, [so that he] could become a great king of initiation, and then established him as a great initiation king of the Sat-de-li nature to hold the position of Wheel-turning King, so that he I am the king of all four continents, complete with seven treasures. Those seven treasures are not gold, silver, agate, pearls, etc., but seven treasures (Satta ratanāni) in the Four Great Jewels:

One ​​is Luan Bao (Cakra-ratna). If, due to good fortune, the Luan King perceives [the position of] the Golden Wheel King, the ghosts, gods, heaven, and earth will build a golden wheel. How big is that luan? The largest Presidential vehicle is not as big as that wheel, even bigger than a ship. The king's relatives, the four great armies, and the seven treasures are all placed on that wheel. The seven treasures are all included in the Luan Treasure. The king can ride that wheel to travel to four great continents: Dong Thang Than Chau, Bac Cau Lo Chau, Tay Nguu Ha Chau [and Nam Thiem Bo Chau]. We can only be in Nam Thiem Bo Chau because it is south of the sun. North of the sun is Bac Cau Lo Chau. To the west of the sun is Tay Niu Ha Chau, to the east of the sun is Dong Thang Than Chau.

This is a myth, Buddhist scriptures quote myths to explain about Kim Luan Vuong. We do not need to talk about the four great continents. A Nam Thiem Bo Chau has many races, many languages, and many living customs. Each tribe has their own living customs. As countries develop, they have a common language to communicate. In unexplored places, there are places where airplanes have flown, and there are places where airplanes have not yet flown. Especially the dragon race in the sea, how many types of sentient beings are there in the sea? For the king's four continents, you must understand all languages. The first thing is living habits, they have different customs. If we want unification, is it that easy? Unifying the four great continents is not easy! The king has this divine power, that is Luan Bao.

There is also Tuong Bao (Hasti-ratna), that elephant is different from normal elephants. [Although it] does not have great magical powers like the elephant ridden by Samantabhadra Bodhisattva, but is a common type of Statue of Treasure. The Bao statue is a treasure among elephants. That elephant is a precious elephant. There is also Ma Bao (Aśva-ratna), the pegasus that flies in the sky, which means “treasure horse”, the pegasus that can fly. As for Chau Bao (Maṇi-ratna), Chau Bao means Nhu Y Bao Chau (Cintāmaṇi). All of Luan King's treasures are different from ours. We don't have Da Minh Chau, so in the dark we have to use the light of a lamp. If there was a Night Pearl, this house would brighten up. We also don't have Ty Thuy Chau. Regardless of whether you go to a river, lake, canal, or sea, whenever you use Ty Thuy Chau, the water immediately splits into two so you can pass through. Even a whirlwind, no matter a storm, no matter what kind of wind, if you use the Dinh Phong Pearl towards it, the wind will no longer exist. Luan Vuong has these treasures, which are complete, but we do not have the blessing of meeting them. However, these jewels are not as good as the Nhu Y Jewel in the hands of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Cultivate and achieve achievements like Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, you will have the Wishful Pearl.

Those are the seven treasures, and there is the Female Treasure (Strī-ratna). Nu Bao is also a beauty. Those beauties are not greedy beauties at all, but are very pure. Everyone listened to the teaching of Vimalakirti Sutra, and the goddess said that Sariputta was the manifestation of Bodhisattva. Although this Luan King has virtue, he still cannot feel the Bodhisattva manifest [as a Female Treasure]. People should not think that [Nu Bao] are singers and prostitutes, they are all singers! If you think of Nu Bao as singers in the human world, you will not become a treasure. In the human world, what is Bao? Bao is precious and rare. Use this meaning to talk about Nu Bao.

There is also the general commander of the army (Chief Binh Bao, Pariṇāyaka-ratna), all on Kim Luan. That great minister has unimaginable power and can crush all enemies. At that time, everyone will maintain the precepts and practice the Ten Virtuous Deeds, so how can there be enemies? Wherever the king's Luan Treasure goes, that place is pure, honoring the king as a great king. Full of Seven Treasures, commanding the four great continents, all are free. Whenever it comes to King Sat-de-loi, King Luan has enough “heavenly sons”, that is, a thousand sons, but they are not born from the same wife, or the king has countless wives. This type of situation cannot be predicted by the rule “one wife, one husband”! The king lived an extremely long life, was courageous, and had a thousand sons, but his conduct was pure. If the Holy King Turning the Wheel was truly lustful, it wouldn't work, nor could he be the Holy King Turning the Wheel. This is the intention. [Children] are sometimes reincarnated. In that case, one thousand children are all brave and virtuous, able to crush the enemy's resentment.

Pham is the four great continents controlled by the king, all the way to the edge of the sea. The edge of the sea is not easy to reach. The Pacific Ocean and the Atlantic Ocean are the oceans we see, and the seven golden mountains surrounding Mount Meru and the seven layers of fragrant water sea, outside are all salt water seas. There is a proverb that says: "Three mountains, six waters, one part of land", meaning: Fields only account for one part, three parts are mountain land, six parts are wetland. Upland fields can only be grown in part. Has anyone measured how big the Pacific Ocean is? There are five more oceans! Not just one ocean, but also the Indian Ocean, Southern Ocean, Arctic Ocean. “Everlasting ocean” means that even the edge of the ocean reaches the end. That is to say the vast dominion, in addition to the earth, all the mountains and seas. At that time, the king had no punishment, no reprimand, all punishments were suspended. There is also no instrument to punish, no sword or staff, because [everyone] practices the Dharma, and everyone enjoys peace and joy. Therefore, that initiated king achieved the tenth king wheel.

Because of this wheel, in the four great continents until it covers eighty-four thousand “small chapters”, that is, small continents. Eighty-four thousand small continents, eighty-four thousand small countries. This is to state a general number, established in it. All of those sentient beings practice the Ten Virtuous Paths, preserve their bodies, have a long life, grow, die, and die, and do not fall into the three evil realms. At that time, King Kim Luan led the people to practice the Ten Virtuous Deeds. When their lifespan expires, they will be reborn in heaven and will not fall into the three evil realms. Buddhist scriptures only say that, in the end, how many Golden Wheel Kings appeared in the world is completely unrecorded. At least in this country, there are no records. Thiet Luan Vuong also did not exist. At that time, it was only said “the entire land, the whole land of the king” (all over the land, nothing is the king's land). “Pho thien chi ha” (Under the whole sky) [in the parlance of ancient Chinese emperors] was almost only [the land] on both sides of the Yellow River. The territory ruled by the Three Emperors and Five Emperors was very small. That is "sitting at the bottom of a well to look at the sky, a frog sitting at the bottom of a well", not knowing how big other people's territories are outside your own territory. That's the meaning, it's okay to understand that comprehensive meaning!

This is using Buddha's eye to see. In such a good country, when the four great continents are all good, or when the great continent has been established for more than ten thousand years, the Buddha will live for eighty thousand years, and sometimes the Buddha will stay in the world for an entire eon. At those times, it is possible that Kim Luan Vuong is protecting the Dharma. But Śākyamuni Buddha's vow was not like that. [When he appeared in the world] people's lifespan was only one hundred years, and the country was often in war and chaos. During Buddha's time, there should have been no wars or chaos, right? During Buddha's time, it was like that [war and chaos]. If we study Indian history and consider what India's situation was like, we will see the same situation. Furthermore, Śākyamuni Buddha only taught on both sides of the Ganges River. You come to India to worship the relics, just [places] on both sides of the Ganges River. Later, Buddhism spread throughout the four great continents. Except for Bac Cau Lo Chau who doesn't believe it, other places all have it, even a great thousand world, that is, three thousand great worlds.

But for the land we live in, according to what we can see, we can only understand that! [For our limited understanding], the four great continents seem mythical, because they were not recorded, and this type of memory is not preserved in consciousness! Or maybe they did in their previous lives, but now they're all addicted; But you must practice, be courageous and diligent in practice, and you will achieve supernatural powers and [know that all the realms mentioned in the Buddhist scriptures] really exist.

Therefore, there are monks who enter Samadhi and observe, can observe quite a lot of the world, why don't they say anything? Who believes it or not? You can also be criticized as crazy, mentally deranged! So there must be equality! The Buddha who appears in the human world cannot [appear] much superior to others. The A Ham Sutra says that He was like everyone else, also held an alms bowl, and lived the same life as everyone else. Because if you want to save others and appear especially high, others will feel that He is incomprehensibly high: "How can we learn?" That's why some people say: "How can I accept the precepts like those of your noble monks?" There are also people who look at it and even think that what can they do if they don't eat meat? Someone said: "I also want to be a monk, but if they don't let me eat meat, I won't do it!" Wishing everything must be according to desire to perceive, that is impossible! If you perceive it like that, Luan Vuong is also like that.

(Kinh) Thiện nam tử! Như thị Như Lai tích Bồ Tát vị, tri tự tha thân hữu vô lượng chủng chư phiền não bệnh, dĩ Định hương thủy, tẩy dục kỳ thân, cập dĩ Đế pháp đại từ đại bi, quán mộc kỳ thủ, trước tàm quý y. Thập phương nhất thiết chư Phật Thế Tôn, dĩ chư Tĩnh Lự, đẳng trì tinh tấn, phương tiện trí ý, từ bi hộ niệm, hàm tác thị ngôn: “Như thị Đại Sĩ, thị đại phước huệ trang nghiêm bảo khí, kham dung nhất thiết tam chủng bất hộ, tứ vô sở úy, Như Lai thập lực, cập dữ thập bát bất cộng Phật pháp, kham đắc vô thượng Nhất Thiết Trí trí, đại từ, đại bi, vô bất cụ túc, thường hân lợi lạc nhất thiết chúng sanh. Thị cầu Phật Bảo thương nhân đạo thủ, năng cứu hữu tình sanh tử chúng khổ, năng thí hữu tình Niết Bàn đại lạc. Ngã đẳng nhất thiết chư Phật Thế Tôn, ưng dĩ thành ngôn, dữ kỳ sở nguyện, linh thành Như Lai Ứng Chánh Đẳng Giác, đắc vô thượng pháp, vi đại pháp vương”. Ngã ư nhĩ thời, y phước huệ lực, dũng mãnh, tinh tấn, ư Tứ Thánh Đế như thật tri dĩ, chứng đắc Vô Thượng Chánh Đẳng Bồ Đề. Thiện nam tử! Như Chuyển Luân Vương thống tứ đại châu, giai đắc tự tại, như thị Như Lai ư Tứ Tĩnh Lự, Tứ Vô Sắc Định, tứ chủng phạm trụ, tứ vô ngại giải, tứ thánh đế quán, tứ vô sở úy, Như Lai thập lực, cập dữ thập bát bất cộng Phật pháp, Nhất Thiết Chủng Trí giai đắc tự tại. Như Chuyển Luân Vương cụ túc thất bảo, như thị Như Lai thành tựu thất chủng Bồ Đề Phần bảo. Như Chuyển Luân Vương thiên tử cụ túc, dũng kiện, đoan chánh, năng phục oán địch, như thị Như Lai hữu A Nhã Đa Kiều Trần Na vi tối sơ, Tô Bạt Đà La Tô Lạt Đa vi tối hậu. Chư đại Thanh Văn, tùng Phật tâm sanh, tùng Phật khẩu sanh, tùng pháp hóa sanh, đắc Phật pháp phần, chư lậu vĩnh tận, danh vi dũng kiện, cụ tứ phạm trụ, danh vi đoan chánh, năng phục nhất thiết thiên ma, ngoại đạo dị luận, oán địch. Như Chuyển Luân Vương, hóa cập bát vạn tứ thiên tiểu chử. Như thị Như Lai ư bách câu-chi Nam Thiệm Bộ Châu, ư bách câu-chi Tây Cù Đà Ni châu, ư bách câu-chi Đông Tỳ Đề Ha châu, ư bách câu-chi Bắc Câu Lô châu, ư bách câu-chi chư đại minh hải, ư bách câu-chi chư Diệu Cao sơn, ư bách câu-chi tứ đại vương thiên, ư bách câu-chi nãi chí Phi Tưởng Phi Phi Tưởng thiên, ư bách câu-chi đại Luân Vi sơn, ư thử cao quảng nhất Phật độ trung, ngôn âm thí hóa, giai đắc tự tại. Thiện nam tử! Ngã thành như thị đệ thập Phật Luân. Do thử luân cố, như thật liễu tri tự thân, tha thân, chư lậu vĩnh tận, lợi ích an lạc vô lượng hữu tình, đắc an ổn trụ, đắc vô kinh khủng, đắc vô sở úy. Tự xưng ngã xử đại tiên tôn vị, chuyển ư Phật Luân, tồi chư thiên ma, ngoại đạo tà luận, xử đại chúng trung, chánh sư tử hống.
(Kinh: Này thiện nam tử! Như Lai xưa thuộc địa vị Bồ Tát cũng như thế, biết thân mình và thân người khác có vô lượng các loại bệnh phiền não. Dùng nước Định thơm để tắm rửa thân mình, dùng Đế pháp đại từ, đại bi để xối, gội đầu mình, mặc áo hổ thẹn. Mười phương hết thảy chư Phật Thế Tôn dùng các Tĩnh Lự, đẳng trì, tinh tấn, phương tiện trí ý, từ bi hộ niệm, đều nói như thế này: “Vị Đại Sĩ như thế là vật dụng báu trang nghiêm bằng phước huệ to lớn, có thể chứa hết thảy ba thứ bất hộ, bốn món vô sở úy, mười lực của Như Lai, cùng với mười tám món Phật pháp bất cộng, kham đạt được trí Nhất Thiết Trí vô thượng, đại từ, đại bi không gì chẳng trọn đủ, thường thích lợi lạc hết thảy chúng sanh, là người hướng dẫn cho thương nhân [thâu lượm] Phật Bảo, có thể cứu các nỗi khổ sanh tử cho hữu tình, có thể thí niềm vui Niết Bàn to lớn cho hữu tình. Hết thảy chư Phật Thế Tôn chúng ta hãy nên dùng lời chân thành để thỏa nguyện của ông ta, khiến cho ông ta thành Như Lai, Ứng Cúng, Chánh Đẳng Giác, đắc vô thượng pháp, làm đại pháp vương”. Ngay trong lúc ấy, ta nương vào sức phước huệ, dũng mãnh, tinh tấn, đã biết Tứ Thánh Đế đúng như thật rồi, chứng đắc Vô Thượng Chánh Đẳng Bồ Đề. Này thiện nam tử! Như Chuyển Luân Vương thống lãnh bốn đại châu đều được tự tại, cũng như thế, Như Lai đối với Tứ Tĩnh Lự, Tứ Vô Sắc Định, bốn loại phạm trụ, tứ vô ngại giải, tứ thánh đế quán, tứ vô sở úy, Như Lai thập lực, và mười tám món Phật pháp bất cộng, Nhất Thiết Chủng Trí, đều được tự tại. Như Chuyển Luân Vương trọn đủ bảy báu; cũng như thế, Như Lai thành tựu bảy loại báu Bồ Đề Phần. Như Chuyển Luân Vương có đủ một ngàn con trai dũng kiện, đoan chánh, có thể hàng phục oán địch, cũng giống như thế, Như Lai có A Nhã Đa Kiều Trần Na là đệ tử tối sơ, Tô Bạt Đà La Tô Lạt Đa là đệ tử tối hậu. Các đại Thanh Văn sanh từ tâm Phật, sanh từ miệng Phật, từ pháp hóa sanh, có phần trong Phật pháp, các lậu vĩnh viễn hết sạch, ai nấy đều dũng cảm, tráng kiện, trọn đủ tứ phạm trụ, được gọi là đoan chánh, có thể hàng phục hết thảy dị luận của hết thảy thiên ma, ngoại đạo và oán địch. Như Chuyển Luân Vương giáo hóa trọn khắp tám vạn bốn ngàn tiểu châu, cũng giống như thế, Như Lai trong một trăm câu-chi Nam Thiệm Bộ Châu, trong một trăm câu-chi Tây Cù Đà Ni châu, trong một trăm câu-chi Đông Tỳ Đề Ha châu, trong một trăm câu-chi Bắc Câu Lô châu, trong một trăm câu-chi các biển lớn mênh mông, trong một trăm câu-chi các núi Diệu Cao, trong một trăm câu-chi tứ đại vương thiên, trong một trăm câu-chi cho đến Phi Tưởng Phi Phi Tưởng thiên, trong một trăm câu-chi núi đại Luân Vi, trong một Phật độ cao rộng ấy, dùng ngôn âm để ban bố sự giáo hóa, đều được tự tại. Này thiện nam tử! Ta thành tựu Phật Luân thứ mười như thế. Do vì luân ấy, biết rõ đúng như thật thân mình và thân người khác đã vĩnh viễn hết sạch các lậu, lợi ích an lạc vô lượng hữu tình, được trụ trong an ổn, được không kinh hoảng, được chẳng sợ hãi, tự xưng ta thuộc địa vị đại tiên tôn quý, chuyển Phật Luân, dẹp tan tà luận của các thiên ma và ngoại đạo, ở trong đại chúng thực hiện sư tử hống).

Kế đó, nói về Phật Luân. “Thiện nam tử, như thị Như Lai tích Bồ Tát vị” (Này thiện nam tử! Như Lai xưa kia ở địa vị Bồ Tát cũng như thế), [nghĩa là] khi đức Phật trong quá khứ, hành Bồ Tát đạo trong Đâu Suất Thiên Cung, chỉ là từ sự từng trải của bản thân giống hệt như chúng sanh, biết thân mình và thân người khác, cũng tức là khi đức Phật hành Bồ Tát đạo, trong lúc tu nhân, chưa thành Phật, biết thân của chính mình và thân của hết thảy chúng sanh đều có vô lượng các loại bệnh phiền não. Đấy chẳng phải là thân bệnh của đại vương quán đảnh, ông ta biết vô lượng bệnh phiền não. Phật dùng Định hương, để trừ phiền não thì dùng Định để trừ. Định có thể sanh ra Huệ. Dùng Định hương thì mới có thể trừ khử phiền não. Dùng nước Định thơm ấy để xối gột cái thân. Dùng gì để xối gột? “Đế pháp”. Đế pháp là lý pháp. Nước thơm tắm gội là pháp thế gian. Thế gian dùng hương để trị liệu là sạch sẽ nhất, thanh tịnh nhất, thanh khiết, thơm tho nhất để tẩy gột thân bệnh thì còn được, chứ chẳng thể tẩy gột bệnh phiền não của chúng sanh. Đế pháp có thể nói là tâm pháp, là lý pháp, nhập lý, là minh tâm kiến tánh. Dùng “hành đại từ, đại bi” cũng có nghĩa là cứu vớt, che chở hết thảy chúng sanh. Bi có thể dẹp khổ, Từ có thể ban vui, ban cho chúng sanh sự vui sướng. Lấy nước đại từ đại bi để xối gội đầu. Chúng ta biết khi Thích Ca Mâu Ni Phật giáng sanh, phụ vương của Ngài dùng nước bốn biển rưới lên đỉnh đầu đức Phật. Đó là pháp thế gian. Ông ta lấy nước bằng cách nào? Do long vương đem đến cúng dường đức Phật.

“In front of Tam Quy shirt” (Wearing Tam Quy shirt): Wearing Tam Quy shirt, means having shame or shame. Tam felt that he was at fault, so he repented, always feeling that he was unworthy, arrogant, and complacent. Diligent, courageous, without thoughts of arrogance or arrogance. If you do bad things yourself, you will be ashamed of others. Mindfulness is within oneself. Noble is [speaking in terms of] behavior. If thoughts give rise to bad thoughts or feelings that are harmful to sentient beings, no matter what thoughts arise, they will be harmful to sentient beings. At the same time, it is also unfavorable for oneself, unfavorable for cultivating the religion. He wore clothes like that. Clothing is intended to protect the body, using Tam Quy to protect the Dharma Body, making the Dharma Body pure, causing the Dharma Body to exist forever. All the Buddhas and World-Honored Ones of the ten directions are "sudden Buddhas" (using the Buddhas). Stillness is still Concentration, is cultivating Thinking. Cultivation of Thought is also called samadhi, also known as Concentration.

“Equity of diligence, mental means”: Equality of perseverance is equality. The Three Learnings, Concentration, and Wisdom are all accepted and maintained equally [then called Equal Retention]. All sentient beings are equal, there is no taking or giving up. What is the use of being so diligent? Seek wisdom and means. If you want to benefit sentient beings, you must attain wisdom of means. Regarding the Truth of Dharma, skillful means are necessary. Having that wisdom, how can we use compassion to protect our thoughts and thoughts? People with afflictions. For those who have illnesses and afflictions, compassionately protect them.

“The function of speaking is like a Great Being, displaying great blessings and wisdom adorned with treasures” (It is all said like this: Such a Great Being is a treasure adorned with great blessings): He said, when I was still in the position of a monk, practicing the Bodhisattva path, I did so. All sentient beings praise me for having great blessings and wisdom, which is a precious and solemn object. That treasure is a solemn treasure. What is that? It is a blessing. That precious item is used to store blessings. He is like a treasure, like a treasure filled with jewels. That treasure can contain all three types of impurities. There are many ways to explain the term “three types of impurity”. Some people say "not protecting and reciting the three objects" is fine, or understanding it as "not having the mind to protect and reciting the Three Jewels" is also okay, or "hells, hungry ghosts, and animals are three types that cannot be protected, so do not protect and recite them." So when we develop Bodhi mind, we can even tolerate, endure, and tolerate them, meaning we can protect all sentient beings, even those who cannot be protected. In other words, “tolerating the three unprotected things” means being able to protect them.

“The Four Fearless Powers, the Tathagata's Ten Powers”: In the previous section, there was talk about the Four Powerless Powers, but the Tathagata's Ten Powers and the eighteen dharmas do not add up. In the past, I rarely mentioned them, only mentioning the names. The meanings in those nouns are very deep, I will only outline them. What are the ten types of Ten Forces? These are the ten types of wisdom of the Tathagata. From wisdom comes strength, from that strength it benefits sentient beings. Of those ten types of wisdom, one is the Power of Non-Land of Wisdom. The Buddha's wisdom knows the birthplace of all sentient beings, where they were born in the past, where they will be born, [that is] where they were born from, and where they will be born again. That is the Land of Tri Luc.

Second is the Power of Karma. The cause of karma is the result of karma, among which is the Fruit of the Fruit, its cause is complicated and complex. For example, the deeds done in this life include good karma and bad karma, some are big good, some are small, some are big evil, some are small. Of these types of karma, whichever karma ripens first will receive the results of that karma first. The Buddha knew clearly, he had that wisdom. Here we are talking about all sentient beings, not just one or two people, the comprehensive scope of [knowledge of the karma of other beings] of all sentient beings is too much.

The third type is Calm Liberation, Equal Retention of Wisdom. Can achieve all kinds of liberation, liberation is Concentration, Tranquility is Concentration. We talk about one hundred and eight doors of samadhi. Samadhi is Tinh Lu, Tinh Lu Dinh. The process of Tinh Lu is also very many, the Buddha all accepted and maintained them equally. Just like when we receive and maintain several sutras, each sutra [selects] only one chapter, such as [receiving and maintaining] the Universal Door chapter of the Lotus Sutra, which is also considered receiving and upholding the Lotus Sutra, but that is only one chapter in the twenty-eight chapters of the Lotus Sutra. The Samantabhadra Sutra is the last chapter in the eighty-one chapters of [the Avatamsaka Sutra], [reciting that chapter] is also considered the recitation of the Avatamsaka Sutra. Reciting one chapter is equivalent to reciting the entire sutra. We must understand this level of meaning. If we don't have that mentality, we won't be equal. “Trì” means “retain” (to hold), using that wisdom to treat all samadhi, can make sentient beings liberate.

The fourth type is Can Thang Liet Tri Luc. Upper capacity, lower capacity, or intermediate capacity, this is the Dharma teaching corresponding to the capacity. The ten types of intelligence are meant to correspond to [the fundamentals of] sentient beings. He knows whether they are of high quality or low quality, and knows whether their capacity is ripe or not. Buddha had that kind of wisdom. That's called [Chan Thang Liet] Tri Luc.

The fifth type is the Entertaining Force Winning Strain. Of all dharmas, all things, all dharma principles, all dharma events, the Buddha has all kinds of winning solutions, transcending the world, surpassing the Two Vehicles, surpassing Bodhisattvas. This type of intelligence is higher than the Ten Grounds. Of the ten types of wisdom in Buddhahood, only the Buddha is complete and ultimately perfect.

The sixth type is the Intellectual Realm Race. Precept means “birth”. The border between this district and that district, between this village and that village [is called Gender]. Know the nature of all living beings. The Avatamsaka Sutra talks about “dharma realm”, the realm that gives birth to all kinds of dharma, so it is called “dharma realm”. Here we do not say it is the dharma realm, but it is called “the race of superior intelligence and wisdom”, which has this type of wisdom.

The seventh type is the Intellectual Force of Beast Transformation. We have just explained the five types of Transformations, but that is only the beginning. [Transforming Animal Actions means] being able to know which path all sentient beings will move towards due to the karma they have created. Regarding the ten dharma realms, we often talk about the six paths, not mentioning the dharma realm saints, that is, Sravakas, Pratyekabuddhas, Bodhisattvas, and Buddhas, [due to good karma] will also advance towards those dharma realms. If our current actions aim to move towards the Buddha Dharma world, we will be Buddha. Currently, you are using your mind, currently thinking, currently doing, that is the cause. You follow that path, that is, when you are doing it, you have already distinguished where you are going. This is very clear. If you practice the Dharma of Suffering, Origin, Cessation, and Path, you will progress towards Shravaka. Learning the twelve causes and conditions of dependent origination will lead you towards the Dharma of Pratyekabuddha. Practicing the Six Paramitas, cultivating the Prajnaparamita, cultivating the Six Virtues of Thousand Virtues, will progress towards the Bodhisattva's Dharma. Bodhisattvas can eventually become Buddhas. That is “turning beast” (progressing completely).

The eighth type is Entering the Power of Mindfulness and Mindfulness, also called Sufficient Network Information. The Buddha is the ultimate Sustainer, knowing the sustenance of all living beings. Know all sentient beings in countless past lives. The Buddha knew clearly the story of every living being in countless eons. Even what you are thinking right now, what thoughts you are thinking, thinking about your countless lives in the past, the Buddha knows it clearly and understands it like the back of his hand. In the Diamond Sutra, the Buddha used the amount of sand in the Ganges River as an example, each grain of sand is a world, up to one mote in the three thousand great thousand worlds, and used [the amount] of sand in a Ganges River in each world in the worlds as much as the sands of the Ganges River accumulate, there are Buddha lands as many as that, each Buddha land has limitless and limitless sentient beings, the Buddha knows their thoughts. What are the boundless, limitless sentient beings thinking in their minds? Compared with the sixty billion people on earth today, I don't know how many thousands, thousands, thousands of times more! Therefore, the Buddha knows our thoughts clearly. That is Niem Tri Luc, inconceivable! Finally, the Buddha said, the minds of all sentient beings, the past mind is impossible, the future mind is impossible, the present mind is impossible, the three minds are impossible. The Buddha clearly explained your thoughts like that. [In the poem praising the Buddha, there is the sentence] “every moment of thought can be known” means that in every moment of thought, the Buddha knows every single thing. Whatever you think, He will calculate it for you. That's called Dependent on Wisdom Power. Whatever you think, just think it, the Buddha will know it.

The ninth type is the Power of Death and Life. Die here, be born there, die from there, be born here. Birth and death, birth and death.

The tenth type is Gonorrhea At Tri Luc. The Buddha is the ultimate defilement. The Second Vehicle is also said to have been exhausted, there is no more creation. At that time, they just did not fall into the three realms. The End of the Buddha's Asrava is not falling into the nine dharma realms, nor regressing to Bodhisattva status. He can also manifest as all sentient beings, because He has completely eliminated all defilements. Only when the defilements are eliminated can they manifest. Because of its manifestation, it is possible to save sentient beings. Those are ten types of intelligence.

This is roughly speaking, but the Avatamsaka Sutra talks about ten different types of wisdom, a little more in-depth. The sutras talk about ten types of intelligence, whether deep or shallow, whether perception is deep or shallow, depending on each person's intelligence. For example, like the water in the ocean, the taste is all salty. Even if you take a cup [to taste it], it's still the same salty taste. That's the meaning. To study Buddhism, you only need to enter the Buddhist sect, even take refuge in the Buddha, take refuge in the Dharma, and take refuge in the Sangha. That is practice.

When transmitting the Three Refuges, I often bless people like this. I said: "You recite taking refuge in the Buddha, taking refuge in the Dharma, taking refuge in the Sangha. Before you go to sleep, you should recite it. When you wake up in the morning, you should recite it. In this way, you will complete all the Buddha Dharma." Although you don't make such detailed distinctions, in general, we say "Buddha, Dharma, Sangha", that is dharma. Dharma is spoken by whom? Buddha said. Who transmitted it? Venerable monks and monks pass it on. Whenever you recite “Buddha, Dharma, Sangha”, you have completed this set of sutras, and you have also completed that set of sutras. This Dharma completes all Dharmas, all Dharma stores in the ten directions. When we worship, isn't that what we pray for? Isn't that what repentance is? You must understand the ten Buddha wisdoms like that. After explaining, you will dedicate more!

There are also eighteen non-plus dharmas. The eighteen non-combined dharmas are the Body Unconditioned, the Speech Unconditioned, the Mind Unconditioned, the three karmas without errors or mistakes, those are the three dharmas. Thought is thought. “A body without loss” is a body without mistakes. Thus, the Buddha's body and the body of all sentient beings, even the Bodhisattva's body, are incompatible (Buddha has special dharmas that other positions do not have). That is to say, the Buddha's eighteen non-combined dharmas are not the same as those of the great Bodhisattvas; that is Non-Communist. Buddha's body is Infinite Body, Infinite Speech, Infinite Mind, Infinite Thoughts (no strange thoughts), Infinite Concentration (mind is never not Concentrated), His mind is always in Concentration. Even when manifesting his incarnation to benefit sentient beings, He was always in Concentration, never without Concentration. “Na Gia is always in Concentration” has such a meaning. There is nothing that Buddha's wisdom cannot illuminate. Regardless of any dharma, there is no dharma that does not shine. The seventh non-plus Dharma is Desire without Reduction, which means helping sentient beings without getting tired or tired. The eighth Dharma is Endless Effort, which means eternal diligence. The ninth Dharma is Non-Reduction Mindfulness, which means that every thought does not forget the benefit of sentient beings. Reciting Non-Reduction means there is no thought that misses the benefit of sentient beings.

Therefore, we must not forget the Three Jewels in every recitation, not miss a single recitation! In twenty-four hours, how many thoughts do we have? Therefore, we will know immediately how far we are from Buddha! You tell me, in twenty-four hours, how many times do I recite the Three Jewels? How many times do you recite the Three Jewels? I know it very clearly myself. What are you thinking? Wealth, beauty, profit, fame, wealth, and one's own family and relatives. We monks think of temples and religious friends. Even when you recite Buddhist scriptures or recite Buddha's name, your thoughts are still lingering around there. If you have attachment, your mind will be unequal. We can't [distinguish] big, small, from one to the other. It's like when we open our eyes, we immediately see men, women, old, young, with many distinct appearances. [When attaining Buddhahood], all those thoughts are lost. Desire without reduction is to save sentient beings without reduction. Unmitigated Diligence means not having a single thought of retreat.

All corresponding wisdom is undiminished, eternal and unremitting. Infinite Wisdom, Infinite Liberation, Infinite Liberation and Knowledge, body karma can act according to wisdom, verbal karma can act according to wisdom, mental karma can act according to wisdom, wisdom knows the past without hindrance. The past still has the past, the past still has obstacles. No obstacles, no obstacles. Wisdom knows the future is unobstructed, wisdom knows the present is unobstructed. A total of eighteen dharmas. These dharmas are not common to all Bodhisattvas. We don't need to say any more, [Buddha's non-communal dharmas] are not shared with us. Only Buddha and Buddha have those dharmas in common. Those are called the eighteen non-plus dharmas[52].

The ten powers and eighteen non-plus dharmas include everything. Only then can we attain the Supreme Omniscience, great kindness, great compassion, nothing is incomplete, always working to benefit all sentient beings, our minds always seek. The mind is happy and joyful in benefiting sentient beings. We all have to learn from Buddha, what are we learning? Don't see this as bad, that as good, that as beautiful. You are very excited to be close to beautiful people. As for the bad guy, when he sees that person, he loses interest and walks away a bit. That person talks to you, you are not very patient, your mind is unfair! There are still people you hate, and there are people who have harmed and resented you. The first thing you must develop your heart for is to save those who oppose you, that is, your unjust family. If you can save the wronged family, naturally your six relatives will be saved, your afflictions will be less, there will be no resentment, and there will be no hatred. That person harms you, uses his mind to harm you, you use compassion to treat that person.

I tell a story: When we were in New York, there was a Malay girl, among her colleagues at the post office, there was a white girl who was always trying to make things difficult for her. The two of them sat at the same desk. She came to repent at my place, extremely angry, planning to quit and not do that job anymore, but thought again: It's very difficult to get a job at the post office. Having entered the post office, labor insurance and benefits are especially good, I want to use forbidden spells to curse that white woman, making her miserable. I said: "Don't curse her. The curse will get worse. Please pray on her behalf and pray for her to change her mind." She said: "That woman has harmed me like that. Do you still bow for her and dedicate it to her?" I replied: "That is the mysterious method in Buddhism, using compassion to treat those who harm you. In the past, you must have had a predestined relationship with her. Otherwise, there would not be a reunion. Just try it." The first time she said it, she didn't do it. After saying it two or three times [she still refused], I thought of a way. I said: "You go buy coffee, buy another cup. Lunch is all about drinking coffee and eating bread. You buy an extra portion for her. You treat her especially well. The worse she treats you, the better you treat her. You only do this for eight days, ten meals, let's see how it goes?" After that, she followed my suggestion, and the white lady treated her better. In the past, when I needed to stop the car, the white woman specifically stopped the car, forcing her to stop as well, unable to drive into the parking lot. Later, treat her exceptionally well.

It's a small matter, it's also that both sides don't have a big grudge, which means something like that can be changed at once. If you have a big grudge, no matter how kind you are to that person, he or she still has the mentality of not trusting you. Even between mothers and children, sisters-in-law, and brothers, this phenomenon exists. What is the cause? Holding grudges from past lives. Which side ends? That problem cannot be solved! Currently, you use good methods, pray to Buddha or Bodhisattva to bless that person to remove the resentment. Only when we unwind can we attain Bodhi. For the unjust family, you must especially dedicate it to them. Therefore, you must treat everyone equally, no one is good, no one is bad. We, as magicians, should not discriminate against our Dharma friends. Or maybe it's because this Dharma friend has great wisdom. As soon as I said it, he understood immediately, the conversation was very agreeable, and he was especially a little kinder to him. Being very rude to other Dharma friends, always thinking that person is not satisfactory, that is not okay! That is not the beginning of great compassion. The more you are a Dharma friend, the more you must treat them especially well. The more they do not move forward, are not diligent, or are lazy, the more you must be especially compassionate towards them, forgive them, and do not let them relax.

We have a Dharma friend in Mainland who has taken refuge in Buddha for many years. No way! It's okay to not speak. Whenever you open your mouth, you're [criticizing] this or that friend, stirring up gossip, that's called "speaking about the faults of the Three Jewels". To the monks, he told the monks' mistakes. Even Śākyamuni Buddha, Amitābha Buddha, and Medicine Master Buddha were all critical. He has been studying Buddhism for many years, his discriminatory mind is too heavy! We must consider each Dharma friend as Śākyamuni Buddha. The person who uses medicine to save sentient beings and does so is the Medicine Master Buddha, Amitābha Buddha, and Immortal Tathagata. You can say the same. The means to benefit the birth of fifty-three different Buddhas. They attained the same Basic Wisdom, complete Dharma Bodies just like us, but their skillful means are not the same, we must understand! Between friends, we must treat each other in harmony.

(Sutra) Good man! Falling into the realm of the ten Buddha Wheels, the power of the original vows, the Buddha land, the five defilements and evils must necessarily be sentient beings, the damage must necessarily be pure and good dharma, the dharma possess the seven holy treasures, the far away must be intelligent, the one who is far away from the net of riches, is often eager to keep the evil beasts far away, the suffering of future generations cannot be feared, the suffering of ignorance and darkness is often aggravated, the ten evil karmas are created, the Five Infinitesimals are created, and the Dharma is defamed. Destroy the saints and saints, abandon good dharmas, and banish evil dharmas. In the middle of the ego period, one achieves the Buddha's ten-wheeled existence, attains peace and stability, attains no fear, attains no fear, proclaims oneself the position of a great immortal, turns the Buddha wheel, destroys the heavenly demons, heretical teachings, destroys all sentient beings, and is like a diamond solidly afflicted with afflictions.
(Sutra: O good man! I achieved ten Buddha Wheels like that, by the power of my original vow, in In this Buddha world, all sentient beings in the evil life of the five defilements have reduced all good dharmas to be pure, lack all the Seven Noble Wealth treasures, are far away from all intelligent, diligent, and wise people, are covered by the trap of the Perpetual View and Perpetual View, often like to sit in a car on evil destiniess, are not afraid of suffering in the afterlife, are often in the darkness of ignorance and heavy all around, complete with the ten evil karmas, commit the sins of the Five Immaculate Continents, slander the Dharma, and disparage the sages. Holy, free from all good dharmas and all evil dharmas. I, in that place, have achieved the Buddha's Ten Wheels like that, can live in peace, can not be frightened, can not be afraid, claiming that I belong to the position of a noble great immortal, turning the Buddha wheel, subduing the evil thoughts of demons and pagans, eliminating all afflictions as solid as diamonds of all sentient beings, placing all powerful beings in the irreversible position according to their wishes. three vehicles”).

This last paragraph is to summarize the Ten Wheels of the Buddha. The Buddha told Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, “good man” is the name the Buddha used to call Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. In order to achieve the ten types of Buddha Wheels mentioned above, I also have the power of the original vows. Due to the power of the original vows, I will be born in this evil world of the five defilements, liberating all sentient beings from suffering. As for the good dharmas. Thus, the word “pure” is intended to represent good dharma. “White” is the opposite of dark, “good” is the opposite of “evil”, “pure” is the opposite of “defilement”. Sentient beings in this evil life of the five impurities all practice dark dharmas, all are contaminated dharmas, all are impure dharmas, lacking of The Seven Noble Treasures. The Seven Noble Treasures [of Luan King] mentioned in the above section are: Faith, Precepts, Virtue, Dharma (listening to Dharma), Giving, Wisdom, those seven treasures are absent and lacking for all wise and wise people who have left this evil world. Stupid and impure people are all sentient beings' evil karma.

“ Doan Thuong la hammock” (The grid of Doan Kien and Thuong Kien): Doan is Duan Kien, Thuong is Thuong Kien, all of which do not believe in cause and effect, do not believe in good and evil retribution. If there is no bias in Paragraph, it will be biased towards Constant. Or think that the dead are destroyed. Perpetual View is like this: Seeing all dharmas as always being like that [for example, when a person dies, he will be reincarnated as a human, and an animal will be reborn as an animal]. [Those views] obscure your own wise mind, obscure your clear mind. What do they like? Abiding in the evil destinies, [that is the meaning of the sentence] "often eager to take refuge in distant evil beasts", often doing evil karma, very little good karma. “The evil beast is far away” means entering the evil destinies. “Evil Beast” is purely about the three evil destiniess. Because they don't believe in cause and effect, they don't believe in enjoying happiness or suffering in the future. They have the thought of Ending the View, do not believe in future suffering, so they do not have fear. If you arise in fear of future suffering, [realize] that if you do evil, do something that harms others, or harms others or benefits you, you will definitely suffer evil consequences. If that fear arises, that person will not do it. Hearing that "harming others will ultimately harm yourself", people [entangled in the Doan Kien or Permanent View] will not believe those words, of course they must achieve immediate peace and happiness first, let alone the consequences. Therefore, that person is not frightened or afraid of suffering in the next life. What that person focuses on and does is completely black karma. Due to the darkness of ignorance, that person creates the Ten Evil Karmas. The ten negative karmas are killing, stealing, lust, greed, anger, ignorance, lying, embellishing words, double-talk, and harsh words. These are all evil karma, also ten evil karma. “The Five Uninterrupted Crimes”: The Five Uninterrupted Crimes are killing one's father, killing one's mother, causing the Buddha's body to bleed, disrupting the harmony of the Sangha, and killing an Arhat. If you commit those five types of crimes, you will fall into hell as quickly as an arrow. Destroy the Dharma and practice evil views. The Buddha's teachings are all true Dharma, they slander and do not believe; because he did not believe, he blasphemed him. That is, they slander the saints, destroy the Three Jewels, and slander the Three Jewels.

Canceling the Dharma preached by the Buddha, defaming and defaming the sages and monks; That is also defamation, the meaning is the same. Away from good dharmas [is the meaning of the sentence] “away from good dharmas”. They commit all evil deeds, that is "the master of evil deeds". This is a way of saying that the sentient beings in this life are evil and have the five defilements. Their body, mouth, and mind are all doing that, what they have done is all evil karma. There is no good dharma, because it has been “damaged”. “Loss” is loss, or reduction, not complete destruction. Therefore, sentient beings in the world of evil and five defilements are all driving cars down evil destiniess, not driving cars down good paths. “Excessive evil beasts far away” is practicing the Ten Evil Karmas, which will result in suffering in the next life. No matter the time or place, or all the things done, they are in dark ignorance. They say “dark ignorance” because they have no wisdom. Therefore, they complete the “evil beast” carriage. Even more serious than the Ten Evils is committing the crime of Five Immaculate Confessions, slandering the Dharma, and slandering the sages and saints. During the five evil worlds, the reason we can live peacefully is because we rely on the ten Buddha Wheels as mentioned above.

“I have achieved complete loyalty like the ten-circle Buddha, attaining peace and stability, attaining no fear, attaining fearlessness, calling myself a great immortal, turning the wheel of Buddha, subduing the demons and evil heretics” (I am in there, by achieving the Buddha's ten circles like that, I can abide in peace, be able to not to be frightened, to be fearless, to claim that I belong to the position of a noble great immortal, to turn the Buddha Wheel, to subdue the evil opinions of the demons and pagans): That type of sentient being has afflictions as solid as diamond, very difficult to change. Is it very difficult to change each of our afflictions? Very difficult to change! Afflictions include so many! Because we do not have wisdom, we cannot see all things clearly. Ego Attachment and Ego View are always very deep. Whenever there's something that doesn't please you, troubles arise. There are many things like that, some light, some serious. If you want to eliminate this type of affliction, it is very difficult!

Therefore, the Buddha said: To save sentient beings in the Sa Ba world, the Sa Ba world is stubborn, difficult to tame, very difficult to save. Their afflictions are as solid as diamonds. In that situation, the Buddha still liked them. This Sa Ba world still has good beings, not all of them are [corrupt, stubborn] like that, there are still wise people, either hoping to escape the three worlds, hoping to attain the state of the three vehicles. Thus, according to what they believe and like, the Buddha will establish all sentient beings, preach the Dharma to them, causing them to abide in the Non-Returning position in the three vehicles, that is, Shravaka, Pratyekabuddha, Bodhisattva, no longer regressing into the six paths, no longer rotating in the six paths. The status does not change, according to the six paths, that is, it does not retreat to become an ordinary person!

(Sutra) At the time of the ear, gather together all Bodhisattvas, Mahasattvas, all Shravakas, all heavens and dragons, The vast majority of grandmothers are bound to be Yet Tra Bo Dat Na, people and non-humans alike, with great joy, singing "good ear" in unison, dances of fragrance and dance, dances of flowers, dances of treasures, dances of yyu, and the earth is bound to be shaken. The text says that the ten Buddha Wheels, when the assembly gathers, the eighty-four hundred na-du-da Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat, attain the Infinite Dharma of Forbearance. Resurrection of countless Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas, to attain the seed of dharani samadhi forbearance. Resurrection of immeasurable existence, countless sentient beings, the initial state of Supreme Perfect Enlightenment, attains irreversible. Resurrect immeasurable beings, countless sentient beings, to attain enlightenment.
(Sutra: At that time, in the assembly, all the Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas, all All the Sravakas, all the heavens, all the dragons, and in general, even all the Bodhisattvas, human beings, non-humans, etc., rejoiced greatly, chanting "How good" in unison, raining great incense, raining flowers, raining all kinds of treasures, pouring rain of clothes, all the great earth was shaken. In the assembly, there were eighty-four hundred thousand natu-da Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas who attained Wushu. There are countless Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas who have achieved all kinds of dharani and samādhi. There are also countless and countless sentient beings who have first attained Supreme Enlightenment and have attained the fruit of non-regression.

The Buddha preached the Dharma, from heaven, dragons to Gandharva, Asura, to non-human beings, etc., due to hearing the Buddha preach about the Buddha Wheel, they were all extremely happy. Those attending that meeting were the four disciples, including Bodhisattvas, Shravakas, and Pratyekabuddhas. Because they heard the Buddha preach the Dharma, they were all happy. “Singing together is good” (Singing together “how good”) is also praise. At the same time, in the assembly, a rain of incense is poured down, “vu dai hoa vu” means using all kinds of incense, flowers, and treasures to make offerings. The number [is so great that] we have to use the word Vu to describe it, like the sky sending down a sweet rain. At that time, all six great earths shook. The earth was shaken, meaning that when the Buddha preached the Dharma, the earth shook. It is said that there are ten such Buddha Wheels. Hearing that Buddha Wheel, those who heard the Dharma in the assembly, there were eighty-four hundred thousand na-du-da Bodhisattva Ma-Ha-sattva. “Na-du-da” is a million, “Cau-sà-la” is Uc, also a million millions. In that assembly, how many great Bodhisattvas attained Non-Birth Dharma Forbearance? As many as eighty-four hundred thousand million such Bodhisattvas have attained the Dharma of Non-Birth Forbearance.

“There are countless Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas who have attained the seed of dharani samadhis” (There are also countless Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas who have attained the types of dharanis and mahasattvas), attaining immeasurable samadhi. “Da-la-ni” is the total maintenance, total maintenance of all dharmas.

“There are immeasurable, countless sentient beings, who have initially developed the mind of Supreme Enlightenment, attaining the mind of no regression” (Again, there are countless sentient beings who have initially attained the mind of Supreme Perfect Enlightenment, who have attained the mind of no regression): There are sentient beings in that assembly who develop the mind of Bodhisattva, achieving the state of non-regression. Non-regression refers to faith. Once you have faith, then develop your mind. Once you have developed your mind, your faith will not retreat. There are also countless sentient beings who have attained enlightenment. The fruit they have witnessed is First Fruit, Second Fruit, Third Fruit, Four Fruit, or Pratyekabuddha. This is to say that when the Buddha preached the Ten Wheels, there were many Bodhisattvas, there were many such sentient beings who either developed their minds, or attained fruition, some attained the status of No Birth Dharma Forbearance. This is the part of the text that talks about the benefits after listening to a sermon. The second book, the Ten Wheels chapter, has been preached.

The afflictions of living beings in the five evil life are as hard as diamonds, everyone can understand. However, killing the Buddha or causing the Buddha's body to bleed is impossible, but destroying a statue drawn on paper, or a statue made of clay or carved wood, will be a corresponding crime. Breaking the dharma, that is, [destroying] the Noble Dharma, defaming the Sangha, inciting discord among the Sangha, disrupting the harmony of the Sangha, hitting both ends, stirring up gossip and gossip, this is a very serious crime. This is not to say that the person used his verbal karma to stir up controversy, but rather because he broke the harmony with the Sangha, it became a crime of rebellion. At present, I'm afraid that situation is not uncommon. Many sentient beings create this karma, but in the past, very few heard of the phenomenon of killing one's father or mother. Currently, there are not many cases of this type of crime. Why? Heavy karma! The blessings of sentient beings become lighter and lighter, even non-existent. Therefore, this phenomenon appears in society. Buddha said: “Buddhism is in the world, it does not leave the world”.
