They take care of cleaning, cleaning, or liberating captive animals (life release). Like the many forest gardens of Co Son, the fruit trees on the mountain have tens of thousands of tangerine roots, there must be someone to pick them, someone to take care of them, those people are all called “pure people”. Cooking in the temple, doing all sorts of different jobs, are all pure people. Bhikkhus cannot do it! Whatever a monk does, it will be a violation of the precepts. That was back then, now everyone has to do it themselves. When Buddhism was spread to China, it was all self-cultivated and self-eating. The monk grows his own food, cooks his own food, and takes care of his own life. That depends on the country's legal regime. Anyone who robs the Sangha of things will have to receive retribution, they will definitely receive retribution!

In temples, there are many things, or species of living beings, that are owned by the temple. Or the clothes and food of the temple, or the bed, the throne, the bedding, or the medicines, other items needed for life that belong to the temple, and the offerings given to the monks of the four directions like that, are things that should be reserved for those who are fully virtuous, diligently practice, learn the conduct of both Learned and Unlearned, up to the pure Buddhas who have attained the ultimate fruition. The above items, down to animals and plants: Plants in gardens, forests, animals in temples; There are temples and pagodas and donkeys and horses, because they have manors. In the manor, there must be donkeys, horses, and cows, all of which belong to temples and pagodas. There are also animals that people release. In the mountains, the vast majority are mountains, they release them on the mountains. That mountain area belongs to the temple, and everything belongs to the monk. Whether people or things, belong to the ownership and enjoyment of virtuous people, diligently practicing, belonging to the status of Learned and Uneducated. Being Learned means not yet attaining the Four Fruits, Uneducated is the position of having attained the Four Fruits. When you reach the status of Uneducated, you will attain extreme results. That is the proper enjoyment of a pure monk.

Only monks,Brahmins of the Shengdāra level, due to powerful forces, invade the pure precepts of the Buddha, do not listen to them, return to evil and break the precepts, commit evil deeds, do business at home for lay karma practitioners, spiritual community users, or single users. Breaking the precepts, the up-sūṣa is a good way to enjoy, or to enjoy together, or to enjoy alone, or to use the worldly cause, to enjoy together. Due to the predestined relationship, the spirit protecting the country is necessarily heavenly, dragon, Yoc Xa god-class, and those who believe in the Three Jewels without moving and destroying, the Kshat-de-loi Chien-tà-la king, the nun-chi-mon,Brahmin-class Chien-tà-la, the mind gives rise to anger and anger. destined to be born in the Infinite Hell.
(Sutra: That King Sat-de-loi Chien-do-la until those The flocks of monks, brahmins, etc., due to strong forces, invaded and robbed them of all the pure virtues, not allowing them to enjoy them, and gave them to those who broke the precepts, those who do business in the worldly affairs of lay people, to enjoy together, or to enjoy alone, or with worldly people, because of that cause and effect, causing all the gods, dragons, Yak Xoa gods, etc. to protect the country In the end, those who believe in the Three Jewels are not corrupted, not shaken, and have anger and anger towards King Sat-de-loi Chien-tala to the Cham-dila in the world of monks, Brahmins, etc. Broadly speaking, up to King Sat-de-loi Chien-tala, and officials, lay people, wealthy people, monks, Brahmins... of that type of Chien-dala, will soon suffer four limbs. crippled, lacking, for many days and nights, unable to speak, suffering from poisons, extreme pain that is difficult to bear

A monk is a monk who breaks the precepts. If everyone has seen Photo Tran Hoi Uc Luc, they will know: Old shaman Dam Hu took over Phap Nguyen Pagoda, but was sued by evil monks. They want to usurp the treasures of Phap Nguyen Pagoda. Therefore, the pure Bhikkhu and the evil Bhikkhu must go to court. At that time, the Northeast warlord was still occupying the Northeast, Duong Lang Cac[79] took refuge in the old magician Dam Hu. Even though he had power, old magician Dam Hu did not do so. After that, he still handed over that temple to those monks. What will those evil monks be like? Those who have these things will enjoy it together with other evil monks, or enjoy it alone, or enjoy it together with worldly people, pure people, and lay people, or enjoy it together with the evil people of the Lambala. Because of that fate, he angered the guardian god. The gods, dragons, Yoc Xoa gods, etc., who protect that country, are those who believe in the Three Jewels and do not waver, immediately giving rise to anger.

As for “u Kshat-de-li Chien-tà-la king, the monk, Brahman-level Chon-dà-la, the mind gives rise to anger and anger.Qthe preaching of the mind even to the point of Sat-de-li The King of the Lamb, the minister, the layman, the rich man, the recluse, the Brahman of the rank of the Lord of the Lamb, is inconvenient and has a defective body" (creating anger and anger towards King Sat-de-li of the Lamb to those monks and Brahmins of the Lamb-dala. Broadly speaking, all the way to King Sat-de-li of the Lamb and the officials, laymen, and chiefs. Those fake monks, monks, Brahmins, will soon have crippled and missing limbs.) It is not that the Buddha cursed them. He saw the cause and effect of retribution, saw that they were bound to suffer that extreme suffering. Otherwise, you will say "Buddha also cursed others". This is like when reading the Universal Gate chapter, [seeing in the sutra that] someone uses poison to poison another person, [because the person who is harmed has the heart to recite the name of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva], it turns out that [the person who harmed others] will have to suffer, they themselves have to bear [the consequences], someone asked me: "Great Compassion Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva is not compassionate." I asked: "Why?" That person replied: "Pham Pho Mon says that when using poison to harm another person, Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva will make that person drink poison, causing harm to that person." I said: "That is not the intention of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva. You have misunderstood the meaning of the sutra. That is the person's own retribution."

Just like here the Buddha said "soon, all limbs will be disabled and lacking"; That is the Buddha seeing that that person must receive that retribution. Until "after many days and nights, ending the mouth without speaking, experiencing all the sufferings and poisons, painful and difficult to endure. At the end of life, one is destined to be born in the Uninterrupted Hell" (for many days and nights, tongue-tied, unable to speak, suffering poisons, extreme pain that is hard to bear. At the end of life, one is certain to be born in the Unintermittent Hell): As long as one is alive, one will suffer a little, still comfortable, still much better than the Uninterrupted Hell. If you die, you will definitely fall into the Unending Hell. We must understand this principle correctly! Otherwise, it would be said that "Buddha cursed those people to fall into the Avīci Hell (Relentless Hell)", which is not the meaning at all! The Buddha saw their retribution, but could not save them. They committed that crime, Buddha cannot save them!

Therefore, in the end, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva vowed to save them. Saying so much is to show the great compassion of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. This is the Ten Wheels of Kṣitigarbha Sūtra that specifically displays the great vow of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva goes there to save those people.

(Sutra) Phuc, good man! In the future, in the future, in the middle of the Buddha's salvation, there are Kshatriya kings, officials, lay people, wealthy people, monks, Brahmins of the Chongdala level, people, according to evil actions, good roots are minimal. He is a monk who is a monk, well-versed, well-versed, and even perfect in his speech, or can communicate with the Shravaka Vehicle, or can communicate with the Single Enlightenment Vehicle, or can communicate with the Supreme Vehicle, spreading the word widely and benefiting sentient beings. It's like talking about a magician, insulting, humiliating, slandering, being contemptuous, annoying, forcing, confusing the magician, obstructing the Dharma.
(Sutra: Come here, good man! In the future life, where In this Buddha land, there is King Kshat-de-loi Chien-dala, officials, laymen, wealthy people, monks, Brahmins, etc. who are Cham-dila who follow evil friends, have few good roots. NBroadly speaking, until they don't see, don't fear the consequences of suffering in the next life, see people who follow my dharma, become monks, well-versed, multi-literate, and speak extremely well. perfect, or can teach and communicate the dharma of the Shravaka Vehicle, or can teach and communicate the dharma of the Single Enlightenment Vehicle, or can teach and communicate the dharma of the Supreme Vehicle, causing [those dharmas] to be widely spread, benefiting sentient beings like that. They reprimand, curse, humiliate, slander, despise, ridicule, deceive, oppress, confuse the magician, and obstruct the dharma.
.

The evil wheel in the previous part is to deprive the Sangha of their belongings, while the evil wheel in this part is that this evil person colludes with another evil person, that is, he colludes with evil people, without fear of suffering in the next life. Seeing people who rely on Buddhism to become a monk, "well-versed, well-educated".

“Dwisdom” means “understand clearly, have wisdom”. “Multi-literacy” means listening to a lot of Buddha Dharma, expanding wisdom. “Perfect Speech”, “perfection” is that person who preaches the Dharma, explains the Dharma spoken by the Buddha, makes the Dharma exist in the world, brings benefits to mankind, or is able to convey and communicate the Shravaka Vehicle Dharma. Next is [to explain in more detail] the meaning of the word “perfect speech”: Either one can convey the dharma of the Single Enlightened Vehicle, or one can convey the dharma of the Supreme Vehicle, that is, the Mahayana dharma, causing the three vehicle dharma to be widely spread, benefiting sentient beings.

“Belgium is like preaching to a Dharma master, insulting, humiliating, defaming, scorning, harassing, oppressing, confusing the magician, obstructing the Dharma” (They then reprimanded, cursed, humiliated, slandered, despised, ridiculed, deceived, oppressed, and deranged the Dharma teacher." shaman, obstructing the Dharma): Do not allow him to preach the Dharma, his mind will be disturbed.

(Sutra) Because of predestined fate, the spirit protects the country, necessarily the heavens, dragons, Duoc Xoa gods, and faith in the Three Jewels. The saboteur, the Kshat-de-li Chien-dala king, the monk, the Brahman-level Chom-dala person, has anger and anger in his mind. Brahmins of the Shengthāra level, who are not nine-to-none, have a defective body, are unable to speak, are unable to speak, are subjected to all kinds of suffering and poisons, are painfully arduous, and are destined to be reborn in the Uninterrupted Hell.
(Sutra: Because of that cause, all the heavens, dragons, Duoc Xoa, etc. The people of the country who believe in the Three Jewels are unmoved and have anger and indignation towards King Sat-de-loi Chien-tala to the Cham-t-la people in the world of Samanas, Brahmins, etc. Broadly speaking, up to King Sat-de-loi Chien-tala and the officials, lay people, wealthy people, monks, Brahmins... these are the Cham-dila guys who will soon have crippled limbs. lacking, for many days and nights he was speechless, suffered from extreme poisons and pain that was difficult to endure, and was certain to be born in the Hell of No Intermittent.

Due to this cause and effect, all the gods, dragons, Yak-Xa gods, etc. who are the protectors of this country, the protectors of the people in the country, who are believers in the Three Jewels, [faith] cannot be corrupted, will have anger and indignation towards King Sat-de-loi Chien-tà-la, to those who Chom-dala in the world of monks, Brahmins, etc. Broadly speaking, there will be resentment towards the Kshat-de-li-Ghen-dala, officials, lay people, wealthy people, monks, Brahmins, etc. who are Chom-dala guys. Due to resentment, the Kshat-de-loi Chien-dala kings [as well as their Chien-dà-la officials, wealthy people, etc.] soon had their limbs crippled and lacking. “Details of disability” are limbs that are crippled or incomplete, or people who have had a car accident, or fallen from a mountain, or fallen into the water while traveling, are all manifestations of incomplete limbs. Nowadays, this thing has also changed! One time, I worshiped Wutai Mountain. Where the road running from the riverside to the pagoda is so long, both sides of the road are full of beggars, of all shapes and sizes. When you see it, you will be afraid. Or only half a face remains, or one eye. Disabilities are also different, the left arm is hooked, the right thigh is dangling, all kinds of strange shapes, you can't imagine. Nowadays, there are no more, does that mean there are no evildoers anymore? No! In the past, it could be said that the Bodhisattva appeared so that when you came to that place, you would know how to repent by seeing that appearance. Currently, because that place has become a place of commerce, those people are no longer there, no longer seen!

Due to that cause, that country is no longer secure, the guardian gods no longer protect it. Strange things arose in that country, the armies of our own country and the armies of other countries fought with each other, disasters and epidemics raged, and the people's hearts were not at peace, until not long after, their limbs were crippled. “Uda day, unable to speak, suffering from painful poisons” (For many days and nights, the tongue was stuck, unable to speak, suffered from painful poisons): It can be said that it is no different from people living a vegetable life in the present, extremely painful, difficult to bear! When you die, you will definitely be born in the Uninterrupted Hell.

(Sutra) Phuc, good man! In the future, in the future, in the middle of the Buddha's salvation, there are Kshatriya kings, officials, lay people, wealthy people, monks, Brahmins of the Chongdala level, people, according to evil actions, good roots are minimal. possessing alms in the four directions: monks, monasteries, estates, people, animals, treasures, flowers, fruit trees, infected trees, warm trees, medicinal trees, and miscellaneous objects. I, my disciples, virtuous, rich in virtue, diligently practice Learning, Unlearning, and with the will to attain the ultimate fruit,pure up-so-satisana to receive and receive. BI Sat-de-loi Chien-tupla king, The monks and brahmins of the Shengdala level, with powerful forces, can either take it from themselves, or take it from teachers, or take it for their own use, or take it for their own sake. Due to the predestined relationship, the spirit protecting the country is necessarily heavenly, dragon, Yoc Xa god-class, those who believe in the Three Jewels without moving and destroy, the Kshat-de-loi Chien-tu-la king, Nichi monk, Brahmin-class Chien-dala, the mind gives rise to anger and anger. Preaching and expounding on the Kshatriya kings, officials, lay people, wealthy people, monks, Brahmins of the Chongdala level, those who are not nine-to-none are physically disabled, are unable to speak, are unable to speak, are subjected to all kinds of suffering and pain, suffer hardship, and are destined to be reborn in the Uninterrupted Hell.
(Sutra: Come here, good man! In the future life, in In that Buddha world, there is King Kshatriya Chien-tala and ministers, laymen, wealthy people, monks, Brahmins, etc. who are Cham-dila who follow evil friends, with few good roots. Nbroadly speaking, until they do not see, do not fear the consequences of suffering in the next life, they see that there are gifts given to the Sangha of the four directions, such as rooms in temples, decorations. Farms, fields, people, animals, wealth, flowering trees, fruit trees, trees with resin used to make dyes, shade trees, trees for making spices, etc. and other things needed for life. My disciples are pure and virtuous, diligently practicing the practices of Learning and Non-Learning, until they attain the ultimate fruition, they should enjoy [those things]. That Lamb as well as the monks, Brahmins, etc., who rely on strong forces, either force themselves, usurp, or teach others to appropriate for their own use, or for others to use. Due to that cause, all the gods, dragons, Gods of Yak Xoa, etc., who protect the kingdom, believe in the Three Jewels without being damaged, have anger and resentment towards King Sat-de-loi. Lambu-la to the monks, Brahmans Lamb-dala. Broadly speaking, up to King Sat-de-loi Chien-dala, ministers, laymen, wealthy people, monks, Brahmins... those Lamb-dala guys will soon have crippled limbs, be speechless for many days and nights, and suffer extreme, unbearable pain and suffering reborn in the Infinite Hell).

This is following evil friends, being instigated and taught by evil people, until there is no fear of suffering in the next life. Seeing things given as alms to the Sangha of the four directions, such as rooms in temples, farms, fields, property of people and animals, flowering trees, fruit trees, dye trees, shady trees, aromatic trees, etc. “Impacted” (dye tree) bears fruit containing dye. This tree has two uses: The fruit it produces can dye clothes, or be used to dye [other materials]. These things are all repetitions, the middle part changes a little, [that is] the things, the scenes, change a little. The scriptures before and after are identical. These are evil people who together deprive the Sangha of their belongings.

(Sutra) Phuc, good man! In the future, in the midst of the Buddha's salvation, there will be a Kshatriya king, an official, a lay person, a rich man, a recluse, a Brahmin of the Chongdala level, a person with very few good roots, no faith in his mind, a delusion, a fool, arrogance of intelligence, an untruthful speech, far removed from good and evil, and subject to evil. Obeying all the holy dharmas, the mind is hesitant, has no opinion, does not fear the sufferings of the future, often ridicules the evil rules and doubts, is eager to kill living beings, has even wrong views, is arrogant, and cares about the world, claiming to be self-centered and skeptical in the law. Bi-sad-de-loi Chien-tupla king, mother-chi monk, Brahman-class Chom-dala, species of means, destroy the ego, slander the ego of the dharma child, bring down anger, insult, destroy, disgrace, torture, ban, banish the details, and even destroy one's life. Falling into preaching the Dharma, not being able to believe in life, destroying Tot-dump-ba, visiting the temples, forcing the Buddha, withdrawing from the spirit, returning to the world, obstacles arise, being subdued by ca-sa, the race of the region, and the servants. Due to the predestined relationship, the spirit protecting the country is necessarily heavenly, dragon, and Duoc Xoa god-class, who believes in the Three Jewels, and does not move or destroy.
(Sutra: Come here, good man! In the future life, where In this Buddha world, there is King Sat-de-li Chien-t-la, officials, lay people, wealthy people, monks, Brahmins, etc., who have few good roots, have no faith, are ignorant, are arrogant, are not intelligent, are not truthful in their words, stay away from good friends, follow evil friends, hold on to hesitation, do not see, do not fear the consequences of the next life, often prefer to be close to the real Demonstrating evil precepts, loving to kill, even holding false views, deceiving the world, claiming "I am one who abides in precepts." King Sat-de-loi Chien-dala and the Lamb-dala group of monks and Brahmins used all kinds of means to destroy my dharma and become monks, many times they were angry, scolded, cursed, beaten, imprisoned, and cut off their feet. Regarding the Dharma I preached, they refused to believe and accept it, destroyed the stupa and the rooms in the temple, chased and oppressed the monks to return to the world, hindered people from shaving their heads and wearing ka-sa clothes, drove them away in all kinds of ways, making them look like servants. Because of this cause and effect, all gods, dragons, and gods Medicine Xoa etc... are protectors of the country, their faith in the Three Jewels does not fail).

Confesses to be very intelligent, but speaks insincerely. “Untruthful speech”: Not speaking truthfully. Some Buddhist disciples asked: "Master! We do business, don't tell lies, don't tell a little lie, there will be no way to do business!" I said: "When I haven't been to America, I have no way to answer you. After arriving in America, I saw merchants in America, in supermarkets, no one talked to you. You don't need to ask for the price, they all clearly state it. If you want to buy it, take it. There's no bargaining, if you want to buy it, you buy it." They said: "If you sell wholesale, you have to pay the price." I said: "The person selling that item is a wholesaler. He went there to estimate a shipment. They also haggled and bargained." I said: "That doesn't mean you can't lie! Just tell the truth, you don't have to lie to make money!" That is to create trust for them, not to discount. As for the present, what we hear, whether from traders to non-traders, how many true sentences can they say?

Master shouldn't lie, right? Here, there are evil monks, and there are also Chien-dala monks who do not speak the truth, lie, and embellish words, which are very difficult to stop! Why? Because they "separate themselves from good friends, act according to evil, follow the holy dharmas, their mind is always hesitant" (stay away from good friends, follow evil friends, embrace hesitation towards the holy dharmas). They doubted the Buddha's teachings, asking: "Are the Buddha's words true?" There is another type of saying: "The Buddha spoke more than two thousand years ago, but now it is no longer useful! What era is it now? Do you still keep mentioning words from more than two thousand years ago?" I said: "Buddha spoke of greed, anger, and ignorance. He taught that lying is deceit. So in this era, no matter what country people belong to, if you swindle money or cheat, is it a crime or not? Is cheating a crime or not? Still impossible! Can you say false words or not? Don't lie! You should still promote honesty. Killing, stealing, and sexual misconduct, there's no need to talk about it anymore! Killing, stealing, and lusting, in any era, No matter what dynasty or country, no matter how it is modified, killing, stealing, and sexual misconduct are still crimes!”

“According to evil, follow evil” (Following evil friends): That person does not have a good heart, his mind turns into evil, does not believe in the Buddha's teachings. “The heart is always hesitant” (Hold in hesitation): Not very confident! There are many friends who have doubts about this issue. Whenever one has such an idea, while practicing, that person is often skeptical and cannot believe sincerely. So if you practice, hoping to attain sainthood and end afflictions, it is all very difficult. Even though you have sown good roots, you still don't know how many years, how many lives, it will take you to gradually train them! If your heart is sincere, you will take advantage of it and will be able to attain salvation very quickly. It cannot be said to be "immediately attaining results", but over two or three lifetimes, you will gradually be able to enter, be able to enter the door.

Currently, we are all outside Buddhism, seeming to believe in Buddhism, in fact, we have not entered Buddhism! What is the cause? “The mind is always hesitant” (Hold on indecisiveness). This is like drinking water, whether it's hot or cold, you know for yourself. However, the Buddha said so, we then believe in the Buddha's words, but still do not see or fear the consequences of suffering in the next life, because if we do not see, we will not be afraid. Many people were scared when they saw it. When you see it, you're afraid, but it's already too late, there's no time left. If you regret it, it's too late! Don't worry or doubt. Can you distinguish who is an evil friend and who is a good friend? I don't even know this anymore! In general, it is necessary to know good and evil, it is necessary to know good people and evil people. But there are people who pretend to be good on the outside but are very evil in their hearts. It's not easy for you to know! If you recite a lot, pray to Buddha or Bodhisattva for a lot, use the Contemplation Wheel to ask: "I am close to this master, does he have holy conduct in his heart? Is he really a good master or not?" You will be able to know. The Contemplation Sutra teaches like that, don't say it was the shaman Mong Tham who said it. If I say that, everyone will curse me! In the Upper volume of the Contemplation of Good and Evil Karma Sutra, it is said very clearly: If you want to be close to that person, or be friends with that person, and consider him or her to be a good friend, you must consider whether he or she is a good friend or not? The requirements of good knowledge are very high!

What conditions must be fulfilled to be considered good knowledge? We are not very demanding. This is the end of the Dharma, there is no way, just be a little better! First, you should plant the Contemplation Wheel, if [Contemplation Sat Wheel] teaches: "You should not be close to that person. That person has no real virtue internally. [What] that person shows at the present time is all a false appearance." Or "you can get close to that person and you will be able to gain benefits". The Contemplation Sutra says it very clearly; Once you observe it, you will know immediately!

“Often mocks and practices close to evil rules of doubt” (Often likes to practice and stay close to evil rules of doubt): Evil rules of doubt are rules of doubt that are not prescribed by the Buddha. Regarding the evil law, we give the following example: To make offerings to heaven and gods, one must kill pigs, goats, and even chickens. This is called wrong knowledge, wrong view. Loving the killing of living beings is wrong knowledge, wrong views, "If you are arrogant, clingy to the world, you call yourself a follower of the law of doubt" (But embracing arrogance, deceit, bewitching the world, calling yourself "I am one who abides in the law of doubt"): Also calling yourself a person who maintains the precepts!

“King Kshat-de-li-King-dala, the monk, Brahman-level Chom-dala, race of means, destroying the ego” (King Kshat-de-li-Cham-d-la to the monks-Gm-d-la, Brahmins, etc. use all kinds of means to destroy my Dharma): They think of all kinds of means, always hoping to destroy Buddha Dharma. They even said that they also studied the Medicine Master's Dharma, also preached the Medicine Master Sutra, and also bowed to Medicine Master Sam. In general, it is always mixed with wrong knowledge and wrong views. They mixed Taoism, even evil religions, witchcraft (sorcery, magic) into the mix. Gradually, living beings cannot distinguish between what is real, what is fake, what is Buddhism, what is Taoism. That's called “destruction”.

“If you take refuge in the dharma child and become a monk, you will be filled with anger and anger, you will be insulted and humiliated, you will be tortured, you will be banned, you will be banished in detail, and you will end your life.” (For those who took refuge in my Dharma and became a monk, many times they were angry, scolded, cursed, humiliated, beaten, imprisoned, cut off their limbs, until they died. life): As for the dharma I had spoken, they refused to believe and accept it. “Destroying Tot-dump-ba” (Destroying the tower) is also destroying pagodas and temples. "Introduction to the temples" (And the rooms in the temple): "The temple" here specializes in talking about the tower, while "The temple" in the following section is about the temples and shrines. This is the translation. The Sanskrit language in the Buddhist scriptures does not call [temples and temples] Tu, but is translated by us. A Lan Nha or Sangha-lam, the reason translated into Tu is because China uses the word Tu to visualize. "Forcing them to return to the world"

“Obstacles like this arise, being obeyed by ca-sa” (Obstacle of people who shave their hair and wear ca-sa): Do not allow you to become a monk, use all kinds of ways to chase away, command, “subservient servants” (like servants): Command people to become monks, use monks, treat them as servants. These are all true.

(Sutra) U Sat-de-loi Chien-tu-la king, Nai Chi monk, Brahmans of the Chongdala level, their minds give rise to anger and anger. Qtold the story of the Sat-de-li of the Chon-dala kings, ministers, lay people, wealthy people, monks, Brahmins of the Sheep-dala people, no nine inconvenient as the body is disabled, Uda-day If you die, you will not speak, you will experience all kinds of suffering and poisons, you will suffer pain and suffering, and you will end up in the Unintermittent Hell.
The monks, Brahmans, etc. of the Lambdala. Broadly speaking, up to the Kshatriya kings of the Lambdala, ministers, lay people, wealthy monks, monks, Brahmins, etc. of that type of Lambdala, soon their limbs became disabled and lacking, for many days and nights they were tongue-tied, unable to speak, suffered extreme and unbearable suffering, and were destined to be reborn in hell. Vo Gian prison).

Those people will never hear these words. Even if I hear it, I still don't believe it. Can they hear the Mahabodhi Sutra of the Ten Wheels? They are not heard! In the past when teaching the Mahayana Dharma, saying these words seemed to be afraid of offending others. At that time, if you offended the kings, offended the great ministers, including monks, Brahmins, and those who believed in the Buddha Dharma, all of you should examine yourself, is it such a thing or not? This sutra is explained very little, we just follow the sutra.

(Sutra) Good man! The weak Kshatriya-kings of the Lambdala kings, officials, lay people, wealthy people, monks, Brahmins of the Chomdala level, have the theory of the ten evil realms, either one achieves one, or one achieves it, the first practice must be good, the bad roots are destroyed, the level of decay is extinguished, there is no such thing as a defective body, the sun is broken, the tongue is closed, the tongue is speechless, the suffering and poisons are endured, painful and difficult to endure, the life is final. born in the Hell of No Cockroaches. Try the Kshatriya-king of the Lambdala king, the official, the layman, the rich man, the monk, the Brahmin of the Chomdala level, if in the future, with a lowly person, it is difficult to attain, not to mention the ability to attain the Second Vehicle of Bodhi! Supreme Mahayana, extremely wonderful. Like evil people, Mahayana's name is difficult to attain, not to mention the ability to attain Supreme Buddhahood! A visionary saves himself and others, even the Buddhas cannot save him!
(Sutra: Good man! If King Sat-de-loi Chien-t-la, and the others Devotees in the world of officials, lay people, wealthy people, monks, Brahmins... regarding the ten evil wheels mentioned above, if they accomplish any one wheel, or complete it, all the good roots that have been cultivated before will be destroyed, burned, and will all turn into ashes. This passage and the previous passage are similar, one is good, the other is evil. In the Great Collection of Ten Wheels of Kṣitigarbha Sūtra, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva requested and preached the Dharma, taking Him as the main essence, so it is called Ksitigarbha Ten Wheels of Kṣitigarbha Sūtra. From here on, in the previous section, we talked about Ten Unwholesome Deeds so much. If we say the opposite, [that is] not doing those evil things until we stay away from those evil things, how much merit and virtue will they have? Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva asked like that. Comparing the text in this section with the previous section, a little explanation is needed.

What is “Truth and goodness”? True goodness is liberation, truly achieving liberation, if you practice, you will be able to attain Nirvana, that is the meaning of “true goodness”. Truly practicing, truly liberated, until steadfast faith, the Kshatriyas, officials, Brahmins, lay people, wealthy people, and monks, these people themselves protect their own thoughts, skillfully protect their thoughts. When we read the Pure Hanh chapter, [the main meaning in that sutra] isn't "good use of the mind" (skillful use of the mind)? The meaning is "you can skillfully use your mind to not only protect the present life, but also protect the next life!"

Next are the Three Jewels, protecting the Buddha, protecting the Dharma, and protecting the Sangha. In protecting monks, there are those who are good and maintain pure precepts, while others are not dharma weapons, but also break the precepts. In the previous section, it was said that a Bhikkhu breaks the precepts, even those who do not have any precepts, as long as that person shaves off their beard and hair, puts on the ka-sa robe, from Kshatriya to Brahmin all respectfully protect and listen to them towards them, [ie] the Sravakayana dharma, the Pratyekabuddha dharma, and the Mahayana dharma, that is, the three vehicle dharma, respectfully listen and accept. Once you believe, you can receive, and after receiving, you can practice. Not only believe, but also do. Offering is almsgiving. For those who have fulfilled all the precepts, are pure, virtuous, and practice diligently, until Bo Dat Gia La has attained the fruition, which is also the First Fruition, Second Fruition, Third Fruition, and Fourth Fruition; That is completely speaking according to the Hinayana dharma, that person can skillfully protect and help them practice, meaning “to protect the dharma” for them. He also turned to them and asked questions about the Buddha's teachings, happily discussed them, and stayed away from monks who broke the precepts and did evil deeds. That's from a good perspective. As for those who break the precepts, they will not be infected by the Bhikkhu who breaks the precepts. As for the things offered by the four directions in the Sangha Lam, which are also the things of the Sangha, that person neither illegally appropriates nor illegally appropriates, but also helps protect them.

Then the offerings to the Sangha of the four directions up to the stupa, as well as the belongings of the Sangha, are offerings to the masses in the Lam Sangha, "generally not self-appropriated" (not self-appropriated at all), that is, the Kshatriya kings and powerful mandarins do not rob themselves, do not take it for their own possession, and do not take it for themselves. to use for oneself, without allowing others to take it away, nor to allow others to use it. As long as one can speak the Three Vehicles Dharma, they will all support, respectfully make offerings, and help that person practice more diligently. In the previous paragraph, it was said that if you practice there, there are evil Bhikkhus who destroy the peaceful Bhikkhus, as well as evil Brahmins who destroy the peaceful Bhikkhus, they (the king, the great minister) will immediately protect and comfort those monks. Believe, accept and uphold the Dharma spoken by the Buddha. “Do not destroy all good things” (Do not destroy the towers at all), that is, [do not destroy] pagodas, temples or towers at all.

Regarding the Ten Unwholesome Deeds mentioned in the previous section, they themselves are not infected and do not commit evil deeds. They also advised those people to leave the ten evil wheels. For the beings of Bodakāra who have been infected and accumulated the ten evil wheels, the kings who initiated the Kshatriya and Brahman all advised those people to stay away from the ten evil wheels. "Learning how the ancient kings ruled the country with the correct Dharma" (Learned the complete Dharma of the previous kings to rule the country): This is an example, [implying] learning the Dharma Jewels taught by the Buddhas of the past. Only then can the Three Jewels not be destroyed. “Thieu” means “inheritance”. “Thieu Three Jewels” (Continuing the nature of the Three Jewels), often causes Buddhism, Dharma, Sangha and the Three Jewels to flourish, and often wants to be close to good knowledge, compassionately comfort and nurture all people in the country. Thus, “according to the season of doubt” (according to the appropriateness), that is, according to [the nature of] that practitioner to the evil-doing Bhikkhus, correct them. To correct them, they also need to protect, educate, and guide them. They must choose the means to educate and guide them, causing them to abandon evil dharma and practice the Dharma.

“As shown in the true good Kshatriya, the true good Brahman level, attaining blessings? Destroying sins?” (How many blessings will the true good Kshatriya to the true good Brahman get? How many sins will be destroyed?): Increase blessings, destroy sins, regardless of person. From cultivating the Dharma to being able to live happily in the world, one can always practice the Dharma beyond this world. In the previous section, it was said that the kings of Cham-t-la-Kat-de-li, She-ng-la-Brahmin, etc., did evil things, along with evil Bhikkhus, destroying Bhikkhus' pure conduct, to the point of making it impossible for them to practice the Way. Those who committed such many sins all fell into the Hell of No Interruptions. [Here], on the contrary, how many benefits can those who uphold the Buddha Dharma, Sangha, and Three Jewels gain?

“Good man” here is the title [the Buddha used to call] Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Suppose there is a person appearing in the world, complete with great power, that is to say, his meritorious karma, compared to the king who initiated Sat-de-li to protect good believers and subdue those with evil nature, how great is his merit? That is to say, to evaluate that person's merits, the Buddha used similes, simulating each level. [In the first level of simile, the Buddha said]: Suppose there is such a person appearing in the world, that person has a lot of power.

“Preliminary part”, [that is] at sunrise, “accumulate the seven treasures, completing Thiem Bo Chau”: In the morning, by his own might, can he gather the seven treasures, agate, coral, amber, how many in total? As much as Nam Thiem Bo Chau! Early in the morning, use that many seven treasures to make offerings to the Buddhas and disciples. “The middle part of the sun” means that at noon, seven treasures are also gathered, filling the Thiem Bo Chau. [In the morning] after giving alms, at noon they gathered the seven treasures, filling the Nam Thiem Bo Chau with that much amount, "to serve all the Buddhas and their disciples. After the sun, the seven-jeweled heron, complete the Thiem Bo Chau, to serve all the Buddhas and their disciples" [meaning] that very day, at noon, in the evening, even in the morning, in the three divine periods, all the seven treasures were gathered full of Nam Thiem. Bo Chau, three times gathered the seven treasures throughout Nam Thiem Bo Chau like that to give alms and offerings to the Buddhas and disciples, and it wasn't even just [doing so] for one day!

“Just like day after day continues” [that is] every day [continue] to make offerings like that. How much time to make offerings? “One hundred thousand years” (One hundred thousand years): Either make offerings for one hundred years, or make offerings for one thousand years. Tell me, does that person have much merit or virtue? Using those seven treasures to make offerings to the Buddhas, making offerings three times a day, making offerings for hundreds of thousands of years, is that merit and virtue great? Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva replied: “World-Honored One, very much! Venerable One, very much!” That offering is inconceivable, the merit accumulated by that person “is immeasurable, boundless, incalculable”. Using numbers to calculate, every day like that three times to make offerings to the seven treasures that many, his merit and virtue even if he uses math, numbers, examples [to calculate or compare] it cannot be calculated! Only the Buddha knows the blessings of that offering, others do not know: Except for the Buddha, other great Bodhisattvas have no way to know.

Buddha taught: “Good man! As it is, as it is”, [meaning] what he said is very true. "As the theory" has the meaning: As you just asked me "if the truly good Kshatriya king to the truly good Brahmins, etc...." does not collect the ten evil wheels himself, and even advises others to leave the ten evil wheels, how great a blessing will he gain? That person's merit is compared to the merit just mentioned above “exceeds the accumulation of blessings” (far more than the merits accumulated before), “accumulation” means “gathering”. Speaking of that person's merits, the accumulated merits [of that person] are immeasurable, boundless, incalculable. That good man himself did not become infected with the ten evil wheels, and even advised others not to be infected with the ten evil wheels and leave the ten evil wheels. His merit and virtue far exceeds the blessing of the person making the above offerings. This is the first step. Now let's say it's one level higher!

(Sutra) “Huu, good man! Suppose a person of great power appears in the world, the monks of the four directions set up a monastery, are generous and generous with the Four Great Continents, have wonderful rooms, beds, clothes, food, medicine, and personal equipment, spiritual Tathagatas, Sravakas, Bodhisattvas, and great disciples who only stay in the middle, diligently practice the kind of good qualities, the weak dwelling, the weak mind, the non-existence of the breath, and the sutras of hundreds of thousands of na-du-da tues, providing offerings. seemingly, continuously without stopping. Trying to gather blessings, security and prosperity? Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva said: "Even the most, World-Honored One! Even the most, great virtue! Trying to gather countless and boundless blessings, cannot be described by calculations, calculations, numbers, similes cannot be accessed, only Buddha can understand, the remainder has no knowledge." Buddha said: "Good man! As it is, as it is, as it is."
(Sutra: “Come, good man! Suppose someone appears in the world, with great power large, because the monks of the four directions built temples, the size of four great continents, with the best rooms, beds, blankets, clothes, food, medicine, and all necessary things, so that the Tathagata, Sravakas, Bodhisattvas, and great disciples could diligently practice all kinds of good things in them, whether night or day, without being lazy or resting for hundreds of thousands of years of continuous provision and offerings. Are there many blessings accumulated by that person?

Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva said: "World-Honored One, very much! Venerable One, very much! That person has accumulated immeasurable, boundless merit, which cannot be counted, mathematics, numbers, examples are not comparable, only the Buddha can know, others do not know."

Buddha said: "Good man! That's true, that's true, just as you said").

Building a residence in Sangha Lam, that is, a residence for monks. How big is that temple? Building a pagoda "dense and spacious, equivalent to the four great continents" (as large as four continents): The four great continents all become one temple! That person has great power and the best house. In each room, there are also living items such as clothes, beds, blankets, clothes, food, “supplements” (everything necessary for life is complete). The things needed for life are very complete, so that the Tathagata, not one or two Buddhas [but Buddhas], makes the Sravakas and Bodhisattvas who are disciples of the Tathagata live in the temple that that person created. “Diligence in practicing all kinds of good products” (Diligence in practicing all kinds of good products), of course Buddhas and Bodhisattvas will teach, lead, and preach the Dharma. If you preach the Dharma, there are still many sentient beings who can practice diligently. Good qualities are taught by the Buddha, as said in the sutras, either practicing Meditation, or reciting, or worshiping. “Weak dwelling, weak heart, non-existence, sutra of hundreds of thousands of verses na-du-da tue” (Whether day or night, there is no laziness, no rest, through hundreds of thousands of verses na-du-da tue), na-du-da is memories, hundreds of thousands verses memories, many like that, “providing offerings, continuously without stopping, testing the cause of blessings to gather security for multi-fu?” (provision, merit, continuously without end, is that person's merit and virtue great?)

“ Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat said: - Even Da, World-Honored One! Even Da, Venerable!” (Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat said: - World-Honored One, many! Venerable One, very many). The World-Honored One said that the blessings accumulated by that person are immeasurable, boundless, and incalculable. We can imagine this. We build an ordinary temple, like the rich man Anathapindika built the Ky Vien monastery for the Buddha. When the rich man created a monastery, Da Ma Thien also created a palace for him in the third heaven. His monastery in the human world has not yet been completed, but the palace of merit [in heaven] has already been built! That is just Ky Vien monastery. Ky Vien Monastery is just a forest in Xa Ve country, but how big is the monastery [mentioned here]? The amount is equal to four great continents! This merit is of course greater than that merit, and the merit [to be enjoyed] after death is of course also very great. But worldly merit and worldly merit are different. No matter how great the blessings of humanity and heaven are, they are still illusory. The Buddha used this simile to say that that person has accumulated immeasurable, boundless blessings, which cannot be counted, calculated, calculated, numbered, or have no examples. Only the Buddha can know, others do not know. Like in the previous part, the Buddha taught: “Good man! As it is, as it is”. The Buddha told Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva: What you said is correct, it is as you said, such blessings are immeasurable and boundless.

(Sutra) “Huu, good man! Suppose there are people, appearing in the world, with great power, the monks of the four directions set up a self-dancing camp, generous and generous with the fourteen great continents, superior rooms, beds, clothes, food, medicine, and personal equipment, spiritual Tathagatas, Thanh Van, Bodhisattvas, the great disciples only stay in the middle, diligently practice the weak, weak, and non-existent species. Sutras of hundreds of thousands of verses, na-du-da tue, providing, making offerings, continuously without end, testing the accumulation of blessings, security and multi-fu? Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva said: "Even the most, World-Honored One! Even the most, great virtue! The accumulation of blessings is immeasurable, boundless, indescribable, calculations, numbers, examples cannot be mentioned, only Buddha can understand, the remainder is ignorant." Buddha said: "Good man! As it is, as it is, as it is."
(Sutra: “Come, good man! Suppose someone appears in the world, with great power large, because the monks from all directions built temples, the size of fourteen great continents, with the best rooms, beds, blankets, clothes, food, medicine, and all necessary things, so that the Tathagata, Sravakas, Bodhisattvas, and great disciples could diligently practice all kinds of good things, whether night or day, without being lazy or stopping for hundreds of thousands of years, providing and making offerings There is no end to the merits accumulated by that person? Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva said: "World-Honored One, very many! That person has accumulated immeasurable merits, which cannot be counted, calculated, numbered, or compared, only Buddha can know, others do not know." Buddha said: "That's right, that's right, it's just like what you said."

In the previous part, it was said about the four great continents, here it is said twice, also constructing wonderful rooms, beds, blankets, clothes, food, medicine, all conditions, so that the Tathagata, Sravakas, Bodhisattvas, great disciples, etc. can practice there, up to preaching the Dharma to save sentient beings, day and night without interruption. Over hundreds of thousands of verses of na-du-da years, providing, making offerings, continuously without end. Not just for a day or two, but for an infinite, endless period of time. Does that person accumulate much merit or virtue? Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat said: “World-Honored One, very many! Venerable One, very many”. That person accumulates immeasurable and boundless merit and virtue, which cannot be counted, calculated, calculated, or compared to all examples. Only the Buddha can know, others do not know. The Buddha taught: "Good man! As it is, it is as it is, it is as it is said", [meaning] you are very right, that merit is immeasurable, boundless.

(Sutra) Huu, good man! Suppose there is a human being, appearing in the world, a mighty man, a Buddha with relics, starts Tot-dump-ba, solemn, lofty, generous, equal to three thousand great thousand worlds. Nthe former theory of the four directions Sangha creates from the gathering of blessings, testing The theory of the Buddha's relics arising Tot-dump-ba, the gathering of blessings, the most inadequate middle part, the most inadequate middle part, the most inadequate middle part, the most inadequate heron part, the most inadequate heron part, na-du-most part, number part, math part, next part, example part, nai chi o-bani-shat-dam part, heron is the most inadequate.
(Sutra: Come here, good man! Suppose someone appears In the world, with great power, for the sake of the Buddha's relics, the Buddha's relics are built, solemn, magnificent, tall and wide, equal to the three thousand great thousand worlds. The blessings accumulated from building pagodas for the monks of the four directions as mentioned in the previous section compared to the blessings being mentioned here, that is, compared to the amount of blessings achieved by building the tower to worship the Buddha's relics, will not be equal to one hundredth, nor one thousandth, nor one hundredth. thousand, is not equal to one part of verse-chi, one part of na-du-da, one part of math, one part of number, one part of next, one part of example, even not equal to one part of lo-ba-ni-shat-dam).

Why add the sentence “a mighty man” (with great power)? If we don't have that kind of strength, how can we create achievements? This person's blessings are inconceivable! Again, for the sake of the Buddha's relics, we created Stupa, that is, we built a tower to worship the relics. That tower was built with the size of three thousand worlds, as high and wide as that. The merits accumulated by building pagodas for the four directions The monks mentioned in the previous section, if compared with this story, that is, compared with the merits accumulated by building Tot-d-ba for the Buddha's relics, “U hundred parts in the middle are the most inadequate, U Thien part is the most inadequate, U Thien part is the most inadequate heron, U Cau-chi part is the most inadequate, Na-du-most part, number part, math part, next part, example part, upanisadam-api (not equal to one hundredth, one thousandth, one hundred thousandth, one part sentence-chi, one part na-du-da, one part math, one part number, one part next, one part example up to one part o-ba-ni-shat-dam): Upanisad-dam (Upanisadam-api)[81] is an extremely small part, the smallest number, “the most inadequate” (not even one part).

This is the reverse. How to say it in reverse? In the previous section we talked about numbers. Then, bring the merit of the Kshatriya, the good king of Kshatriya, the true good Kshatriya, [ie the merit due to] the king himself not being attached to the ten evil wheels, advising others not to be attached to the ten evil wheels, to stay away from the ten evil wheels to compare step by step. At present, speaking in reverse, without mentioning the merits of the truly good King of Kshatriya, it is still intended to point out: That merit, or the merit of the person who has done things like creating a stupa to worship Buddha's relics, even though it is so great, still cannot be compared to a part of the merit of the truly good king who stays away from the ten evil wheels and advises others to stay away from the ten evil wheels. Not only is it not equal to one tenth, it is not equal to one hundredth, but even one part of a sentence is not equal!

“ Na-duu-most part, number part, math part, next part, example part, nāi chi o-ba-ni-shat-dam the most inadequate heron part”: Everyone should know that this passage has the meaning of showing the merit and virtue of leaving the ten evil wheels. The more the Buddha spoke, the deeper he spoke, the deeper he spoke, the more he spoke. The merit of staying away from the ten evil realms, as well as teaching others to stay away from the ten evil realms, is truly incalculable, greater than any merit or virtue, because this is a dharma that transcends the world, will lead to birth and death. From now on, I will forever be free and will never do evil again. That's the meaning!

(Sutra) Huu, good man! Suppose one attains Paramita, attains the eight liberations, attains tranquility, is the Great Arahant, transforms the three thousand great thousand worlds, such as Dao, Demon, Bamboo, Vi, Cam Gia, Tung Lam, must be able to overcome the five realms, and experience hundreds of millennia. At one time, there was a person who appeared like that, with great power and great power, mocking the blessings and virtues of the ancestors, and all the Arhats who had been cursed by him, incense ladders and desires, offerings of robes and bowls, hundreds of millennium sutras, upper chambers, sieves, bed pans, clothes, food, medicine, and various kinds of cultivation facilities like dharma instruments. The Arhats attained Nirvana, offered the burnt portion, collected the relics, miraculously seven treasures, started Tot-dump-ba, and attained peace in the middle period. Offerings of various kinds of jewels, phan, flowers, incense, flowers, music, and children. Just like the previous explanation of the Buddha's relics starting example part, nai chi o-ba-ni-shat-dam part, heron is the most inadequate.
(Sutra: Come here, good man! Suppose there were great men. Arahants attained Paramita, complete with eight liberations, Tranquility, Equanimity, all over the three thousand great thousand worlds such as rice, sesame, bamboo, reeds, sugar cane, forests, all were tied tightly in five places, for hundreds of thousands of years, at that time, someone appeared in the world, with great power, because of his love of merit, he untied the Arhats, used fragrant water to bathe, offered robes and bowls, and offered rooms The arhats have already entered Nirvana, then they make offerings, cremate them, collect relics, use the seven miraculous treasures to build a stupa, and place them in it. They also use various kinds of treasures, parasols, incense sticks, flowers, and music to make offerings By untying and making offerings to these Arhats, it is not equal to one hundredth, nor one thousandth, nor one hundred thousandth, nor one part verse-chi, one part na-du-da, one part number, one part math, one part next, one part of similes, even one part of lo-ba-ni-shat-dam, it is not all equal).

(Sutra) Good man! The poor true good King of the Kshatriya, the most righteous brahmin, with the ten evil wheels, untainted by himself, the heron often encourages the forgiveness of the ten evil wheels, accumulates merit, accumulates countless blessings, is boundless, cannot be counted. atrium.
Brahmins, etc. are not infected with the ten evil circles themselves, and often advise others to leave the ten evil circles. They will gain merit beyond the merits accumulated above, which are immeasurable and boundless.

Those truly good Brahmins themselves are not infected with the ten evils, and also advise others not to be infected, and will gain merit beyond the amount of accumulated merit as mentioned above, which is immeasurable, boundless, and cannot be counted. In the previous section [it was mentioned that the good deeds from using the seven treasures to fill the four great jewels to make offerings three times a day for hundreds of thousands of years] to creating stupas and temples, step by step, floor by floor compared, [even though] they become bigger and bigger, more and more, are still not equal to the merit and virtue achieved by the true good Brahmins because they themselves are not infected with these ten evil wheels, and also advise others to leave the ten evil wheels. [That is the meaning of the sentence] “with so much money, blessings gather that are immeasurable, boundless, unaccountable, like giving birth to blessings, eliminating sins with heron ears”.

When that person is alive, the merit and virtue are inconceivable, and the destruction of evil is the same, just like the merit and virtue. It also means: That person can gradually become a Buddha. Leaving the Ten Evils is the Ten Goods. What is the difference between the Ten Evils and the Ten Goods? He causes all sentient beings to leave the ten evils, also respectfully makes offerings to the Three Jewels, abides in the Three Jewels, causes the Buddha Dharma to exist forever in the world, causes the dharma eyes of sentient beings to not be cut off, and even more sentient beings in the future will attain salvation. This cannot be measured. Based on this to speculate, that merit is incalculable! Showing [alms] of wealth, up to building stupas, up to all kinds of offerings, are all limited. Why? Those things still belong to the physical world. Making people leave the ten evils means they belong to the world.

(Sutra) Good man! The weak true good of the Kshatriya king, the true good ministers, the lay people, the wealthy, the monks, the Brahmins, in the future world, after five hundred years, the dharma of desire is extinguished at the time, the ability to protect the self, the dharma eye, the ability to protect the self, the good to protect others, the good to protect the future, the good to protect the self of the dharma of renunciation, the weakness of the dharma weapon, the weakness of the non-dharma weapon, the lower will is limitless, the world except the development, being deceived by ca-sa, universal Good guardians, respectfully make offerings, the soul will not be harmed. Good potential protects the three vehicles of the Dharma. At the time of hearing offerings to the Sravaka Dharma, the Single Enlightened One attains the Mahayana Dharma and will not be defamed. U Single Enlightenment Vehicle, access to Mahayana cause, the heron does not increase disability. Hearing offerings to the Single Enlightenment Dharma, at the time of the Sravakayana, the Mahayana Dharma will not be defamed.
