Hearing offerings to the Mahayana Dharma, at the time of the Shravaka Vehicle, the Single Enlightenment Vehicle Dharma, does not give rise to defamation. U Thanh Van Vehicle, Single Enlightenment Vehicle, the heron does not increase disability. U Thanh Van Vehicle, Single Enlightenment Vehicle, do not seek to realize, only seek to realize the Mahayana true Dharma. Abiding in the Mahayana, with precepts, rich in virtue, diligently cultivating, and even attaining the fruit of Bodhisattva Jāla, most people are close to them, take care of them, make offerings, deeply respect them, request them, listen to them.
officials, lay people, wealthy people, monks, brahmins, etc. in the future life, the last five hundred years, when the dharma is about to be destroyed, can skillfully protect my dharma eye, can skillfully protect myself, but also skillfully protect others, skillfully protect disciples who have become monks in my dharma, whether they are dharma objects, or not dharma objects, even those who have no precepts, shave off beard and hair, put on robes, can skillfully protect them everywhere, respectfully make offerings, so that they do not When you hear and accept and make offerings to the Sravakayana dharma and the Mahayana dharma, there will be no defamation towards those who [practice] the Sravakayana dharma and the Mahayana dharma listen, accept, and make offerings to the Mahayana dharma, and do not defame the Shravaka Vehicle and the Single Enlightenment Vehicle. For those who [practice] the Sravaka Vehicle and the Single Enlightenment Vehicle, do not be jealous of the Sravaka Vehicle and the Single Enlightenment Vehicle. They only seek to attain the Mahayana dharma. ask, listen and accept).

In this passage, Buddha again gives an example to talk about. If one leaves the ten evil wheels, "the weak, truly good Kshatriya king, will meet the truly good officials, lay people, wealthy people, monks, Brahmins of the class" (if there is the truly good Kshatriya king and the truly good officials, lay people, wealthy people, monks, Brahmins, etc.), five hundred years later in the future life, "after five hundred years" refers to five hundred years. the last hundred years [during the End of Dharma]. Here, there are two ways to say it:

1) True Dharma five hundred years, Dharma statue five hundred years, Dharma end five hundred years. That is an expression that covers fifteen hundred years. [This theory] is sometimes said to be the True Dharma for five hundred years, the Dharma Image for five hundred years, and the End of the Dharma for a thousand years.

Those expressions are completely unrelated, here we only talk about the last five hundred years. [If you understand] The Dharma ends in ten thousand years, then when nine thousand five hundred years have passed, only five hundred years remain, at that time, the Dharma is about to disappear.

When the Buddhadharma still exists, it means that the Dharma Ending period will still exist for a very long time. [Here] it is said that when the dharma is about to be destroyed, in the last five hundred years, at that time, even during the time when the Tam Vu Buddha destroyed the Buddha, we think that the time has not yet come for the dharma to be destroyed, that dharma can exist in the world. That person not only protects himself, but also skillfully protects others, and also skillfully protects disciples who become monks according to the Buddha's Dharma in the next life. Regardless of whether [that monastic person] maintains the precepts or not, whether it is a dharma weapon or not a dharma weapon, even if he does not receive the precepts, as soon as he shaves off his hair and beard, he is "put on a ca-sa" (put on a ca-sa), even if that ca-sa is a novice's ca-sa, like the man y[82] is not a Field of Merit (puṇyakṣetra).

“Universally good protector, respectfully make offerings” (Skilled to be able to protect all over, respectfully make offerings): Abandoning the ten evil wheels, that King Kshat-de-li “a brahmin level” (up to the Brahmin level) can skillfully protect the Buddha Dharma, can cause The Buddha Dharma remains in the world, so that those who study it will not be harmed or disturbed, and will equally protect and maintain the Dharma of the Three Vehicles. For the following parts of the scriptures, if you understand the meaning like that, it's okay. Protect the Thanh Van Dharma, do not destroy the Single Enlightenment Dharma, do not destroy the Mahayana Dharma. Protect the Single Enlightenment Dharma, do not destroy the Thanh Van Dharma, do not destroy the Mahayana Dharma. So when making offerings to the Mahayana dharma, he does not blaspheme the Shravaka dharma, nor does he blaspheme the Single Enlightenment dharma. Of the three vehicles, whichever one believes in, he will not destroy the other two vehicles, but must uphold the three vehicles together. Don't hate or slander, but make offerings equally. If Bo Dat Gia La is a person who abides in the fruition, that is, he abides in the First Fruition, Second Fruition, Third Fruition, and Four Fruition. “Fruit Pillar” refers to the entire Arhat Vehicle and Thanh Van Vehicle. That person must "closely make offerings, deeply respect, ask questions, listen to receive" (closely make offerings, deeply respect, ask questions, listen and receive).

(Sutra) Far from breaking the precepts, evil deeds turn on the number. You should give alms to the Sangha of the four directions, and use it for non-spiritual people without the law. You need to protect and worship the monks of the four directions. U Tot-dump-ba, up to the Sangha Ky things, the general does not take it for himself, the one who does not teach others takes it, the heron does not use it on his own, the one who does not teach it does not use it. Proficient in explaining the Three Vehicles of Dharma, reverently making offerings, providing powerful blessings, not allowing others to defame or destroy others. Respect and comfort monks. Believe in and uphold the Tathagata's holy teachings. Chung does not destroy theTot-dump-ba. Heron often protects the monks in all four directions. U-ta became a monk and his disciples, never destroyed, and returned to the world of history. Adhering to the ten evil wheels, from the source of impurities, the heron often recommends abandoning the ten evil wheels. He learned how the king ruled the country righteously. The Ten Good Karmas transform the world. Often close to good knowledge, introduced to the Three Jewels, the spirit is always prosperous, the good eye protects the dharma, the spirit is indestructible. Like the true good King of the Kshatriya, the true good Brahman, because of his merits and virtues, his name is unimaginable and he receives national benefits. Necessary heaven, dragon, Yoc Xa ghost spirit, nirvana Yet Tra Bo Dat Na class, the stage gives birth to joy, compassion supports the most dharma weapon, true field of blessings, the heron gives birth to joy, compassion protects thoughts.
(Sutra: Abstaining from the sūtra, breaking the precepts, evil deeds. For offerings to the four directions Monks do not allow others to use them illegally, and are even more diligent in guarding and making offerings to the Sangha in the four directions. They do not appropriate or teach others to appropriate them, nor do they use them themselves or teach others to use them. They respectfully make offerings, increase and protect their power, and do not let others defame or humiliate [the monk]. Accept and uphold the holy teachings of the Tathagata. He does not destroy the stupas and also protects the temples of the monks of the four directions. He does not destroy or force them to return to the world. He does not infect the ten evil destiniess. He also fully advises others to leave the ten evil destiniess of the ancestors. Use the Ten Good Karmas to transform the world Prosperous, skillfully upholding the Dharma eye, not allowing it to be destroyed. The truly good Kshatriya kings up to the truly good Brahmans, due to all such merits, are said to not receive the benefits of the people in vain. All the gods, dragons, Yak Soa, ghosts, and even the Bodhisattvas, etc., are happy and compassionately support all Dharma objects, and the true fields of merit also give birth to joy and compassion.

Abstain from breaking precepts and evil deeds. Bhikkhus' bad actions can be transformed; Here we are talking about [staying away from] the monks' bad actions that cannot be transformed. They do not accept and cannot enjoy the offerings given to the Sangha of the four directions. Whenever they enjoy it, it will be illegal. “Need to protect” (Be more diligent in protecting): Protecting the things belonging to the Sangha in purity, not allowing evil monks to enjoy them. “Those who are able to explain the three vehicles of dharma, respectfully make offerings” (For those who can argue and preach the three vehicles of dharma, all respectfully make offerings): What offerings? For those who can preach the three vehicles, we respectfully make offerings, increasing the power of protection.

Even though he has broken the precepts, he can still explain the dharma, so he must also respectfully make offerings to him, invite him to preach the dharma, and not let others slander him. Respect and comfort all monastics. Believe, accept and uphold Tathagata's holy teachings like that. All dharmas spoken by the Buddha, which are also the Buddha's teachings, are holy teachings. The great saint does not destroy the Dharma, does not destroy the people who study the Dharma, does not destroy the pagodas and stupas, and does not destroy pagodas and stupas. There are people who vandalize towers and temples. Right now, we don't see it here; But if you travel to Mainland China, no matter which ashram you go to, you will see stupas, shrines vandalized, and pagodas burned. Committing such crimes is unthinkable. Now we are talking about good people, who are good people? Truly good and faithful, even up to the Kshatriya kings, Brahmins, etc. They not only protect true monastics, but also protect the dharma, protect pagodas, protect the temples of the four directions and the temples where monks reside.

“For my monastic disciples, I will never destroy them and return to the secular world” (For my monastic disciples, I will not destroy them or oppress them to return to the secular world): He does not force people to become monks. Destroying pagodas and temples, not allowing them to become monks, forcing them to return to the secular world, is called “history books”. Monks in Mainland China used to suffer like that. Anyway, there is definitely a previous cause (previous cause) that causes destruction, it is not born without cause. The good Dharma protector will not protect the evil Rakshasa kings or the evil Brahmins, etc. like that. “With the ten evil wheels, the self is not infected with the ten evil wheels” (The self is not infected with the ten evil wheels), also often advises others to leave the ten evil wheels, learn the full dharma of ruling the country of the ancestors, learn all the teachings of the Buddhas. According to Buddhism, the Ten Good Karmas transform the world. The Ten Virtuous Karmas are shallow and deep. If we ourselves can not kill, do not steal, do not commit sexual misconduct, do not lie, do not gossip, do not speak evil words, not give rise to greed, anger, ignorance, and keep ourselves pure, we also advise all sentient beings to do the same, not create the ten evil karmas, practice the Ten Good Karmas, use the Ten Good Karmas to "transform the world, always be close to good knowledge" (to change the world, always be close to good knowledge). Regarding good knowledge, the Second Treatise on the Bodhi Path[83] has been explained very thoroughly.

“Thieu Three Jewels” (Continuing the nature of the Three Jewels): Causes the nature of the Three Jewels to never be cut off. The nature of the Buddha Treasure is not cut off, that is, any [Buddha or Bodhisattva statue] made of clay, carved wood, or printed or drawn on paper, is considered a Buddha Treasure. It is the reincarnation of Buddha. We see paper statues, clay statues, carved wooden statues, and consider them to be incarnations of Buddhas. When the Buddha was in the Dao Loi heaven saying the Ksitigarbha Sutra for too long, the king, ministers, and great disciples remembered the Buddha and invited artists to paint statues and images of the Buddha. When Śākyamuni Buddha returned from heaven to earth, the painted statue himself came to welcome the Buddha. Because that statue has its own superiority, people respect it. Don't see it as paper, don't see it as carved clay or wood statues. If you think it is a real Buddha, it will truly be a Buddha. If in your mind you think it's mud, if you think it's paper, then it's just a drawing on paper!

Patriarch Don Ha split the Buddha statue, wanting to find relics in the Buddha statue. The other monk told him: "That is a wooden statue, how can there be relics?" That statement is not entirely true; That's because your practice power is not enough. Sometimes images on paper can give birth to relics. With full potency, paper can produce relics. You see in the Induction Luc there are written [stories like that]: From the scriptures appeared relics. National Master Thanh Luong recited the Avatamsaka Sutra, and relics appeared in the Avatamsaka Sutra. The relics fell out of the scriptures. In the past, there were many such things. This is all because of moral inspiration and blessings, absolutely nothing surprising! If you practice, you can also achieve it!

Sometimes in the Tripitaka, opening the Sutra and reciting it will produce relics. Where do relics appear in the Sutra Pitaka? It is an offering made by a good deity protecting the dharma. Therefore, it depends on how the cultivator uses his mind to do it. That merit is determined by your mind, not by your actions. You must understand this principle. After you know, when you chant the sutras, study the dharma, listen to the dharma, your mind will have a kind of feeling, which is absolutely not something that appears on the outside! Even if it's flashy, don't take it as real. As long as your mind is free of afflictions, it is real. The mind is not troubled, always maintains pure joy. That's real, that's your own Dharmakaya appearing. Phenomena seen from the outside are other people's, not yours. What you really are is in your peaceful mind, there will never be any heat in your mind. People beat you, scold you, insult you, you all [feel] good, eliminating my bad karma. Just like the Diamond Sutra teaches: Being despised and humiliated by others means that in your previous life you committed a crime worthy of being sent to hell, but now [due to being despised and humiliated, you] have not yet had to suffer it. If you have committed a light sin, you have taken great advantage!

If someone curses, you say “Amitābha Buddha”; At that time, it is appropriate for you to recite like that. It's absolutely not like when you call on the phone, someone asks you: "Who is that?", and then answers: "Amitābha Buddha!" So that's not possible, you are not Amitābha Buddha! People ask who you are! Nowadays, when making phone calls, there are often [situations] like being asked: "Who is this?" [Caller answers]: “Amitābha Buddha!” I said: “Are you Amitābha Buddha?” We have many disciples. Whenever they call and want to talk to me, I ask: "Who is it?" [Hearing response] “Amitābha Buddha”, I thought Amitābha Buddha was calling me! Some people think: "If I speak and answer by reciting Amitābha Buddha, it seems like I'm using a lot of effort. I can't leave Amitābha Buddha anywhere." Actually, I don't know where my mind has gone! Therefore, this method must be used wisely, must be skillfully used with the mind!

Manjushri Bodhisattva teaches us: People with wisdom use their mind skillfully, don't use it in the wrong place! If used in the wrong place, it is not only unprofitable, but also harmful! When others hear it, they will be very contemptuous. You must understand this principle! Saying that we don't need to recite sutras or bow to Buddha, but just hope for something to be touched, [such as] a light appearing, a lamp wick showing flowers, those things don't bring you any benefit! It just makes you increase your faith, makes your faith a little better, but you don't gain any real benefits! What are the actual benefits? At the time when afflictions should arise, there will be no afflictions! For others, it is endless suffering, but for you it will be joy, no sadness, living a little longer, and getting sick less!

Therefore, if there is a disease, it must still be treated. Buddha also talked about curing illness, but you must know the cause of the illness. The karma you created in the past, just relying on worldly medicine will not be enough, you have to repay the debt! Worldly medicine cannot cure any disease! Do you want to drink something good to prolong your life? I see that in the past, emperors and mandarins, who didn't have money? Is there any emperor who doesn't eat well? Can they prolong their lives? Impossible! You accumulate merit, do more good deeds, release more living beings, don't kill others, naturally others won't kill you. You don't hurt others, others won't hurt you. But everywhere you hurt others, you naturally have to suffer retribution. Good people and evil people differentiate here. We must truly protect the Buddha Dharma, often making the Three Jewels flourish, just like protecting the eyes of living beings. That is called “dharma eye”, causing it not to be destroyed. After not being destroyed, all sentient beings still have Dharma to learn. Once they have learned, they will be able to attain enlightenment.

“Such as the truly good Kshat-de-li-King, the truly good Brahmin level, because of such merits, the unimaginable name receives national benefits” (The truly good Kshat-de-li-King to the truly good Brahmins like that, due to such full merit, is called “in vain” enjoy the benefits of the people”): The king of Sat-de-li is [symbolizes the entire] nation, and the people of the whole country respect him. Those great gods “all the heavens, dragons, Yaoc Xoa ghosts and gods” (all the heavens, dragons, Duoc Xoa, ghosts and gods), “Nai Chi Yet Tra Bo Dat Na” (until Yet Tra Bo Dat Na), “god” are the god kings. All those divine kings were filled with joy, even the evil demon kings were filled with joy. “Compassion supports all dharma objects, the true blessing field brings joy, compassion protects thoughts” (Compassion supports all dharma objects, the true blessing field also gives birth to joy, compassion protects thoughts).

(Sutra) Due to the fate of people and people, the state of the country, the destiny of love, prosperity, peace and prosperity Lac. LThe nation's soldiers are invincible, respectful and respectful, and return to their father. Through trial and error, one can encourage the cultivation of good karma, dry up evil beasts, increase gods and humans, protect one's life, attain long-lasting spirituality, self-destroy afflictions, destroy the heron spirit, abbot Bodhi path, Six Paramita, destroy all evil destiniess. U the sea of birth and death, never fall into samsara, always separate from evil friends, always be close to good Existing, being born, constantly realizing the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, respectfully and in accordance with their deeds, they are temporarily absent. BAt the nine stages, depending on the mind's derision, you all abide in the Buddha's land, attaining Supreme Bodhi.
Prosperous, peaceful, rich and happy. Neighboring countries do not raise troops to invade, all respect, admire virtue, come to surrender, ask for dependence. Therefore, one after another, I advise you to practice good karma, dry up evil destiniess, increase heaven and human life, protect your body and life for a long time, destroy your own afflictions, also eliminate [afflictions] for others, practice the Bodhi path, Six Paramitas, destroy all evil destiniess, no longer sink for a long time in the sea of birth and death, forever. Leave evil friends, always be close to good friends, always meet Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, revere them, never give up. Soon, everyone will follow their wishes, everyone will abide in the Buddha's land, attain Supreme Bodhi).

That country is very peaceful, life is very happy. “Peace and happiness” (Peace, wealth, joy): Even neighboring countries cannot invade. [Their] army "cannot be harmed, respects virtue" (cannot invade or cause harm, all respect virtue), respect that country, praise its virtues. They naturally obey you. You don't need to compete, you don't need to conquer. As long as you are a virtuous person, others will respect you. You use violence to subdue others. Today they submit, tomorrow they will not submit and will rebel again!

During the Tang Dynasty, the national strength was strong and treated the surrounding countries, such as the Tho Pho people[84]. The Tufan people are also Tibetans, from Qinghai to Tibet, fighting for many years, from the Tang Dynasty to the Qing Dynasty. During the prosperous period under Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty, many wars, big and small, killed many people. From the mainland [China], sent troops to attack Tay Khang, to the border with Tibet, that is, the Dai Kim Xuyen and Little Kim Xuyen areas, those places encountered the disaster of war from year to month. That was the prosperous time of Qianlong. If it weren't for the prosperous era, there would be no need to talk about war anymore, harming each other. Wherever there is war, there will be epidemics, that is, places where pestilence spreads, winds are out of season, floods are caused by rising water at the wrong time, and fires are caused by sudden fires. They should not burn but keep burning. That is the Four Great Races and the four precepts being harmed by not doing good deeds. That is retribution.

But in the Dharma-Ending Age, those phenomena [prosperity] could not exist! Why can't there be? Because the human heart is incapable of [creating dominant phenomena]. If the human heart has the ability, it will be the Dharma, not the End of Dharma. But we cannot require everyone to be like that, so each individual of us should create the ability. If your mind purely practices the Ten Good Karmas, the Dharma will remain in the world. We maintain the Buddha Dharma in this world, promote the Buddha Dharma, practice the Ten Good Karmas, without harming anyone, and no one will harm us. I do not take revenge, I only demand for myself, then it will be practicing Bodhi, the Buddha Dharma will last a long time, the Bodhi path will also last in the world. Almsgiving, precepts, patience, Meditation, Prajnaparamita, Six Paramitas all last a long time. "Destroying all the evil destiniess, there will be no eternal sea of ​​birth and death" (Destroying all the evil destiniess, no longer sinking for a long time in the sea of ​​birth and death): There will be no sea of ​​birth and death, it does not exist, and there is no damnation!

“Always leave evil friends, always be close to good friends, be born and always realize Buddhas and Bodhisattvas” (Usually leave evil friends, often be close to good friends. Always meet Buddhas and Bodhisattvas in life): People should not think that worshiping Ngu Dai Mountain is planting great and inconceivable good roots, [so people living in Ngu Dai Son are all good people]! If you worship Ngu Dai Mountain, you have planted great good roots, but those who were born and raised in Ngu Dai Mountain did not sow good roots. “A famous mountain leaves no good people behind”, [meaning] “there are no good people who live on a famous mountain”! After [Mainland] implemented religious tolerance, I led monks from the Chinese Buddhist Academy, more than twenty monks to worship Wutai Mountain, right when the weather was very hot. Wutai Mountain belongs to Taihuai Town, [that town] is also the center of Wutai region. Every year in July, there is a donkey and horse festival there. Donkeys and horses from ten to twenty surrounding districts are brought to sell at Dai Hoai Tran. At that time, we wanted to go there to clean Master Nang Hai's tower[85]. If we wanted to climb up to Dai Loa Dang, there were only donkeys and horses there, no pigs! The monks asked me: "Dear old magician! Why does Ngu Dai Mountain have so many donkeys and horses?" I said: "You must pay attention. If you do not practice well, you will not become a human, but will become a donkey or a horse." I said: "The donkeys and horses in Wutai Mountain are the people living around Wutai Mountain. Those people specialize in stealing things from monks, stealing things from temples and pagodas. Even the stones in the pagodas are carried away by them. Tell me, is that evil or not?" Are the people in Putuo Mountain and the people in Emei Mountain all doing good deeds? No way! Why? Try to guess for yourself, or research and ponder for yourself, you will know immediately!

If one can regularly “enlighten the Buddhas, Bodhisattvas respect them, accept them, and temporarily leave them alone” (when they meet Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, they revere them, acknowledge them, never let go): Even for a short period of time, they will not let go, will be “it's up to your heart to mock” (depending on your heart's desires), it's the same if you want to be reborn in the world of Ultimate Bliss, but it's the same for being born in heaven, forever being reborn in the good path, or [being born in] the world of Medicine Master Lapis la Light Tathagata, wherever you want to go, “you all abide in the Buddha's land” (everyone abides in the Buddha's land), which is the pure Buddha land. You can reach the pure Buddha land of the ten directions, immeasurable Buddhas. Having reached the pure Buddhaland, still not becoming a Buddha? Achievement in one lifetime! In the world of Ultimate Bliss, there is no more cycle of life. No matter how long it takes, we can still attain Supreme Bodhi in the end!

(Sutra) At the time, we are loyal to all the heavenly emperors, to all our relatives, we are all the same to Tat Xa Gia Gia, Visiting his relatives, following the throne, he bowed to the Buddha, joined his palm, respectfully, and spoke to the Buddha: "World-Honored One! In the future world, after five hundred years, in the Buddhaland, the dharma of desires will be extinguished at the time, the only good one is the Kshatriya king, the only true good Brahman, the ten evil wheels, the ability to renounce oneself, the ability to encourage others, the spirit of renunciation, the good protection of others, the good protection of future generations, the protection of the Dharma, Introducing the Three Jewels, the spiritual element is prosperous, the essential words are not cut off, like the Buddha's teachings, like the three vehicles, the three vehicles are respectfully listened to, the three vehicles are not hidden, they protect, make offerings, do not disturb the mind, need to be protected, not harmed by the ego, the true good of the Kshatriya-king, the mother of the true Brahman, needs the support of the family. dharma, attains growth.”
(Sutra: At that time, in the great assembly, all the heavenly emperors and their relatives, up to the end All Siddhartha and his relatives stood up from their seats, bowed at the Buddha's feet, clasped their hands, respectfully, and said to the Buddha: "World-Honored One, in the next life, in the last five hundred years, in this Buddha-land, when the dharma is about to be destroyed, if there is a truly good Kshatriya king, even a truly good Brahman, etc. who can separate himself from those ten evil wheels, he can also advise others to stay away, and protect them well. Both oneself and others, skillfully maintain the Dharma, and continue the Three Jewels' nature, making them flourish and not be cut off. In short, as the Buddha taught, such people respectfully listen and accept them, do not hide them, protect them, and make offerings to them, without causing them to be disturbed or disturbed, and are more diligent in protecting them and not allowing them to be violated or harmed With the true goodness of the Kshatriya king and the true goodness of Brahmans, all of them diligently support them, causing those ten dharmas to all grow."

“Tat Xa Gia De” is the king of bloodsucking demons, Tat Xa Gia (Piśāca) is a type of demon. “Access to your relatives” (And your relatives): This is the Bodhisattva incarnate, do not consider them as demons. If they were [truly] demons, they would not be able to come to this dharma conference. That is the Bodhisattva appearing and appearing. Just like when we look at the Ksitigarbha Sutra, we see that there are many demon kings. Those demons are not ordinary people either. Isn't the demon king Chu Mang going to become a Buddha in the future? The Buddha predicted for him that in the next seventy lives he would become a Buddha. That is the manifestation of the great Bodhisattva. “Tung toa Nhi Khoi” (Standing up from the seat), is not one person, or two people. The gods of Thich and the heavenly emperors include many, and many of their relatives, the word “near chi” (until) in this passage expresses a simplified meaning, [connoting] there are also ghost kings belonging to the eight orders of ghosts and gods, there are also many “paying respects to the Buddha, joining hands, paying homage” (paying respects at the Buddha's feet, clasping hands, paying homage); It is a ritual to honor the Buddha.

“ Nhi spoke to the Buddha: - Venerable World-Honored One! In the future world, after five hundred years, in the Buddha land, the dharma of desire is cessation of time, the only good true being of the Kshat-de-benefit king, the only true good Brahman-level, the ten evil wheels, the power of self-disengagement, the ability to encourage others, the spirit of separation, good protection self-forgiveness, good protection of future generations, protection of the Dharma, introduction to the Three Jewels, prosperity of the spiritual order, non-existence of non-existence" (Speaking to the Buddha: "World-Honored One! In the future, in the last five hundred years, in this Buddha-land, when the dharma is about to be destroyed, if there is a truly good Kshatriya king, even a truly good Brahman, etc., he or she can separate themselves from those ten evil wheels, and can also advise others to stay away, and skillfully protect them." Maintaining both yourself and others, skillfully protecting the next life, protecting the Dharma, continuing the Three Jewels' nature will make them flourish, not be cut off"). This passage of scripture is said by everyone together, directed towards the Buddha and expressed. They say that in the Dharma-Ending Age, in the last five hundred years, the Buddha Dharma was about to be destroyed, those kings and Brahmins left the ten evil circles, and were able to advise others to leave, skillfully protecting themselves, skillfully protecting future generations, protecting the true Dharma, being able to continue the prosperity of the Three Jewels, all of them causing them to flourish, not being cut off. “The essential language is as taught by the Buddha” (In short, it is exactly as the Buddha taught): This passage of scripture is not a complete repetition of what the Buddha taught, “like the equal person, the three-vehicle dharma, respectfully listens and listens, is not hidden at all, the three-vehicle person, respectfully protects, does not disturb the mind” (such people regarding the three-vehicle dharma, respectfully listen and receive, are not hidden at all. For people of the three vehicle, protect and maintain offerings, not causing them to be disturbed or confused), “interference” is to disturb and cause harm.

“ U The Three Treasures need to be protected by the family, not to be harmed by spirits. I am a relative, the true good Kshatriya-king, the true good Brahman class, need the support of the family, the magical ten dharmas attain growth” (For the belongings of the Three Jewels, The more diligent we are to protect, not to be violated or harmed. We and our relatives will be more diligent in supporting the true good of the Kshatriya king and the true good Brahman, causing those ten dharmas to increase.) That is the guardian angel. We often talk about good gods protecting the dharma, how many good gods protecting the dharma are there? It's also an inconceivable amount. If you have good deeds, both sides of your body will have good gods protecting the dharma. You have received the Three Refuges and the Five Precepts, each of which has five good deities protecting the dharma. If you break one precept, you will lose five. The five precepts were broken, and the twenty-five good gods who protected the dharma were no longer there. Therefore, we must maintain the precepts and maintain the pure precepts. Each precept has five good deities protecting the dharma. If you break one precept, there will be no more. You can't see it either. If you have broken a precept, you will feel overwhelmed and very uncomfortable. That is because the good spirits have left and the evil spirits have come!

In the Buddhist scriptures, the Precepts Sutras say: At that time, in India, the Buddha allowed monks to eat meat, but garlic, chives, onions, palanquins, hung cu, or five huan (five vegetables with a strong odor) could not be eaten. Because after eating, at night when you sleep, ghost kings and evil spirits will come and eat, not by eating your flesh, but by inhaling the breath you exhale. They take in that breath, and then they are full, and your [aura] will match theirs. Therefore, the Buddha did not allow his disciples to eat five huan; Those things are called five huan. We often call eating meat five huan, that's not true, it's called Tinh (fishy). Tinh is not Huan, garlic, onions... are Huan. Next, talk about ten dharmas, causing all ten dharmas to increase. What are the ten dharmas?

(Sutra) One level and one level? One, increases life span. The second person, growing without misfortune. Tam false, disease-free growth. Four beings, increasing relatives. Five fakes, increase wealth. Green fake, growing private tools. Seven people, growing freely. Eight falsehoods, increasing reputation. Nine people, increase good friends. Ten practitioners, increase wisdom. Venerable World-Honored One! Weaknesses the true goodness of the Kshatriya-king, the great ambition of the true good Brahman, the ten evil wheels, the ability to self-separate, the ability to encourage others, the spirit of separation.
(Sutra: What is ten? One is the growth of life span. Two là tăng trưởng không nạn. Ba là tăng trưởng không bệnh. Bốn là tăng trưởng quyến thuộc. Năm là tăng trưởng của cải. Sáu là tăng trưởng vật dụng cần dùng. Bảy là tăng trưởng tự tại. Tám là tăng trưởng tiếng tăm. Chín là tăng trưởng bạn lành. Mười là tăng trưởng trí huệ. Đại đức Thế Tôn! Nếu chân thiện Sát-đế-lợi vương cho đến các chân thiện Bà-la-môn ấy, đối với mười ác có thể tự xa lìa, cũng có thể khuyên người khác khiến cho xa lìa, sẽ trọn đủ các merit as mentioned above. We will support that person to definitely achieve those ten dharmas of growth).

What is ten? One is to increase longevity, that is, longevity. Second, growth is accident-free, there are no accidents at all. Any accident that comes to you will turn dangerous into good. Sometimes in Taiwan, I had a car accident right in front of me; On the road, you can see it at any time. Car crash, I think only a few seconds difference. That person drives a little faster and will pass, or a little slower and will not collide. They weren't fast, they weren't slow, just in time to collide. That's called karma. That's the truth. You don't have that karma, your lifespan is long, you grow without misfortune, you grow without illness. We develop Bodhi mind, and our mind grows, good roots always grow, and karma will disappear at any time. Is your lifespan fixed? Still not fixed! If you do that (that is, do not practice the ten evil wheels), your lifespan will increase. A person's lifespan is originally sixty years old, but now we can increase it to one hundred years old. Such is “increase in lifespan, increase in accident-free growth, increase in illness-free growth, increase in relatives”. Not only will you yourself be well, but the people you live with will also be well. They want to be close to you, they want to follow you. As for “growth in wealth, growth in personal belongings, growth in freedom” (growth in wealth, growth in necessary items, growth in freedom), these things are not easy. Free growth is a very comfortable life, no worries, no worries, leisurely, leisurely, nothing disturbs you. Whatever you do, you feel free.

“Growth in reputation” (Growth in reputation), reputation is “name” in this sentence. Aren't current people greedy for fame? That name is not something you can ask for. If you do good things, good news will spread far and wide. Like the name of Śākyamuni Buddha, the ten methods of precepts are known to all Buddhas. Amitābha Buddha, all Buddha realms know. Not only in this world of ours do we want to recite Buddha's name and seek rebirth in the Pure Land. In the worlds of the ten directions, there are many people who recite Buddha's name and seek rebirth in the Pure Land, coming there to study. You should know, they came to the Pure Land to study. Sentient beings in the world of Ultimate Bliss want to go to Medicine Master Lapis la Light Tathagata, Immovable Tathagata, or to other places to study [very easily]. Because, the Bodhisattvas in the Pure Land and the masses in the Lien Tri Hai Hoi wake up early every morning, at breakfast time, they go to ten billion Buddha lands in the ten directions to make offerings, and then return, still not having breakfast. You can consult what that means?

“Grow good friends” (Grow good friends): Good people want to be close to you, bad people leave. That is “all methods are gathered together, objects are clustered” (similar methods are grouped together, all things are divided into separate categories depending on their characteristics), which implies that meaning. Finally, “increase in wisdom”, will increase Prajna wisdom. "Venerable World-Honored One! Weaknesses the true goodness of the Kshatriya-king, the true good Brahman-level, the ten evil wheels, the ability to self-separate, the ability to encourage others, the spirit of separation, the predecessors preached the merits and falsehood, the self-support" (Venerable World-Honored One! If the truly good Kshat-de-ri-kings, even those true-good Brahmans, could separate themselves from the ten evil wheels, but also can advise others to stay away, they will complete the merits as mentioned above, we will support). For the ten types mentioned above, we all support them, making them live long, up to increasing their wisdom, making them wise. “Determining to attain the ten dharmas of growth” (Definitely will attain those ten dharmas of growth): We protect that person, causing those ten dharmas to grow in him!

(Kinh) Phuc th, World-Honored One! If you have the true goodness of the Kshatriya king, you will attain the true goodness of the Brahmin level, and achieve the same as the previous theory of merit and virtue. The lower level of your family will be supported by the family, and the spirit of the ten dharma stages will be far away from you. Ha class vi ten? One person, far away from one's family and enemies. The second person, far away must not love sight, sound, smell, taste, or touch. Tam fake, stay away from all kinds of diseases. Four people, stay away from all evil attachments and evil views. The five people, far away from all evil delusions, take refuge. Green people, stay away from all evil and evil misfortunes. Seven people, stay away from necessarily evil careers. The eight falsehoods, far from all evil knowledge. Nine people, far from home, must stay at home. Ten people, if they are far away, they must be buried prematurely. Venerable World-Honored One! Weaknesses the true goodness of the King of the Kshatriyas, the true will of the Brahman level, becomes the basis for preaching all the merits and virtues, supports the ego, and tries to attain the ten dharmas of separation.
When good Brahmins achieve the merits as mentioned above, we will be more diligent in supporting them, making them stay away from the ten dharmas. One is to stay away from all resentment, robbers, and enemies. Second is to stay away from all unlovable "sights, sounds, smells, tastes, and touches". ác kiến. Năm là xa lìa hết thảy quy y tà vạy, hư vọng. Sáu là xa lìa hết thảy tà ác tai quái. Bảy là xa lìa hết thảy sự nghiệp tà ác. Tám là xa lìa hết thảy tri thức tà ác. Chín là xa lìa hết thảy bùn lầy tại gia. Mười là xa lìa hết thảy chết yểu chẳng đúng thời. Bạch đại đức Thế Tôn! Nếu chân thiện Sát-đế-lợi vương cho đến các chân thiện Bà-la-môn ấy thành tựu các We will support the merits as mentioned above and will definitely make them stay away from those ten dharmas.)

In addition to increasing the ten dharmas, there are also ten dharmas that will be separated. “Stay far away from all enemies and enemies” (Stay away from all enemies, bandits, enemies): Enemies and those who oppose you will all stay away, even the bandits like I just mentioned will also stay away. “Absolutely no love for sight, sound, taste, touch” (Stay away from all unlovable sights of “sight, sound, smell, taste, touch”): The sights of “sight, sound, scent, taste, touch” that you do not like will not appear, only the things you love will appear. “Non-love” means you don't like it. Unpleasant sights, sounds, smells, tastes, and touches do not represent money. Your eyes cannot see, your ears cannot hear, and your six senses are not involved. That is the protector of the Dharma to protect you.

“Three falsehoods, stay away from all obstacles and diseases” (Third is to stay away from all disasters, epidemics, and diseases): Infectious diseases are useless for you. No matter what disease is considered very dangerous, you don't need to be afraid. Haven't I told everyone before: Leprosy [causes the patient] to lose all their eyebrows, and the mind will gradually go crazy. After that, he bit his own finger and kept biting. In Tibet, if you encounter a patient of this type, you take them to the top of a high mountain, use rocks to build a house for them to live in, and when the family members give them food, they are all very far away and ask them to come get it themselves, until they die!

In Mainland China, there are also people with leprosy who are isolated from everyone. This disease is very dangerous. The French church specializes in collecting leprosy patients, the spirit of Catholicism is inconceivable! I highly praise them. The nurses and doctors, no one returned alive. If they go in there for a maximum of five years, a minimum of three years, or a little later, they will definitely get infected. They live there to treat patients and alleviate their suffering. When I was in prison, they arrested someone like that, sixty something years old. When we brought him in, we found out that he had leprosy, so he was immediately confined to a separate room, isolated from us. Someone needs to bring food to that person, but no one wants to go. I said: "It's okay if I go!" I do it very well, I don't need to work, I don't do anything. Every day, I give him rice, and at that time, I also feed him rice. Later, that person's whole body rots, ask if he or she is suffering or not? That person also did not know, shaking his head to show that he did not know, his whole body was already rotten. I came out of that room, no one else lived with me, I was in a separate cell.

Afterwards, many doctors examined me and said I was not infected. After that, they lived with me again. Indeed, I did not get sick after that. That disease did not spread to me, I had faith myself. But then why did I do that? I also hope to die. Dying that way is also very good, rotting and dying, eliminating disaster and avoiding disaster! But I can't die, basically to wait until now, when everyone and I can study together. There were many things that were unthinkable, because at that time the infectious disease was extremely fierce. But what karma is there? Wrong knowledge, evil views, we still have, we should not think that if we believe in Buddha, even a little wrong view will no longer exist! I see that everyone [has wrong views] either more or less. The more right view, the less wrong view, because right view overcomes wrong view. When we look at the problem and think about it, there are many things that are not correct or accurate; Thousands of times, don't be arrogant or complacent. We learn too little, know too little, and even though we know, we cannot do anything, we cannot change our own minds.

Greed, anger, ignorance, we all know are poisonous, who doesn't get angry? We are disciples of Buddha, those who do not believe in Buddha do not speak, is there anyone who does not have greed? Greed includes many things, even when we learn good dharma. For example, if we recite the Great Compassion Mantra seven times, seven times it doesn't work, so we recite it one hundred and eight times. Isn't that greed? But because it follows good mental factors, it cannot be classified as greed, but in a meaningful sense, it is. If you recite it once, sincerely, it will also be of immeasurable merit. One hundred and eight sessions of eliminating false thoughts is still not as good as one session. It has this meaning, which means you have to be sincere once and have true faith.

“Fourth, stay away from all evil attachments and evil views” (Fourth is to stay away from all attachments to evil and evil views): There is never a time when it is not good, there is no such thing. Hearing what others say, they don't accept it: "I learned this very well, but you guys can't learn anything at all!" Those things all belong to wrong views! The scriptures in this set of sutras teach: You listen to the Shravaka Vehicle dharma, if you blaspheme the Single Enlightenment Vehicle dharma, if you blaspheme the Mahayana dharma, it will be wrong view. Studying the Mahayana Dharma, if you reject the Shravaka Dharma or the Single Enlightenment Dharma, it will be a wrong view. Right and wrong in just one thought! Therefore, whenever we have the opportunity, we should repent a lot. We should not be stubborn about our own opinions, and we should not assume that what we see is right, it is not certain! You see it as yellow, others see it as white. Because you wear colored glasses, because you have so many false thoughts, so many distracting thoughts, so many inaccurate interpretations, how can you see accurately? Only by following Buddha's teachings can we prove whether it is correct or not! You should not be stubborn about your own opinion. Saying this is wrong knowledge, do not be afraid of wrong views. Because we recite Amitābha Buddha's right view. When you recite Amitābha Buddha, don't reject Medicine Buddha, because when you recite Amitābha Buddha, [see] others reciting the Medicine Buddha Sutra, [then protest]: "That's impossible! Why don't you recite Amitābha Buddha? I'm going to the West, you're going to the East, it can't work. That's out of order!" That is wrong knowledge, wrong view! You say: "I don't go anywhere, I'm from the Sa Ba world, why do I need to go to the Pure Land world, it's too difficult!" That's not right either, it's also wrong knowledge, wrong view. When you have not entered the position of Faith, it is very difficult to say that you have right knowledge and right view. After believing, is it completely true or not? Not yet! It is necessary to reach the First Pillar to not retreat; That's called Phat Tam Tru. Developing Bodhi mind again, developing Bodhi mind before does not count, that is not truly developing!

“To take refuge from all evil delusions” (To depart from all evil delusions to take refuge): This is even more common! After taking refuge in the Three Jewels, I still want to do hexagrams and still want to believe in God. After taking refuge in the Three Jewels, I still hope to live in this world for a hundred years, or a thousand years, learning Qigong to make my body a little better and to be able to cure diseases. It's not that we want to maintain a long life, we just want our body to be healthy. If we speak truly strictly, Buddha's disciples have received the Three Refuges and Five Precepts, requiring a lot. Furthermore, there are many disciples who want to receive the Bodhisattva Precepts. You have to learn them first. Do you have that much courage? Develop Bodhi mind. As soon as we escape the Bodhi mind, we will fall into hell. If we have committed a crime, we can repent! If you want to become a Buddha, that single thought has surpassed many lifetimes! Therefore, before receiving the Bodhisattva Precepts, you must study them first. Only when you understand clearly can you truly shoulder the burden. Only then can one receive precepts. The Three Refuges, the Five Precepts, and the Bodhisattva Precepts must be accepted. If you can bear them, you should also receive them. If you can't bear it, you have to endure it. Why? You can sow the seed to become a Buddha. If you commit a crime, immediately repent. How to repent? Dear Buddha, chanting Buddha's name can repent. Even chanting Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva can repent. The Contemplation Sutra also teaches the same, teaches to practice two types of Contemplation. "If you don't cultivate into the Realm of One True Realm, you can still recite my name!" That is, if you recite the name Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, you can also enter the practice of Contemplation.

Until “complete separation from evil knowledge” (away from all evil knowledge). Where does your evil knowledge come from? Taught by evil knowledge! If you leave them, there will be no more.

“ Absolute separation from stagnation at home” (Away from all the mud and mud at home): Consider the home as a mud pit. Actually, those gods are also in the mud. Heaven, man, Asura, and the six paths are all in the mud. If they were separated, then Brahma would have no mud. After that, he will also fall in the mud, without end, because he has not yet become a Buddha.

“Departing from all premature deaths at the wrong time” (Separation from all premature deaths at the wrong time): Death is premature, life span has not yet ended. When you read the Medicine Buddha Sutra, don't you see that there are nine types of sudden death (“death”)? Not worthy of death, meeting death at the wrong time, just like I just said: Taking one step earlier will not incur that karma, one step late will not incur that karma. Go a little faster and you'll pass, or a little slower and you won't hit it. Not fast, not slow, just in time to be hit by a car, something happened! “Yeu burial” (premature death) is very difficult to say. Babies in the mother's womb, not yet born, die. Fetal death also exists. As far as life expectancy is concerned, there is a death at any age. There are any types of death at the bone (“death”). In Hong Kong there are also many [cases of such bone-crushing deaths]. The person walking below, repairing above, falls a brick, or drops something, right on the head, that person dies immediately, how can it not be called "not worthy of death"? Know what to do? There are a lot of stories like that, it's called “premature burial”.

"Usually, the Mahayana diligently practices, is brave, steadfast, often achieves immeasurable, countless sentient beings' transformations, wisdom is unsurpassed, naturally skillful" (Usually for the Mahayana, diligently practices, is courageous, steadfast, often achieves immeasurable, countless sentient beings are enlightened without relying on anyone else, naturally or skillfully): That is the achievement of wisdom, [that wisdom] is not caused by other things, but by oneself. mind changes. The things that have been done, the mind does not forget): Achieving inconceivable wisdom, that is, strong memory, not abandoning sentient beings, liking to practice the Four Nieces, which is almsgiving, loving speech, beneficial actions, co-workers, [those are] the Four Laws of Niece. Use almsgiving, loving speech, beneficial actions, and cooperation, these four types to receive all sentient beings. “Never separate from the Dharma field of blessings” (Never separate from the field of blessings): Always never separate from the Dharma, always never separate from the Dharma Jewel. “Tadyathā”: What is Tadyathā? It is “that is, the mantra written” (immediately saying the mantra), the mantras in the sutras all have [this sentence]. It's not that the mantras are all very long, but Dat-diettha is "the theory of the written mantra", and also the beginning of saying the mantra. Every mantra has this sentence. After that sentence (the sentence “i.e. the theory of written notes”) is the real note, the previous sentences are not notes. As in the Shurangama mantra, there are many sentences that are not real mantras. The Great Compassion Mantra is the same, you must know that from the word “dada cess tha” onwards is the mantra. What are the previous sentences? The previous sentences are pre-expedient and also belong to the rituals and sadhanas of preaching sutras and preaching the Dharma. Therefore, how much is the Shurangama uncle? “Sitātapatrā)[86] is the Shurangama uncle. That's called “paying attention”[87]. There are also mantras that are shorter than Shurangama, and there are also very long mantras. Compared to the Datta-tha part here, it is even longer. Each mantra is like that.
